        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
        if d:IsA("Sound") then task.spawn(a655ArmSound, d) end
      end)
      for _, d in ipairs(kf:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Sound") then task.spawn(a655ArmSound, d) end
      end
    end
  end

  do
    local curKillerFolder = nil
    local b14SubConns = {}
    local function dropB14SubConns()
      disconnectConnArray(b14SubConns)
    end
    local function hookKiller(k)
      if k == curKillerFolder and k and k.Parent and k:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) then return end
      dropB14SubConns()
      curKillerFolder = k
      clearKillerSoundConns()
      if not (k and k.Parent and k:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService)) then
        a655ScanRound()
        return
      end
      if autoBlock then
        a655ScanRound()
        a655MountEar()
      end
      b14SubConns[#b14SubConns + 1] = k.ChildAdded:Connect(function(addedChild)
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not autoBlock then return end
        a655ScanRound()
        task.delay(0.2, function()
          if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and autoBlock and addedChild and addedChild.Parent then
            for _, d in ipairs(addedChild:GetDescendants()) do
              if d:IsA("Sound") then task.spawn(a655ArmSound, d) end
            end
          end
        end)
        task.delay(1, function()
          if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and autoBlock then a655ScanRound() end
        end)
      end)
      b14SubConns[#b14SubConns + 1] = k.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(removedChild)
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
        if #k:GetChildren() == 0 then
          clearKillerSoundConns()
        else
          for s, dropFn in pairs(killerSoundConns) do
            if not (s and s.Parent and s:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService)) or (removedChild and s:IsDescendantOf(removedChild)) then
              killerSoundConns[s] = nil
              if type(dropFn) == "function" then
                pcall(dropFn)
              else
                pcall(function() dropFn:Disconnect() end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if autoBlock then a655ScanRound() end
      end)
      b14SubConns[#b14SubConns + 1] = k.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent or not k:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) then
          if curKillerFolder == k then
            dropB14SubConns()
            curKillerFolder = nil
            clearKillerSoundConns()
            a655ScanRound()
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    local curPlayersFolder = nil
    local b14PfConns = {}
    local function dropB14PfConns()
      disconnectConnArray(b14PfConns)
    end
    local function bindPlayersFolder(pf)
      if pf == curPlayersFolder and pf and pf.Parent then return end
      dropB14PfConns()
      curPlayersFolder = pf
      if not (pf and pf.Parent) then return end
      local kf = pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      if kf then hookKiller(kf) end
      b14PfConns[#b14PfConns + 1] = pf.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
        if c.Name == "Killers" then
          hookKiller(c)
          task.delay(0.5, function()
            if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not autoBlock then return end
            local k2 = pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
            if k2 then
              a655ScanRound()
              a655MountEar()
            end
          end)
        end
      end)
      b14PfConns[#b14PfConns + 1] = pf.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
        if c == curKillerFolder or c.Name == "Killers" then
          hookKiller(pf:FindFirstChild("Killers"))
        end
      end)
    end
    local pf0 = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    if pf0 then bindPlayersFolder(pf0) end
    local wsConn = workspaceService.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
      if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
      if c.Name == "Players" then
        task.defer(bindPlayersFolder, c)
      end
    end)
    a655FolderConns[#a655FolderConns + 1] = {
      Disconnect = function()
        if wsConn then pcall(function() wsConn:Disconnect() end) wsConn = nil end
        dropB14PfConns()
        dropB14SubConns()
        curPlayersFolder = nil
        curKillerFolder = nil
      end,
    }
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(A655_SWING) do n += 1 end
    if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) then print("[NERG] m1-round ear: scoped to Killers (" .. n .. " M1 ids) · zero-leak · telemetry=ON") end
  end

  animEarConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  a742pSndTouch = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  a742pSndConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  a742pCharConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  do
    local animEarMounting = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

    local function unhookAnimSound(s)
      local c0 = a742pSndConns[s]
      if c0 then pcall(function() c0:Disconnect() end) a742pSndConns[s] = nil end
      a742pSndTouch[s] = nil
    end

    local function hookAnimSound(s)
      if s and s:IsA("Sound") and s.Parent and s:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) and not a742pSndConns[s] then
        a742pSndTouch[s] = 0
        local cId = s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
          a742pSndTouch[s] = os.clock()
        end)
        local cAnc
        cAnc = s.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
          if not parent or not s:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) then
            unhookAnimSound(s)
          end
        end)
        a742pSndConns[s] = {
          Disconnect = function()
            if cId then pcall(function() cId:Disconnect() end) cId = nil end
            if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
          end,
        }
      end
    end

    local function unmountAnimEar(k)
      local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
      local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      if k then
        animEarMounting[k] = nil
        pcall(function() k:SetAttribute("__A641_ANIM_EAR", nil) end)
        if animEarConns[k] then pcall(function() animEarConns[k]:Disconnect() end) animEarConns[k] = nil end
        if a742pCharConns[k] then pcall(function() a742pCharConns[k]:Disconnect() end) a742pCharConns[k] = nil end
      end
      pruneOrphanKillerConns(animEarConns, kf, animEarMounting)
      pruneOrphanKillerConns(a742pCharConns, kf, animEarMounting)
      for s in pairs(a742pSndConns) do
        if not (s and s.Parent and kf and s:IsDescendantOf(kf)) or (k and s:IsDescendantOf(k)) then
          unhookAnimSound(s)
        end
      end
    end

    local function mountAnimEar(k)
      if not autoBlock or not (k and k.Parent) or k:GetAttribute("__A641_ANIM_EAR") or animEarMounting[k] then return end
      animEarMounting[k] = true
      local hum = k:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or k:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
      local an = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5))
      if not animEarMounting[k] then return end
      animEarMounting[k] = nil
      local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
      local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      if not (autoBlock and hum and an and k.Parent and kf and k:IsDescendantOf(kf) and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
      if k:GetAttribute("__A641_ANIM_EAR") then return end
      if animEarConns[k] then pcall(function() animEarConns[k]:Disconnect() end) animEarConns[k] = nil end
      if a742pCharConns[k] then pcall(function() a742pCharConns[k]:Disconnect() end) a742pCharConns[k] = nil end
      k:SetAttribute("__A641_ANIM_EAR", true)
      animEarConns[k] = an.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(Track)
        if not a742oAnimM1 then return end
        local aid = Track and Track.Animation and tostring(Track.Animation.AnimationId):match("%d+")
        if aid and A742o_ANIM and A742o_ANIM[aid] and autoBlock then
          A663_LOG("ANIM-FIRE", aid, k.Name, "anim-m1")
          local nowL = os.clock()
          for s, t0 in pairs(a742pSndTouch) do
            if not s.Parent or not s:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) then
              unhookAnimSound(s)
            elseif t0 > 0 and nowL - t0 <= 0.6 and s:IsDescendantOf(k) and s.SoundId ~= "" then
              local sidL = tostring(s.SoundId):match("%d+")
              if sidL and A655_SWING and A655_SWING[sidL] ~= k.Name then
                A655_SWING[sidL] = k.Name
                A663_LOG("SOUND-LEARN", sidL, k.Name, "anim-pair")
              end
            end
          end
          dispatchKillerM1(k)
        end
      end)
      for _, d in ipairs(k:GetDescendants()) do hookAnimSound(d) end
      local cDesc = k.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
        if d:IsA("Sound") then
          task.defer(hookAnimSound, d)
        end
      end)
      local cAnc
      cAnc = k.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        local pfNow = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
        local kfNow = pfNow and pfNow:FindFirstChild("Killers")
        if not parent or not (kfNow and k:IsDescendantOf(kfNow)) then
          unmountAnimEar(k)
        end
      end)
      a742pCharConns[k] = {
        Disconnect = function()
          if cDesc then pcall(function() cDesc:Disconnect() end) cDesc = nil end
          if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
        end,
      }
    end

    local function f22()
      local curAnimKf = nil
      local animKfConns = {}
      local animPfConns = {}
      local curAnimPf = nil
      local function dropAnimKfConns()
        disconnectConnArray(animKfConns)
      end
      local function dropAnimPfConns()
        disconnectConnArray(animPfConns)
      end
      local function bindAnimKillers(killers3)
        if killers3 == curAnimKf and killers3 and killers3.Parent and killers3:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) then return end
        dropAnimKfConns()
        curAnimKf = killers3
        pcall(unmountAnimEar, nil)
        if not (killers3 and killers3.Parent and killers3:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService)) then return end
        if autoBlock then
          for _, k in ipairs(killers3:GetChildren()) do
            task.spawn(function() pcall(mountAnimEar, k) end)
          end
        end
        animKfConns[#animKfConns + 1] = killers3.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
          if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not autoBlock then return end
          task.wait(0.1)
          if autoBlock and child.Parent and child:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
            pcall(mountAnimEar, child)
          end
        end)
        animKfConns[#animKfConns + 1] = killers3.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
          pcall(unmountAnimEar, child)
        end)
        animKfConns[#animKfConns + 1] = killers3.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
          if not parent or not killers3:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) then
            if curAnimKf == killers3 then
              dropAnimKfConns()
              curAnimKf = nil
              pcall(unmountAnimEar, nil)
            end
          end
        end)
      end
      local function bindAnimPlayers(players2)
        if players2 == curAnimPf and players2 and players2.Parent then return end
        dropAnimPfConns()
        curAnimPf = players2
        if not (players2 and players2.Parent) then return end
        local k0 = players2:FindFirstChild("Killers")
        if k0 then bindAnimKillers(k0) end
        animPfConns[#animPfConns + 1] = players2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
          if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
          if c.Name == "Killers" then
            task.defer(bindAnimKillers, c)
          end
        end)
        animPfConns[#animPfConns + 1] = players2.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
          if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
          if c == curAnimKf or c.Name == "Killers" then
            bindAnimKillers(players2:FindFirstChild("Killers"))
          end
        end)
      end
      rawset(_G, "__NERG_SYNC_AB_EARS", function(on)
        if not on then
          if a655EarConn then pcall(function() a655EarConn:Disconnect() end) a655EarConn = nil end
          if clearKillerSoundConns then pcall(clearKillerSoundConns) end
          pcall(unmountAnimEar, nil)
        else
          if a655ScanRound then pcall(a655ScanRound) end
          if a655MountEar then pcall(a655MountEar) end
          local pfA = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
          local kfA = pfA and pfA:FindFirstChild("Killers")
          if kfA then
            for _, k in ipairs(kfA:GetChildren()) do
              task.spawn(function() pcall(mountAnimEar, k) end)
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      local pfNow = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
      if pfNow then bindAnimPlayers(pfNow) end
      local wsAnimConn = workspaceService.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
        if c.Name == "Players" then
          task.defer(bindAnimPlayers, c)
        end
      end)
      a655FolderConns[#a655FolderConns + 1] = {
        Disconnect = function()
          if wsAnimConn then pcall(function() wsAnimConn:Disconnect() end) wsAnimConn = nil end
          dropAnimPfConns()
          dropAnimKfConns()
          curAnimPf = nil
          curAnimKf = nil
        end,
      }
    end
    pcall(f22)
  end
end
-- A742p: AB detect "Hitbox OBB 0ms + Khung Viền Neon 3D" — toán học PointToObjectSpace + Frame-0 AntiSpin + Safe Config Reader
A742P_SIZES = { Noli = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), Slasher = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), c00lkidd = Vector3.new(5, 7, 7.5), ["1x1x1x1"] = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), JohnDoe = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), Sixer = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), Nosferatu = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), Azure = Vector3.new(5, 7, 8.5) }
A742P_ZOFF = { Noli = -1.7, Slasher = -2.1, c00lkidd = -1.2, ["1x1x1x1"] = -2, JohnDoe = -2.5, Sixer = 0, Nosferatu = -2, Azure = -2 }
local A742P_FALLBACK = Vector3.new(4.5, 6, 7.5)
local A742P_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 225)
local HB_NEON_CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255)
local HB_NEON_IDLE = Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255)
a742pLenScale = v2.get("a742pLenScale", 1)
a742pWidScale = v2.get("a742pWidScale", 1)
a742pZExpOn = v2.get("a742pZExpOn", false)
a742pZExpSens = v2.get("a742pZExpSens", 1)
a742pAntiSpinOn = v2.get("a742pAntiSpinOn", false)
a742pAntiSpinSens = v2.get("a742pAntiSpinSens", 1)
a742pPreviewOn = v2.get("a742pPreviewOn", false)
a742pShowWire = v2.get("a742pShowWire", false)
a742pPreviewGui, a742pPreviewConn, a742pPreviewDragConn, a742pSetPreview, a742pSyncLoop = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
a742pBoxes, a742pHeart = {}, nil
local a742pKinematics = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local a742pFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
a742pFolder.Name = "NergABBoxes"
a742pFolder.Parent = workspaceService
do
  local killerBoxSpecCache = {}
  local M1_SIZE_KEYS = { "SlashHitboxSize", "AttackHitboxSize", "M1HitboxSize", "PunchHitboxSize", "StabHitboxSize", "HitboxSize" }
  local function isSafeM1BoxSize(v)
    return typeof(v) == "Vector3"
      and v.X >= 3.5 and v.X <= 9.0
      and v.Y >= 4.0 and v.Y <= 10.0
      and v.Z >= 5.0 and v.Z <= 11.0
  end
  local function resolveKillerBoxSpec(kModel)
    local rawName = (kModel and kModel.Name) or ""
    local base = rawName:gsub("^[!#]", "")
    local cached = killerBoxSpecCache[base]
    if cached then
      return cached.size, cached.zoff, base
    end
    local size = A742P_SIZES[base] or A742P_FALLBACK
    local zoff = A742P_ZOFF[base] or -1.2
    pcall(function()
      local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      local killers = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      local kDir = killers and (killers:FindFirstChild(base) or killers:FindFirstChild(rawName))
      local cfgMod = kDir and kDir:FindFirstChild("Config")
      if cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local ok, cfg = pcall(require, cfgMod)
        if ok and type(cfg) == "table" then
          for _, key in ipairs(M1_SIZE_KEYS) do
            local cand = cfg[key]
            if isSafeM1BoxSize(cand) then
              size = cand
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    if base ~= "" then
      killerBoxSpecCache[base] = { size = size, zoff = zoff }
    end
    return size, zoff, base
  end

  local hbWirePool, hbWireUsed = {}, 0
  local function getHbWirePart(idx)
    local p = hbWirePool[idx]
    if not (p and p.Parent == a742pFolder) then
      p = Instance.new("Part")
      p.Name = "NergHBEdge"
      p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
      p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
      p.Parent = a742pFolder
      hbWirePool[idx] = p
    end
    return p
  end
  local function hideAllHbWires()
    for i = 1, hbWireUsed do
      local p = hbWirePool[i]
      if p then p.Transparency = 1 end
    end
    hbWireUsed = 0
  end
  local function placeHbWireEdge(a, b, color, trans, thick)
    local mag = (b - a).Magnitude
    hbWireUsed += 1
    local p = getHbWirePart(hbWireUsed)
    if mag < 0.02 then
      p.Transparency = 1
      return
    end
    p.Size = Vector3.new(thick, thick, mag)
    p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) * 0.5, b)
    p.Color = color
    p.Transparency = trans
  end
  local function drawNeonWireBox(centerCF, sizeVec, color, trans, thick)
    local hx, hy, hz = sizeVec.X * 0.5, sizeVec.Y * 0.5, sizeVec.Z * 0.5
    local th = thick or 0.11
    local c1 = centerCF * Vector3.new(-hx, -hy, -hz)
    local c2 = centerCF * Vector3.new( hx, -hy, -hz)
    local c3 = centerCF * Vector3.new( hx, -hy,  hz)
    local c4 = centerCF * Vector3.new(-hx, -hy,  hz)
    local c5 = centerCF * Vector3.new(-hx,  hy, -hz)
    local c6 = centerCF * Vector3.new( hx,  hy, -hz)
    local c7 = centerCF * Vector3.new( hx,  hy,  hz)
    local c8 = centerCF * Vector3.new(-hx,  hy,  hz)
    placeHbWireEdge(c1, c2, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c2, c3, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c3, c4, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c4, c1, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c5, c6, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c6, c7, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c7, c8, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c8, c5, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c1, c5, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c2, c6, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c3, c7, color, trans, th)
    placeHbWireEdge(c4, c8, color, trans, th)
  end

  local function evalBoxTouchOBB(boxCF, boxSize, myChar, myHrp)
    if not (myHrp and myChar) then return false end
    local halfX, halfY, halfZ = boxSize.X * 0.5, boxSize.Y * 0.5, boxSize.Z * 0.5
    local rel0 = boxCF:PointToObjectSpace(myHrp.Position)
    if math.abs(rel0.X) <= (halfX + 1.0) and math.abs(rel0.Y) <= (halfY + 1.5) and math.abs(rel0.Z) <= (halfZ + 0.65) then
      return true
    end
    for _, pp in ipairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
      if pp:IsA("BasePart") and pp ~= myHrp then
        local rel = boxCF:PointToObjectSpace(pp.Position)
        local sz = pp.Size
        local mX = math.min(sz.X * 0.5, 0.85)
        local mY = math.min(sz.Y * 0.5, 1.25)
        local mZ = math.min(sz.Z * 0.5, 0.85)
        if math.abs(rel.X) <= (halfX + mX) and math.abs(rel.Y) <= (halfY + mY) and math.abs(rel.Z) <= (halfZ + mZ) then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end

  local function stepKillerBoxGeometry(kb, h9, baseX, baseY, baseZ, zoff, nowT, myHrp)
    local look = h9.CFrame.LookVector
    local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
    flat = (flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    local baseW = (baseX or 5) * (a742pWidScale or 1)
    local baseL = (baseZ or 8) * (a742pLenScale or 1)

    local kPos = h9.Position
    local dx, dz, dist, toSurvX, toSurvZ = 0, 0, 0, flat.X, flat.Z
    if myHrp then
      dx = myHrp.Position.X - kPos.X
      dz = myHrp.Position.Z - kPos.Z
      dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
      if dist > 0.01 then
        toSurvX = dx / dist
        toSurvZ = dz / dist
      end
    end

    local kin = a742pKinematics[kb]
    if not kin then
      kin = {
        lastPX = kPos.X,
        lastPZ = kPos.Z,
        velBX = 0,
        velBZ = 0,
        lastLookX = flat.X,
        lastLookZ = flat.Z,
        lastDot = myHrp and (flat.X * toSurvX + flat.Z * toSurvZ) or nil,
        angSpd = 0,
        extraX = 0,
        peakX = 0,
        holdUntil = 0,
        extraZ = 0,
        lastSampleT = nowT,
      }
      a742pKinematics[kb] = kin
    end

    local sampleDt = nowT - (kin.lastSampleT or nowT)
    local dtSampled = nil
    if sampleDt >= 0.015 then
      local dt = math.clamp(sampleDt, 0.015, 0.12)
      dtSampled = dt
      kin.lastSampleT = nowT

      local vx = (kPos.X - (kin.lastPX or kPos.X)) / dt
      local vz = (kPos.Z - (kin.lastPZ or kPos.Z)) / dt
      if (vx * vx + vz * vz) <= 14400 then
        kin.velBX = (kin.velBX or 0) * 0.5 + vx * 0.5
        kin.velBZ = (kin.velBZ or 0) * 0.5 + vz * 0.5
      end
      kin.lastPX, kin.lastPZ = kPos.X, kPos.Z

      local lookDot = math.clamp(flat.X * (kin.lastLookX or flat.X) + flat.Z * (kin.lastLookZ or flat.Z), -1, 1)
      local rawAng = math.acos(lookDot) / dt
      if rawAng <= 25 then
        kin.angSpd = (kin.angSpd or 0) * 0.45 + rawAng * 0.55
      end
      kin.lastLookX, kin.lastLookZ = flat.X, flat.Z
      kin.lastDot = myHrp and (flat.X * toSurvX + flat.Z * toSurvZ) or nil
    end

    if a742pAntiSpinOn then
      local physAng = math.abs(h9.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y)
      local effAngSpd = math.max(kin.angSpd or 0, (physAng <= 25) and physAng or 0)
      local sensX = math.clamp(tonumber(a742pAntiSpinSens) or 1, 0.2, 2.5)
      local maxCapX = 5.2 * math.clamp(sensX, 0.5, 2.5)
      local candX = (effAngSpd >= 0.75) and math.clamp((effAngSpd - 0.75) * 1.35 * sensX, 0, maxCapX) or 0
      if candX >= (kin.extraX or 0) - 0.05 and candX > 0 then
        kin.extraX = candX
        kin.peakX = candX
        kin.holdUntil = nowT + 0.18
      elseif nowT <= (kin.holdUntil or 0) then
        kin.extraX = math.max(candX, kin.peakX or kin.extraX or 0)
      elseif dtSampled then
        local decayed = math.max(candX, (kin.extraX or 0) * math.exp(-4.2 * dtSampled))
        kin.extraX = (decayed >= 0.05) and decayed or 0
        kin.peakX = kin.extraX
      end
    else
      kin.extraX = 0
      kin.peakX = 0
      kin.holdUntil = 0
    end

    local extraZ = 0
    local kVel = h9.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local velAX, velAZ = kVel.X, kVel.Z
    if a742pZExpOn and myHrp then
      local velBX, velBZ = kin.velBX or 0, kin.velBZ or 0
      local kvx, kvz = velAX, velAZ
      if (velBX * velBX + velBZ * velBZ) > (velAX * velAX + velAZ * velAZ) then
        kvx, kvz = velBX, velBZ
      end
      local fwdSpd = kvx * flat.X + kvz * flat.Z
      local toSurvSpd = kvx * toSurvX + kvz * toSurvZ
      if fwdSpd < -1.5 or toSurvSpd < -1.5 then
        extraZ = math.clamp(math.min(fwdSpd, toSurvSpd) * 0.12 * (a742pZExpSens or 1), -2.2, 0)
      else
        local effSpd = math.min(fwdSpd, toSurvSpd)
        if effSpd > 1.5 then
          local sensZ = math.clamp(a742pZExpSens or 1, 0.2, 2.5)
          extraZ = math.clamp(effSpd * 0.14 * sensZ, 0, 4.2 * math.clamp(sensZ, 0.5, 2.0))
        end
      end
    end
    kin.extraZ = extraZ

    local extraX = a742pAntiSpinOn and (kin.extraX or 0) or 0
    local newX = math.max(2.0, baseW + extraX)
    local newZ = math.max(2.5, baseL + extraZ)
    local boxSize = Vector3.new(newX, baseY or 7, newZ)
    local pos = kPos + flat * ((zoff or -1.2) + 2 + (newZ - (baseZ or 8)) * 0.5)
    local boxCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + flat)
    local curDotNow = myHrp and (flat.X * toSurvX + flat.Z * toSurvZ) or nil
    local flatSpdNow = math.sqrt(velAX * velAX + velAZ * velAZ)
    return boxCF, boxSize, dist, curDotNow, flatSpdNow, extraZ, extraX
  end

  local function a742pEvalBoxNow(kb, bb, nowT, renderWire)
    local h9 = kb and kb:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not h9 then return end
    local myChar = localPlayer.Character
    local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local boxCF, boxSize, dist, curDot, flatSpd, extraZ, extraX =
      stepKillerBoxGeometry(kb, h9, bb.baseX, bb.baseY, bb.baseZ, bb.zoff, nowT, myHrp)
    bb.curX, bb.curZ = boxSize.X, boxSize.Z

    if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) and _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG then
      pcall(
        _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.boxStep,
        bb,
        myHrp and dist or nil,
        curDot,
        flatSpd,
        extraZ,
        extraX
      )
    end

    local activeEnd = bb.activeUntil or bb.untilT
    if nowT > activeEnd then
      if renderWire then
        local fadeAlpha = math.clamp((nowT - activeEnd) / math.max(0.05, (bb.untilT or activeEnd) - activeEnd), 0, 1)
        local wCol = bb.fired and VIS_GREEN or HB_NEON_CYAN
        drawNeonWireBox(boxCF, boxSize, wCol, 0.08 + 0.90 * fadeAlpha, 0.10)
      end
      return
    end

    local touches = evalBoxTouchOBB(boxCF, boxSize, myChar, myHrp)
    if touches and not bb.fired then
      bb.fired = true
      bb.firedAt = nowT
      A663_LOG("GEOM-FIRE", kb.Name, kb.Name, "hitbox")
      if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) and _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG then
        pcall(_G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.boxEnd, kb, bb, "FIRED")
      end
      task.spawn(f19, "swing", kb)
    end
    if renderWire then
      local wCol = (touches or bb.fired) and VIS_GREEN or HB_NEON_CYAN
      drawNeonWireBox(boxCF, boxSize, wCol, (touches or bb.fired) and 0.03 or 0.08, 0.12)
    end
  end

  local function a742pStepLoop()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not autoBlock or not a742pHitboxMode then
      hideAllHbWires()
      if a742pHeart then a742pHeart:Disconnect() a742pHeart = nil end
      return
    end
    hideAllHbWires()
    local now2 = os.clock()
    local hasActiveBox = false
    for kb, bb in pairs(a742pBoxes) do
      if not (kb and kb.Parent) or now2 > bb.untilT then
        if not bb.fired and v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) and _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG then
          pcall(_G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.boxEnd, kb, bb, "NOFIRE")
        end
        a742pBoxes[kb] = nil
      else
        hasActiveBox = true
        a742pEvalBoxNow(kb, bb, now2, true)
      end
    end

    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    if kf then
      local myChar = localPlayer.Character
      local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      for _, k in ipairs(kf:GetChildren()) do
        if not a742pBoxes[k] then
          local h9 = k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if h9 then
            if not a742pShowWire and myHrp and (h9.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude > 25 then
              a742pKinematics[k] = nil
            else
              local specSz, specZoff = resolveKillerBoxSpec(k)
              local boxCF, boxSize = stepKillerBoxGeometry(k, h9, specSz.X, specSz.Y, specSz.Z, specZoff, now2, myHrp)
              if a742pShowWire then
                local touchesIdle = evalBoxTouchOBB(boxCF, boxSize, myChar, myHrp)
                drawNeonWireBox(boxCF, boxSize, touchesIdle and VIS_GREEN or HB_NEON_IDLE, touchesIdle and 0.04 or 0.18, 0.11)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    if not hasActiveBox and not a742pShowWire and not a742pAntiSpinOn and not a742pZExpOn then
      if a742pHeart then
        a742pHeart:Disconnect()
        a742pHeart = nil
      end
    end
  end

  a742pSyncLoop = function()
    local want = __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and autoBlock and a742pHitboxMode
      and (next(a742pBoxes) ~= nil or a742pShowWire or a742pAntiSpinOn or a742pZExpOn)
    if want then
      if not a742pHeart then
        a742pHeart = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(a742pStepLoop)
      end
    else
      hideAllHbWires()
      if a742pHeart then
        a742pHeart:Disconnect()
        a742pHeart = nil
      end
    end
  end

  function a742pSpawnBox(k)
    if not (k and k.Parent) then return end
    local hrp = k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local a742pB, zoff, base = resolveKillerBoxSpec(k)
    local now = os.clock()
    local b = a742pBoxes[k]
    if b then
      if not b.fired and v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) and _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG then
        pcall(_G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.boxEnd, k, b, "NOFIRE")
      end
      b.baseX, b.baseY, b.baseZ = a742pB.X, a742pB.Y, a742pB.Z
      b.zoff = zoff
      b.activeUntil = now + 0.35
      b.untilT = now + 0.52
      b.minDist, b.maxExtraZ, b.maxExtraX, b.minDot, b.lastSpd = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
      if b.firedAt and now - b.firedAt >= 0.5 then b.fired, b.firedAt = nil, nil end
      a742pEvalBoxNow(k, b, now, false)
      a742pSyncLoop()
      return
    end
    local newBox = {
      activeUntil = now + 0.35,
      untilT = now + 0.52,
      zoff = zoff,
      baseX = a742pB.X,
      baseY = a742pB.Y,
      baseZ = a742pB.Z,
      curX = a742pB.X * (a742pWidScale or 1),
      curZ = a742pB.Z * (a742pLenScale or 1),
      fired = nil,
      firedAt = nil,
    }
    a742pBoxes[k] = newBox
    A663_LOG("GEOM-BOX", base, k.Name, "hitbox")
    a742pEvalBoxNow(k, newBox, now, false)
    a742pSyncLoop()
  end

  function a742pClearBoxes()
    a742pBoxes = {}
    table.clear(a742pKinematics)
    hideAllHbWires()
    if a742pHeart then a742pHeart:Disconnect() a742pHeart = nil end
    if a742pFolder and a742pFolder.Parent then
      for _, c in ipairs(a742pFolder:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(hbWirePool)
  end

  local function isMainMenuOpen()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return false end
    if windUI and windUI.Unloaded then return false end
    return oceanUI.visible(a742pPreviewGui)
  end

  local abPrevRefs = nil
  local function placePreviewBeam(part, a, b, col, trans)
    local mag = (b - a).Magnitude
    if mag < 0.05 then part.Transparency = 1 return end
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, mag)
    part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) * 0.5, b)
    part.Color = col
    part.Transparency = trans
  end

  local function stepAbPreviewVisual(refs, t, doTxt)
    if not refs then return end
    local baseW = 5 * (a742pWidScale or 1)
    local baseL = 8 * (a742pLenScale or 1)
    local extraZ, zShift = 0, 0
    if a742pZExpOn and t > 0 then
      local simSpd = 26 * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 2.6))
      local sensZ = math.clamp(a742pZExpSens or 1, 0.2, 2.5)
      extraZ = math.clamp(simSpd * 0.14 * sensZ, 0, 4.2 * math.clamp(sensZ, 0.5, 2.0))
      zShift = -math.sin(t * 2.6) * 0.65
    end
    local extraX, yawFlick = 0, 0
    if a742pAntiSpinOn and t > 0 then
      yawFlick = math.sin(t * 5.2) * 0.55
      local simAngSpd = 0.85 + math.abs(math.cos(t * 5.2)) * 4.5
      local sensX = math.clamp(tonumber(a742pAntiSpinSens) or 1, 0.2, 2.5)
      local maxCapX = 5.2 * math.clamp(sensX, 0.5, 2.5)
      extraX = math.clamp((simAngSpd - 0.75) * 1.35 * sensX, 0, maxCapX)
    end
    local newX = math.max(2.0, baseW + extraX)
    local newZ = math.max(2.5, baseL + extraZ)
    local baseZPos = a742pHitboxMode and (4.2 + zShift) or 0.0
    local rigRootPos = Vector3.new(0, 3.0, baseZPos)
    local rigCF = CFrame.new(rigRootPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yawFlick, 0)
    local lookFlat = rigCF.LookVector
    local swing = (t > 0) and (math.sin(t * 9) * 0.65) or 0

    refs.torso.CFrame = rigCF
    refs.head.CFrame = rigCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0)
    refs.lArm.CFrame = rigCF * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    refs.rArm.CFrame = rigCF * CFrame.new(1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    refs.lLeg.CFrame = rigCF * CFrame.new(-0.5, -1.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.0, 0)
    refs.rLeg.CFrame = rigCF * CFrame.new(0.5, -1.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.0, 0)

    if a742pHitboxMode then
      if refs.vpCam then
        refs.vpCam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(11.5, 9.8, -8.5), Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0.2))
      end
      refs.coneWingL.Transparency = 1
      refs.coneWingR.Transparency = 1
      for i = 1, #refs.coneArcs do refs.coneArcs[i].Transparency = 1 end
      local zoff = -2.0
      local basePos = rigRootPos + lookFlat * (zoff + 2 + (baseL - 8) / 2)
      local baseCF = CFrame.lookAt(basePos, basePos + lookFlat)
      local baseSz = Vector3.new(baseW, 7, baseL)
      refs.baseBox.Size = baseSz
      refs.baseBox.CFrame = baseCF
      refs.baseBox.Transparency = 0.88
      local wireCF, wireSz, wireCol = baseCF, baseSz, HB_NEON_CYAN
      if extraZ > 0.02 or extraX > 0.02 then
        local dynPos = rigRootPos + lookFlat * (zoff + 2 + (newZ - 8) / 2)
        local dynCF = CFrame.lookAt(dynPos, dynPos + lookFlat)
        local dynSz = Vector3.new(newX, 6.8, newZ)
        refs.dynBox.Size = dynSz
        refs.dynBox.CFrame = dynCF
        refs.dynBox.Transparency = 0.86
        wireCF, wireSz, wireCol = dynCF, dynSz, VIS_GREEN
      else
        refs.dynBox.Transparency = 1
      end
      if refs.coneRing and #refs.coneRing >= 12 then
        local hx, hy, hz = wireSz.X * 0.5, wireSz.Y * 0.5, wireSz.Z * 0.5
        local c1 = wireCF * Vector3.new(-hx, -hy, -hz)
        local c2 = wireCF * Vector3.new( hx, -hy, -hz)
        local c3 = wireCF * Vector3.new( hx, -hy,  hz)
        local c4 = wireCF * Vector3.new(-hx, -hy,  hz)
        local c5 = wireCF * Vector3.new(-hx,  hy, -hz)
        local c6 = wireCF * Vector3.new( hx,  hy, -hz)
        local c7 = wireCF * Vector3.new( hx,  hy,  hz)
        local c8 = wireCF * Vector3.new(-hx,  hy,  hz)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[1], c1, c2, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[2], c2, c3, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[3], c3, c4, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[4], c4, c1, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[5], c5, c6, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[6], c6, c7, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[7], c7, c8, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[8], c8, c5, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[9], c1, c5, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[10], c2, c6, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[11], c3, c7, wireCol, 0.05)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[12], c4, c8, wireCol, 0.05)
        for i = 13, #refs.coneRing do refs.coneRing[i].Transparency = 1 end
      end
      if doTxt then
        refs.hdr.Text = a742pPreviewOn and "HITBOX 3D PREVIEW (LIVE)" or "HITBOX 3D PREVIEW (STATIC)"
        refs.infoLbl1.Text = string.format("Base: %.1fW x %.1fL | Live: %.1fW x %.1fL", baseW, baseL, newX, newZ)
        refs.infoLbl2.Text = string.format("+Z (Speed): +%.2fst | +X (Spin): +%.2fst", extraZ, extraX)
      end
    else
      refs.baseBox.Transparency = 1
      refs.dynBox.Transparency = 1
      local coneR = math.clamp(tonumber(visionRange) or 13.5, 2.0, 25.0)
      local ringR = math.max(tonumber(circleRange) or 18.0, coneR + 1.0)
      local halfAng = math.rad(math.clamp(visionAngle or 85, 15, 200) * 0.5)
      local maxR = v8 and ringR or coneR
      local camDist = math.clamp(maxR * 1.15 + 4.0, 12.0, 38.0)
      if refs.vpCam then
        refs.vpCam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(camDist * 0.62, camDist * 0.74, -camDist * 0.58), Vector3.new(0, 1.0, -coneR * 0.15))
      end
      local yPlane = 0.22
      local centerRing = Vector3.new(rigRootPos.X, yPlane, rigRootPos.Z)
      if refs.coneRing then
        local rN = #refs.coneRing
        if v8 then
          for i = 1, rN do
            local a0 = ((i - 1) / rN) * math.pi * 2
            local a1 = (i / rN) * math.pi * 2
            local p0 = centerRing + Vector3.new(math.cos(a0) * ringR, 0, math.sin(a0) * ringR)
            local p1 = centerRing + Vector3.new(math.cos(a1) * ringR, 0, math.sin(a1) * ringR)
            placePreviewBeam(refs.coneRing[i], p0, p1, VIS_PURPLE, 0.22)
          end
        else
          for i = 1, rN do refs.coneRing[i].Transparency = 1 end
        end
      end
      local apex = Vector3.new(rigRootPos.X, yPlane + 0.04, rigRootPos.Z)
      local segN = #refs.coneArcs
      if default then
        local wL = apex + visRotY(lookFlat, halfAng) * coneR
        local wR = apex + visRotY(lookFlat, -halfAng) * coneR
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneWingL, apex, wL, VIS_GREEN, 0.08)
        placePreviewBeam(refs.coneWingR, apex, wR, VIS_GREEN, 0.08)
        for i = 1, segN do
          local a0 = -halfAng + (2 * halfAng) * ((i - 1) / segN)
          local a1 = -halfAng + (2 * halfAng) * (i / segN)
          placePreviewBeam(refs.coneArcs[i], apex + visRotY(lookFlat, a0) * coneR, apex + visRotY(lookFlat, a1) * coneR, VIS_GREEN, 0.08)
        end
      else
        refs.coneWingL.Transparency = 1
        refs.coneWingR.Transparency = 1
        for i = 1, segN do refs.coneArcs[i].Transparency = 1 end
      end
      if doTxt then
        refs.hdr.Text = a742pPreviewOn and "VISION CONE 3D PREVIEW (LIVE)" or "VISION CONE 3D PREVIEW (STATIC)"
        refs.infoLbl1.Text = string.format("Circle: %.1fst | Cone: %.1fst (%d deg)", ringR, coneR, math.floor((visionAngle or 85) + 0.5))
        refs.infoLbl2.Text = string.format("Cone Vis: %s | Circle Vis: %s | 0.30s Gate: ON", default and "ON" or "OFF", v8 and "ON" or "OFF")
      end
    end
  end

      p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
      p.Size, p.Color, p.Material, p.Transparency = sz, col, mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, trans or 0
      p.Parent = wm
      return p

    floorPart.Color = oceanUI.tint(floorPart, "Color", 9)
    floorPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0)
    local head = makeVpPart("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 248), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
    local torso = makeVpPart("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), oceanUI.colors[1], Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
    torso.Color = oceanUI.tint(torso, "Color", 1)
    local lArm = makeVpPart("LeftArm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Color3.fromRGB(185, 195, 210), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
    local rArm = makeVpPart("RightArm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Color3.fromRGB(185, 195, 210), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
    local lLeg = makeVpPart("LeftLeg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Color3.fromRGB(130, 145, 165), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
    local rLeg = makeVpPart("RightLeg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Color3.fromRGB(130, 145, 165), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)

    local baseBox = makeVpPart("BaseHitbox", Vector3.new(5, 7, 8), A742P_COLOR, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0.776)
    local dynBox = makeVpPart("DynHitbox", Vector3.new(5, 6.8, 8), oceanUI.colors[1], Enum.Material.Neon, 0.594)
    dynBox.Color = oceanUI.tint(dynBox, "Color", 1)
    local coneWingL = makeVpPart("ConeWingL", Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 6), VIS_GREEN, Enum.Material.Neon, 1)
    local coneWingR = makeVpPart("ConeWingR", Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 6), VIS_GREEN, Enum.Material.Neon, 1)

					elseif k == "Outline" then

					elseif k == "Font" or k == "FontFace" or k == "TextScaled" or k == "ZIndex" or k == "Name" or k == "RichText" then
						pcall(function() tl[k] = v end)
					else
						bag[k] = v
					end
				end,

	fn16 = function(arg)
		if not assets then
			return nil
		end
		local v3 = assets

		for _, v4 in ipairs(arg) do
			if v3:FindFirstChild(v4) then
				v3 = v3[v4]
				continue
			end
			return nil
		end

		if v3:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, result = pcall(require, v3)
			if ok and type(result) == "table" then
				return result
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function fn18(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if not arg then
			return {}
		end
		local tbl15

		if type(arg2) == "string" then
			tbl15 = { arg2 }
		else
			tbl15 = arg2
		end

		local tbl16 = {}

		local function fn19(arg4)
			if type(arg4) == "string" or type(arg4) == "number" then
				return string.match(tostring(arg4), "%d+")
			end
			return nil
		end

		if arg3 and arg[arg3] then
			local v3 = fn19(arg[arg3])

			if v3 then
				table.insert(tbl16, v3)
			end
		end

		if tbl15 then
			for _, v3 in ipairs(tbl15) do
				if arg[v3] then
					local v4 = fn19(arg[v3])

					if v4 then
						table.insert(tbl16, v4)
					end
				end

				local v4 = string.split(v3, ".")
				local v5 = arg

				for _, v6 in ipairs(v4) do
					if type(v5) == "table" then
						v5 = v5[v6]
					else
						v5 = nil
						break
					end
				end

				local v6 = fn19(v5)

				if v6 then
					table.insert(tbl16, v6)
				end

				if #v4 > 1 then
					local v7 = v4[#v4]

					if arg[v7] then
						local v8 = fn19(arg[v7])

						if v8 then
							table.insert(tbl16, v8)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if #tbl16 == 0 then
			local fn20 = nil

			fn20 = function(arg4)
				for k, v3 in pairs(arg4) do
					if type(v3) == "table" then
						fn20(v3)
					else
						local v4 = fn19(v3)

						if v4 then
							local str2 = tostring(k):lower()
							local pos = arg3 and str2:find(arg3:lower(), 1, true)
							local flag2 = false

							if pos then
								flag2 = true
							end

							if tbl15 then
								for _, v5 in ipairs(tbl15) do
									if str2:find(v5:lower(), 1, true) or v5:lower():find(str2, 1, true) then
										flag2 = true
										break
									end
								end
							end

							if flag2 then
								table.insert(tbl16, v4)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			pcall(fn20, arg)
		end

		return tbl16
	end

	local abilityCatalogCache = {}
	local function cloneAbilityCatalog(src)
		local out = {}
		for k, ab in pairs(src) do
			out[k] = table.clone(ab)
		end
		return out
	end

	local function fn19(arg)
		local attribute = arg:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or arg.Name
		local attribute2 = arg:GetAttribute("SkinName") or ""
		local str2 = arg.Parent and arg.Parent.Name == "Killers" and "Killers" or "Survivors"
		local cacheKey = str2 .. ":" .. tostring(attribute) .. ":" .. tostring(attribute2)
		local cached = abilityCatalogCache[cacheKey]
		if cached then
			return cloneAbilityCatalog(cached)
		end
		local v3 = fn16({ str2, attribute, "Config" })
		local v4 = fn16({ str2, attribute, "Behavior" })
		local flag2 = attribute2 ~= "" and fn16({ "Skins", str2, attribute, attribute2, "Config" }) or nil
		local tbl15 = {}

		if v4 and v4.Abilities then
			local v5 = tbl12[attribute]

			if v5 then
				for i, v6 in ipairs(v5) do
					local name = v6.Name
					local v7 = v4.Abilities[name]

					if v7 then
						local icon = v7.Icon or ""

						if name == "Broadcast" and attribute == "Veeronica" then
							icon = tbl13[1]
						end

						local tbl16 = {}
						local cooldown

						if typeof(v7.Cooldown) == "number" then
							cooldown = v7.Cooldown
						elseif v6.CooldownKey and v3 then
							cooldown = v3[v6.CooldownKey]
						else
							cooldown = nil

							if v3 then
								cooldown = v3[name .. "Cooldown"]
							end
						end

						if v6.Anim then
							local anim = v6.Anim

							if flag2 and flag2.Animations then
								tbl16 = fn18(flag2.Animations, anim, name)
							end

							if #tbl16 == 0 and v3 and v3.Animations then
								tbl16 = fn18(v3.Animations, anim, name)
							end
						end

						local activeCondition

						if attribute == "Slasher" and name == "RagingPace" then
							activeCondition = "IsEnraged"
						elseif attribute == "Veeronica" and name == "Sk8" then
							activeCondition = "IsSkating"
						elseif attribute == "Noob" and tbl14[name] then
							activeCondition = name .. "Active"
						else
							local flag3 = attribute == "TwoTime" and name == "Crouch"
							activeCondition = nil

							if flag3 then
								activeCondition = "IsCrouching"
							end
						end

						if #tbl16 > 0 or v6.CustomTrigger then
							local tbl17 = { AnimIds = tbl16 }
							cooldown = cooldown or 0
							tbl17.Cooldown = cooldown
							tbl17.Icon = icon
							tbl17.AlwaysShow = v6.AlwaysShow or false
							tbl17.CycleIcons = v6.CycleIcons or false
							tbl17.CustomTrigger = v6.CustomTrigger
							tbl17.LayoutOrder = i
							tbl17.ActiveCondition = activeCondition
							tbl15[name] = tbl17
						end
					end
				end
			else
				local n5 = 0

				for k, ability in pairs(v4.Abilities) do
					n5 += 1
					local layoutOrder = ability.LayoutOrder or n5
					local icon = ability.Icon or ""
					local cooldown = typeof(ability.Cooldown) == "number" and ability.Cooldown or v3 and v3[k .. "Cooldown"] or 0
					local tbl16 = {}

					if flag2 and flag2.Animations then
						tbl16 = fn18(flag2.Animations, nil, k)
					end

					if #tbl16 == 0 and v3 and v3.Animations then
						tbl16 = fn18(v3.Animations, nil, k)
					end

					if #tbl16 > 0 then
						tbl15[k] = {
							AnimIds = tbl16,
							Cooldown = cooldown,
							Icon = icon,
							AlwaysShow = false,
							CycleIcons = false,
							LayoutOrder = layoutOrder,
							ActiveCondition = nil,
						}
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if next(tbl15) == nil and v3 and v3.Animations then
			local n5 = 0

			for k in pairs(v3.Animations) do
				local v5 = v3[k .. "Cooldown"]

				if v5 then
					local tbl16 = {}

					if flag2 and flag2.Animations then
						tbl16 = fn18(flag2.Animations, nil, k)
					end

					if #tbl16 == 0 then
						tbl16 = fn18(v3.Animations, nil, k)
					end

					if #tbl16 > 0 then
						n5 += 1

						tbl15[k] = {
							AnimIds = tbl16,
							Cooldown = v5,
							Icon = "",
							AlwaysShow = false,
							CycleIcons = false,
							LayoutOrder = n5,
							ActiveCondition = nil,
						}
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if next(tbl15) ~= nil then
			abilityCatalogCache[cacheKey] = cloneAbilityCatalog(tbl15)
		end

		return tbl15
	end

	local function extractFirstAnimId(val, depth)
		if (depth or 0) > 3 or val == nil then return nil end
		if typeof(val) == "Instance" and val:IsA("Animation") then
			return string.match(tostring(val.AnimationId), "%d+")
		elseif type(val) == "string" or type(val) == "number" then
			return string.match(tostring(val), "%d+")
		elseif type(val) == "table" then
			for _, subv in pairs(val) do
				local id = extractFirstAnimId(subv, (depth or 0) + 1)
				if id then return id end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local animObjMeta = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function getAnimMeta(anim)
		if not anim then return nil end
		local m = animObjMeta[anim]
		local aid = anim.AnimationId
		if m and m.raw == aid then
			return m
		end
		local s = tostring(aid or "")
		local nm = anim.Name and anim.Name:lower() or ""
		m = {
			raw = aid,
			id = string.match(s, "%d+"),
			isRun = (nm == "run" or nm == "sprint" or nm == "injuredrun" or nm == "golemrun"),
			isGolem = (s:lower():find("golem", 1, true) ~= nil),
		}
		animObjMeta[anim] = m
		return m
	end

	local function fn20(arg, arg2)
		if arg2 then
			if arg2._hasGolemStep or arg2._hasGolemTrack then
				return true
			end
			if arg2._tracksAt ~= nil then
				return false
			end
		elseif arg:GetAttribute("FootstepOverride") == "GolemFootsteps" then
			return true
		end

		local tracks = (arg2 and arg2._frameTracks) or (arg2 and arg2.AbilityState and arg2.AbilityState.Animator and arg2.AbilityState.Animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks())
		if tracks then
			for _, v3 in ipairs(tracks) do
				local m = getAnimMeta(v3.Animation)
				if m and m.isGolem then
					return true
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn21(arg, arg2)
		if fn20(arg, arg2) then
			return { MaxStamina = 50, StaminaGain = 20, StaminaLoss = 10, MinStamina = 0, PenaltyTime = 2, SprintSpeed = 26 }
		end
		local str2 = arg.Parent and arg.Parent.Name == "Survivors" and "Survivors" or "Killers"
		local rawName = tostring(arg:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or arg:GetAttribute("ActorDisplayName") or arg.Name)
		local name = rawName:gsub("^[!#]", "")
		if str2 == "Survivors" then
			return tbl10
		end
		local spec = SPECIAL_KILLER_STAMINA[rawName] or SPECIAL_KILLER_STAMINA[arg.Name] or SPECIAL_KILLER_STAMINA[name]
		if spec then
			return {
				MaxStamina = spec.MaxStamina,
				StaminaGain = spec.StaminaGain,
				StaminaLoss = spec.StaminaLoss,
				MinStamina = spec.MinStamina or 0,
				PenaltyTime = spec.PenaltyTime or 2,
				SprintSpeed = spec.SprintSpeed or 27,
			}
		end
		local v3 = fn16({ "Killers", name, "Config" }) or fn16({ "Killers", arg.Name, "Config" })

		if v3 then
			if v3.MaxStamina == 50 then
				return { MaxStamina = 50, StaminaGain = 20, StaminaLoss = 10, MinStamina = 0, PenaltyTime = 2, SprintSpeed = 26 }
			end
			return {
				MaxStamina = v3.MaxStamina or 110,
				StaminaGain = v3.StaminaGain or 21,
				StaminaLoss = v3.StaminaLoss or 9.5,
				MinStamina = v3.MinStamina or 0,
				PenaltyTime = 2,
				SprintSpeed = v3.SprintSpeed or 27,
			}
		end

		return { MaxStamina = 110, StaminaGain = 21, StaminaLoss = 9.5, MinStamina = 0, PenaltyTime = 2, SprintSpeed = 27 }
	end

	local function fn22(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local str2 = arg.Parent and arg.Parent.Name == "Survivors" and "Survivors" or "Killers"

			local idS = v3 and v3.Animations and extractFirstAnimId(v3.Animations[str3], 0)

	local function fn23(arg, arg2, cachedTracks, allowRunName)
		if not arg and not cachedTracks then
			return false
		end

		local tracks = cachedTracks or arg:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
		for _, v3 in ipairs(tracks) do
			if v3.WeightCurrent > 0.35 then
				local m = getAnimMeta(v3.Animation)
				if m then
					if arg2 and m.id == arg2 then
						return true
					end
					if allowRunName and m.isRun then
						return true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn24(arg)
		if arg and arg.MaxHealth > 0 then
			return arg.Health / arg.MaxHealth
		end
		return 1
	end

	local function fn25(arg)
		local myCh = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
		if myCh and myCh.Parent and myCh.Parent.Name == "Survivors" then
			local myHrp = myCh:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local myHum = myCh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if myHrp and (not myHum or myHum.Health > 0) and (myHrp.Position - arg).Magnitude < n4 then
				return true
			end
		end
		if next(tbl8) ~= nil then
			for k, v3 in pairs(tbl8) do
				if v3.Type == "Survivor" and k.Parent and (not v3.Hum or v3.Hum.Health > 0) then
					local sPos = v3.LastPosition
					if not sPos then
						local sHrp = (v3._hrp and v3._hrp.Parent == k and v3._hrp) or k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						sPos = sHrp and sHrp.Position
					end
					if sPos and (sPos - arg).Magnitude < n4 then
						return true
					end
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		local pf = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
		local sf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
		if sf then
			for _, surv in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
				if surv:IsA("Model") then
					local sHrp = surv:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local sHum = surv:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if sHrp and (not sHum or sHum.Health > 0) and (sHrp.Position - arg).Magnitude < n4 then
						return true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function isLocalPlayChar(ch)
		if not ch or not localPlayer then return false end
		if ch == localPlayer.Character then return true end
		local myName = localPlayer.Name
		if ch.Name == myName or ch:GetAttribute("Username") == myName then return true end
		local okP, plr = pcall(function() return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ch) end)
		if okP and plr == localPlayer then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function parseHasteVal(v)
		if v == true then return 1.25 end
		local n = tonumber(v)
		if not n or n <= 0 then return nil end
		if n > 1.0 and n <= 2.5 and n ~= 2 then
			return n
		elseif n >= 1 and n <= 5 then
			return 1 + 0.2 * n
		elseif n > 0 and n < 1.0 then
			return 1 + n
		end
		return 1.25
	end

	local function getHasteCooldownRate(char, st)
		local nowH = os.clock()
		if st and st._cdRate and nowH - (st._hasteAt or 0) < 0.15 then
			return st._cdRate
		end
		local rate = 1.0
		if char and char.Parent then
			local aH = parseHasteVal(char:GetAttribute("Haste") or char:GetAttribute("HasteLevel") or char:GetAttribute("AbilityHaste") or char:GetAttribute("CooldownMultiplier"))
			if aH and aH > rate then rate = aH end
			for _, fName in ipairs({ "StatusEffects", "Effects", "Buffs", "SpeedMultipliers" }) do
				local folder = char:FindFirstChild(fName)
				if folder then
					for _, ch in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
						if ch.Name == "Haste" or ch.Name:find("Haste") then
							local val = ch:GetAttribute("Level") or ch:GetAttribute("Tier") or ch:GetAttribute("Value") or (ch:IsA("ValueBase") and ch.Value) or true
							local r = parseHasteVal(val)
							if r and r > rate then rate = r end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local directHaste = char:FindFirstChild("Haste")
			if directHaste then
				local val = directHaste:GetAttribute("Level") or directHaste:GetAttribute("Tier") or (directHaste:IsA("ValueBase") and directHaste.Value) or true
				local r = parseHasteVal(val)
				if r and r > rate then rate = r end
			end
		end
		if st then
			st._cdRate = rate
			st._hasteAt = nowH
		end
		return rate
	end

	local function fn29(arg, arg2)
		if not arg2.Animation or not arg2.Animation.AnimationId then
			return
		end
		local v3 = string.match(tostring(arg2.Animation.AnimationId), "%d+")
		if not v3 then
			return
		end

		local nowCast = os.clock()
		arg.LastCastAt = arg.LastCastAt or {}
		for k, ability in pairs(arg.Abilities) do
			if ability.AnimIds and #ability.AnimIds > 0 and fn26(ability, v3) then
				local lastAt = arg.LastCastAt[k] or 0
				if not arg.Timers[k] or arg.Timers[k] <= 0 or (nowCast - lastAt >= 0.8) then
					arg.Timers[k] = ability.Cooldown
					arg.LastCastAt[k] = nowCast

					if ability.CycleIcons then
						fn27(arg)
					end

					local playerStateRef = arg.PlayerStateRef

					if playerStateRef and playerStateRef.NoobEffects and ability.ActiveCondition and tbl14[k] then
						local v4 = tbl14[k]
						playerStateRef.NoobEffects[k] = tick() + v4
						playerStateRef[ability.ActiveCondition] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if arg.EnragedAnimIds and arg.EnragedAnimIds[v3] then
			local playerStateRef = arg.PlayerStateRef

			if playerStateRef then
				playerStateRef.IsEnraged = true
				playerStateRef.EnrageStartTime = tick()
			end
		end

		if arg.Sk8StartAnimId and v3 == arg.Sk8StartAnimId then
			local playerStateRef = arg.PlayerStateRef

			if playerStateRef then
				playerStateRef.IsSkating = true
			end
		end

		if v3 == "122542233810574" or v3 == "119326397274934" then
			local playerStateRef = arg.PlayerStateRef
			if playerStateRef and type(playerStateRef.CurrentStamina) == "number" then
				local maxS = (playerStateRef.Stats and playerStateRef.Stats.MaxStamina) or 100
				playerStateRef.CurrentStamina = math.clamp(playerStateRef.CurrentStamina + 4, 0, maxS)
			end
		end
	end

	local function fn30(arg, arg2, arg3, hum)
		if isLocalPlayChar(arg) then
			if RemovePlayerTagDrawing then pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, arg) end
			return
		end
		local v3 = fn20(arg, nil)
		local v4 = fn21(arg, nil)
		local animator = hum and hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
		if not flag or isLocalPlayChar(arg) or not (arg and arg.Parent and (arg.Parent.Name == "Survivors" or arg.Parent.Name == "Killers") and arg:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
			if RemovePlayerTagDrawing then pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, arg) end
			return
		end
		local prevSt = tbl8[arg]
		if prevSt then
			if prevSt.CrouchAttrListener then pcall(function() prevSt.CrouchAttrListener:Disconnect() end) end
			if prevSt.AbilityState then
				local pab = prevSt.AbilityState
				if pab.Connections then
					for _, c3 in ipairs(pab.Connections) do pcall(function() c3:Disconnect() end) end
				end
				if pab.BillboardCache and pab.BillboardCache.Gui then
					pcall(function() pab.BillboardCache.Gui:Destroy() end)
				end
			end
			tbl8[arg] = nil
		end
		local str2 = arg.Parent.Name == "Survivors" and "Survivor" or "Killer"
		local charType = (arg:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or arg:GetAttribute("ActorDisplayName") or arg.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
		local v5 = fn24(hum)
		local isInjured = v5 <= 0.5
		local v6 = fn22(arg, false, false)
		local v7 = fn22(arg, true, false)
		local v8 = fn22(arg, false, true)
		local v9 = string.match(tostring(v6 or ""), "%d+")
		local v10 = string.match(tostring(v7 or ""), "%d+")
		local v11 = string.match(tostring(v8 or ""), "%d+")

		local tbl15 = {
			Name = arg.Name,
			Type = str2,
			Stats = v4,
			CurrentStamina = v4.MaxStamina,

	local function computeFootOffY(hrp, hum)
		if not hrp then return 3.0 end
		local hip = hum and hum.HipHeight or 0
		if hip > 0 then
			return hrp.Size.Y * 0.5 + hip
		end
		return 3.0
	end

	local function ensureDeviceGuiFrame(tag, char)
		local dev = tag.DeviceGuiFrame
		if dev and dev.Parent then
			return dev
		end
		if not (forsakenDeviceESP and forsakenDeviceESP.Parent) then
			return nil
		end
		local plr = tag.RealNamePlr or (char and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char))
		tag.RealNamePlr = plr
		local iconD = math.clamp(math.floor((tbl.EspIconSize or 28) * 0.48 + 0.5), 12, 64)
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, iconD, 0, iconD)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Visible = false
		frame.Parent = forsakenDeviceESP
		local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		imageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		imageLabel.Image = tbl11[plr and plr:GetAttribute("Device") or "Unknown"] or tbl11.Unknown
		imageLabel.Parent = frame
		tag.DeviceGuiFrame = frame
		tag._lastDevSize = iconD
		tag._lastDevX = nil
		tag._lastDevY = nil
		tag._lastDevVis = false
		return frame
	end

	CreatePlayerTagDrawing = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		if tbl7[arg] then
			RemovePlayerTagDrawing(arg)
		end

		if isLocalPlayChar(arg) then
			return
		end

		local function fn32(size, color)
			local v3 = forsakenFK.textTag()
			v3.Visible = false
			v3.Center = true
			v3.Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			v3.Outline = true
			v3.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			pcall(function() v3.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold) end)
			v3.RichText = true
			v3.Size = size
			v3.Color = color
			v3.Text = ""
			return v3
		end

		local espTextSize = (tbl.EspTextSize or 14)
		local playerFromCharacter = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(arg)
		local tagEntry = {
			MainText = fn32(espTextSize, arg2 and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
			DeviceGuiFrame = nil,
			HRP = arg3,
			Hum = arg4,
			RealNamePlr = playerFromCharacter,
			RealName = playerFromCharacter and playerFromCharacter.Name or arg.Name,
			CharName = arg.Name,
			_footOffY = computeFootOffY(arg3, arg4),
			_lineCount = 0,
			_lastMainText = "",
			_lastX = -1,
			_lastY = -1,
		}
		if tbl.TagsOptions and tbl.TagsOptions.Device then
			ensureDeviceGuiFrame(tagEntry, arg)
		end
		tbl7[arg] = tagEntry
	end

	RemovePlayerTagDrawing = function(arg)
		if tbl7[arg] then
			local v3 = tbl7[arg]
			v3.MainText:Remove()

			if v3.DeviceGuiFrame then
				v3.DeviceGuiFrame:Destroy()
			end

			tbl7[arg] = nil
		end


		local v3 = tbl8[arg]

		if v3 then
			if v3.CrouchAttrListener then
				v3.CrouchAttrListener:Disconnect()
			end

			if v3.AbilityState then
				local abilityState = v3.AbilityState

				if abilityState.Connections then
					for _, connection3 in ipairs(abilityState.Connections) do
						connection3:Disconnect()
					end
				end

				if abilityState.BillboardCache and abilityState.BillboardCache.Gui then
					abilityState.BillboardCache.Gui:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		tbl8[arg] = nil
	end

local function escapeRichText(s)
	return tostring(s or ""):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")
end
local function color3ToHex(c)
	if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return "#FFFFFF" end
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X",
		math.clamp(math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255),
		math.clamp(math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255),
		math.clamp(math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255)
	)
end
