		local opts = tbl.TagsOptions or {}
		local myChar = localPlayer.Character
		local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		for char in pairs(tbl7) do
			local cp0 = char and char.Parent
			if not (cp0 and (cp0.Name == "Survivors" or cp0.Name == "Killers") and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
				pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, char)
			end
		end
		for char, st in pairs(tbl8) do
			local cp = char.Parent
			if char == myChar or isLocalPlayChar(char) or not (cp and (cp.Name == "Survivors" or cp.Name == "Killers") and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, char) continue end
			fn31(char, st, delta)
			local ab = st.AbilityState
			local tag = tbl7[char]
			local hrp = (st._hrp and st._hrp.Parent == char and st._hrp) or (tag and tag.HRP and tag.HRP.Parent == char and tag.HRP) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hrpPos = hrp and hrp.Position
			local dA = (hrpPos and myHRP) and (hrpPos - myHRP.Position).Magnitude or 0
			if ab and hrpPos then
				local cache = ab.BillboardCache
				local isAbOn2 = (_G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true) or (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp == true and opts.Abilities == true)
				local dOK = (not myHRP) or (dA <= 120)
				local wantA = false
				if isAbOn2 and dOK then
					local offY = (cache and cache.OffsetY) or 4.45
					local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrpPos + Vector3.new(0, offY, 0))
					wantA = sp.Z > 0
				end
				if cache and cache.Gui and cache.Gui.Enabled ~= wantA then
					cache.Gui.Enabled = wantA
				end
				if not wantA then
					for k in pairs(ab.Abilities) do
						local remaining = ab.Timers[k] or 0
						if remaining > 0 then
							remaining = remaining - delta
							if remaining < 0 then remaining = 0 end
							ab.Timers[k] = remaining
						end
					end
				else
					if myHRP and cache and cache.MainContainer then
						cache._aT = (cache._aT or 0.12) + delta
						if cache._aT >= 0.12 then
							cache._aT = 0
							if cache.DistanceScale then
								cache.DistanceScale.Scale = math.clamp(1.06 - dA / 125, 0.35, 1.0)
							end
						end
					end
					local cdRate = getHasteCooldownRate(char, st)
					local lastTenth = ab.LastTenth
					if not lastTenth then
						lastTenth = {}
						ab.LastTenth = lastTenth
					end
					for k, ability in pairs(ab.Abilities) do
						local remaining = ab.Timers[k] or 0
						if remaining > 0 then
							remaining = remaining - delta * cdRate
							if remaining < 0 then remaining = 0 end
							ab.Timers[k] = remaining
						end
						local activeCond = ability.ActiveCondition and st[ability.ActiveCondition] == true
						local show = (ability.AlwaysShow == true or remaining > 0 or activeCond == true)
						local frame = ab.Frames[k]
						if show and not frame then
							frame = createFrame(ab, k, ability)
						end
						if frame then
							if frame.Visible ~= (show == true) then frame.Visible = show == true end
							if show then
								local onCd = remaining > 0
								local stateKey = onCd and "CD" or "RDY"
								local shade = (ab.Shades and ab.Shades[k]) or (frame:FindFirstChild("IconFrame") and frame.IconFrame:FindFirstChild("CooldownShade"))
								if frame:GetAttribute("_st") ~= stateKey then
									frame:SetAttribute("_st", stateKey)
									local icLbl = ab.IconLabels and ab.IconLabels[k]
									local stroke = (ab.Strokes and ab.Strokes[k]) or (frame:FindFirstChild("IconFrame") and frame.IconFrame:FindFirstChild("IconStroke"))
									if icLbl then
										icLbl.ImageColor3 = onCd and Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
									end
									if stroke then
										stroke.Color = onCd and Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 135) or Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 130)
										stroke.Thickness = onCd and 1.2 or 2
									end
								end
								local tenth = onCd and math.floor(remaining * 10 + 0.5) or -1
								if lastTenth[k] ~= tenth then
									lastTenth[k] = tenth
									local txt = onCd and string.format("%.1f", remaining) or ""
									local ui = ab.TimersUI[k]
									if ui then
										ui:SetAttribute("L", txt)
										ui.Text = txt
									end
									if shade then
										local cdTotal = tonumber(ability.Cooldown)
										if onCd and cdTotal and cdTotal > 0 then
											local ratioY = math.clamp(remaining / cdTotal, 0, 1)
											shade.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, ratioY)
											if not shade.Visible then shade.Visible = true end
										else
											if shade.Visible then shade.Visible = false end
										end
									end
								elseif not onCd and shade and shade.Visible then
									shade.Visible = false
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if tag and tag.HRP and tag.HRP.Parent then
				local tPos = (tag.HRP == hrp and hrpPos) or tag.HRP.Position
				local dTag = (tag.HRP == hrp and dA) or ((myHRP and (tPos - myHRP.Position).Magnitude) or 0)
				local visible = false
				local sp, onScr
				local textY = 0
				if dTag <= 120 then
					local footOff = tag._footOffY or 3.0
					sp, onScr = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(Vector3.new(tPos.X, tPos.Y - footOff, tPos.Z))
					if onScr and sp.Z > 0 then
						visible = true
						textY = math.floor(sp.Y + 6.5)
					end
				end
				if visible then
					st._txtT = (st._txtT or 0.05) + delta
					if st._txtT >= 0.05 then
						st._txtT = 0
						if not tag._footOffY then tag._footOffY = computeFootOffY(tag.HRP, tag.Hum) end
						table.clear(_nameBuf)
						table.clear(_statBuf)
						local teamHex = color3ToHex(st.Type == "Killer" and tbl.EspKillerColor or tbl.EspSurvivorsColor)
						if opts.Name == true then
							_nameBuf[#_nameBuf + 1] = escapeRichText(tag.RealName or tag.CharName)
						end
						if opts.Role then
							_nameBuf[#_nameBuf + 1] = st.Type == "Killer" and "[KILLER]" or "[SUR]"
						end
						local line1 = (#_nameBuf > 0) and string.format('<font color="%s">%s</font>', teamHex, table.concat(_nameBuf, " ")) or nil
						if opts.Health and tag.Hum then
							local hpPct = math.floor(fn24(tag.Hum) * 100 + 0.5)
							if hpPct <= 25 then
								_statBuf[#_statBuf + 1] = string.format('<font color="#FF5050">HP %d%%</font>', hpPct)
							else
								_statBuf[#_statBuf + 1] = string.format("HP %d%%", hpPct)
							end
						end
						if opts.Stamina then
							local stVal = math.floor((st.CurrentStamina or 0) + 0.5)
							_statBuf[#_statBuf + 1] = string.format("⚡%d", stVal)
						end
						if opts.Distance and myHRP then
							local distM = math.floor(dTag + 0.5)
							_statBuf[#_statBuf + 1] = string.format("%dm", distM)
						end
						if opts.Velocity then
							local velSt = math.floor((st.DisplaySpeed or 0) + 0.5)
							_statBuf[#_statBuf + 1] = string.format("%d st/s", velSt)
						end
						local line2 = (#_statBuf > 0) and string.format('<font color="#FFFFFF">%s</font>', table.concat(_statBuf, " | ")) or nil
						local mainT
						if line1 and line2 then
							mainT = line1 .. "\n" .. line2
							tag._lineCount = 2
						elseif line1 then
							mainT = line1
							tag._lineCount = 1
						elseif line2 then
							mainT = line2
							tag._lineCount = 1
						else
							mainT = ""
							tag._lineCount = 0
						end
						if mainT ~= tag._lastMainText then
							tag.MainText.Text = mainT
							tag._lastMainText = mainT
						end
					end
					local mC = tag._lastMainText or ""
					local hasText = #mC > 0
					if hasText then
						local px = math.floor(sp.X + 0.5)
						if px ~= tag._lastX or textY ~= tag._lastY then
							tag._lastX, tag._lastY = px, textY
							tag.MainText.Position = Vector2.new(px, textY)
						end
					end
					tag.MainText.Visible = hasText
				else
					if tag.MainText.Visible then tag.MainText.Visible = false end
				end
				if opts.Device and visible then
					local dev = ensureDeviceGuiFrame(tag, char)
					if dev then
						local baseD = math.clamp(math.floor((tbl.EspIconSize or 40) * 0.48 + 0.5), 12, 64)
						local dS2 = math.clamp(1.0 - dTag / 140, 0.45, 1.0)
						local dN2 = math.clamp(math.floor(baseD * dS2 + 0.5), 10, 64)
						if tag._lastDevSize ~= dN2 then
							tag._lastDevSize = dN2
							dev.Size = UDim2.new(0, dN2, 0, dN2)
						end
						local mC = tag._lastMainText or ""
						local textH = (#mC > 0 and ((tag._lineCount or 1) * (tbl.EspTextSize or 14) + 2)) or 0
						local devX = math.floor(sp.X - dN2 / 2 + 0.5)
						local devY = math.floor(textY + textH + 4)
						if tag._lastDevX ~= devX or tag._lastDevY ~= devY then
							tag._lastDevX, tag._lastDevY = devX, devY
							dev.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(devX, devY)
						end
						if not tag._lastDevVis then
							tag._lastDevVis = true
							dev.Visible = true
						end
					end
				elseif tag._lastDevVis then
					tag._lastDevVis = false
					if tag.DeviceGuiFrame then
						tag.DeviceGuiFrame.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local espHookedFolders = {}
	local espFolderConns = {}
	local espPlayersFolder = nil
	local espPlayersConn = nil
	local espMounting = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function clearEspFolderConn(tName)
		local list = espFolderConns[tName]
		if list then
			for i = #list, 1, -1 do
				local c = list[i]
				list[i] = nil
				pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
			end
			espFolderConns[tName] = nil
		end
		espHookedFolders[tName] = nil
	end

	StopESPSystem = function()
		flag = false

		if connection2 then
			connection2:Disconnect()
			connection2 = nil
		end

		if espPlayersConn then
			pcall(function() espPlayersConn:Disconnect() end)
			espPlayersConn = nil
		end
		espPlayersFolder = nil
		clearEspFolderConn("Survivors")
		clearEspFolderConn("Killers")

		for _, v3 in ipairs(tbl9) do
			pcall(function() v3:Disconnect() end)
		end

		tbl9 = {}

		for k in pairs(tbl7) do
			pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, k)
		end
		for k in pairs(tbl8) do
			pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, k)
		end

		tbl7 = {}
		tbl8 = {}
		table.clear(espMounting)

		if forsakenDeviceESP then
			forsakenDeviceESP:Destroy()
			forsakenDeviceESP = nil
		end

		if forsakenAbilityESP then
			forsakenAbilityESP:Destroy()
			forsakenAbilityESP = nil
		end
	end

	StartESPSystem = function()
		local guiParent = fn17()

		if not (forsakenDeviceESP and forsakenDeviceESP.Parent) then
			forsakenDeviceESP = (guiParent and guiParent:FindFirstChild("ForsakenDeviceESP")) or CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ForsakenDeviceESP") or Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			forsakenDeviceESP.Name = "ForsakenDeviceESP"
			forsakenDeviceESP:SetAttribute("GEN", 4)
			forsakenDeviceESP.DisplayOrder = 10
			forsakenDeviceESP.Parent = guiParent
		end

		if not (forsakenAbilityESP and forsakenAbilityESP.Parent) then
			forsakenAbilityESP = (guiParent and guiParent:FindFirstChild("ForsakenAbilityESP")) or CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ForsakenAbilityESP") or Instance.new("Folder")
			forsakenAbilityESP.Name = "ForsakenAbilityESP"
			forsakenAbilityESP:SetAttribute("GEN", 4)
			forsakenAbilityESP.Parent = guiParent
		end

		local function fn34(child)
			if not (child and child:IsA("Model")) or espMounting[child] then return end
			if isLocalPlayChar(child) then return end
			espMounting[child] = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local humanoidRootPart = child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or child:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
				local humanoid = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or child:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
				local head = child:FindFirstChild("Head") or child:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
				if isLocalPlayChar(child) then
					espMounting[child] = nil
					pcall(RemovePlayerTagDrawing, child)
					return
				end

				if flag and humanoidRootPart and humanoid and child.Parent and child:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if not tbl8[child] then
						pcall(fn30, child, humanoidRootPart, head, humanoid)
					elseif tbl.PlayersTagsEsp and not tbl7[child] then
						CreatePlayerTagDrawing(child, child.Parent.Name == "Killers" and tbl.EspKillerColor or tbl.EspSurvivorsColor, humanoidRootPart, humanoid)
					end
				end
				espMounting[child] = nil
			end)
		end

		local function fn35(arg)
			if not (arg and arg.Parent and arg:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
				return
			end
			local tName = arg.Name
			if espHookedFolders[tName] ~= arg then
				clearEspFolderConn(tName)
				espHookedFolders[tName] = arg
				local cAdd = arg.ChildAdded:Connect(fn34)
				local cRem = arg.ChildRemoved:Connect(RemovePlayerTagDrawing)
				local cAnc
				cAnc = arg.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
					if not parent or not arg:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if espHookedFolders[tName] == arg then
							clearEspFolderConn(tName)
						end
					end
				end)
				espFolderConns[tName] = { cAdd, cRem, cAnc }
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
				if not tbl8[child] or (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp and not tbl7[child]) then
					fn34(child)
				end
			end
		end

		local function bindPlayersRoot(players2)
			if not (players2 and players2.Parent) then return end
			if espPlayersFolder ~= players2 then
				if espPlayersConn then pcall(function() espPlayersConn:Disconnect() end) espPlayersConn = nil end
				espPlayersFolder = players2
				espPlayersConn = players2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(sub)
					if flag and (sub.Name == "Survivors" or sub.Name == "Killers") then
						task.defer(fn35, sub)
					end
				end)
			end
			fn35(players2:FindFirstChild("Survivors"))
			fn35(players2:FindFirstChild("Killers"))
		end

		local playersNow = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
		if playersNow then
			bindPlayersRoot(playersNow)
		else
			task.spawn(function()
				local pWait = workspace:WaitForChild("Players", 15)
				if flag and pWait then bindPlayersRoot(pWait) end
			end)
		end

		if not flag then
			flag = true
			table.insert(tbl9, workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
				if flag and ch.Name == "Players" then
					task.defer(bindPlayersRoot, ch)
				end
			end))
		end

		if not connection2 then
			connection2 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(fn33)
		end
	end

end

	local function applyAbilityIconFrameSize(iconFrame, n, tSz)
		iconFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, n, 0, n)
		iconFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -n / 2, 0.5, -n / 2)
		local cornerR = UDim.new(0, math.max(5, math.floor(n * 0.2)))
		local uc = iconFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if uc then uc.CornerRadius = cornerR end
		local sh = iconFrame:FindFirstChild("CooldownShade")
		if sh and sh:IsA("Frame") then
			sh.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
			sh.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
			sh.BackgroundTransparency = 0.64
			local suc = sh:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
			if suc then suc.CornerRadius = cornerR end
		end
		local tm = iconFrame:FindFirstChild("Timer")
		if tm and tm:IsA("TextLabel") then
			tm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			tm.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1)
			tm.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0)
			tm.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
			tm.TextSize = tSz
		end
		if iconFrame.Parent and iconFrame.Parent:IsA("Frame") then
			iconFrame.Parent.Size = UDim2.new(0, n, 0, n)
		end
	end
	local function a723IconSweep(n, nd)
		local cg = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
		local tSz = math.clamp(math.floor(n * 0.4 + 0.5), 12, 18)
		for _, g in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
			if g.Name == "ForsakenAbilityESP" or g.Name == "ForsakenDeviceESP" then
				for _, d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and g.Name == "ForsakenAbilityESP" then
						d.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(210, (n + 4) * 5), 0, n + 8)
					elseif d.Name == "IconFrame" and d:IsA("Frame") then
						applyAbilityIconFrameSize(d, n, tSz)
					elseif d:IsA("Frame") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "ForsakenDeviceESP" then
						d.Size = UDim2.new(0, nd, 0, nd)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	rawset(_G, "__A723_TOKEN", {})
	-- [r44 Event-Driven] Quét khởi tạo 1 lần duy nhất, sau đó chỉ cập nhật khi Slider thay đổi
	pcall(function()
		local n = tbl.EspIconSize or 28
		local nd = math.clamp(math.floor(n * 0.48 + 0.5), 12, 64)
		a723IconSweep(n, nd)
	end)
	local killers, ingame, survivors
	local espPurgeThread, espWatchThread, hlReconcileThread = nil, nil, nil
	local syncEspWatchdogs, ensureHlReconcileLoop
	local function cancelThreadSafe(th)
		if th and coroutine.running() ~= th then
			pcall(task.cancel, th)
		end
	end
	local function resolveFolders()

		local kp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
		killers = kp and kp:FindFirstChild("Killers")
		survivors = kp and kp:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
		local mp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		ingame = mp and mp:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
	end
	local function syncEspAndHlLoops()
		if syncEspWatchdogs then syncEspWatchdogs() end
		if ensureHlReconcileLoop then ensureHlReconcileLoop() end
	end
	local function setTeamHighlightEsp(propKey, folderName, labelPrefix, v)
		tbl[propKey] = v
		resolveFolders()
		local isKillerTeam = (folderName == "Killers")
		local curFolder = isKillerTeam and killers or survivors
		local paintFn = isKillerTeam and killerEsp or survivorsEsp
		if v and not curFolder then
			syncEspAndHlLoops()
			pcall(function() if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) then print("[NERG] " .. labelPrefix .. " esp ON but " .. folderName .. " folder missing (lobby) — waiting for next round") end end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local kp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players") or workspace:WaitForChild("Players", 60)
				local tf = kp and kp:WaitForChild(folderName, 60)
				if tf and tbl[propKey] then
					pcall(function() if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) then print("[NERG] " .. folderName .. " folder up — painting highlights") end end)
					pcall(isKillerTeam and killerEsp or survivorsEsp)
					if ensureHlReconcileLoop then ensureHlReconcileLoop() end
				end
			end)
			return
		end
		pcall(paintFn)
		syncEspAndHlLoops()
		pcall(function() if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) then print("[NERG] " .. labelPrefix .. " esp → " .. tostring(v)) end end)
	end
	local function updateTeamTagColors(wantKiller, c)
		for k, v in pairs(tbl7) do
			local st = tbl8[k]
			local isK = ((st and st.Type == "Killer") or (k ~= nil and k.Parent ~= nil and k.Parent.Name == "Killers")) == true
			if c and (isK == wantKiller) and v.MainText then
				v._lastMainText = ""
			end
		end
	end
	ESP_SET = {
		killer = function(v)
			setTeamHighlightEsp("KillerEsp", "Killers", "killer", v)
			if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
		end,
		surv = function(v)
			setTeamHighlightEsp("SurvivorsEsp", "Survivors", "survivor", v)
			if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
		end,
		color_killer = function(c)
			tbl.EspKillerColor = c
			updateTeamTagColors(true, c)
			pcall(killerEspColorUpdate)
			if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
		end,
		color_surv = function(c)
			tbl.EspSurvivorsColor = c
			updateTeamTagColors(false, c)
			pcall(survivorsEspColorUpdate)
			if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
		end,
		ability = function(v)
			pcall(function()
				rawset(_G, "NERG_ABILITY_ESP", v and true or false)
				if not tbl.TagsOptions then tbl.TagsOptions = {} end
				tbl.TagsOptions.Abilities = v and true or false
				if v then
					StartESPSystem()
				elseif not tbl.PlayersTagsEsp then
					StopESPSystem()
				end
				if syncEspWatchdogs then syncEspWatchdogs() end
				if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
			end)
		end,
		tags = function(v)
			pcall(function()
				tbl.PlayersTagsEsp = v and true or false
				if v then
					StartESPSystem()
					local plFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
					if plFolder then
						for _, teamName in ipairs({ "Killers", "Survivors" }) do
							local tf = plFolder:FindFirstChild(teamName)
							if tf then
								for _, ch in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
									if ch:IsA("Model") and ch ~= localPlayer.Character and not tbl7[ch] then
										local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
										local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
										if hrp and hum then
											CreatePlayerTagDrawing(ch, teamName == "Killers" and tbl.EspKillerColor or tbl.EspSurvivorsColor, hrp, hum)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				elseif not _G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP then
					StopESPSystem()
				else
					for k, v3 in pairs(tbl7) do
						pcall(function() v3.MainText:Remove() end)
						if v3.DeviceGuiFrame then pcall(function() v3.DeviceGuiFrame:Destroy() end) end
						tbl7[k] = nil
					end
				end
				if syncEspWatchdogs then syncEspWatchdogs() end
				if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
			end)
		end,
		opt = function(k, v)

		end,
		dbg = function()

		iconsize = function(n)

	local function destroyEspScreenGuis()
		pcall(function()
			local hub = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
			for _, g in ipairs(hub:GetChildren()) do

	rawset(_G, "NERG_ESP_SHUTDOWN", function()
		pcall(function()
			rawset(_G, "NERG_ABILITY_ESP", false)
			tbl.PlayersTagsEsp = false
			tbl.KillerEsp = false
			tbl.SurvivorsEsp = false
			cancelThreadSafe(espPurgeThread)

			cancelThreadSafe(hlReconcileThread)

				for i = #ESP_SET._previewConns, 1, -1 do
					local pc = ESP_SET._previewConns[i]
					ESP_SET._previewConns[i] = nil
					pcall(function() pc:Disconnect() end)
				end
			end
			if StopESPSystem then StopESPSystem() end
		end)
		pcall(killerEsp)
		pcall(survivorsEsp)
		destroyEspScreenGuis()
	end)
	local function purgeOldESP()
		local cg = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
		for _, g in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
			if (g:IsA("ScreenGui") or g:IsA("Folder")) and (g.Name == "NergFK_TextTags" or g.Name == "ForsakenDeviceESP" or g.Name == "ForsakenAbilityESP") and g:GetAttribute("GEN") ~= 4 then
				pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
			end
		end
		for _, g in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
			if g:IsA("Folder") and g.Name == "ForsakenAbilityESP" then
				for _, bb in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
					if bb:IsA("BillboardGui") and (not bb.Adornee or not bb.Adornee:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
						pcall(function() bb:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	purgeOldESP()
	destroyEspScreenGuis()
	pcall(function()
		local kp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
		if kp then
			for _, teamName in ipairs({ "Killers", "Survivors" }) do

				if tf then
					for _, d in ipairs(tf:GetDescendants()) do
						if d:IsA("Highlight") and (d:GetAttribute("NergHL") == true or d.Name == "External_Protected_HL") then

						end

			end
		end

	local function isOurHL(d)
		return d:IsA("Highlight") and (d:GetAttribute("NergHL") == true or d.Name == "External_Protected_HL" or d.Name == tostring(_G.__NERG_HL_NAME))
	end
	local function nergEspSweepTeam(teamName)
		local kp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
		local f = kp and kp:FindFirstChild(teamName)
		if f then
			for _, ch in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
				for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
					if isOurHL(d) then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
				end
			end
		end
		if teamName == "Killers" then
			local mp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
			local ig = mp and mp:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
			if ig then
				for _, ch in ipairs(ig:GetChildren()) do
					if isOurHL(ch) then
						pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
					elseif ch:IsA("Model") or ch:IsA("Folder") then
						for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
							if isOurHL(d) then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local lastK5, lastS5, lastIng5 = nil, nil, nil
	syncEspWatchdogs = function()
		local wantTagsOrAb = (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp == true or _G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true)
		local wantAnyEsp = wantTagsOrAb or (tbl.KillerEsp == true or tbl.SurvivorsEsp == true)
		if wantTagsOrAb and not espPurgeThread then
			espPurgeThread = task.spawn(function()
				while __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp == true or _G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true) do
					task.wait(4)
					if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp == true or _G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true)) then break end
					pcall(purgeOldESP)
				end
				espPurgeThread = nil
			end)
		elseif not wantTagsOrAb and espPurgeThread then
			cancelThreadSafe(espPurgeThread)
			espPurgeThread = nil
		end
		if wantAnyEsp and not espWatchThread then
			espWatchThread = task.spawn(function()
				while __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp == true or _G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true or tbl.KillerEsp == true or tbl.SurvivorsEsp == true) do
					task.wait(5)
					if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then break end
					pcall(function()
						local mapInst = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
						local curIng = mapInst and mapInst:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
						local ingChanged = (curIng ~= lastIng5)
						lastIng5 = curIng
						if tbl.KillerEsp ~= lastK5 or (tbl.KillerEsp and ingChanged) then
							lastK5 = tbl.KillerEsp
							if tbl.KillerEsp then pcall(killerEsp) else pcall(nergEspSweepTeam, "Killers") end
						end
						if tbl.SurvivorsEsp ~= lastS5 or (tbl.SurvivorsEsp and ingChanged) then
							lastS5 = tbl.SurvivorsEsp
							if tbl.SurvivorsEsp then pcall(survivorsEsp) else pcall(nergEspSweepTeam, "Survivors") end
						end
						if ingChanged and (tbl.PlayersTagsEsp or _G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true) then
							pcall(StartESPSystem)
						end
					end)
				end
				espWatchThread = nil
			end)
		elseif not wantAnyEsp and espWatchThread then
			cancelThreadSafe(espWatchThread)
			espWatchThread = nil
		end
	end
	syncEspWatchdogs()
	pcall(function() for _ = 1, 3 do print('[A693] AUTO-ON-CALLED') end end)


-- [NERG-B1/r14] Objects + Items ESP (port tu TO-A615 · event-driven · self-destruct via __NERG_KILLED)
do
	local OBJ = {
		master = false, itemsOn = false, tagsOn = false, azureRadius = false,
		perType = { Graffiti = true, TaphTrap = true, Ritual = true, Builderman = true, AzureTrap = true },
		colors = {
			Graffiti = Color3.fromRGB(255, 192, 203),
			TaphTrap = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0),
			Ritual = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255),
			Builderman = Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 250),
			AzureTrap = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30),
			Items = Color3.fromRGB(89, 0, 255),
		},
	}
	rawset(_G, "NERG_OBJ", OBJ)

	local REG = {
		{ key = "Graffiti", label = "Graffiti", trans = true,
			match = function(d) return d.Name == "GraffitiCL" end },
		{ key = "TaphTrap", label = "Taph Trap", trans = false,
			match = function(d) return d.Name == "SubspaceTripmine" or d:FindFirstChild("Wire") ~= nil end },
		{ key = "Ritual", label = "Ritual", trans = true,
			match = function(d) return string.find(d.Name, "RespawnLocation", 1, true) ~= nil end },
		{ key = "Builderman", label = "Sentry/Dispenser", trans = false,
			match = function(d) return d.Name == "BuildermanSentry" or d.Name == "BuildermanDispenser" end },
		{ key = "AzureTrap", label = "Azure Trap", trans = false,
			match = function(d)
				if not (d:IsA("Model") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Ingame") then
					return false
				end
				local name = d.Name
				if name == "GroundBulbModel" or name == "GroundBulb" then
					return d.PrimaryPart ~= nil or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") ~= nil
				end
				if name == "VineModel" then
					return d:FindFirstChild("AnimationController") ~= nil or d:FindFirstChild("RootPart") ~= nil
				end
				return false
			end,
			radius = function(d)
				local name = d.Name
				if name == "GroundBulbModel" or name == "GroundBulb" then return 30 end
				if name == "VineModel" then return 20 end
				return nil
			end },
	}
	local ITEM_MATCH = { BloxyCola = true, Medkit = true }
	local HLNAME = "NP_ObjHL"

	local reg, items = {}, {}
	local conns, ingame = {}, nil
	local scannedMasterFor, scannedItemsFor = nil, nil
	local supConn, tagConn = nil, nil
	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	local rs = game:GetService("RunService")

	local function baseOf(d)
		if not d then return nil end
		if d:IsA("Model") then return d.PrimaryPart or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
		if d:IsA("Tool") then
			return d:FindFirstChild("ItemRoot", true) or d:FindFirstChild("Handle", true) or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d end
		return nil
	end
	OBJ.baseOf = baseOf

	local function findEntry(d)
		if not (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end
		local nm = d.Name
		if nm == "GraffitiCL" then return REG[1] end
		if nm == "SubspaceTripmine" or (d:IsA("Model") and d:FindFirstChild("Wire") ~= nil) then return REG[2] end
		if string.find(nm, "RespawnLocation", 1, true) ~= nil then return REG[3] end
		if nm == "BuildermanSentry" or nm == "BuildermanDispenser" then return REG[4] end
		if (nm == "GroundBulbModel" or nm == "GroundBulb" or nm == "VineModel") and d:IsA("Model") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Ingame" then
			local ok, res = pcall(REG[5].match, d)
			if ok and res then return REG[5] end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function applyHL(target, color)
		local adornee = target
		if target:IsA("Tool") then
			adornee = baseOf(target) or target
		end
		local fT, oT = espT(0.65), espT(0.3)
		local hl = target:FindFirstChild(HLNAME)
		if not hl then
			hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
			hl.Name = HLNAME
			hl.FillTransparency = fT
			hl.OutlineTransparency = oT
			hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			hl.Parent = target
		else
			if math.abs(hl.FillTransparency - fT) > 0.01 then hl.FillTransparency = fT end
			if math.abs(hl.OutlineTransparency - oT) > 0.01 then hl.OutlineTransparency = oT end
		end
		if hl.Adornee ~= adornee then hl.Adornee = adornee end
		if hl.FillColor ~= color then hl.FillColor = color end
		if hl.OutlineColor ~= color then hl.OutlineColor = color end
		return hl
	end

	local function rmReg(inst)
		local rec = reg[inst]
		if not rec then return end
		if rec.hl then pcall(function() rec.hl:Destroy() end) end
		if rec.tag then pcall(function() rec.tag.Remove() end) end
		if rec.cyl then pcall(function() rec.cyl:Destroy() end) end
		if rec.trans and rec.savedT ~= nil and inst.Parent then
			pcall(function() inst.Transparency = rec.savedT end)
		end
		reg[inst] = nil
	end

	local function rmItem(tool)
		local rec = items[tool]
		if not rec then return end
		if rec.hl then pcall(function() rec.hl:Destroy() end) end
		if rec.box then pcall(function() rec.box:Destroy() end) end
		if rec.tag then pcall(function() rec.tag.Remove() end) end
		items[tool] = nil
	end

	local function clearRegAll()
		for inst in pairs(reg) do rmReg(inst) end
	end

	local function clearItemsAll()
		for tool in pairs(items) do rmItem(tool) end
	end

	local function syncObjTag(rec, label, color)
		if OBJ.tagsOn then
			if not rec.tag then
				rec.tag = forsakenFK.textTag()
				rec._vis, rec._lx, rec._ly = nil, nil, nil
			end
			rec.tag.Text = label
			rec.tag.Color = color
			rec.tag.Size = 14
		elseif rec.tag then
			rec.tag.Remove()
			rec.tag = nil
			rec._vis, rec._lx, rec._ly = nil, nil, nil
		end
	end

	local function applyReg(inst, entry)
		local active = OBJ.master and OBJ.perType[entry.key]
		local rec = reg[inst]
		if not active then
			if rec then rmReg(inst) end
			return
		end
		local bp = baseOf(inst)
		if not bp then
			if rec then rmReg(inst) end
			return
		end
		if not rec then
			rec = { entry = entry, bp = bp }
			reg[inst] = rec
			if entry.trans and inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				rec.trans = true
				rec.savedT = inst.Transparency
				pcall(function() inst.Transparency = 0 end)
			end
		else
			rec.bp = bp
		end
		local col = OBJ.colors[entry.key]
		rec.hl = applyHL(inst, col)
		syncObjTag(rec, entry.label, col)
		if rec.cyl and rec.cyl.Parent ~= inst then
			rec.cyl = nil
		end
		if OBJ.azureRadius and entry.radius then
			local okR, r = pcall(entry.radius, inst)
			if okR and r and bp then
				local cyl = inst:FindFirstChild("NP_ObjRadius")
				if not cyl then
					cyl = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
					cyl.Name = "NP_ObjRadius"
					cyl.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
					cyl.Transparency = 0.75
					cyl.Height = 0.05
					cyl.AlwaysOnTop = true
					cyl.Parent = inst
				end
				cyl.Adornee = bp
				cyl.Radius = r
				cyl.CFrame = bp.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(bp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
				rec.cyl = cyl
			elseif rec.cyl then
				pcall(function() rec.cyl:Destroy() end)
				rec.cyl = nil
			end
		elseif rec.cyl then
			pcall(function() rec.cyl:Destroy() end)
			rec.cyl = nil
		end
	end

	local function applyItem(tool)
		local active = OBJ.itemsOn and ITEM_MATCH[tool.Name] == true
		local rec = items[tool]
		if not active then
			if rec then rmItem(tool) end
			return
		end
		local bp = baseOf(tool)
		if not bp then
			if rec then rmItem(tool) end
			return
		end
		if not rec then
			rec = {}
			items[tool] = rec
		end
		local col = OBJ.colors.Items
		rec.bp = bp
		rec.hl = applyHL(tool, col)
		local box = tool:FindFirstChild("NP_ItemBox")
		if not box then
			box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
			box.Name = "NP_ItemBox"
			box.AlwaysOnTop = true
			box.ZIndex = 7
			box.Transparency = 0.45
			box.Parent = tool
		end
		box.Adornee = bp
		box.Size = bp.Size + Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
		box.Color3 = col
		rec.box = box
		syncObjTag(rec, tool.Name, col)
	end

	local pendingTargets = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function detachConns()
		if conns.added then pcall(function() conns.added:Disconnect() end) conns.added = nil end
		if conns.rem then pcall(function() conns.rem:Disconnect() end) conns.rem = nil end
		table.clear(pendingTargets)
	end

	local function scanIngame(doMaster, doItems)
		if not ingame then return end
		local scanM = (doMaster ~= false) and OBJ.master
		local scanI = (doItems ~= false) and OBJ.itemsOn
		if not (scanM or scanI) then return end
		for _, d in ipairs(ingame:GetDescendants()) do
			if (d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("Model")) and ITEM_MATCH[d.Name] == true then
				if scanI then applyItem(d) end
			elseif scanM then
				local e = findEntry(d)
				if e then applyReg(d, e) end
			end
		end
	end

	local RELEVANT_NAMES = {
		BloxyCola = true, Medkit = true, GraffitiCL = true, SubspaceTripmine = true,
		BuildermanSentry = true, BuildermanDispenser = true, GroundBulbModel = true,
		GroundBulb = true, VineModel = true, Wire = true, ItemRoot = true, Handle = true, RootPart = true,
	}
	local CHILD_INDICATOR_NAMES = {
		Wire = true, ItemRoot = true, Handle = true, RootPart = true,
	}

	local function findRelevantAncestor(inst)
		local cur = inst
		local depth = 0
		while cur and cur ~= ingame and depth < 4 do
			local nm = cur.Name
			if RELEVANT_NAMES[nm] or string.find(nm, "RespawnLocation", 1, true) ~= nil then
				if CHILD_INDICATOR_NAMES[nm] then
					return cur:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") or cur:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or cur.Parent
				end
				return cur
			end
			cur = cur.Parent
			depth += 1
		end
		return nil
	end

	local cullFar
	local function ensureConns()
		local mp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		local ing = mp and mp:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
		if ing ~= ingame then
			clearRegAll()
			clearItemsAll()
			ingame = ing
			scannedMasterFor = nil
			scannedItemsFor = nil
			detachConns()
			if not ingame then return end
			conns.added = ingame.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
				if not (OBJ.master or OBJ.itemsOn) then return end
				if not (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("AnimationController")) then return end
				local target = findRelevantAncestor(d)
				if not target or pendingTargets[target] then return end
				pendingTargets[target] = true
				task.defer(function()
					pendingTargets[target] = nil
					if not target.Parent then return end
					if (target:IsA("Tool") or target:IsA("Model")) and ITEM_MATCH[target.Name] == true then
						applyItem(target)
						if cullFar then pcall(cullFar) end
						return
					end
					if (d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("Model")) and ITEM_MATCH[d.Name] == true then
						applyItem(d)
						if cullFar then pcall(cullFar) end
						return
					end
					local e = findEntry(target)
					if e then
						applyReg(target, e)
						if cullFar then pcall(cullFar) end
					else
						local ed = (d ~= target and d.Parent) and findEntry(d) or nil
						if ed then
							applyReg(d, ed)
							if cullFar then pcall(cullFar) end
						end
					end
				end)
			end)
			conns.rem = ingame.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d)
				pendingTargets[d] = nil
				if reg[d] then rmReg(d) end
				if items[d] then rmItem(d) end
			end)
		end
		if not ingame then return end
		local needM = OBJ.master and (scannedMasterFor ~= ingame)
		local needI = OBJ.itemsOn and (scannedItemsFor ~= ingame)
		if needM or needI then
			if needM then scannedMasterFor = ingame end
			if needI then scannedItemsFor = ingame end
			scanIngame(needM, needI)
			if cullFar then pcall(cullFar) end
		end
	end

	local function projectSingleTag(inst, rec, cam, myPos, maxDist)
		local t = rec.tag
		if not t then return end
		if rec._inRange == false then
			if rec._vis ~= false then
				rec._vis = false
				t.Visible = false
			end
			return
		end
		local bp = rec.bp
		if bp == nil or bp.Parent == nil then
			bp = baseOf(inst)
			rec.bp = bp
		end
		local show = false
		if bp and bp.Parent then
			local bpPos = bp.Position
			if not myPos or (bpPos - myPos).Magnitude <= maxDist then
				local sp, onScr = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bpPos)
				if onScr and sp.Z > 0 then
					show = true
					local sx, sy = math.floor(sp.X + 0.5), math.floor(sp.Y + 0.5)
					if sx ~= rec._lx or sy ~= rec._ly then
						rec._lx, rec._ly = sx, sy
						t.Position = Vector2.new(sx, sy)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if rec._vis ~= show then
			rec._vis = show
			t.Visible = show
		end
	end

	local cachedObjChar, cachedObjHrp = nil, nil
	local function projStep()
		if next(reg) == nil and next(items) == nil then return end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local lp = players.LocalPlayer
		local ch = lp and lp.Character
		if ch ~= cachedObjChar or not (cachedObjHrp and cachedObjHrp.Parent == ch) then
			cachedObjChar = ch
			cachedObjHrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
		end
		local myPos = cachedObjHrp and cachedObjHrp.Position
		for inst, rec in pairs(reg) do
			projectSingleTag(inst, rec, cam, myPos, 120)
		end
		for tool, rec in pairs(items) do
			projectSingleTag(tool, rec, cam, myPos, 300)
		end
	end

	local function hideTagTable(tblRef)
		for _, rec in pairs(tblRef) do
			rec._vis = false
			if rec.tag then rec.tag.Visible = false end
		end
	end

	local function setTagLoop(on)
		if on and not tagConn then
			tagConn = rs.RenderStepped:Connect(projStep)
		elseif not on and tagConn then
			tagConn:Disconnect()
			tagConn = nil
			hideTagTable(reg)
			hideTagTable(items)
		end
	end

	local MAX_OBJ_HL, MAX_ITEM_HL = 8, 5
	local function cmpDist(a, b) return a.d < b.d end
	local myList, iList = {}, {}
	cullFar = function()
		local lp = players.LocalPlayer
		local ch = lp and lp.Character
		local myHRP = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local myPos = (myHRP and myHRP.Position) or (cam and cam.CFrame.Position)
		if not myPos then return end
		table.clear(myList)
		for inst, rec in pairs(reg) do
			if not inst.Parent or not inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or (ingame and not inst:IsDescendantOf(ingame)) then
				rmReg(inst)
			elseif OBJ.master and rec.entry then
				local bp = rec.bp
				if bp == nil or bp.Parent == nil then
					bp = baseOf(inst)
					rec.bp = bp
				end
				if bp and bp.Parent and bp:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					local d = (bp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
					if d > 120 then
						rec._inRange = false
						if rec.hl and rec.hl.Parent and rec.hl.Enabled then rec.hl.Enabled = false end
					else
						rec._inRange = true
						myList[#myList + 1] = { d = d, inst = inst, rec = rec }
					end
				else
					rmReg(inst)
				end
			end
		end
		if #myList > MAX_OBJ_HL then
			table.sort(myList, cmpDist)
		end
		for i, e in ipairs(myList) do
			if i <= MAX_OBJ_HL then
				if not e.rec.hl or not e.rec.hl.Parent then
					e.rec.hl = applyHL(e.inst, OBJ.colors[e.rec.entry.key])
				end
				if not e.rec.hl.Enabled then e.rec.hl.Enabled = true end
				if OBJ.azureRadius and e.rec.cyl and (e.rec.entry.key == "AzureTrap") then
					local dynR = e.rec.entry.radius and e.rec.entry.radius(e.inst)
					if dynR and dynR ~= e.rec.cyl.Radius then
						pcall(function() e.rec.cyl.Radius = dynR end)
					end
				end
			else
				if e.rec.hl and e.rec.hl.Parent and e.rec.hl.Enabled then e.rec.hl.Enabled = false end
			end
		end
		table.clear(iList)
		for tool, rec in pairs(items) do
			if not tool.Parent or not tool:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or (ingame and not tool:IsDescendantOf(ingame)) then
				rmItem(tool)
			elseif OBJ.itemsOn then
				local bp = rec.bp
				if bp == nil or bp.Parent == nil then
					bp = baseOf(tool)
					rec.bp = bp
				end
				if bp and bp.Parent then
					local d = (bp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
					if d > 300 then
						rec._inRange = false
						if rec.hl and rec.hl.Parent and rec.hl.Enabled then rec.hl.Enabled = false end
						if rec.box and rec.box.Visible then rec.box.Visible = false end
					else
						rec._inRange = true
						iList[#iList + 1] = { d = d, inst = tool, rec = rec, bp = bp }
					end
				else
					rmItem(tool)
				end
			end
		end
		if #iList > MAX_ITEM_HL then
			table.sort(iList, cmpDist)
		end
		for i, e in ipairs(iList) do
			if i <= MAX_ITEM_HL then
				if not e.rec.hl or not e.rec.hl.Parent then
					e.rec.hl = applyHL(e.inst, OBJ.colors.Items)
				elseif e.rec.hl.Adornee ~= e.bp and e.inst:IsA("Tool") then
					e.rec.hl.Adornee = e.bp
				end
				if not e.rec.hl.Enabled then e.rec.hl.Enabled = true end
				if e.rec.box then
					e.rec.box.Adornee = e.bp
					e.rec.box.Color3 = OBJ.colors.Items
					if not e.rec.box.Visible then e.rec.box.Visible = true end
				end
			else
				if e.rec.hl and e.rec.hl.Parent and e.rec.hl.Enabled then e.rec.hl.Enabled = false end
				if e.rec.box and e.rec.box.Visible then e.rec.box.Visible = false end
			end
		end
	end

	local function rescanAll()
		for inst, rec in pairs(reg) do
			if rec.entry then applyReg(inst, rec.entry) end
		end
		for tool in pairs(items) do
			applyItem(tool)
		end
		pcall(cullFar)
	end

	local accObj = 0
	local function stopObjSupLoop()
		if supConn then
			pcall(function() supConn:Disconnect() end)
			supConn = nil
		end
	end
	local function startObjSupLoop()
		if supConn then return end
		accObj = 0
		supConn = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			if _G.__NERG_KILLED or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE then
				stopObjSupLoop()
				pcall(function() OBJ.shutdown() end)
				return
			end
			if not (OBJ.master or OBJ.itemsOn) then
				stopObjSupLoop()
				return
			end
			accObj += dt
			if accObj < 0.5 then return end
			accObj = 0
			pcall(ensureConns)
			pcall(cullFar)
		end)
	end
	local function syncObjActiveState()
		if not (OBJ.master or OBJ.itemsOn) then
			stopObjSupLoop()
			detachConns()
			ingame = nil
			scannedMasterFor = nil
			scannedItemsFor = nil
			setTagLoop(false)
		else
			startObjSupLoop()
			setTagLoop(OBJ.tagsOn)
		end
	end
	function OBJ.setMaster(v)
		OBJ.master = v and true or false
		if not OBJ.master then
			clearRegAll()
			scannedMasterFor = nil
		else
			pcall(ensureConns)
		end
		rescanAll()
		syncObjActiveState()
	end
	function OBJ.setItems(v)
		OBJ.itemsOn = v and true or false
		if not OBJ.itemsOn then
			clearItemsAll()
			scannedItemsFor = nil
		else
			pcall(ensureConns)
		end
		rescanAll()
		syncObjActiveState()
	end
	local OBJ_TYPE_MAP = {
		["Graffiti"] = "Graffiti",
		["Taph Traps"] = "TaphTrap",
		["Rituals"] = "Ritual",
		["Builderman"] = "Builderman",
		["Azure Traps"] = "AzureTrap",
	}
	function OBJ.setType(k, v)
		local want = v and true or false
		local was = OBJ.perType[k]
		OBJ.perType[k] = want
		if OBJ.master and want and not was then
			scannedMasterFor = nil
			pcall(ensureConns)
		end
		rescanAll()
	end
	function OBJ.setTypes(o)
		local sel = {}
		if type(o) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(o) do
				if type(k) == "number" and type(v) == "string" then sel[v] = true
				elseif v == true and type(k) == "string" then sel[k] = true end
			end
		end
		local needEnsure = false
		for label, internalKey in pairs(OBJ_TYPE_MAP) do
			local want = (sel[label] == true or sel[internalKey] == true)
			local was = OBJ.perType[internalKey]
			OBJ.perType[internalKey] = want
			if OBJ.master and want and not was then
				needEnsure = true
			end
		end
		if needEnsure then
			scannedMasterFor = nil
			pcall(ensureConns)
		end
		rescanAll()
	end
	function OBJ.setTags(v)
		OBJ.tagsOn = v and true or false
		setTagLoop(OBJ.tagsOn and (OBJ.master or OBJ.itemsOn))
		rescanAll()
	end
	function OBJ.setAzure(v)
		OBJ.azureRadius = v and true or false
		rescanAll()
	end
	function OBJ.setColor(k, c)
		OBJ.colors[k] = c
		rescanAll()
	end
	OBJ.syncOpacity = rescanAll
	function OBJ.shutdown()
		stopObjSupLoop()
		setTagLoop(false)
		clearRegAll()
		clearItemsAll()
		detachConns()
		ingame = nil
		scannedMasterFor = nil
		scannedItemsFor = nil
	end
end


-- [NERG-ITEM-MAP] Dedicated Map Items ESP (Brandon Graffiti/Bottle, Hotel Fruits)
do
	local ITEM_MAP = {
		master = false,
		graffiti = false,
		fruits = false,
		candy = false,
		pumpkin = false,
		showDist = false,
	}
	rawset(_G, "NERG_ITEM_MAP", ITEM_MAP)

	local ITEM_META = {
		["Blueberries"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255), icon = "🫐", name = "Blueberries" },
		["Cherries"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 70), icon = "🍒", name = "Cherries" },
		["Grapes"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 70, 240), icon = "🍇", name = "Grapes" },
		["Lemons"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 50), icon = "🍋", name = "Lemons" },
		["Mangos"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 30), icon = "🥭", name = "Mangos" },
		["Oranges"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0), icon = "🍊", name = "Oranges" },
		["Passionfruits"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 180), icon = "🍈", name = "Passionfruits" },
		["Watermelons"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 220, 90), icon = "🍉", name = "Watermelons" },
		["Fruit"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0), icon = "🍎", name = "Fruit" },
		["Wipe"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180), icon = "🧼", name = "Wipe" },
		["Spray Bottle"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255), icon = "🧴", name = "Spray Bottle" },
		["C00lCandy"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 190), icon = "🍬", name = "Candy" },
		["Pumpkin"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 20), icon = "🎃", name = "Pumpkin" },
	}

	local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
	local players = game:GetService("Players")

	local activeEntries = {}
	local mapConns = {}
	local heartbeatConn = nil
	local accTime = 0

	local function getTargetPart(inst)
		return _G.NERG_OBJ and _G.NERG_OBJ.baseOf and _G.NERG_OBJ.baseOf(inst) or nil
	end

	local function isEntryStillValid(inst, rec)
		if not (inst and inst.Parent and inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
			return false
		end
		local kind = rec and rec.kind
		if kind == "graffiti" then
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Transparency >= 0.98 then
				return false
			end
			local prompt = (rec.prompt and rec.prompt.Parent and rec.prompt:IsDescendantOf(inst)) and rec.prompt or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if rec then rec.prompt = prompt end
			if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled or prompt.ActionText ~= "Wipe" then
				return false
			end
			return true
		elseif kind == "bottle" then
			local p = inst.Parent
			return p ~= nil and p.Name == "BottleSpawns"
		elseif kind == "fruit" then
			local p = inst.Parent
			return p ~= nil and p.Name == "OrangeFruits"
		elseif kind == "candy" then
			local p = inst.Parent
			return p ~= nil and p.Name == "CurrencySpawns"
		elseif kind == "pumpkin" then
			return inst:FindFirstAncestor("PUMPKINS_SPAWNERS") ~= nil
		end
		return true
	end

	local pendingRootConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local trackedIngame, trackedSubMap = nil, nil
	local refreshItemMapEntries

	local function clearPendingRootProp(inst)
		local c = pendingRootConns[inst]
		if c then
			pendingRootConns[inst] = nil
			pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
		end
	end

	local function clearAllPendingRootConns()
		for inst, c in pairs(pendingRootConns) do
			pendingRootConns[inst] = nil
			pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
		end
	end

	local function clearRecord(inst)
		clearPendingRootProp(inst)
		local rec = activeEntries[inst]
		if not rec then return end
		if rec.conn then pcall(function() rec.conn:Disconnect() end) end
		if rec.extraConns then
			for i = #rec.extraConns, 1, -1 do
				local c = rec.extraConns[i]
				rec.extraConns[i] = nil
				pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
			end
		end
		if rec.hl then pcall(function() rec.hl:Destroy() end) end
		if rec.bb then pcall(function() rec.bb:Destroy() end) end
		activeEntries[inst] = nil
	end

	local function createAdornment(inst, metaKey, kind)
		if activeEntries[inst] then return end
		if kind == "graffiti" and inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Transparency >= 0.98 then return end
		local part = getTargetPart(inst)
		if kind == "candy" or kind == "pumpkin" then
			local root = inst:FindFirstChild("Root")
			if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then part = root end
		end
		if not part then return end

		local meta = ITEM_META[metaKey] or { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0), icon = "✨", name = metaKey }
		local color = meta.color
		local name = meta.name
		local icon = meta.icon
		local baseText = string.format("%s %s", icon, name)

		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = "NP_MapItemHL"
		hl.Adornee = (inst:IsA("Tool") and part) or inst
		hl.FillColor = color
		hl.FillTransparency = espT(0.82)
		hl.OutlineColor = color
		hl.OutlineTransparency = espT(0.55)
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Enabled = false
		hl.Parent = inst

		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Name = "NP_MapItemBB"
		bb.Adornee = part
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 22)
		bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		bb.MaxDistance = 260

		local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		tl.Name = "CardLabel"
		tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		tl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
		tl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
		tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		tl.TextScaled = false
		tl.TextSize = 11
		tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
		tl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		tl.Text = baseText

		local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		uiScale.Name = "DistScale"
		uiScale.Scale = 0.85
		uiScale.Parent = tl

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
		corner.Parent = tl

		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = color
		stroke.Thickness = 1
		stroke.Transparency = 0.35
		stroke.Parent = tl

		tl.Parent = bb
		bb.Parent = inst

		local extraConns = {}
		local prompt = (kind == "graffiti") and inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or nil
		local rec = {
			inst = inst,
			part = part,
			name = name,
			icon = icon,
			baseText = baseText,
			color = color,
			kind = kind,
			hl = hl,
			bb = bb,
			tl = tl,
			scale = uiScale,
			_lastScale = 0.85,
			_lastDistM = nil,
			_showingDist = false,
			prompt = prompt,
			extraConns = extraConns,
		}

		local function checkNow()
			if activeEntries[inst] and not isEntryStillValid(inst, rec) then
				clearRecord(inst)
			end
		end

		rec.conn = inst.AncestryChanged:Connect(checkNow)
		if kind == "graffiti" then
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				extraConns[#extraConns + 1] = inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(checkNow)
			end
			if prompt then
				extraConns[#extraConns + 1] = prompt.AncestryChanged:Connect(checkNow)
				extraConns[#extraConns + 1] = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(checkNow)
				extraConns[#extraConns + 1] = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ActionText"):Connect(checkNow)
				extraConns[#extraConns + 1] = prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
					task.defer(checkNow)
				end)
			end
		end

		activeEntries[inst] = rec
	end

	-- [HW] Global Map-Item Highlight cap (HW_HL_CAP = 6 across all activeEntries)
	local HW_HL_CAP = 6
	local hwList = {}
	local lastKiller = nil

	local function hwByDist(a, b)
		return a.dist < b.dist
	end

	local function imIsKiller()
		local lp = players.LocalPlayer
		local ch = lp and lp.Character
		local par = ch and ch.Parent
		return par ~= nil and par.Name == "Killers"
	end

	local function hwKindOf(inst)
		if not inst:IsA("Model") then return nil end
		local nm = inst.Name
		if nm == "C00lCandy" then
			local p = inst.Parent
			if p and p.Name == "CurrencySpawns" then return "candy" end
		elseif nm == "Pumpkin" then
			if inst:FindFirstAncestor("PUMPKINS_SPAWNERS") then return "pumpkin" end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function hwTry(inst)
		if not ITEM_MAP.master or activeEntries[inst] or not inst.Parent then return end
		local kind = hwKindOf(inst)
		if kind == "candy" then
			if not ITEM_MAP.candy or imIsKiller() then return end
		elseif kind == "pumpkin" then
			if not ITEM_MAP.pumpkin or not imIsKiller() then return end
		else
			return
		end
		if inst:FindFirstChild("Root") then
			clearPendingRootProp(inst)
			createAdornment(inst, kind == "candy" and "C00lCandy" or "Pumpkin", kind)
			if refreshItemMapEntries then refreshItemMapEntries() end
			return
		end
		if pendingRootConns[inst] then return end
		local c
		c = inst.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
			if ch.Name == "Root" then
				clearPendingRootProp(inst)
				task.defer(hwTry, inst)
			end
		end)
		pendingRootConns[inst] = c
	end

	refreshItemMapEntries = function()
		local lp = players.LocalPlayer
		local char = lp and lp.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myPos = hrp and hrp.Position
		if not myPos then
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			myPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
		end
		table.clear(hwList)

		for inst, rec in pairs(activeEntries) do
			if not isEntryStillValid(inst, rec) then
				clearRecord(inst)
			else
				local part = rec.part
				if not part or not part.Parent then
					part = getTargetPart(inst)
					rec.part = part
					if rec.bb then rec.bb.Adornee = part end
				end
				if part and rec.tl then
					local d = myPos and (part.Position - myPos).Magnitude or nil
					rec.dist = d or math.huge
					if d == nil or d <= 180 then
						hwList[#hwList + 1] = rec
					elseif rec.hl and rec.hl.Enabled then
						rec.hl.Enabled = false
					end
					if rec.scale and d and d <= 260 then
						local newScale = math.clamp(0.90 - d / 260, 0.50, 0.90)
						if math.abs((rec._lastScale or 0) - newScale) >= 0.02 then
							rec._lastScale = newScale
							rec.scale.Scale = newScale
						end
					end
					if ITEM_MAP.showDist and d then
						local distM = math.floor(d + 0.5)
						if rec._lastDistM ~= distM or not rec._showingDist then
							rec._lastDistM = distM
							rec._showingDist = true
							rec.tl.Text = string.format("%s [%dm]", rec.baseText, distM)
						end
					elseif rec._showingDist then
						rec._showingDist = false
						rec._lastDistM = nil
						rec.tl.Text = rec.baseText
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local nHw = #hwList
		if nHw > 0 then
			if nHw > HW_HL_CAP then table.sort(hwList, hwByDist) end
			for i = 1, nHw do
				local hwHl = hwList[i].hl
				local hwWant = i <= HW_HL_CAP
				if hwHl and hwHl.Enabled ~= hwWant then hwHl.Enabled = hwWant end
			end
			table.clear(hwList)
		end
	end

	local function scanItems()
		if not (ITEM_MAP.master and (ITEM_MAP.graffiti or ITEM_MAP.fruits or ITEM_MAP.candy or ITEM_MAP.pumpkin)) then
			for inst in pairs(activeEntries) do
				clearRecord(inst)
			end
			return
		end

		local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		local ingame = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
		trackedIngame = ingame
		if not ingame then
			trackedSubMap = nil
			for inst in pairs(activeEntries) do
				clearRecord(inst)
			end
			return
		end

		local currentMap = ingame:FindFirstChild("Map")
		trackedSubMap = currentMap
		if not currentMap then return end

		if ITEM_MAP.master and ITEM_MAP.graffiti then
			local graffitiFolder = currentMap:FindFirstChild("Graffiti")
			if graffitiFolder then
				for _, child in ipairs(graffitiFolder:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Transparency < 0.98 then
						local prompt = child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
						if prompt and prompt.Enabled and prompt.ActionText == "Wipe" then
							createAdornment(child, "Wipe", "graffiti")
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local bottleSpawns = currentMap:FindFirstChild("BottleSpawns")
			if bottleSpawns then
				for _, child in ipairs(bottleSpawns:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") or child.Name:find("SprayBottle") then
						createAdornment(child, "Spray Bottle", "bottle")
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for inst, rec in pairs(activeEntries) do
				if rec.kind == "graffiti" or rec.kind == "bottle" then
					clearRecord(inst)
				end
			end
		end

		if ITEM_MAP.master and ITEM_MAP.fruits then
			local fruitsFolder = currentMap:FindFirstChild("OrangeFruits")
			if fruitsFolder then
				for _, child in ipairs(fruitsFolder:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
						createAdornment(child, child.Name, "fruit")
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for inst, rec in pairs(activeEntries) do
				if rec.kind == "fruit" then
					clearRecord(inst)
				end
			end
		end

		local killerNow = imIsKiller()
		lastKiller = killerNow
		if ITEM_MAP.master and ITEM_MAP.candy and not killerNow then
			local candyFolder = currentMap:FindFirstChild("CurrencySpawns")
			if candyFolder then
				for _, child in ipairs(candyFolder:GetChildren()) do
					hwTry(child)
				end
			end
		else
			for inst, rec in pairs(activeEntries) do
				if rec.kind == "candy" then
					clearRecord(inst)
				end
			end
		end

		if ITEM_MAP.master and ITEM_MAP.pumpkin and killerNow then
			local pumpkinFolder = currentMap:FindFirstChild("PUMPKINS_SPAWNERS")
			if pumpkinFolder then
				for _, d in ipairs(pumpkinFolder:GetDescendants()) do
					if d.Name == "Pumpkin" then
						hwTry(d)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for inst, rec in pairs(activeEntries) do
				if rec.kind == "pumpkin" then
					clearRecord(inst)
				end
			end
		end

		refreshItemMapEntries()
	end

	local function hookMapEvents()
		for _, c in ipairs(mapConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		table.clear(mapConns)
		clearAllPendingRootConns()

		local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		local ingame = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
		trackedIngame = ingame
		trackedSubMap = ingame and ingame:FindFirstChild("Map") or nil
		if not ingame then return end

		table.insert(mapConns, ingame.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
			local hwNm = d.Name
			if hwNm == "C00lCandy" or hwNm == "Pumpkin" then
				if ITEM_MAP.master and (ITEM_MAP.candy or ITEM_MAP.pumpkin) then
					task.defer(hwTry, d)
				end
				return
			end
			if not (ITEM_MAP.master and (ITEM_MAP.graffiti or ITEM_MAP.fruits)) then return end
			local p = d.Parent
			local pName = p and p.Name or ""
			local isCand = d:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
				or pName == "BottleSpawns"
				or pName == "OrangeFruits"
				or d.Name == "Mouth"
				or d.Name:find("SprayBottle") ~= nil
			if not isCand then return end
			task.defer(function()
				if not d.Parent then return end
				if ITEM_MAP.graffiti then
					if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled and d.ActionText == "Wipe" and d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and d.Parent.Transparency < 0.98 then
						createAdornment(d.Parent, "Wipe", "graffiti")
					elseif (d:IsA("Tool") or d.Name:find("SprayBottle")) and d:IsDescendantOf(ingame) then
						local p2 = d.Parent
						if p2 and p2.Name == "BottleSpawns" then
							createAdornment(d, "Spray Bottle", "bottle")
						end
					end
				end
				if ITEM_MAP.fruits then
					local p2 = d.Parent
					if p2 and p2.Name == "OrangeFruits" then
						createAdornment(d, d.Name, "fruit")
					end
				end
				refreshItemMapEntries()
			end)
		end))

		table.insert(mapConns, ingame.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d)
			clearPendingRootProp(d)
			if activeEntries[d] then
				clearRecord(d)
			end
		end))
	end

	local function updateLoop(dt)
		if _G.__NERG_KILLED or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE then
			ITEM_MAP.shutdown()
			return
		end

		if not ITEM_MAP.master then return end

		accTime += dt
		if accTime < 0.25 then return end
		accTime = 0

		local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		local curIng = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
		local curSubMap = curIng and curIng:FindFirstChild("Map")
		local killerNow = imIsKiller()
		if curIng ~= trackedIngame then
			trackedIngame = curIng
			trackedSubMap = curSubMap
			lastKiller = killerNow
			hookMapEvents()
			scanItems()
			return
		elseif curSubMap ~= trackedSubMap or killerNow ~= lastKiller then
			trackedSubMap = curSubMap
			lastKiller = killerNow
			scanItems()
			return
		end

		refreshItemMapEntries()
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.setMaster(v)
		ITEM_MAP.master = v and true or false
		if ITEM_MAP.master then
			hookMapEvents()
			scanItems()
			if not heartbeatConn then
				heartbeatConn = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(updateLoop)
			end
		else
			for _, c in ipairs(mapConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
			table.clear(mapConns)
			clearAllPendingRootConns()
			trackedIngame, trackedSubMap = nil, nil
			for inst in pairs(activeEntries) do clearRecord(inst) end
			if heartbeatConn then
				heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
				heartbeatConn = nil
			end
		end
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.setGraffiti(v)
		ITEM_MAP.graffiti = v and true or false
		scanItems()
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.setFruits(v)
		ITEM_MAP.fruits = v and true or false
		scanItems()
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.setCandy(v)
		ITEM_MAP.candy = v and true or false
		scanItems()
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.setPumpkin(v)
		ITEM_MAP.pumpkin = v and true or false
		scanItems()
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.setShowDist(v)
		ITEM_MAP.showDist = v and true or false
		if ITEM_MAP.master then
			refreshItemMapEntries()
		end
	end

	function ITEM_MAP.syncOpacity()
		local fT, oT = espT(0.82), espT(0.55)
		for _, rec in pairs(activeEntries) do
			if rec.hl and rec.hl.Parent then
				rec.hl.FillTransparency = fT
				rec.hl.OutlineTransparency = oT
			end
		end
	end

	local mapWatchConn = nil
	function ITEM_MAP.shutdown()
		if heartbeatConn then
			pcall(function() heartbeatConn:Disconnect() end)
			heartbeatConn = nil
		end
		if mapWatchConn then
			pcall(function() mapWatchConn:Disconnect() end)
			mapWatchConn = nil
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(mapConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		table.clear(mapConns)
		clearAllPendingRootConns()
		trackedIngame, trackedSubMap = nil, nil
		for inst in pairs(activeEntries) do clearRecord(inst) end
		table.clear(activeEntries)
	end

	local function checkMapIngame()
		local mapF = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		if mapF then
			if mapWatchConn then mapWatchConn:Disconnect() end
			mapWatchConn = mapF.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
				if c.Name == "Ingame" and ITEM_MAP.master then
					task.wait(1)
					if not (ITEM_MAP.master and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
					hookMapEvents()
					scanItems()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	pcall(checkMapIngame)
end


-- [NERG-B2/r17] Projectile landing-marker (doc-module-game · defensive · poll-0.5s · tu-huy KILLALL)
do
	local P = { on = false, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) }
	rawset(_G, "NERG_PROJ", P)
	local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
	local m1, m2 = nil, nil
	local markers = {}
	local projFolder = nil

	local function ensureProjFolder()
		if projFolder and projFolder.Parent then return projFolder end
		projFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("NergProjLines")
		if not projFolder then
			projFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			projFolder.Name = "NergProjLines"
			projFolder.Parent = workspace
		end
		return projFolder
	end

	local function clearAll()
		for id, entry in pairs(markers) do
			if type(entry) == "table" and entry.part then
				pcall(function() entry.part:Destroy() end)
			end
			markers[id] = nil
		end
	end

	local function ensureMods()
		if m1 and m2 then return true end
		local ok1, r1 = pcall(function() return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Systems.Player.Game.ProjectileReplication) end)
		local ok2, r2 = pcall(function() return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Gameplay.PredictProjectile) end)
		if ok1 and type(r1) == "table" and type(r1.Projectiles) == "table" then m1 = r1 end
		if ok2 and type(r2) == "table" and type(r2.FindLeadShot) == "function" then m2 = r2 end
		return m1 ~= nil
	end

	local projRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	projRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	projRayParams.IgnoreWater = true
	projRayParams.RespectCanCollide = true
	local projFilter = {}
	local lastProjPf, lastProjFolder, lastProjCam = nil, nil, nil

	local function refreshProjRayFilter()
		local pf = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
		local f = ensureProjFolder()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if pf ~= lastProjPf or f ~= lastProjFolder or cam ~= lastProjCam then
			lastProjPf, lastProjFolder, lastProjCam = pf, f, cam
			table.clear(projFilter)
			if pf then projFilter[#projFilter + 1] = pf end
			if f then projFilter[#projFilter + 1] = f end
			if visFolder then projFilter[#projFilter + 1] = visFolder end
			if a742pFolder then projFilter[#projFilter + 1] = a742pFolder end
			if cam then projFilter[#projFilter + 1] = cam end
			projRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = projFilter
		end
	end

	local function landingOf(p)
		local cf = p.InitialCFrame
		local vel = p.InitialVelocity
		if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(vel) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
		local pos = cf.Position
		local g = math.abs(tonumber(p.Gravity) or 0)
		refreshProjRayFilter()
		local prev = pos
		local steps = 18
		local maxT = math.clamp(tonumber(p.Lifetime) or 5.5, 4.0, 7.0)
		for i = 1, steps do
			local t = (i / steps) * maxT
			local nxt = pos + vel * t - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * g * t * t, 0)
			local seg = nxt - prev
			if seg.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(prev, seg, projRayParams)
				if hit then
					return hit.Position
				end
			end
			prev = nxt
		end
		return prev
	end

	local function projPoll()
		if not P.on then return end
		if not ensureMods() then return end
		local live = m1.Projectiles
		if next(live) == nil and next(markers) == nil then return end
		local liveN = 0
		for _ in pairs(live) do liveN += 1 end
		local maxAge = tonumber(P.maxAge) or 5.0
		local nowP = os.clock()
		for id, entry in pairs(markers) do
			if live[id] == nil then
				if type(entry) == "table" and entry.part then
					pcall(function() entry.part:Destroy() end)
				end
				markers[id] = nil
			elseif type(entry) == "table" then
				local age = nowP - (entry.birth or nowP)
				if age >= maxAge then
					if entry.part then
						pcall(function() entry.part:Destroy() end)
					end
					markers[id] = false
				else
					local ratio = math.clamp(age / maxAge, 0, 1)
					local fade = ratio * ratio
					local pt = entry.part
					local ad = entry.ad
					if pt and pt.Parent then
						pt.Color = P.color
						pt.Transparency = 0.5 + (0.5 * fade)
					end
					if ad and ad.Parent then
						ad.Color3 = P.color
						ad.Transparency = 0.4 + (0.6 * fade)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for id, p in pairs(live) do
			if markers[id] == nil and type(p) == "table" then
				local land = nil
				pcall(function() land = landingOf(p) end)
				if land then
					local pos = p.InitialCFrame.Position
					local thick = 0.8
					pcall(function()
						local m = p.Model
						if m then
							if m:IsA("Model") then
								local es = m:GetExtentsSize()
								thick = math.max(es.X, es.Y)
							elseif m:IsA("BasePart") then
								thick = math.max(m.Size.X, m.Size.Y)
							end
						end
					end)
					thick = math.clamp(thick, 0.8, 6) * 1.2
					local mag = (land - pos).Magnitude
					local part = Instance.new("Part")
					part.Name = "NP_ProjLine_" .. tostring(id)
					part.Anchored = true
					part.CanCollide = false
					part.CanQuery = false
					part.CanTouch = false
					part.CastShadow = false
					part.Size = Vector3.new(thick, thick, mag)
					part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, land) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -mag / 2)
					part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					part.Color = P.color
					part.Transparency = 0.5
					pcall(function() part.Parent = ensureProjFolder() end)
					local ad = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
					ad.Size = part.Size
					ad.AlwaysOnTop = true
					ad.ZIndex = 10
					ad.Adornee = part
					ad.CFrame = CFrame.new()
					ad.Color3 = P.color
					ad.Transparency = 0.4
					ad.Parent = part
					markers[id] = { part = part, ad = ad, birth = nowP }
				end
			end
		end
		local mc = 0
		for _ in pairs(markers) do mc += 1 end
		P.dbg = { t = nowP, n = liveN, m = mc }
	end

	local projAcc = 0
	local function stopProjLoop()
		if P.hbConn then
			pcall(function() P.hbConn:Disconnect() end)
			P.hbConn = nil
		end
	end
	local function startProjLoop()
		if P.hbConn then return end
		projAcc = 0
		P.hbConn = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			if _G.__NERG_KILLED or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE then
				pcall(function() P.shutdown() end)
				return
			end
			if not P.on then
				stopProjLoop()
				return
			end
			projAcc += (dt or 0.016)
			if projAcc < 0.033 then return end
			projAcc = 0
			pcall(projPoll)
		end)
	end
	function P.set(v)
		P.on = v and true or false
		if P.on then
			startProjLoop()
		else
			stopProjLoop()
			clearAll()
		end
	end
	function P.setColor(c)
		P.color = c
	end
	function P.shutdown()
		P.on = false
		stopProjLoop()
		clearAll()
		if projFolder then
			pcall(function() projFolder:Destroy() end)
			projFolder = nil
		end
		lastProjPf, lastProjFolder, lastProjCam = nil, nil, nil
	end
end

-- [NERG-B2b/r24] Projectile WINDUP preview (VANG) — port 1:1 tu TO Cursedsaken (block tbl8 "ProjectileWindupPreview")
-- Nguon: uploads/Cursedsaken.md @3253-3745: fn14/15/16, v6-draw, v7-Cat(Nosferatu-Spire),
