-- [A747] Anti Backstab (port) — event-driven · default OFF · full cleanup
do
  local ABS_SOUND_IDS = { ["134932463887703"] = true, ["101489994047160"] = true }
  local ABS_ANIM_IDS = { ["100725497418533"] = "Stab", ["89448354637442"] = "LungeStart" }
  local ABS_MODEL_NAME = "TwoTime"

  local abs = {
    on = v2.get("a747ABOn", false) and true or false,
    showRing = v2.get("a747ABRing", false) and true or false,
    range = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a747ABRange", 27)) or 27, 10, 120),
    duration = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a747ABDur", 0.8)) or 0.8, 0.15, 2),
    locked = false,
    gui = nil,
    hits = 0,
    myCharConn = nil,
    conns = {},
    soundConns = {},
    animConns = {},
    rings = {},
  }

  local absSession
  local scanThread
  local absWatch
  local absTurn
  local absFolder
  local absFolderToken
  local absFolderConns = {}

  local function absIsKiller()
    local ch = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
    local p = ch and ch.Parent
    return p ~= nil and p.Name == "Killers" and ch:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
  end

  local function absTarget(model)
    local pl = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sv = pl and pl:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    return sv ~= nil and sv:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and model ~= nil
      and model:IsA("Model") and model.Parent == sv
      and (model.Name == ABS_MODEL_NAME or model:GetAttribute("CharacterName") == ABS_MODEL_NAME)
  end

  local function absLive(session)
    return session ~= nil and absSession == session and abs.on
      and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
      and localPlayer.Character == session.char and absIsKiller()
  end

  local function absTrack(c)
    if c then abs.conns[#abs.conns + 1] = c end
    return c
  end

  local function absDropTargets()
    absFolderToken = nil
    for _, c in ipairs(absFolderConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(absFolderConns)
    absFolder = nil
    for _, c in pairs(abs.animConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    for _, c in pairs(abs.soundConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
  end

  local function absDropConns()
    absWatch = nil
    if abs.myCharConn then
      pcall(function() abs.myCharConn:Disconnect() end)
      abs.myCharConn = nil
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(abs.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(abs.conns)
    absDropTargets()
  end

  local function absGui()
    if abs.gui and abs.gui.Parent then return abs.gui end
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return nil end
    abs.gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    abs.gui.Name = "NergAbsGui"
    abs.gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    abs.gui.DisplayOrder = 5
    abs.gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    abs.gui.Parent = pg
    return abs.gui
  end

  local function absLabel(show)
    pcall(function()
      local g = absGui()
      if not g then return end
      local lbl = g:FindFirstChild("AbsTaunt")
      if not lbl then
        lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Name = "AbsTaunt"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 50)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.34, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = "At least they tried"
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = 34
        lbl.TextTransparency = 1
        lbl.Parent = g
      end
      tweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(show and 0.15 or 0.5), { TextTransparency = show and 0 or 1 }):Play()
    end)
  end

  local function absRing(model)
    if not abs.on or not abs.showRing or not absIsKiller() then return end
    if abs.rings[model] or not model or not model.Parent then return end
    if not players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return end
    local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local ring = Instance.new("Part")
    ring.Name = "NergAbsRing"
    ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, abs.range * 2, abs.range * 2)
    ring.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50)
    ring.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
    ring.Transparency = 0.5
    ring.Anchored = false
    ring.CanCollide = false
    ring.CanTouch = false
    ring.CanQuery = false
    ring.CastShadow = false
    ring.Massless = true
    ring.Locked = true
    ring.Parent = hrp
    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    w.Part0 = hrp
    w.Part1 = ring
    w.Parent = ring
    abs.rings[model] = ring
  end

  local function absRingOff(model)
    local r = abs.rings[model]
    if r then pcall(function() r:Destroy() end) end
    abs.rings[model] = nil
  end

  local function absRingsClear()
    for m in pairs(abs.rings) do absRingOff(m) end
  end

  local function absRingsResize()
    for _, r in pairs(abs.rings) do
      if r and r.Parent then r.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, abs.range * 2, abs.range * 2) end
    end
  end

  local function absNearestModel(pos, limit)
    if not pos then return nil end
    local pl = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sv = pl and pl:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    if not sv then return nil end
    local best, bestD = nil, limit or 14
    for _, model in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do
      if absTarget(model) then
        local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
          local d = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
          if d < bestD then best, bestD = model, d end
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end

  local function absFindModel(pos)
    if typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then return absNearestModel(pos) end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    return hrp and absNearestModel(hrp.Position, abs.range) or nil
  end

  local absCatalogBuilt = false
  local function absHarvestCatalog()
    if absCatalogBuilt then return end
    absCatalogBuilt = true
    pcall(function()
      local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      if not assets then return end
      local function extractIds(val, outTbl, tagVal, depth)
        if (depth or 0) > 3 or val == nil then return end
        if type(val) == "string" or type(val) == "number" then
          local num = tostring(val):match("%d+")
          if num then outTbl[num] = tagVal end
        elseif typeof(val) == "Instance" and (val:IsA("Animation") or val:IsA("Sound")) then
          local raw = val:IsA("Animation") and val.AnimationId or val.SoundId
          local num = tostring(raw):match("%d+")
          if num then outTbl[num] = tagVal end
        elseif type(val) == "table" then
          for _, subv in pairs(val) do extractIds(subv, outTbl, tagVal, (depth or 0) + 1) end
        end
      end
      local function harvestCfg(cfgMod)
        if not (cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript")) then return end
        local ok, mod = pcall(require, cfgMod)
        if not (ok and type(mod) == "table") then return end
        if type(mod.Animations) == "table" then
          for k, v in pairs(mod.Animations) do
            local kl = tostring(k):lower()
            if kl:find("stab") or kl:find("lunge") or kl:find("dagger") then
              extractIds(v, ABS_ANIM_IDS, tostring(k), 0)
            end
          end
        end
        if type(mod.Sounds) == "table" then
          for k, v in pairs(mod.Sounds) do
            local kl = tostring(k):lower()
            if kl:find("stab") or kl:find("lunge") or kl:find("dagger") then
              extractIds(v, ABS_SOUND_IDS, true, 0)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local surv = assets:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      local ttBase = surv and surv:FindFirstChild(ABS_MODEL_NAME)
      if ttBase then harvestCfg(ttBase:FindFirstChild("Config")) end
      local skins = assets:FindFirstChild("Skins")
      local sSurv = skins and skins:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      local ttSkins = sSurv and sSurv:FindFirstChild(ABS_MODEL_NAME)
      if ttSkins then
        for _, sk in ipairs(ttSkins:GetChildren()) do
          harvestCfg(sk:FindFirstChild("Config"))
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  local function absReleaseTurn()
    local turn = absTurn
    absTurn = nil
    if turn then
      if turn.thread and coroutine.running() ~= turn.thread then pcall(task.cancel, turn.thread) end
      pcall(function() a724RotUnlock(turn.hum, "abs") end)
    end
    abs.locked = false
    if abs.gui and abs.gui.Parent then absLabel(false) end
  end

  local function absTrigger(target)
    if not abs.on or abs.locked or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    if not absIsKiller() then return end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local model
    if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
      model = target
    else
      model = absFindModel(target)
    end
    if not absTarget(model) or model == ch then return end
    local ttRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not ttRoot or not ttRoot.Parent then return end
    if (myRoot.Position - ttRoot.Position).Magnitude > abs.range then return end
    local turn = { hum = hum, char = ch }
    absTurn = turn
    abs.locked = true
    abs.hits += 1
    absLabel(true)
    turn.thread = coroutine.create(function()
      pcall(function()
        if hum and hum.Parent then a724RotLock(hum, "abs") end
        local deadline = os.clock() + abs.duration
        local hp0 = hum and hum.Health
        while os.clock() < deadline and abs.on and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
          if absTurn ~= turn or localPlayer.Character ~= ch or not absIsKiller() or not absTarget(model) then break end
          local ch2 = localPlayer.Character
          local r2 = ch2 and ch2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local hum2 = ch2 and ch2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if hum2 ~= hum then break end
          if hp0 and hum2 and hum2.Health < hp0 - 0.5 then break end
          if not r2 or not ttRoot.Parent then break end
          local p2 = r2.Position
          local t2 = ttRoot.Position
          local flat = Vector3.new(t2.X - p2.X, 0, t2.Z - p2.Z)
          if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then break end
          if hum2 then a724RotLock(hum2, "abs") end
          r2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p2, Vector3.new(t2.X, p2.Y, t2.Z))
          runService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end
      end)
      if absTurn == turn then absReleaseTurn() end
    end)
    task.spawn(turn.thread)
  end

  local function absOwned(model, owner, session)
    return absLive(session) and absTarget(model) and abs.animConns[model] == owner
  end

  local function absCheckSound(snd, model, owner, session)
    if not absOwned(model, owner, session) or not snd:IsDescendantOf(model) then return end
    local ok, id = pcall(function() return snd.SoundId:match("%d+") end)
    if ok and id and ABS_SOUND_IDS[id] then absTrigger(model) end
  end

  local function absBindSound(snd, model, owner, session)
    if not absOwned(model, owner, session) then return end
    if not (snd and snd:IsA("Sound") and snd:IsDescendantOf(model)) or abs.soundConns[snd] then return end
    local cId, cPlay, cPlaying, cAnc
    local entry = { owner = owner }
    local function dropSnd()
      if abs.soundConns[snd] == entry then abs.soundConns[snd] = nil end
      if cId then pcall(function() cId:Disconnect() end) cId = nil end
      if cPlay then pcall(function() cPlay:Disconnect() end) cPlay = nil end
      if cPlaying then pcall(function() cPlaying:Disconnect() end) cPlaying = nil end
      if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
    end
    entry.Disconnect = dropSnd
    abs.soundConns[snd] = entry
    cId = snd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
      if snd.IsPlaying then absCheckSound(snd, model, owner, session) end
    end)
    cPlay = snd.Played:Connect(function() absCheckSound(snd, model, owner, session) end)
    cPlaying = snd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsPlaying"):Connect(function()
      if snd.IsPlaying then absCheckSound(snd, model, owner, session) end
    end)
    cAnc = snd.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      if not snd:IsDescendantOf(model) then dropSnd() end
    end)
    if snd.IsPlaying then absCheckSound(snd, model, owner, session) end
  end

  local function absScanSounds(model, owner, session)
    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("Sound") then absBindSound(d, model, owner, session) end
    end
  end

  local function absHookModel(model)
    local session = absSession
    if not absLive(session) or not absTarget(model) then return end
    if abs.showRing then absRing(model) else absRingOff(model) end
    if abs.animConns[model] then return end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then return end
    local owner = {}
    local cAnim, cDesc, cAnc
    owner.Disconnect = function()
      if abs.animConns[model] == owner then abs.animConns[model] = nil end
      if cAnim then pcall(function() cAnim:Disconnect() end) cAnim = nil end
      if cDesc then pcall(function() cDesc:Disconnect() end) cDesc = nil end
      if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
      for _, entry in pairs(abs.soundConns) do
        if entry.owner == owner then entry:Disconnect() end
      end
      absRingOff(model)
    end
    abs.animConns[model] = owner
    cAnim = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
      if not absOwned(model, owner, session) then return end
      local ok, aid = pcall(function() return track.Animation.AnimationId end)
      local num = ok and aid and aid:match("%d+")
      if num and ABS_ANIM_IDS[num] then absTrigger(model) end
    end)
    cDesc = model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("Sound") then task.defer(absBindSound, d, model, owner, session) end
    end)
    cAnc = model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      if not absTarget(model) then owner:Disconnect() end
    end)
    absScanSounds(model, owner, session)
  end

  local function absScanTick()
    local session = absSession
    if not absLive(session) then return end
    local pl = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sv = pl and pl:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    if absFolder ~= sv then
      absDropTargets()
      absRingsClear()
      absFolder = sv
      if sv then
        local folderToken = {}
        absFolderToken = folderToken
        absFolderConns[#absFolderConns + 1] = sv.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
          task.delay(0.15, function()
            if absLive(session) and absFolderToken == folderToken and model.Parent == sv then pcall(absHookModel, model) end
          end)
        end)
        absFolderConns[#absFolderConns + 1] = sv.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(model)
          if absFolderToken ~= folderToken or model.Parent == sv then return end
          local owner = abs.animConns[model]
          if owner then owner:Disconnect() end
          absRingOff(model)
        end)
        absFolderConns[#absFolderConns + 1] = sv.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
          if absFolderToken == folderToken and (sv.Parent ~= workspace:FindFirstChild("Players") or not sv:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
            absDropTargets()
            absRingsClear()
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    for model, owner in pairs(abs.animConns) do
      if not absTarget(model) then owner:Disconnect() end
    end
    if sv then
      for _, model in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do pcall(absHookModel, model) end
    end
    if not abs.showRing then
      absRingsClear()
    else
      for model, ring in pairs(abs.rings) do
        if not absTarget(model) or not ring.Parent or not players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then absRingOff(model) end
      end
    end
  end

  local function absStopScan()
    absSession = nil
    if scanThread then pcall(task.cancel, scanThread) scanThread = nil end
    absDropTargets()
    absRingsClear()
    absReleaseTurn()
  end

  local function absStartScan()
    local session = absSession
    if not absLive(session) or scanThread then return end
    local worker
    worker = coroutine.create(function()
      while absLive(session) do
        pcall(absScanTick)
        task.wait(1)
      end
      if scanThread == worker then scanThread = nil end
    end)
    scanThread = worker
    task.spawn(worker)
  end

  local function absSyncRole()
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not abs.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not absIsKiller() then
      absStopScan()
      return
    end
    if absSession and absSession.char == ch then absStartScan() return end
    absStopScan()
    absSession = { char = ch }
    absStartScan()
  end

  local function absBindMyChar(ch)
    if abs.myCharConn then pcall(function() abs.myCharConn:Disconnect() end) abs.myCharConn = nil end
    local watch = absWatch
    if ch then
      abs.myCharConn = ch.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if absWatch == watch and localPlayer.Character == ch then
          absStopScan()
          absSyncRole()
        end
      end)
    end
    absSyncRole()
  end

  local function absStart()
    if not abs.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    if absWatch then
      if absWatch.ready then absSyncRole() end
      return
    end
    local watch = {}
    absWatch = watch
    absHarvestCatalog()
    if absWatch ~= watch or not abs.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    watch.ready = true
    absTrack(localPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Character"):Connect(function()
      if absWatch == watch then absBindMyChar(localPlayer.Character) end
    end))
    absBindMyChar(localPlayer.Character)
  end

  local function absStop()
    abs.on = false
    absStopScan()
    absDropConns()
    pcall(function()
      if abs.gui then abs.gui:Destroy() end
      abs.gui = nil
    end)
  end

  rawset(_G, "NERG_ABS", {
    on = function() return abs.on end,
    ring = function() return abs.showRing end,
    locked = function() return abs.locked end,
    hits = function() return abs.hits end,
    range = function() return abs.range end,
    duration = function() return abs.duration end,
    rings = function()
      local n = 0
      for _ in pairs(abs.rings) do n += 1 end
      return n
    end,
    set = function(v)
      v2.set("a747ABOn", v and true or false)
      if v then abs.on = true absStart() else absStop() end
      return abs.on
    end,
    setRing = function(v)
      abs.showRing = v and true or false
      v2.set("a747ABRing", abs.showRing)
      if not abs.showRing or not abs.on or not absIsKiller() then
        absRingsClear()
      else
        pcall(absScanTick)
      end
      return abs.showRing
    end,
    setRange = function(n)
      abs.range = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or abs.range, 10, 120)
      v2.set("a747ABRange", abs.range)
      absRingsResize()
      return abs.range
    end,
    setDuration = function(n)
      abs.duration = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or abs.duration, 0.15, 2)
      v2.set("a747ABDur", abs.duration)
      return abs.duration
    end,
    stop = function() absStop() end,
    trigger = function(target) pcall(absTrigger, target) end,
    dbg = function()
      local n = 0
      for _ in pairs(abs.rings) do n += 1 end
      return string.format("on=%s ring=%s killer=%s locked=%s rings=%d range=%.0f dur=%.1f hits=%d model=%s",
        tostring(abs.on), tostring(abs.showRing), tostring(absIsKiller()), tostring(abs.locked), n, abs.range, abs.duration, abs.hits, ABS_MODEL_NAME)
    end,
  })

  -- boot purge: don rac cua lan chay truoc (thu hẹp phạm vi quét nhân vật, xóa bỏ 30.000 objects)
  pcall(function()
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local rootsToScan = { pf, localPlayer and localPlayer.Character }
    for _, root in ipairs(rootsToScan) do
      if root then
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
          if d:IsA("Part") and d.Name == "NergAbsRing" then d:Destroy() end
        end
      end
    end
    local pg0 = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg0 then
      for _, nm in ipairs({ "NergAbsGui", "AbsGui" }) do
        local old = pg0:FindFirstChild(nm)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
      end
    end
  end)

  local absSec = dodgeM1Sec.abs
  CFG_UI["AbsOn"] = absSec:AddToggle("AbsOn", {
    Text = "Anti Backstab",
    Default = abs.on,
    Callback = function(v)
      if uiBoot then return end
      pcall(function() _G.NERG_ABS.set(v) end)
    end,
  })
  CFG_UI["AbsRing"] = absSec:AddToggle("AbsRing", {
    Text = "Show Range Circle",
    Default = abs.showRing,
    Callback = function(v)
      if uiBoot then return end
      pcall(function() _G.NERG_ABS.setRing(v) end)
    end,
  })
  CFG_UI["AbsRange"] = absSec:AddSlider("AbsRange", {
    Text = "Detection Range",
    Min = 10,
    Max = 120,
    Default = abs.range,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(n)
      if uiBoot then return end
      pcall(function() _G.NERG_ABS.setRange(n) end)
    end,
  })
  CFG_UI["AbsDur"] = absSec:AddSlider("AbsDur", {
    Text = "Look Duration (s)",
    Min = 0.15,
    Max = 2.0,
    Default = abs.duration,
    Rounding = 2,
    Callback = function(n)
      if uiBoot then return end
      pcall(function() _G.NERG_ABS.setDuration(n) end)
    end,
  })

  if abs.on then task.defer(absStart) end
end

-- [A750] Auto Dodge (Slasher Raging Pace / John Doe 404 Error) — Dynamic Skin Catalog · Zero-Delay Local Animator Mount · Default OFF · Full Cleanup
do
  local autoDodge = {
    on = v2.get("a750DodgeOn", false) and true or false,
    meleeRadius = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a750DodgeMelee", 18)) or 18, 8, 30),
    chanceRadius = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a750DodgeChance", 75)) or 75, 30, 100),
    facingCheck = v2.get("a750DodgeFacing", false) and true or false,
    showNotif = v2.get("a750DodgeNotif", true) and true or false,
    debounce = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a750DodgeCd", 1.0)) or 1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    lastFired = 0,
    hits = 0,
    conns = {},
    survConns = {},
    gui = nil,
    catalogBuilt = false,
  }

  local STUN_ANIMS = {
    -- Fallback base IDs measured live (docId canon)
    ["87259391926321"] = { char = "Guest1337", skill = "Punch" },
    ["116618003477002"] = { char = "Shedletsky", skill = "Slash" },
    ["100725497418533"] = { char = "TwoTime", skill = "Stab" },
    ["89448354637442"] = { char = "TwoTime", skill = "LungeStart" },
    ["133491532453922"] = { char = "Chance", skill = "AimGun" },
    ["90499469533503"] = { char = "Chance", skill = "GunFire" },
  }

  local STUN_SOUNDS = {
    -- Fallback base sound IDs measured live
    ["133398613783505"] = { char = "Guest1337", skill = "Punch" },
    ["13471740561"] = { char = "Guest1337", skill = "CriticalPunch" },
    ["609342351"] = { char = "Guest1337", skill = "PunchWindup" },
    ["12222208"] = { char = "Shedletsky", skill = "Slash" },
    ["134932463887703"] = { char = "TwoTime", skill = "Stab" },
    ["101489994047160"] = { char = "TwoTime", skill = "CrouchStab" },
    ["139012439429121"] = { char = "Chance", skill = "GunWindUp" },
    ["121120408563206"] = { char = "Chance", skill = "GunFire" },
  }

  local function chanceMisfire(charName, key)
    if charName ~= "Chance" then return false end
    local name = tostring(key):lower()
    return name:find("fail", 1, true) ~= nil or name:find("explode", 1, true) ~= nil
      or name:find("explos", 1, true) ~= nil or name:find("reload", 1, true) ~= nil
      or name:find("click", 1, true) ~= nil
  end

  local function buildDynamicCatalog()
    if autoDodge.catalogBuilt then return end
    autoDodge.catalogBuilt = true
    pcall(function()
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local assets = rs:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      if not assets then return end

      local function extractStunIds(val, outTbl, infoObj, depth)
        if (depth or 0) > 3 or val == nil then return end
        if type(val) == "string" or type(val) == "number" then
          local num = tostring(val):match("%d+")
          if num then outTbl[num] = infoObj end
        elseif typeof(val) == "Instance" and (val:IsA("Animation") or val:IsA("Sound")) then
          local rawId = val:IsA("Animation") and val.AnimationId or val.SoundId
          local num = tostring(rawId):match("%d+")
          if num then outTbl[num] = infoObj end
        elseif type(val) == "table" then
          for key, subv in pairs(val) do
            if not chanceMisfire(infoObj.char, key) then
              extractStunIds(subv, outTbl, infoObj, (depth or 0) + 1)
            end
          end
        end
      end

      local function harvest(cfgMod, sName)
        if not (cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript")) then return end
        local ok, mod = pcall(require, cfgMod)
        if not (ok and type(mod) == "table") then return end
        if type(mod.Animations) == "table" then
          for aKey, aVal in pairs(mod.Animations) do
            local ks = tostring(aKey)
            if not chanceMisfire(sName, ks) and (ks:find("Punch") or ks:find("Slash") or ks:find("Stab") or ks:find("Lunge") or ks:find("AimGun") or ks:find("GunFire") or ks:find("Hatchet") or ks:find("Axe")) then
              extractStunIds(aVal, STUN_ANIMS, { char = sName, skill = ks }, 0)
            end
          end
        end
        if type(mod.Sounds) == "table" then
          for sKey, sVal in pairs(mod.Sounds) do
            local ks = tostring(sKey)
            if not chanceMisfire(sName, ks) and (ks:find("Punch") or ks:find("Slash") or ks:find("Stab") or ks:find("Gun") or ks:find("Hatchet") or ks:find("Axe")) then
              extractStunIds(sVal, STUN_SOUNDS, { char = sName, skill = ks }, 0)
            end
          end
        end
      end

      -- Scan base survivors (Guest1337, Shedletsky, TwoTime, Chance, JaneDoe)
      local bSurv = assets:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      if bSurv then
        for _, sName in ipairs({ "Guest1337", "Shedletsky", "TwoTime", "Chance", "JaneDoe" }) do
          local f = bSurv:FindFirstChild(sName)
          if f then harvest(f:FindFirstChild("Config"), sName) end
        end
      end

      -- Scan all skins
      local sFolder = assets:FindFirstChild("Skins") and assets.Skins:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      if sFolder then
        for _, sName in ipairs({ "Guest1337", "Shedletsky", "TwoTime", "Chance", "JaneDoe" }) do
          local charSkins = sFolder:FindFirstChild(sName)
          if charSkins then
            for _, sk in ipairs(charSkins:GetChildren()) do
              harvest(sk:FindFirstChild("Config"), sName)
            end
          end
        end
      end    end)
  end

  local function showDodgeBanner(txt)
    if not autoDodge.showNotif then return end
    pcall(function()
      local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
      if not pg then return end
      if not autoDodge.gui or not autoDodge.gui.Parent then
        autoDodge.gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        autoDodge.gui.Name = "NergDodgeGui"
        autoDodge.gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        autoDodge.gui.DisplayOrder = 6
        autoDodge.gui.Parent = pg
      end
      local f = autoDodge.gui:FindFirstChild("Banner")
      if not f then
        f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name = "Banner"
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 75)
        f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 32)
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        corner.Parent = f
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Name = "Stroke"
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.5
        stroke.Parent = f
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Name = "Text"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = 13
        lbl.Parent = f
        f.Parent = autoDodge.gui
      end
      local tLbl = f:FindFirstChild("Text")
      if tLbl then tLbl.Text = txt end
      autoDodge.bannerSeq = (autoDodge.bannerSeq or 0) + 1
      local mySeq = autoDodge.bannerSeq
      f.Visible = true
      task.delay(1.8, function()
        if autoDodge.bannerSeq == mySeq and f and f.Parent then f.Visible = false end
      end)
    end)
  end

  local function tryAutoDodge(info, sModel)
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not autoDodge.on then return end
    local myChar = localPlayer.Character
    if not (myChar and myChar.Parent and myChar.Parent.Name == "Killers") then return end
    local myHum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHum and myHum.Health > 0) then return end

    -- Determine killer ability
    local kBase = tostring(myChar:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or myChar.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
    local abilityName, payload = nil, nil
    if kBase == "Slasher" then
      abilityName = "RagingPace"
      payload = buffer.fromstring("\3\n\0\0\0RagingPace")
    elseif kBase == "JohnDoe" or kBase == "JoshDoe" then
      abilityName = "404Error"
      payload = buffer.fromstring("\3\8\0\0\000404Error")
    else
      return
    end

    -- Debounce
    local nowT = os.clock()
    if nowT - autoDodge.lastFired < autoDodge.debounce then return end

    -- Cooldown check via UI
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local mu = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MainUI")
    local ac = mu and mu:FindFirstChild("AbilityContainer")
    local btn = ac and ac:FindFirstChild(abilityName)
    local cdLbl = btn and btn:FindFirstChild("CooldownTime")
    if cdLbl and cdLbl:IsA("TextLabel") then
      local cdTxt = cdLbl.Text
      if cdTxt ~= "" and cdTxt ~= "0" and cdTxt ~= "0.0" then
        local cdVal = tonumber(cdTxt:match("[%d%.]+"))
        if not cdVal or cdVal > 0 then return end
      end
    end

    -- Range check
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local sRoot = sModel and sModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (myRoot and sRoot) then return end

    local dist = (myRoot.Position - sRoot.Position).Magnitude
    local isChance = (info.char == "Chance" or (info.skill and info.skill:find("Gun")))
    local maxDist = isChance and autoDodge.chanceRadius or autoDodge.meleeRadius
    if dist > maxDist then return end

    -- Facing check (optional)
    if autoDodge.facingCheck then
      local toKiller = (myRoot.Position - sRoot.Position).Unit
      local look = sRoot.CFrame.LookVector
      if look:Dot(toKiller) < 0.15 then return end
    end

    -- Fire ability
    autoDodge.lastFired = nowT
    autoDodge.hits += 1
    if remoteEvent then
      remoteEvent:FireServer("UseActorAbility", { [1] = payload })
    end

    if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) then
      print(string.format("[NERG] ★ AutoDodge fired: %s vs %s %s (dist=%.1f)", abilityName, tostring(info.char), tostring(info.skill), dist))
    end
    showDodgeBanner(string.format("★ Auto Dodge: %s vs %s (%s)", abilityName, tostring(info.char), tostring(info.skill)))
  end

  local dodgeSession
  local dodgeScanThread
  local dodgeWatch
  local dodgeCharConn
  local dodgeRoleConn
  local hookedSvFolder
  local dodgeFolderToken
  local dodgeBootPending = true

  local function dodgeIsKiller()
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    return ch ~= nil and ch.Parent ~= nil and ch.Parent.Name == "Killers" and ch:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
  end

  local function dodgeLive(session)
    return session ~= nil and dodgeSession == session and autoDodge.on
      and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
      and localPlayer.Character == session.char and dodgeIsKiller()
  end

  local function dodgeTarget(model)
    local pl = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sv = pl and pl:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    return sv ~= nil and sv:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and model ~= nil
      and model:IsA("Model") and model.Parent == sv
  end

  local function unhookSurvivor(model)
    local conns = autoDodge.survConns[model]
    autoDodge.survConns[model] = nil
    if conns then
      for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    end
  end

  local function hookSurvivor(model)
    local session = dodgeSession
    if not dodgeLive(session) or not dodgeTarget(model) or autoDodge.survConns[model] then return end
    local conns = {}
    autoDodge.survConns[model] = conns
    local function owned()
      return dodgeLive(session) and dodgeTarget(model) and autoDodge.survConns[model] == conns
    end
    local sndConns = {}
    conns[#conns + 1] = {
      Disconnect = function()
        for _, dropFn in pairs(sndConns) do pcall(dropFn) end
      end,
    }
    local function checkSound(d)
      if not owned() or not d:IsDescendantOf(model) then return end
      local num = d.SoundId and tostring(d.SoundId):match("%d+")
      if num and STUN_SOUNDS[num] then tryAutoDodge(STUN_SOUNDS[num], model) end
    end
    local function bindSurvSound(d)
      if not owned() or not (d and d:IsA("Sound") and d:IsDescendantOf(model)) or sndConns[d] then return end
      local cPlay, cPlaying, cId, cAnc
      local function dropSnd()
        sndConns[d] = nil
        if cPlay then pcall(function() cPlay:Disconnect() end) cPlay = nil end
        if cPlaying then pcall(function() cPlaying:Disconnect() end) cPlaying = nil end
        if cId then pcall(function() cId:Disconnect() end) cId = nil end
        if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
      end
      sndConns[d] = dropSnd
      cPlay = d.Played:Connect(function() checkSound(d) end)
      cPlaying = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsPlaying"):Connect(function()
        if d.IsPlaying then checkSound(d) end
      end)
      cId = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
        if d.IsPlaying then checkSound(d) end
      end)
      cAnc = d.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if not d:IsDescendantOf(model) then dropSnd() end
      end)
      if d.IsPlaying then checkSound(d) end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("Sound") then bindSurvSound(d) end
    end
    conns[#conns + 1] = model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("Sound") then task.defer(bindSurvSound, d) end
    end)
    conns[#conns + 1] = model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      if not dodgeTarget(model) and autoDodge.survConns[model] == conns then unhookSurvivor(model) end
    end)
    local mountThread = coroutine.create(function()
      if not owned() then return end
      local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or model:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
      if not owned() or not (hum and hum.Parent == model) then return end
      local an = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5))
      if not owned() or not (an and an.Parent == hum and hum.Parent == model) then return end
      conns[#conns + 1] = an.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
        if not owned() then return end
        local aid = track and track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
        local num = aid and tostring(aid):match("%d+")
        if num and STUN_ANIMS[num] then tryAutoDodge(STUN_ANIMS[num], model) end
      end)
    end)
    conns[#conns + 1] = { Disconnect = function() pcall(task.cancel, mountThread) end }
    task.spawn(mountThread)
  end

  local function dodgeDropTargets()
    dodgeFolderToken = nil
    hookedSvFolder = nil
    for _, key in ipairs({ "svChildAdded", "svChildRemoved", "svAncestry" }) do
      local c = autoDodge.conns[key]
      autoDodge.conns[key] = nil
      if c then pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    end
    for model in pairs(autoDodge.survConns) do unhookSurvivor(model) end
  end

  local function bindDodgeSurvivorsFolder(sv)
    local session = dodgeSession
    if not dodgeLive(session) then return end
    if not (sv and sv.Parent and sv:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
      dodgeDropTargets()
      return
    end
    if hookedSvFolder ~= sv then
      dodgeDropTargets()
      hookedSvFolder = sv
      local folderToken = {}
      dodgeFolderToken = folderToken
      autoDodge.conns["svChildAdded"] = sv.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
        task.wait(0.1)
        if dodgeLive(session) and dodgeFolderToken == folderToken and model.Parent == sv then pcall(hookSurvivor, model) end
      end)
      autoDodge.conns["svChildRemoved"] = sv.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(model)
        if dodgeFolderToken == folderToken and model.Parent ~= sv then unhookSurvivor(model) end
      end)
      autoDodge.conns["svAncestry"] = sv.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if dodgeFolderToken == folderToken and (sv.Parent ~= workspace:FindFirstChild("Players") or not sv:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then dodgeDropTargets() end
      end)
    end
    for model in pairs(autoDodge.survConns) do
      if not dodgeTarget(model) then unhookSurvivor(model) end
    end
    for _, model in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do pcall(hookSurvivor, model) end
  end

  local function dodgeStopScan()
    dodgeSession = nil
    if dodgeScanThread then pcall(task.cancel, dodgeScanThread) dodgeScanThread = nil end
    dodgeDropTargets()
  end

  local function dodgeSyncRole()
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not autoDodge.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not dodgeIsKiller() then
      dodgeStopScan()
      return
    end
    if dodgeSession and dodgeSession.char == ch and dodgeScanThread then return end
    dodgeStopScan()
    local session = { char = ch }
    dodgeSession = session
    local worker
    worker = coroutine.create(function()
      while dodgeLive(session) do
        pcall(function()
          local pl = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
          bindDodgeSurvivorsFolder(pl and pl:FindFirstChild("Survivors"))
        end)
        task.wait(2.0)
      end
      if dodgeScanThread == worker then dodgeScanThread = nil end
    end)
    dodgeScanThread = worker
    task.spawn(worker)
  end

  local function dodgeBindMyChar(ch)
    if dodgeCharConn then pcall(function() dodgeCharConn:Disconnect() end) dodgeCharConn = nil end
    local watch = dodgeWatch
    if ch then
      dodgeCharConn = ch.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if dodgeWatch == watch and localPlayer.Character == ch then
          dodgeStopScan()
          dodgeSyncRole()
        end
      end)
    end
    dodgeSyncRole()
  end

  local function autoDodgeStart()
    if not autoDodge.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    if dodgeWatch then
      if dodgeWatch.ready then dodgeSyncRole() end
      return
    end
    local watch = {}
    dodgeWatch = watch
    buildDynamicCatalog()
    if dodgeWatch ~= watch or not autoDodge.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    watch.ready = true
    dodgeRoleConn = localPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Character"):Connect(function()
      if dodgeWatch == watch then dodgeBindMyChar(localPlayer.Character) end
    end)
    dodgeBindMyChar(localPlayer.Character)
  end

  local function autoDodgeStop()
    dodgeBootPending = false
    dodgeWatch = nil
    dodgeStopScan()
    if dodgeCharConn then pcall(function() dodgeCharConn:Disconnect() end) dodgeCharConn = nil end
    if dodgeRoleConn then pcall(function() dodgeRoleConn:Disconnect() end) dodgeRoleConn = nil end
    for key, c in pairs(autoDodge.conns) do
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
      autoDodge.conns[key] = nil
    end
    autoDodge.bannerSeq = (autoDodge.bannerSeq or 0) + 1
    pcall(function()
      if autoDodge.gui then autoDodge.gui:Destroy() autoDodge.gui = nil end
    end)
  end

  -- Game formula: TurnRate = VoidRushTurnSpeed * (VoidRushInitialTurnMult * ease + 1).
  local function patchSingleConfig(cfg, canonicalKey, isClone)
    if type(cfg) ~= "table" then return end
    if cfg.VoidRushTurnSpeed == nil and cfg.VoidRushDashSpeed == nil then return end
    local orig = noli.savedConfigs[cfg]
    if not orig then
      local baseCanon = noli.canonicalOrig["__BASE__"]
      local skinCanon = canonicalKey and noli.canonicalOrig[canonicalKey]
      if isClone then
        local ref = skinCanon or baseCanon
        orig = {
          turn = (ref and ref.turn) or cfg.VoidRushTurnSpeed or 1,
          mult = (ref and ref.mult) or cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnMult or 6.6,
          dur  = (ref and ref.dur)  or cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnDuration or 1.5,
          spd  = (ref and ref.spd)  or cfg.VoidRushDashSpeed or 60,
        }
      else
        orig = {
          turn = (skinCanon and skinCanon.turn) or cfg.VoidRushTurnSpeed or (baseCanon and baseCanon.turn) or 1,
          mult = (skinCanon and skinCanon.mult) or cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnMult or (baseCanon and baseCanon.mult) or 6.6,
          dur  = (skinCanon and skinCanon.dur)  or cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnDuration or (baseCanon and baseCanon.dur) or 1.5,
          spd  = (skinCanon and skinCanon.spd)  or cfg.VoidRushDashSpeed or (baseCanon and baseCanon.spd) or 60,
        }
        if canonicalKey and not noli.canonicalOrig[canonicalKey] then
          noli.canonicalOrig[canonicalKey] = orig
        end
      end
      noli.savedConfigs[cfg] = orig
    end
    local alive = __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
    if alive and (noli.rushCtrl or noli.rushAim) then
      local ratio = math.clamp((noli.turnStrength - 1.0) / 15.0, 0.0, 1.0)
      local curved = ratio ^ 1.35
      local baseTurn = (orig.turn > 1e-4) and orig.turn or 0.15
      local sustainedMult = 1.0 + curved * 6.5
      local newTurn = baseTurn * sustainedMult
      if noli.rushAim then
        newTurn = math.max(newTurn, 1.5 + curved * 6.0)
      end
      local origPeak = baseTurn * ((orig.mult or 6.6) + 1.0)
      local targetPeak = math.max(newTurn, origPeak * (1.0 + curved * 0.25))
      cfg.VoidRushTurnSpeed = newTurn
      cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnMult = math.max(0.0, (targetPeak / math.max(newTurn, 1e-4)) - 1.0)
      cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnDuration = orig.dur
    else
      cfg.VoidRushTurnSpeed = orig.turn
      cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnMult = orig.mult
      cfg.VoidRushInitialTurnDuration = orig.dur
    end

    noli.origDashSpeed = orig.spd
    if alive and noli.speedOn then
      cfg.VoidRushDashSpeed = noli.dashSpeed
    else
      cfg.VoidRushDashSpeed = orig.spd
    end
  end

  local function syncNoliConfigs()
    pcall(function()
      local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      local killers = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      local noliFolder = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Noli")
      local baseCfgMod = noliFolder and noliFolder:FindFirstChild("Config")
      if baseCfgMod and baseCfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local ok, baseCfg = pcall(require, baseCfgMod)
        if ok and type(baseCfg) == "table" then patchSingleConfig(baseCfg, "__BASE__", false) end
      end

      local chNow = localPlayer.Character
      local mySkinKey = nil
      if chNow then
        local skAttr = chNow:GetAttribute("SkinName")
        if type(skAttr) == "string" and skAttr ~= "" then
          local skins = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Skins")
          local skinKillers = skins and skins:FindFirstChild("Killers")
          local noliSkins = skinKillers and skinKillers:FindFirstChild("Noli")
          local skFolder = noliSkins and noliSkins:FindFirstChild(skAttr)
          local sCfgMod = skFolder and skFolder:FindFirstChild("Config")
          if sCfgMod and sCfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local okS, sCfg = pcall(require, sCfgMod)
            if okS and type(sCfg) == "table" then
              mySkinKey = "skin:" .. skAttr
              patchSingleConfig(sCfg, mySkinKey, false)
            end
          end
        end
      end

      if not noli.actorsMod then
        local okA, aMod = pcall(function()
          return require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Gameplay.Actors)
        end)
        if okA and type(aMod) == "table" then noli.actorsMod = aMod end
      end
      local curActors = noli.actorsMod and noli.actorsMod.CurrentActors
      if type(curActors) == "table" then
        local myActor = curActors[localPlayer]
        if type(myActor) == "table" and type(myActor.Config) == "table" then
          patchSingleConfig(myActor.Config, mySkinKey or "__BASE__", true)
        end

            patchSingleConfig(act.Config, mySkinKey or "__BASE__", true)

        patchSingleConfig(cfg)
      end

        local dashMult = sm and sm:FindFirstChild("VoidRushDash")

          dashMult.Value = targetSpd / 8
        end
      end
    end)

  local function resetPathState()
    noli.waypoints = {}
    noli.wpIdx = 1
    noli.lastPathTargetPos = nil
    noli.lastPathAt = 0
  end

  local function isNoliChar(ch)
    return ch ~= nil and ch.Parent ~= nil and (ch.Name == "Noli" or ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") == "Noli")
  end

  local function isNoliDashing(ch)
    if not isNoliChar(ch) then return false end
    if ch:GetAttribute("VoidRushState") == "Dashing" then return true end
    local sm = ch:FindFirstChild("SpeedMultipliers")
    if sm and sm:FindFirstChild("VoidRushDash") ~= nil then return true end
    return false
  end

  local function releaseAimRotLock()

      noli.savedAutoRotate = nil
      pcall(function()

      end)
    end
  end

  local function unbindAimStep()

    if noli.aimBound then
      noli.aimBound = false
      pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NergNoliRushAim") end)

      releaseAimRotLock()
    end
    noli.curDir = nil
    noli.activeSteerDir = nil
    noli.sawDashMult = false
    noli.dashStartAt = 0
    resetPathState()
