  local losFilter = {}
  local lastLosMy, lastLosTarget, lastLosCam, lastLosPf = nil, nil, nil, nil
  local function refreshLosFilter(myChar, targetChar)
    local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    if myChar ~= lastLosMy or targetChar ~= lastLosTarget or cam ~= lastLosCam or pf ~= lastLosPf then
      lastLosMy, lastLosTarget, lastLosCam, lastLosPf = myChar, targetChar, cam, pf
      table.clear(losFilter)
      if pf then losFilter[#losFilter + 1] = pf end
      if myChar then losFilter[#losFilter + 1] = myChar end
      if targetChar then losFilter[#losFilter + 1] = targetChar end
      if cam then losFilter[#losFilter + 1] = cam end
      if visFolder then losFilter[#losFilter + 1] = visFolder end
      if a742pFolder then losFilter[#losFilter + 1] = a742pFolder end
      losRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = losFilter
    end
  end

  local function hasLineOfSight(fromPos, myChar, targetChar, toPos)
    local origin = fromPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
    local dest = toPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
    local delta = dest - origin
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.5 then return true end
    refreshLosFilter(myChar, targetChar)
    local hit = workspaceService:Raycast(origin, delta, losRayParams)
    return hit == nil
  end

  local function isCorridorClear(origin, dir, dist)
    if workspaceService:Raycast(origin, dir * dist, losRayParams) ~= nil then
      return false
    end
    local sideDist = math.min(dist, 4.5)
    local rightVec = Vector3.new(-dir.Z * 1.2, 0, dir.X * 1.2)
    if workspaceService:Raycast(origin + rightVec, dir * sideDist, losRayParams) ~= nil then
      return false
    end
    if workspaceService:Raycast(origin - rightVec, dir * sideDist, losRayParams) ~= nil then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end

  local function findOpenSteerDir(fromPos, myChar, targetChar, desiredDir, maxDist)
    if not desiredDir then return nil end
    refreshLosFilter(myChar, targetChar)
    local origin = fromPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
    local checkDist = math.clamp(maxDist or 8.0, 2.5, 9.5)
    if isCorridorClear(origin, desiredDir, checkDist) then
      return desiredDir
    end
    local dx, dz = desiredDir.X, desiredDir.Z
    for i = 1, #STEER_ANGLES do
      local cs, sn = STEER_ANGLES[i][1], STEER_ANGLES[i][2]
      local cand = Vector3.new(dx * cs - dz * sn, 0, dx * sn + dz * cs)
      if isCorridorClear(origin, cand, checkDist) then
        return cand
      end
    end
    if workspaceService:Raycast(origin, desiredDir * 3.8, losRayParams) == nil then
      return desiredDir
    end
    for i = 1, #STEER_ANGLES do
      local cs, sn = STEER_ANGLES[i][1], STEER_ANGLES[i][2]
      local cand = Vector3.new(dx * cs - dz * sn, 0, dx * sn + dz * cs)
      if workspaceService:Raycast(origin, cand * 4.2, losRayParams) == nil then
        return cand
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function findNearestSurvivor(myPos, myLookFlat, myChar)
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    if not sf then return nil, nil, false end
    local bestVisChar, bestVisHrp, bestVisScore = nil, nil, math.huge
    local bestOccChar, bestOccHrp, bestOccD = nil, nil, 55
    for _, ch in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
      if ch:IsA("Model") and ch ~= localPlayer.Character and not ch:GetAttribute("Undetectable") then
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
          local tPos = hrp.Position
          local d = (tPos - myPos).Magnitude
          if d <= 150 then
            if hasLineOfSight(myPos, myChar, ch, tPos) then
              local score = d
              if myLookFlat and d > 0.5 then
                local flatTo = Vector3.new(tPos.X - myPos.X, 0, tPos.Z - myPos.Z)
                if flatTo.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                  local dot = myLookFlat:Dot(flatTo.Unit)
                  score = d * (1.0 - 0.22 * dot)
                end
              end
              if score < bestVisScore then
                bestVisScore = score
                bestVisChar = ch
                bestVisHrp = hrp
              end
            elseif d < bestOccD then
              bestOccD = d
              bestOccChar = ch
              bestOccHrp = hrp
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if bestVisChar then
      return bestVisChar, bestVisHrp, true
    end
    return bestOccChar, bestOccHrp, false
  end

  local function computePathThrottled(fromPos, toPos)
    if noli.pathBusy then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    local movedFar = (not noli.lastPathTargetPos)
      or (Vector2.new(toPos.X - noli.lastPathTargetPos.X, toPos.Z - noli.lastPathTargetPos.Z).Magnitude > 6)
    if not movedFar and (now - noli.lastPathAt) < 0.30 then return end
    noli.pathBusy = true
    task.spawn(function()
      local ok = pcall(function()
        local path = pathfindingService:CreatePath({
          AgentRadius = 2.2,
          AgentHeight = 5,
          AgentCanJump = false,
          WaypointSpacing = 3,
        })
        path:ComputeAsync(fromPos, toPos)
        if path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
          local wps = path:GetWaypoints()
          if #wps > 0 then
            local startIdx = 1
            for i = 1, #wps do
              local wp = wps[i].Position
              if Vector2.new(wp.X - fromPos.X, wp.Z - fromPos.Z).Magnitude > 3.5 then
                startIdx = i
                break
              end
            end
            noli.waypoints = wps
            noli.wpIdx = math.min(startIdx, #wps)
            noli.lastPathTargetPos = wps[#wps].Position
          else
            resetPathState()
          end
        else
          resetPathState()
        end
      end)
      if not ok then resetPathState() end
      noli.lastPathAt = os.clock()
      noli.pathBusy = false
    end)
  end

  local function flatUnit(fromPos, toPos)
    local v = Vector3.new(toPos.X - fromPos.X, 0, toPos.Z - fromPos.Z)
    if v.Magnitude < 0.25 then return nil end
    return v.Unit
  end

  local function computeHybridSteer(myHrp, myChar, targetChar, targetHrp, hasLos, allowLead)
    local myPos = myHrp.Position
    local rawTargetPos = targetHrp.Position
    local distToTarget = (rawTargetPos - myPos).Magnitude

    if hasLos then
      resetPathState()
      local aimPos = rawTargetPos
      if allowLead then
        local vel = targetHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local flatV = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        if flatV.Magnitude > 1.5 and flatV.Magnitude < 90 then
          local leadT = math.clamp(distToTarget / 65, 0.02, 0.22)
          local candPos = rawTargetPos + flatV * leadT
          if hasLineOfSight(myPos, myChar, targetChar, candPos) then
            aimPos = candPos
          end
        end
      end
      local direct = flatUnit(myPos, aimPos)
      return findOpenSteerDir(myPos, myChar, targetChar, direct, math.min(distToTarget, 8.5)) or direct
    end

    computePathThrottled(myPos, rawTargetPos)
    local wps = noli.waypoints
    if not wps or #wps == 0 then
      return findOpenSteerDir(myPos, myChar, targetChar, flatUnit(myPos, rawTargetPos), 8.0)
    end

    while noli.wpIdx < #wps do
      local wp = wps[noli.wpIdx].Position
      if Vector2.new(wp.X - myPos.X, wp.Z - myPos.Z).Magnitude < 4.2 then
        noli.wpIdx += 1
      else
        break
      end
    end

    local chosenPos = nil
    local accDist = 0
    local prevPos = myPos
    for i = noli.wpIdx, #wps do
      local wpPos = wps[i].Position
      local seg = Vector2.new(wpPos.X - prevPos.X, wpPos.Z - prevPos.Z).Magnitude
      accDist += seg
      prevPos = wpPos
      if accDist <= 11.5 and hasLineOfSight(myPos, myChar, targetChar, wpPos) then
        chosenPos = wpPos
      else
        break
      end
    end

    if not chosenPos then
      return findOpenSteerDir(myPos, myChar, targetChar, flatUnit(myPos, rawTargetPos), 8.0)
    end

    local wpDir = flatUnit(myPos, chosenPos)
    return findOpenSteerDir(myPos, myChar, targetChar, wpDir, 7.5)
  end

  local function turnRateClamp(curDir, targetDir, dt, maxRadPerSec)
    if not targetDir then return curDir end
    local tx, tz = targetDir.X, targetDir.Z
    local tMag = math.sqrt(tx * tx + tz * tz)
    if tMag < 0.001 then return curDir end
    tx, tz = tx / tMag, tz / tMag
    if not curDir or curDir.Magnitude < 0.001 then
      return Vector3.new(tx, 0, tz)
    end
    local cx, cz = curDir.X, curDir.Z
    local cMag = math.sqrt(cx * cx + cz * cz)
    if cMag < 0.001 then
      return Vector3.new(tx, 0, tz)
    end
    cx, cz = cx / cMag, cz / cMag
    local dot = math.clamp(cx * tx + cz * tz, -1, 1)
    local angle = math.acos(dot)
    local dtClamped = math.clamp(dt or 0.016, 0.002, 0.05)
    local maxTurn = math.min((maxRadPerSec or 4.5) * dtClamped, 0.85)
    if angle <= maxTurn then
      return Vector3.new(tx, 0, tz)
    end
    local sign = (cz * tx - cx * tz < -1e-5) and -1 or 1
    local stepAng = maxTurn * sign
    local cs, sn = math.cos(stepAng), math.sin(stepAng)
    return Vector3.new(cx * cs + cz * sn, 0, -cx * sn + cz * cs)
  end

  local function applyDashSteerFrame(myHrp, hum, steerDir, syncCam)
    if not (myHrp and myHrp.Parent and hum and hum.Parent and steerDir) then return end
    if noli.savedAutoRotate == nil then
      noli.savedAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
    end
    a724RotLock(hum, "noli_aim")
    hum.AutoRotate = false
    pcall(function() myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
    myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myHrp.Position, myHrp.Position + steerDir)
    local curVel = myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local flatSpd = math.sqrt(curVel.X * curVel.X + curVel.Z * curVel.Z)
    if flatSpd > 8 then
      myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(steerDir.X * flatSpd, curVel.Y, steerDir.Z * flatSpd)
    end
    hum:Move(steerDir)
    if syncCam then
      local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
      if cam then
        local camLv = cam.CFrame.LookVector
        local oldFlat = Vector3.new(camLv.X, 0, camLv.Z)
        if oldFlat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
          local focusPos = cam.Focus.Position
          local oldYawCF = CFrame.lookAt(focusPos, focusPos + oldFlat.Unit)
          local newYawCF = CFrame.lookAt(focusPos, focusPos + steerDir)
          cam.CFrame = newYawCF * oldYawCF:ToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  -- 2. On-Demand Aimbot RenderStep (Runs ONLY during Void Rush Dash at RenderPriority.Last)
  local function noliAimStep(dt)
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not noli.rushAim then
      unbindAimStep()
      return
    end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isNoliDashing(ch) then
      unbindAimStep()
      return
    end
    if (os.clock() - (noli.dashStartAt or 0)) > 6.5 then
      unbindAimStep()
      return
    end

    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
      unbindAimStep()
      return
    end

    local lv = myHrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local actualDir = Vector3.new(lv.X, 0, lv.Z)
    actualDir = (actualDir.Magnitude > 0.01) and actualDir.Unit or (noli.curDir or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
    local refDir = (noli.curDir and noli.curDir.Magnitude > 0.01) and noli.curDir.Unit or actualDir

    local tChar, tHrp, hasLos = findNearestSurvivor(myHrp.Position, refDir, ch)
    if not (tChar and tHrp) then
      noli.activeSteerDir = nil
      noli.curDir = actualDir
      releaseAimRotLock()
      return
    end

    local desiredDir = computeHybridSteer(myHrp, ch, tChar, tHrp, hasLos, noli.turnStrength >= 4.0)
    if not desiredDir then
      noli.activeSteerDir = nil
      noli.curDir = actualDir
      releaseAimRotLock()
      return
    end

    local ratio = math.clamp((noli.turnStrength - 1.0) / 15.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    local maxRadPerSec = 2.2 + (ratio ^ 1.2) * 12.0
    local dtClamped = math.clamp(dt or 0.016, 0.002, 0.05)

    local steerDir = turnRateClamp(refDir, desiredDir, dtClamped, maxRadPerSec)
    noli.curDir = steerDir
    noli.activeSteerDir = steerDir
    applyDashSteerFrame(myHrp, hum, steerDir, true)
  end

  local function bindAimStepIfDashing()
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isNoliChar(ch) then
      unbindAimStep()
      return
    end
    syncNoliConfigs()
    if noli.rushAim and isNoliDashing(ch) then
      if not noli.aimBound then
        noli.aimBound = true
        noli.dashStartAt = os.clock()
        noli.activeSteerDir = nil
        local sm = ch:FindFirstChild("SpeedMultipliers")
        noli.sawDashMult = (sm and sm:FindFirstChild("VoidRushDash") ~= nil) or false
        local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp then
          local lv0 = myHrp.CFrame.LookVector
          noli.curDir = Vector3.new(lv0.X, 0, lv0.Z).Magnitude > 0.01 and Vector3.new(lv0.X, 0, lv0.Z).Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        end
        pcall(function()
          runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NergNoliRushAim")
          runService:BindToRenderStep("NergNoliRushAim", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, noliAimStep)
        end)
        if not noli.aimSteppedConn then
          noli.aimSteppedConn = runService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not noli.aimBound or not noli.rushAim or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
            local cNow = localPlayer.Character
            if not isNoliDashing(cNow) or not noli.activeSteerDir then return end
            local hrpNow = cNow:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humNow = cNow:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hrpNow and humNow and humNow.Health > 0 then
              applyDashSteerFrame(hrpNow, humNow, noli.activeSteerDir, false)
            end
          end)
        end
      end
    else
      unbindAimStep()
    end
  end

  local noliCharSeq = 0
  local noliSmThread = nil

  local function clearCharConns()
    noliCharSeq += 1
    if noliSmThread then
      local th = noliSmThread
      noliSmThread = nil
      if coroutine.running() ~= th then
        pcall(task.cancel, th)
      end
    end
    for i = #noli.charConns, 1, -1 do
      local c = noli.charConns[i]
      noli.charConns[i] = nil
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end

  local function getMyNoliActor()
    if not noli.actorsMod then
      local okA, aMod = pcall(function()
        return require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Gameplay.Actors)
      end)
      if okA and type(aMod) == "table" then noli.actorsMod = aMod end
    end
    local curActors = noli.actorsMod and noli.actorsMod.CurrentActors
    if type(curActors) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local act = curActors[localPlayer]
    if type(act) == "table" then return act end
    for _, a in pairs(curActors) do
      if type(a) == "table" and (a.Player == localPlayer or a.Rig == localPlayer.Character) then
        return a
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function isHoldingVoidRush()
    local act = getMyNoliActor()
    local held = act and act.HeldAbilities
    if type(held) == "table" then
      return held.VoidRush == true or (held.VoidRush ~= nil and held.VoidRush ~= false)
    end
    return false
  end

  local function unbindAntiCrashStep()
    if noli.acBound then
      noli.acBound = false
      pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NergNoliAntiCrash") end)
    end
    noli.wallBlockedInDash = false
    noli.wallHugNormal = nil
    noli.wallHugTangent = nil
    noli.wallHugAt = 0
    noli.allowHeadOnCrash = false
    noli.headOnCrashUntil = 0
  end

  local function flatNormalOf(hit)
    if not hit then return nil end
    local fn = Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
    if fn.Magnitude < 0.25 then return nil end
    return fn.Unit
  end

  local function probeNoliHitboxWall(myHrp, ch)
    local now = os.clock()
    local pos = myHrp.Position
    local hrpLv = myHrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local boxLook = Vector3.new(hrpLv.X, 0, hrpLv.Z)
    boxLook = (boxLook.Magnitude > 0.01) and boxLook.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    local boxRight = Vector3.new(-boxLook.Z, 0, boxLook.X)
    local curVel = myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local curFlatVel = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
    local curFlatSpd = curFlatVel.Magnitude
    local moveDir = (curFlatSpd > 2.5) and curFlatVel.Unit or boxLook
    refreshLosFilter(ch, nil)

    if now <= (noli.headOnCrashUntil or 0) then
      return true, nil, math.huge, moveDir, boxLook, curVel, curFlatSpd
    end

    local halfW = 1.65
    local reachF = 3.2
    local originC = pos
    local originFL = pos - boxRight * halfW
    local originFR = pos + boxRight * halfW
    local hitC = workspaceService:Raycast(originC, boxLook * reachF, losRayParams)
    local hitFL = workspaceService:Raycast(originFL, boxLook * reachF, losRayParams)
    local hitFR = workspaceService:Raycast(originFR, boxLook * reachF, losRayParams)
    local nC = flatNormalOf(hitC)
    local nFL = flatNormalOf(hitFL)
    local nFR = flatNormalOf(hitFR)
    local distC = nC and (hitC.Position - originC).Magnitude or nil
    local distFL = nFL and (hitFL.Position - originFL).Magnitude or nil
    local distFR = nFR and (hitFR.Position - originFR).Magnitude or nil

    local hitMove = (curFlatSpd > 4.0) and workspaceService:Raycast(pos, moveDir * 2.8, losRayParams) or nil
    local nMove = flatNormalOf(hitMove)
    local distMove = nMove and (hitMove.Position - pos).Magnitude or nil

    local recentHug = (now - (noli.wallHugAt or 0)) <= 0.25 and noli.wallHugNormal ~= nil
    local frontNorm = nC or nFL or nFR
    local sameWallAsHug = recentHug and frontNorm ~= nil and (noli.wallHugNormal:Dot(frontNorm) >= 0.72)

    local isDirectFrontFaceCrash = false
    if not sameWallAsHug then
      if nC and distC and distC <= 2.9 and boxLook:Dot(-nC) >= 0.93 and moveDir:Dot(-nC) >= 0.78 then
        isDirectFrontFaceCrash = true
      elseif nFL and nFR and distFL and distFR and distFL <= 2.8 and distFR <= 2.8 and math.abs(distFL - distFR) <= 0.55 and boxLook:Dot(-nFL) >= 0.88 then
        isDirectFrontFaceCrash = true
      elseif recentHug and nMove and distMove and distMove <= 2.4 and (noli.wallHugNormal:Dot(nMove) < 0.35) and moveDir:Dot(-nMove) >= 0.85 then
        isDirectFrontFaceCrash = true
      end
    end
    if isDirectFrontFaceCrash then
      noli.headOnCrashUntil = now + 0.28
      noli.allowHeadOnCrash = true
      return true, nil, 0, moveDir, boxLook, curVel, curFlatSpd
    end

    local dirCL = (boxLook * 0.788 - boxRight * 0.615).Unit
    local dirCR = (boxLook * 0.788 + boxRight * 0.615).Unit
    local dirSL = (boxLook * 0.259 - boxRight * 0.966).Unit
    local dirSR = (boxLook * 0.259 + boxRight * 0.966).Unit
    local hitCL = workspaceService:Raycast(pos, dirCL * 2.35, losRayParams)
    local hitCR = workspaceService:Raycast(pos, dirCR * 2.35, losRayParams)
    local hitSL = workspaceService:Raycast(pos, dirSL * 2.15, losRayParams)
    local hitSR = workspaceService:Raycast(pos, dirSR * 2.15, losRayParams)

    local bestNormal, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    local function considerHit(h, origPos, maxAllowed)
      if not h then return end
      local fn = flatNormalOf(h)
      if not fn then return end
      local d = (h.Position - origPos).Magnitude
      if d > maxAllowed then return end
      if d < bestDist then
        bestDist = d
        bestNormal = fn
      end
    end
    considerHit(hitC, originC, 2.25)
    considerHit(hitFL, originFL, 2.20)
    considerHit(hitFR, originFR, 2.20)
    considerHit(hitCL, pos, 2.20)
    considerHit(hitCR, pos, 2.20)
    considerHit(hitSL, pos, 2.05)
    considerHit(hitSR, pos, 2.05)
    return false, bestNormal, bestDist, moveDir, boxLook, curVel, curFlatSpd
  end

  local function noliAntiCrashStep()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not noli.antiCrash then
      unbindAntiCrashStep()
      return
    end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isNoliDashing(ch) then
      unbindAntiCrashStep()
      return
    end
    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHrp then return end
    if isHoldingVoidRush() then
      local act = getMyNoliActor()
      local cfgSpd = (act and type(act.Config) == "table" and tonumber(act.Config.VoidRushDashSpeed))
        or (noli.speedOn and noli.dashSpeed)
        or noli.origDashSpeed
        or 60
      local minSpd = (cfgSpd / 3.5) + 3.5
      local isDirectFront, wallNormal, wallDist, moveDir, boxLook, curVel, curFlatSpd = probeNoliHitboxWall(myHrp, ch)

      if noli.rushAim and noli.activeSteerDir then
        if isDirectFront then
          noli.allowHeadOnCrash = true
          return
        end
        noli.allowHeadOnCrash = false
        local flat = noli.activeSteerDir
        if wallNormal and wallDist <= 2.25 and flat:Dot(-wallNormal) > 0.12 then
          local t1 = Vector3.new(-wallNormal.Z, 0, wallNormal.X)
          local t2 = -t1
          local t = (flat:Dot(t1) >= flat:Dot(t2)) and t1 or t2
          noli.activeSteerDir = t
          noli.curDir = t
          local slideFloor = math.max(minSpd + 4.5, cfgSpd * 0.62)
          local targetSpd = math.max(curFlatSpd, slideFloor)
          myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(t.X * targetSpd, curVel.Y, t.Z * targetSpd)
          return
        end
        if curVel.Magnitude <= minSpd then
          local openDir = findOpenSteerDir(myHrp.Position, ch, nil, flat, 6.5) or flat
          myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(openDir.X * (minSpd + 2.5), curVel.Y, openDir.Z * (minSpd + 2.5))
        end
        return
      end

      local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
      local camLv = (cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector) or boxLook
      local camFlat = Vector3.new(camLv.X, 0, camLv.Z)
      camFlat = (camFlat.Magnitude > 0.01) and camFlat.Unit or boxLook

      if isDirectFront then
        noli.allowHeadOnCrash = true
        noli.wallHugNormal = nil
        noli.wallHugTangent = nil
        noli.wallHugAt = 0
        return
      end
      noli.allowHeadOnCrash = false

      local now = os.clock()
      if wallNormal and wallDist <= 2.25 then
        local t1 = Vector3.new(-wallNormal.Z, 0, wallNormal.X)
        local t2 = -t1
        local score1 = moveDir:Dot(t1) * 0.55 + camFlat:Dot(t1) * 0.45
        local score2 = moveDir:Dot(t2) * 0.55 + camFlat:Dot(t2) * 0.45
        if noli.wallHugTangent and (now - (noli.wallHugAt or 0)) <= 0.25 then
          score1 = score1 + noli.wallHugTangent:Dot(t1) * 0.40
          score2 = score2 + noli.wallHugTangent:Dot(t2) * 0.40
        end
        local t = (score1 >= score2) and t1 or t2

        if camFlat:Dot(wallNormal) > 0.14 and boxLook:Dot(wallNormal) >= -0.05 then
          noli.wallHugNormal = nil
          noli.wallHugTangent = nil
          if curFlatSpd <= minSpd + 3.0 then
            local peelDir = (t * 0.65 + boxLook * 0.35)
            peelDir = (peelDir.Magnitude > 0.01) and peelDir.Unit or boxLook
            local wantSpd = math.max(curFlatSpd, minSpd + 4.5, cfgSpd * 0.62)
            local curFlat = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
            local blended = curFlat:Lerp(peelDir * wantSpd, 0.35)
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(blended.X, curVel.Y, blended.Z)
          end
          return
        end

        local pressingIntoWall = (boxLook:Dot(-wallNormal) > 0.12)
          or (moveDir:Dot(-wallNormal) > 0.08)
          or (curVel.Magnitude <= minSpd + 3.5)
        if pressingIntoWall then
          noli.wallHugNormal = wallNormal
          noli.wallHugTangent = t
          noli.wallHugAt = now
          local slideFloor = math.max(minSpd + 5.0, cfgSpd * 0.64)
          if curFlatSpd < slideFloor or moveDir:Dot(t) < 0.55 then
            local targetSpd = math.max(curFlatSpd, slideFloor)
            local curFlat = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
            local blended = curFlat:Lerp(t * targetSpd, 0.34)
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(blended.X, curVel.Y, blended.Z)
          end
          return
        end
      end

      if noli.wallHugNormal and (now - (noli.wallHugAt or 0)) <= 0.18 then
        local inwardDir = -noli.wallHugNormal
        if boxLook:Dot(inwardDir) > 0.22 and camFlat:Dot(inwardDir) > 0.18 then
          local carryDir = (boxLook * 0.75 + camFlat * 0.25)
          carryDir = (carryDir.Magnitude > 0.01) and carryDir.Unit or boxLook
          local carrySpd = math.max(curFlatSpd, minSpd + 5.5, cfgSpd * 0.68)
          local curFlat = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
          local blended = curFlat:Lerp(carryDir * carrySpd, 0.28)
          myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(blended.X, curVel.Y, blended.Z)
          return
        end
      else
        noli.wallHugNormal = nil
        noli.wallHugTangent = nil
      end

      if curVel.Magnitude <= minSpd then
        local openDir = findOpenSteerDir(myHrp.Position, ch, nil, boxLook, 5.5) or boxLook
        local curFlat = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
        local blended = curFlat:Lerp(openDir * (minSpd + 3.5), 0.40)
        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(blended.X, curVel.Y, blended.Z)
      end
    elseif noli.wallBlockedInDash then
      noli.wallBlockedInDash = false
      if noli.origFireServerConn and noli.netMod then
        pcall(function()
          if noli.netIsDot then
            noli.origFireServerConn(localPlayer.Name .. "VoidRushCollision", "REMOTE_EVENT", false)
          else
            noli.origFireServerConn(noli.netMod, localPlayer.Name .. "VoidRushCollision", "REMOTE_EVENT", false)
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end

  local function bindAntiCrashStepIfDashing()
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if noli.antiCrash and isNoliDashing(ch) then
      if not noli.acBound then
        noli.acBound = true
        noli.wallBlockedInDash = false
        noli.wallHugNormal = nil
        noli.wallHugTangent = nil
        noli.wallHugAt = 0
        noli.allowHeadOnCrash = false
        noli.headOnCrashUntil = 0
        pcall(function()
          runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NergNoliAntiCrash")
          runService:BindToRenderStep("NergNoliAntiCrash", Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, noliAntiCrashStep)
        end)
      end
    else
      unbindAntiCrashStep()
    end
  end

  local function isAnyNoliDashOn()
    return noli.rushCtrl or noli.rushAim or noli.speedOn or noli.antiCrash
  end

  local function hookNoliCharacter(ch)
    clearCharConns()
    unbindAimStep()
    unbindAntiCrashStep()
    if not ch or not isAnyNoliDashOn() then return end
    local mySeq = noliCharSeq
    task.defer(function()
      if noliCharSeq ~= mySeq or not isAnyNoliDashOn() or not (ch and ch.Parent and ch:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) and localPlayer.Character == ch and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
      if not isNoliChar(ch) then
        local waitAttrConn, waitNameConn
        local function onCharIdentityChanged()
          if noliCharSeq ~= mySeq then
            if waitAttrConn then pcall(function() waitAttrConn:Disconnect() end) waitAttrConn = nil end
            if waitNameConn then pcall(function() waitNameConn:Disconnect() end) waitNameConn = nil end
            return
          end
          if isNoliChar(ch) then
            if waitAttrConn then pcall(function() waitAttrConn:Disconnect() end) waitAttrConn = nil end
            if waitNameConn then pcall(function() waitNameConn:Disconnect() end) waitNameConn = nil end
            hookNoliCharacter(ch)
          end
        end
        waitAttrConn = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CharacterName"):Connect(onCharIdentityChanged)
        waitNameConn = ch:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(onCharIdentityChanged)
        noli.charConns[#noli.charConns + 1] = waitAttrConn
        noli.charConns[#noli.charConns + 1] = waitNameConn
        return
      end
      if noli.rushCtrl or noli.rushAim or noli.speedOn then syncNoliConfigs() end
      noli.charConns[#noli.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("VoidRushState"):Connect(function()
        if noliCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
        local st = ch:GetAttribute("VoidRushState")
        if st == "Charging" or st == "Dashing" then
          if noli.rushCtrl or noli.rushAim or noli.speedOn then syncNoliConfigs() end
        end
        bindAimStepIfDashing()
        bindAntiCrashStepIfDashing()
      end)
      noliSmThread = task.spawn(function()
        local sm = ch:FindFirstChild("SpeedMultipliers") or ch:WaitForChild("SpeedMultipliers", 5)
        if noliCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
        noliSmThread = nil
        if not (sm and ch.Parent and ch:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService) and localPlayer.Character == ch and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
        noli.charConns[#noli.charConns + 1] = sm.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
          if noliCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
          if child.Name == "VoidRushDash" then
            if noli.rushCtrl or noli.rushAim or noli.speedOn then syncNoliConfigs() end
            bindAimStepIfDashing()
            bindAntiCrashStepIfDashing()
          end
        end)
        noli.charConns[#noli.charConns + 1] = sm.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
          if noliCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
          if child.Name == "VoidRushDash" then
            bindAimStepIfDashing()
            bindAntiCrashStepIfDashing()
          end
        end)
      end)
      bindAimStepIfDashing()
      bindAntiCrashStepIfDashing()
    end)
  end

  local function syncNoliCharHook()
    if isAnyNoliDashOn() then
      if #noli.charConns == 0 and localPlayer.Character then
        hookNoliCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
      end
    else
      clearCharConns()
    end
  end

  if localPlayer.Character then hookNoliCharacter(localPlayer.Character) end
  noli.charAddedConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    clearCharConns()
    unbindAimStep()
    unbindAntiCrashStep()
    task.delay(0.6, function()
      if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and localPlayer.Character == ch then
        hookNoliCharacter(ch)
      end
    end)
  end)

  local function setAntiCrash(v)
    noli.antiCrash = v and true or false
    v2.set("a751NoliAntiCrash", noli.antiCrash)
    if noli.antiCrash then
      if not noli.hookedNet then
        pcall(function()
          local net = noli.netMod or require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Network.Network)
          if type(net) == "table" and type(net.FireServerConnection) == "function" then
            noli.netMod = net
            noli.origFireServerConn = net.FireServerConnection
            net.FireServerConnection = function(selfArg, eventName, kind, ...)
              if noli.antiCrash and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
                local isDot = (type(selfArg) == "string")
                noli.netIsDot = isDot
                local ev = isDot and selfArg or eventName
                local kd = isDot and eventName or kind
                if ev == (localPlayer.Name .. "VoidRushCollision") and kd == "REMOTE_EVENT" then
                  local held = isDot and kind or select(1, ...)
                  if v2.get("a720Telemetry", false) then
                    print(string.format("[NERG] VoidRushCollision held=%s", tostring(held)))
                  end
                  if held then
                    local allowCrash = noli.allowHeadOnCrash or (os.clock() <= (noli.headOnCrashUntil or 0))
                    if not allowCrash and not (noli.rushAim and noli.activeSteerDir) then
                      local chNow = localPlayer.Character
                      local hrpNow = chNow and chNow:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                      if hrpNow then
                        local directFront = probeNoliHitboxWall(hrpNow, chNow)
                        if directFront then allowCrash = true end
                      end
                    end
                    if allowCrash then
                      noli.wallBlockedInDash = false
                      return noli.origFireServerConn(selfArg, eventName, kind, ...)
                    end
                    noli.wallBlockedInDash = true
                    return nil
                  end
                end
              end
              return noli.origFireServerConn(selfArg, eventName, kind, ...)
            end
            noli.hookedNet = true
          end
        end)
      end
      syncNoliCharHook()
      bindAntiCrashStepIfDashing()
    else
      unbindAntiCrashStep()
      if noli.hookedNet and noli.netMod and noli.origFireServerConn then
        pcall(function()
          noli.netMod.FireServerConnection = noli.origFireServerConn
        end)
        noli.hookedNet = false
      end
      syncNoliCharHook()
    end
  end

  local function setAutoNova(v)
    noli.autoNova = v and true or false
    v2.set("a751NoliAutoNova", noli.autoNova)
    if noli.novaConn then
      pcall(function() noli.novaConn:Disconnect() end)
      noli.novaConn = nil
    end
    table.clear(noli.detonatedIds)
    noli.prevNovaDist = {}
    if not noli.autoNova then return end

    pcall(function()
      if not noli.projMod then
        noli.projMod = require(replicatedStorage.Systems.Player.Game.ProjectileReplication)
      end
    end)

    noli.novaAcc = 0
    noli.novaConn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
      if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not noli.autoNova then
        if noli.novaConn then noli.novaConn:Disconnect() noli.novaConn = nil end
        return
      end
      noli.novaAcc += (dt or 0.016)
      if noli.novaAcc < 0.033 then return end
      noli.novaAcc = 0

      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if not (ch and ch.Parent and (ch.Name == "Noli" or ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") == "Noli")) then return end

      local live = noli.projMod and noli.projMod.Projectiles
      if type(live) ~= "table" or next(live) == nil then
        if noli.prevNovaDist and next(noli.prevNovaDist) ~= nil then table.clear(noli.prevNovaDist) end
        return
      end
      local now = os.clock()
      if now - noli.lastNovaFireAt < 0.45 then return end

      local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
      local sf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      if not sf then return end

      local prevMap = noli.prevNovaDist or {}
      noli.prevNovaDist = prevMap

      for id, p in pairs(live) do
        if not noli.detonatedIds[id] and type(p) == "table" then
          local mdl = p.Model
          local isNova = false
          local pPos = nil
          if typeof(mdl) == "Instance" and mdl.Parent then
            if mdl.Name == "Voidstar" or mdl.Name:find("Voidstar") or mdl.Name:find("Nova") then
              isNova = true
              local okP, posVal = pcall(function()
                return mdl:IsA("BasePart") and mdl.Position or mdl:GetPivot().Position
              end)
              if okP then pPos = posVal end
            end
          end
          if isNova and pPos then
            local bestD = math.huge
            for _, surv in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
              if surv:IsA("Model") and not surv:GetAttribute("Undetectable") then
                local sHrp = surv:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local sHum = surv:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if sHrp and sHum and sHum.Health > 0 then
                  local d = (sHrp.Position - pPos).Magnitude
                  if d < bestD then bestD = d end
                end
              end
            end
            if bestD <= noli.novaRadius then
              local prevD = prevMap[id]
              local innerCore = noli.novaRadius * 0.65
              if bestD <= innerCore or (prevD ~= nil and bestD >= prevD - 0.08) then
                prevMap[id] = nil
                noli.detonatedIds[id] = now
                noli.lastNovaFireAt = now
                if remoteEvent then
                  remoteEvent:FireServer("UseActorAbility", { [1] = buffer.fromstring("\3\4\0\0\0Nova") })
                end
                return
              end
            end
            prevMap[id] = bestD
          end
        end
      end

      for id in pairs(prevMap) do
        if live[id] == nil then prevMap[id] = nil end
      end
      for id, t0 in pairs(noli.detonatedIds) do
        if live[id] == nil or (now - t0) > 10 then
          noli.detonatedIds[id] = nil
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  local function stopNoliSuite()
    noli.rushCtrl = false
    noli.speedOn = false
    noli.rushAim = false
    syncNoliConfigs()
    unbindAimStep()
    clearCharConns()
    if noli.charAddedConn then pcall(function() noli.charAddedConn:Disconnect() end) noli.charAddedConn = nil end
    setAntiCrash(false)
    setAutoNova(false)
  end

      nosBatsAim = v2.get("nosBatsAim", false) and true or false,
      nosSpireCtrl = v2.get("nosSpireCtrl", false) and true or false,
      nosSpireTurn = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("nosSpireTurn", 28)) or 28, 10, 50),
      nosAscentCtrl = v2.get("nosAscentCtrl", false) and true or false,
      nosDiveTurn = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("nosDiveTurn", 14)) or 14, 4, 25),
      nosAscentAim = v2.get("nosAscentAim", false) and true or false,
      nosAscentTarget = tostring(v2.get("nosAscentTarget", "Nearest to Impact") or "Nearest to Impact"),
      azAutoQTE = v2.get("azAutoQTE", false) and true or false,
      azQteDelay = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("azQteDelay", 160)) or 160, 40, 400),
      azGrabAim = v2.get("azGrabAim", false) and true or false,

    local function isLocalNosferatu(ch)
      ch = ch or localPlayer.Character
      if not (ch and ch.Parent and ch.Parent.Name == "Killers") then return false end
      local base = tostring(ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or ch.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
      return base == "Nosferatu" or base == "Nosferatwo"
    end

    local function isLocalAzure(ch)
      ch = ch or localPlayer.Character
      if not (ch and ch.Parent and ch.Parent.Name == "Killers") then return false end
      local base = tostring(ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or ch.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
      return base == "Azure"
    end

    local function getMyKillerActor()
      if not ka.actorsMod then
        local okA, aMod = pcall(function()
          return require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Gameplay.Actors)
        end)
        if okA and type(aMod) == "table" then ka.actorsMod = aMod end
      end
      local curActors = ka.actorsMod and ka.actorsMod.CurrentActors
      if type(curActors) ~= "table" then return nil end
      local myAct = curActors[localPlayer]
      if type(myAct) == "table" then return myAct end
      for _, act in pairs(curActors) do
        if type(act) == "table" and (act.Player == localPlayer or act.Rig == localPlayer.Character) then
          return act
        end
      end
      return nil
    end

    local function findNearestLivingSurvivorToPos(refPos, maxDist, originCheckPos)
      local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
      local sf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      if not (sf and refPos) then return nil end
      local bestHrp, bestD = nil, math.huge
      local capD = maxDist or 160
      for _, surv in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
        if surv:IsA("Model") and surv ~= localPlayer.Character and not surv:GetAttribute("Undetectable") then
          local sHrp = surv:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local sHum = surv:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if sHrp and sHum and sHum.Health > 0 then
            local checkD = originCheckPos and (sHrp.Position - originCheckPos).Magnitude or (sHrp.Position - refPos).Magnitude
            if checkD <= capD then
              local d = (sHrp.Position - refPos).Magnitude
              if d < bestD then
                bestD = d
                bestHrp = sHrp
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return bestHrp
    end

    -- 1. Nosferatu Direct Config Patcher (Spire.TurnControl, Ascent.CanTurn, AscentBite.TurnSpeed)
    local function patchSingleNosConfig(cfgTbl, forceRestore)
      if type(cfgTbl) ~= "table" then return end
      if type(cfgTbl.Spire) ~= "table" and type(cfgTbl.Ascent) ~= "table" and type(cfgTbl.AscentBite) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
      local orig = ka.savedNosConfigs[cfgTbl]
      if not orig then
        orig = {
          spireTurn = (type(cfgTbl.Spire) == "table" and tonumber(cfgTbl.Spire.TurnControl)) or 10,
          ascentCanTurn = (type(cfgTbl.Ascent) == "table" and cfgTbl.Ascent.CanTurn == true) or false,
          diveTurn = (type(cfgTbl.AscentBite) == "table" and tonumber(cfgTbl.AscentBite.TurnSpeed)) or 4,
        }
        ka.savedNosConfigs[cfgTbl] = orig
      end
      local alive = (not forceRestore) and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
      if type(cfgTbl.Spire) == "table" then
        if alive and ka.nosSpireCtrl then
          cfgTbl.Spire.TurnControl = math.clamp(tonumber(ka.nosSpireTurn) or 28, 10, 50)
        else
          cfgTbl.Spire.TurnControl = orig.spireTurn
        end
      end
      if type(cfgTbl.Ascent) == "table" then
        if alive and ka.nosAscentCtrl then
          cfgTbl.Ascent.CanTurn = true
        else
          cfgTbl.Ascent.CanTurn = orig.ascentCanTurn
        end
      end
      if type(cfgTbl.AscentBite) == "table" then
        if alive and ka.nosAscentCtrl then
          cfgTbl.AscentBite.TurnSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(ka.nosDiveTurn) or 14, 4, 25)
        else
          cfgTbl.AscentBite.TurnSpeed = orig.diveTurn
        end
      end
    end

    local nosCatalogHarvested = false
    local nosConfigTables = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

    local function extractNosAnimIds(val, outSet, depth)
      if (depth or 0) > 3 or val == nil then return end
      if type(val) == "string" or type(val) == "number" then
        local id = tostring(val):match("%d+")
        if id then outSet[id] = true end
      elseif typeof(val) == "Instance" and val:IsA("Animation") then
        local id = tostring(val.AnimationId):match("%d+")
        if id then outSet[id] = true end
      elseif type(val) == "table" then
        for _, v in pairs(val) do
          extractNosAnimIds(v, outSet, (depth or 0) + 1)
        end
      end
    end

    local function syncNosferatuConfigs(forceRestore)
      pcall(function()
        if not nosCatalogHarvested then
          local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
          if assets then
            local function processNosCfg(cfgMod)
              if not (cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript")) then return end
              local ok, cfg = pcall(require, cfgMod)
              if not (ok and type(cfg) == "table") then return end
              if type(cfg.Spire) == "table" or type(cfg.Ascent) == "table" or type(cfg.AscentBite) == "table" then
                nosConfigTables[cfg] = true
                patchSingleNosConfig(cfg, forceRestore)
              end
              if type(cfg.Animations) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(cfg.Animations) do
                  local kl = tostring(k):lower()
                  if kl:find("batsthrow", 1, true) then
                    extractNosAnimIds(v, ka.nosBatsThrowAnims, 0)
                  elseif kl:find("batbite", 1, true) then
                    extractNosAnimIds(v, ka.nosDiveAnims, 0)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            local killers = assets:FindFirstChild("Killers")
            local nosBase = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Nosferatu")
            if nosBase then processNosCfg(nosBase:FindFirstChild("Config")) end
            local skins = assets:FindFirstChild("Skins")
            local sKillers = skins and skins:FindFirstChild("Killers")
            local nosSkins = sKillers and sKillers:FindFirstChild("Nosferatu")
            if nosSkins then
              for _, sk in ipairs(nosSkins:GetChildren()) do
                processNosCfg(sk:FindFirstChild("Config"))
              end
            end
            nosCatalogHarvested = true
          end
        else
          for cTbl in pairs(nosConfigTables) do
            patchSingleNosConfig(cTbl, forceRestore)
          end
        end

        local act = getMyKillerActor()
        if act and isLocalNosferatu(act.Rig or localPlayer.Character) and type(act.Config) == "table" then
          patchSingleNosConfig(act.Config, forceRestore)
        end

        for cfgTbl in pairs(ka.savedNosConfigs) do
          patchSingleNosConfig(cfgTbl, forceRestore)
        end
      end)
    end

    -- 2. Hunter's Feast (Bats) Redirect Silent Aim
    local function extractBatsInstPos(inst)
      if not (inst and inst.Parent) then return nil end
      if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst.Position end
      local okP, pos = pcall(function() return inst:GetPivot().Position end)
      if okP and typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then return pos end
      return nil
    end

    local function findActiveBatsPosition(myHrp)
      local cachedInst = ka.activeBatsInst
      if cachedInst and cachedInst.Parent then
        local cachedPos = extractBatsInstPos(cachedInst)
        if cachedPos then return cachedPos, true end
      end
      ka.activeBatsInst = nil
      local now = os.clock()
      local elapsed = now - (ka.batsThrowAt or 0)
      if elapsed <= 6.5 or (now - (ka._lastBatsScanAt or 0)) >= 0.15 then
        ka._lastBatsScanAt = now
        local mp = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local ing = mp and mp:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
        if ing then
          for _, ch in ipairs(ing:GetChildren()) do
            local nm = ch.Name
            if nm == "Bats" or nm:find("Bats", 1, true) then
              local pos = extractBatsInstPos(ch)
              if pos then
                ka.activeBatsInst = ch
                return pos, true
              end
            elseif ch:IsA("BasePart") then
              local snd = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")
              if snd and snd.IsPlaying and tostring(snd.SoundId):find("104283479568709", 1, true) then
                ka.activeBatsInst = ch
                return ch.Position, true
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if elapsed >= 0.28 and elapsed <= 5.5 and myHrp then
        return myHrp.Position + myHrp.CFrame.LookVector * 12, true
      end
      return nil, false
    end

    local function computeNosBatsRedirectAimPos()
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ka.nosBatsAim) then
        return nil, nil
      end
      local now = os.clock()
      if now - (ka._lastBatsAimCalcAt or 0) < 0.015 then
        return ka._cachedBatsAimPos, ka._cachedBatsMyHrp
      end
      ka._lastBatsAimCalcAt = now
      ka._cachedBatsAimPos, ka._cachedBatsMyHrp = nil, nil
      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if not isLocalNosferatu(ch) then
        return nil, nil
      end
      local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
        return nil, nil
      end
      local batsOrigin, active = findActiveBatsPosition(myHrp)
      if not (active and batsOrigin) then
        return nil, nil
      end
      local sHrp = findNearestLivingSurvivorToPos(batsOrigin, 180, myHrp.Position)
      if not sHrp then
        return nil, nil
      end
      local dist = (sHrp.Position - batsOrigin).Magnitude
      local sVel = sHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
      local flatVel = Vector3.new(sVel.X, 0, sVel.Z)
      if flatVel.Magnitude > 85 then flatVel = flatVel.Unit * 85 end
      local tFlight = math.clamp(dist / 120, 0.02, 1.2)
      local aimPoint = sHrp.Position + flatVel * tFlight
      ka._cachedBatsAimPos, ka._cachedBatsMyHrp = aimPoint, myHrp
      return aimPoint, myHrp
    end

    local function restoreNosSilentAimHooks()
      if ka.mouseMod and ka.myGetMousePos then
        pcall(function()
          if ka.mouseMod.GetMousePos == ka.myGetMousePos and ka.prevGetMousePos then
            ka.mouseMod.GetMousePos = ka.prevGetMousePos
          end
          if ka.mouseMod.GetCameraCFrame == ka.myGetCamCF and ka.prevGetCamCF then
            ka.mouseMod.GetCameraCFrame = ka.prevGetCamCF
          end
        end)
      end
      if ka.utilMod and ka.myUtilMousePos then
        pcall(function()
          if ka.utilMod.GetPlayerMousePosition == ka.myUtilMousePos and ka.prevUtilMousePos then
            ka.utilMod.GetPlayerMousePosition = ka.prevUtilMousePos
          end
          if ka.utilMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame == ka.myUtilCamCF and ka.prevUtilCamCF then
            ka.utilMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame = ka.prevUtilCamCF
          end
        end)
      end
    end

    local function syncNosSilentAimHooks()
      local want = ka.nosBatsAim and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
      if not want then
        restoreNosSilentAimHooks()
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        if not ka.mouseMod then
          local sys = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Systems")
          local ply = sys and sys:FindFirstChild("Player")
          local misc = ply and ply:FindFirstChild("Miscellaneous")
          local mpMod = misc and misc:FindFirstChild("GetPlayerMousePosition")
          if mpMod and mpMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local okM, mTbl = pcall(require, mpMod)
            if okM and type(mTbl) == "table" then ka.mouseMod = mTbl end
          end
        end
        local mMod = ka.mouseMod
        if type(mMod) == "table" then
          if type(mMod.GetMousePos) == "function" and mMod.GetMousePos ~= ka.myGetMousePos then
            ka.prevGetMousePos = mMod.GetMousePos
            ka.myGetMousePos = function(...)
              local aimPoint = computeNosBatsRedirectAimPos()
              if aimPoint then return aimPoint end
              return ka.prevGetMousePos(...)
            end
            mMod.GetMousePos = ka.myGetMousePos
          end
          if type(mMod.GetCameraCFrame) == "function" and mMod.GetCameraCFrame ~= ka.myGetCamCF then
            ka.prevGetCamCF = mMod.GetCameraCFrame
            ka.myGetCamCF = function(...)
              local origCF = ka.prevGetCamCF(...)
              local aimPoint, myHrp = computeNosBatsRedirectAimPos()
              if aimPoint and myHrp then
                local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
                local camPos = (cam and cam.CFrame.Position) or (typeof(origCF) == "CFrame" and origCF.Position) or myHrp.Position
                local delta = aimPoint - camPos
                if delta.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                  return CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + delta.Unit)
                end
              end
              return origCF
            end
            mMod.GetCameraCFrame = ka.myGetCamCF
          end
        end
      end)

      pcall(function()
        if not ka.utilMod then
          local mods = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
          local utils = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Utilities")
          local uMod = utils and utils:FindFirstChild("Util")
          if uMod and uMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local okU, uTbl = pcall(require, uMod)
            if okU and type(uTbl) == "table" then ka.utilMod = uTbl end
          end
        end
        local uMod = ka.utilMod
        if type(uMod) == "table" then
          if type(uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition) == "function" and uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition ~= ka.myUtilMousePos then
            ka.prevUtilMousePos = uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition
            ka.myUtilMousePos = function(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
              local targetPlr = (plrArg == nil and typeof(selfArg) == "Instance") and selfArg or plrArg
              if targetPlr == nil or targetPlr == localPlayer then
                local aimPoint = computeNosBatsRedirectAimPos()
                if aimPoint then return aimPoint end
              end
              return ka.prevUtilMousePos(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
            end
            uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition = ka.myUtilMousePos
          end
          if type(uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame) == "function" and uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame ~= ka.myUtilCamCF then
            ka.prevUtilCamCF = uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame
            ka.myUtilCamCF = function(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
              local origCF = ka.prevUtilCamCF(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
              local targetPlr = (plrArg == nil and typeof(selfArg) == "Instance") and selfArg or plrArg
              if targetPlr == nil or targetPlr == localPlayer then
                local aimPoint, myHrp = computeNosBatsRedirectAimPos()
                if aimPoint and myHrp then
                  local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
                  local camPos = (cam and cam.CFrame.Position) or (typeof(origCF) == "CFrame" and origCF.Position) or myHrp.Position
                  local delta = aimPoint - camPos
                  if delta.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                    return CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + delta.Unit)
                  end
                end
              end
              return origCF
            end
            uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame = ka.myUtilCamCF
          end
        end
      end)
    end

    -- 3. Nosferatu Ascension Dive Aimbot (NergNosDiveAim)
    local NOS_DIVE_STEP = "NergNosDiveAim"

    local function unbindNosDiveAim()
      local wasBound = ka.diveAimBound
      ka.diveAimBound = false
      pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(NOS_DIVE_STEP) end)
      if wasBound or a724RotLocks["nos_dive"] then
        pcall(function()
          local ch = localPlayer.Character
          local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          a724RotUnlock(hum, "nos_dive")
        end)
      end
    end

    local function stepNosDiveAim()
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ka.nosAscentAim) then
        unbindNosDiveAim()
        return
      end
      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if not isLocalNosferatu(ch) then
        unbindNosDiveAim()
        return
      end
      local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
        unbindNosDiveAim()
        return
      end
      local act = getMyKillerActor()
      local st = act and type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
      local isSlashing = (st and st.Slashing == true) or (os.clock() <= (ka.diveWindowUntil or 0))
      if not isSlashing then
        unbindNosDiveAim()
        return
      end
      local refPos = myHrp.Position
      if ka.nosAscentTarget == "Nearest to Impact" and act and type(act.Instances) == "table" then
        local diveInd = act.Instances.DiveIndicator
        local indTarget = (type(diveInd) == "table" or typeof(diveInd) == "Instance") and diveInd.Target or nil
        if typeof(indTarget) == "Instance" then
          local okP, tPos = pcall(function()
            return indTarget:IsA("BasePart") and indTarget.Position or indTarget:GetPivot().Position
          end)
          if okP and tPos then refPos = tPos end
        end
      end
      local sHrp = findNearestLivingSurvivorToPos(refPos, 160, myHrp.Position)
      if not sHrp then
        if a724RotLocks["nos_dive"] then a724RotUnlock(hum, "nos_dive") end
        return
      end
      local diveSpd = tonumber(act and act.Config and act.Config.AscentBite and act.Config.AscentBite.Speed) or 100
      local dist = (sHrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
      local sVel = sHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
      local flatVel = Vector3.new(sVel.X, 0, sVel.Z)
      local leadT = math.clamp(dist / math.max(diveSpd, 40), 0.02, 0.45)
      local aimPos = sHrp.Position + flatVel * leadT
      local flatDir = Vector3.new(aimPos.X - myHrp.Position.X, 0, aimPos.Z - myHrp.Position.Z)
      if flatDir.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        a724RotLock(hum, "nos_dive")
        pcall(function() myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
        myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myHrp.Position, Vector3.new(aimPos.X, myHrp.Position.Y, aimPos.Z))
      end
      local bv = myHrp:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyVelocity")
      if bv and bv.Velocity.Magnitude > 5 then
        local dir3D = aimPos - myHrp.Position
        if dir3D.Magnitude > 0.1 then
          bv.Velocity = dir3D.Unit * diveSpd
        end
      end
    end

    local function ensureNosDiveAimBound()
      if not ka.diveAimBound and ka.nosAscentAim and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
        ka.diveAimBound = true
        pcall(function()
          runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(NOS_DIVE_STEP)
          runService:BindToRenderStep(NOS_DIVE_STEP, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 12, stepNosDiveAim)
        end)
      end
    end

    -- 4. Azure Enstrangle (Grab) Aimbot (NergAzureGrabAim)
    local AZ_GRAB_STEP = "NergAzureGrabAim"

    local function unbindAzGrabAim()
      local wasBound = ka.azGrabBound
      ka.azGrabBound = false
      pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AZ_GRAB_STEP) end)
      if wasBound or a724RotLocks["az_grab"] then
        pcall(function()
          local ch = localPlayer.Character
          local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          a724RotUnlock(hum, "az_grab")
        end)
      end
    end

    local function stepAzGrabAim()
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ka.azGrabAim) then
        unbindAzGrabAim()
        return
      end
      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if not isLocalAzure(ch) then
        unbindAzGrabAim()
        return
      end
      local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
        unbindAzGrabAim()
        return
      end
      local act = getMyKillerActor()
      local st = act and type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
      if not (st and st.GrabAimingSequence == true) then
        unbindAzGrabAim()
        return
      end
      local hookRange = tonumber(act and act.Config and act.Config.HookRange) or 60
      local hookSpd = tonumber(act and act.Config and act.Config.HookSpeed) or 270
      local sHrp = findNearestLivingSurvivorToPos(myHrp.Position, hookRange, myHrp.Position)
      if not sHrp then return end
      local dist = (sHrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
      local sVel = sHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
      local flatVel = Vector3.new(sVel.X, 0, sVel.Z)
      local tFlight = math.clamp(dist / math.max(hookSpd, 60), 0.01, 0.35)
      local aimPos = sHrp.Position + flatVel * tFlight
      st.CameraLookPosition = aimPos
      local lookCF = CFrame.lookAt(myHrp.Position, Vector3.new(aimPos.X, myHrp.Position.Y, aimPos.Z))
      local align = myHrp:FindFirstChildOfClass("AlignOrientation")
      if align then
        pcall(function() align.CFrame = lookCF end)
      end
      a724RotLock(hum, "az_grab")
      myHrp.CFrame = lookCF
      local now = os.clock()
      if now - (ka.lastGrabNetAt or 0) >= 0.03 then
        ka.lastGrabNetAt = now
        if not ka.netMod then
          pcall(function() ka.netMod = require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Network.Network) end)
        end
        if type(ka.netMod) == "table" and type(ka.netMod.FireServerConnection) == "function" then
          pcall(function()
            ka.netMod:FireServerConnection(localPlayer.Name .. "AzureUpdateCameraLookVector", "UREMOTE_EVENT", aimPos)
          end)
        end
      end
    end

    local function ensureAzGrabAimBound()
      if not ka.azGrabBound and ka.azGrabAim and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
        ka.azGrabBound = true
        pcall(function()
          runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AZ_GRAB_STEP)
          runService:BindToRenderStep(AZ_GRAB_STEP, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, stepAzGrabAim)
        end)
      end
    end

    -- 5. Azure ConstructQTE Hook & Grab Stamina Protection
    local function syncAzureHooks()
      local alive = __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
      if alive and ka.azAutoQTE then
        if not ka.hookedConstructQte then
          pcall(function()
            local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
            local killers = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Killers")
            local azDir = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Azure")
            local cfgMod = azDir and azDir:FindFirstChild("Config")
            local wkFolder = cfgMod and cfgMod:FindFirstChild("cl_WorkaroundModules")
            local qteScript = wkFolder and wkFolder:FindFirstChild("cl_ConstructQTE")
            if qteScript and qteScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
              local okQ, qMod = pcall(require, qteScript)
              if okQ and type(qMod) == "table" and type(qMod.new) == "function" then
                ka.constructQteMod = qMod
                ka.origConstructNew = ka.origConstructNew or qMod.new
                qMod.new = function(...)
                  local qteObj = ka.origConstructNew(...)
                  if ka.azAutoQTE and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and type(qteObj) == "table" then
                    task.spawn(function()
                      task.wait(0.10)
                      for _ = 1, 3 do
                        local stepSec = math.clamp(tonumber(ka.azQteDelay) or 160, 40, 400) / 1000
                        task.wait(stepSec)
                        if not (ka.azAutoQTE and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and type(qteObj) == "table" and qteObj.Maid and qteObj.UI) then
                          return
                        end
                        if type(qteObj.UI) == "table" and type(qteObj.UI.PlayHitSound) == "function" then
                          pcall(function() qteObj.UI:PlayHitSound() end)
                        end
                        if type(qteObj.AddProgress) == "function" then
                          pcall(function() qteObj:AddProgress(34) end)
                        end
                      end
                    end)
                  end
                  return qteObj
                end
                ka.hookedConstructQte = true
              end
            end
          end)
        end
      elseif ka.hookedConstructQte and ka.constructQteMod and ka.origConstructNew then
        pcall(function() ka.constructQteMod.new = ka.origConstructNew end)
        ka.hookedConstructQte = false
      end

      if alive and ka.azNoGrabStam then
        if not ka.hookedAzBehavior then
          pcall(function()
            local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
            local killers = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Killers")
            local azDir = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Azure")
            local behScript = azDir and azDir:FindFirstChild("Behavior")
            if behScript and behScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
              local okB, bMod = pcall(require, behScript)
              if okB and type(bMod) == "table" and type(bMod.lcl_SetGrabStaminaRegenReduction) == "function" then
                ka.azBehaviorMod = bMod
                ka.origAzGrabStamFn = ka.origAzGrabStamFn or bMod.lcl_SetGrabStaminaRegenReduction
                bMod.lcl_SetGrabStaminaRegenReduction = function(selfArg, actorArg, reduceFlag, ...)
                  if ka.azNoGrabStam and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and reduceFlag == true then
                    return ka.origAzGrabStamFn(selfArg, actorArg, false, ...)
                  end
                  return ka.origAzGrabStamFn(selfArg, actorArg, reduceFlag, ...)
                end
                ka.hookedAzBehavior = true
              end
            end
          end)
        end
      elseif ka.hookedAzBehavior and ka.azBehaviorMod and ka.origAzGrabStamFn then
        pcall(function() ka.azBehaviorMod.lcl_SetGrabStaminaRegenReduction = ka.origAzGrabStamFn end)
        ka.hookedAzBehavior = false
      end
    end

    -- 6. Bloodhook QTE & Event-Driven State Watcher Loop
    local syncNosAzHbLoop

    local function stepBloodhookQTE()
      if not ka.nosAutoQTE then return end
      local qteFrame = ka.activeQteFrame
      if not (qteFrame and qteFrame.Parent) then
        ka.activeQteFrame = nil
        return
      end
      local tempUi = qteFrame.Parent
      local pcRef = qteFrame:FindFirstChild("PC")
      for _, v12 in ipairs(qteFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if v12 ~= pcRef and v12:IsA("GuiObject") and v12.Visible and not ka.qtePromptsSeen[v12] then
          local posOk = (v12.Position.X.Scale < 0.65)
          local transOk = true
          if v12:IsA("ImageLabel") or v12:IsA("ImageButton") then
            transOk = (v12.ImageTransparency < 0.25)
          end
          if posOk and transOk then
            ka.qtePromptsSeen[v12] = true
            local waitSec = math.clamp(tonumber(ka.nosQteDelay) or 85, 20, 350) / 1000
            task.delay(waitSec, function()
              if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ka.nosAutoQTE) then return end
              if not (qteFrame and qteFrame.Parent == tempUi and v12 and v12.Parent == qteFrame and v12.Visible) then
                return
              end
              if v12:IsA("GuiButton") and type(firesignal) == "function" then
                pcall(function()
                  if v12.MouseButton1Click then firesignal(v12.MouseButton1Click) end
                  if v12.Activated then firesignal(v12.Activated) end
                end)
              end
              local tl = v12:FindFirstChild("TextLabel") or v12:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
              local kChar = tl and tostring(tl.Text or ""):upper():match("[WASD]") or nil
              local keyCode = kChar and KEYCODE_BY_CHAR[kChar] or nil
              if keyCode and vimService then
                local wasHeld = false
                pcall(function() wasHeld = userInputService:IsKeyDown(keyCode) end)
                pcall(function() vimService:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game) end)
                task.delay(0.025, function()
                  if not wasHeld and vimService then
                    pcall(function() vimService:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game) end)
                  end
                end)
              end
            end)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    local function stopNosAzHb()
      if ka.hbConn then
        local c = ka.hbConn
        ka.hbConn = nil
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
      end
    end

    local function shouldRunNosAzHb()
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return false end
      if ka.nosAutoQTE and ka.activeQteFrame and ka.activeQteFrame.Parent then
        return true
      end
      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if isLocalNosferatu(ch) and ka.nosAscentAim then
        return true
      end
      if isLocalAzure(ch) and (ka.azGrabAim or ka.azNoGrabStam) then
        return true
      end
      return false
    end

    local function stepNosAzHeartbeat()
      if not shouldRunNosAzHb() then
        stopNosAzHb()
        return
      end
      if ka.nosAutoQTE and ka.activeQteFrame then
        stepBloodhookQTE()
      end
      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if isLocalNosferatu(ch) then
        if ka.nosAscentAim then
          local act = getMyKillerActor()
          local st = act and type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
          if (st and st.Slashing == true) or (os.clock() <= (ka.diveWindowUntil or 0)) then
            ensureNosDiveAimBound()
          elseif ka.diveAimBound then
            unbindNosDiveAim()
          end
        end
      elseif isLocalAzure(ch) then
        local act = getMyKillerActor()
        local st = act and type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
        if ka.azGrabAim then
          if st and st.GrabAimingSequence == true then
            ensureAzGrabAimBound()
          elseif ka.azGrabBound then
            unbindAzGrabAim()
          end
        end
        if ka.azNoGrabStam then
          if not ka.sprintingMod then
            pcall(function()
              ka.sprintingMod = require(replicatedStorage.Systems.Character.Game.Sprinting)
            end)
          end
          if type(ka.sprintingMod) == "table" and type(ka.sprintingMod.StaminaGain) == "number" then
            local fullGain = (act and type(act.Cache) == "table" and tonumber(act.Cache.AzureGrabStaminaGain))
              or (act and type(act.Config) == "table" and tonumber(act.Config.StaminaGain))
              or 21
            if ka.sprintingMod.StaminaGain < fullGain * 0.8 then
              ka.sprintingMod.StaminaGain = fullGain
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    syncNosAzHbLoop = function()
      if shouldRunNosAzHb() then
        if not ka.hbConn then
          ka.hbConn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(stepNosAzHeartbeat)
        end
      else
        stopNosAzHb()
      end
    end

    local function clearQteUiConns()
      ka.activeQteFrame = nil
      if ka.qteUiConns then
        for i = #ka.qteUiConns, 1, -1 do
          local c = ka.qteUiConns[i]
          ka.qteUiConns[i] = nil
          pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
      end
    end

    local function bindQteUiWatchers()
      clearQteUiConns()
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ka.nosAutoQTE) then return end
      ka.qteUiConns = ka.qteUiConns or {}
      local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
      if not pg then return end
      local function onQteCandidate(inst)
        if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ka.nosAutoQTE) then return end
        if inst and inst.Name == "QTE" and inst.Parent then
          ka.activeQteFrame = inst
          syncNosAzHbLoop()
          pcall(stepBloodhookQTE)
        end
      end
      local hookedTempUi = nil
      local function bindTempUiFolder(tempUi)
        if not (tempUi and tempUi.Parent == pg) or hookedTempUi == tempUi then return end
        hookedTempUi = tempUi
        ka.qteUiConns[#ka.qteUiConns + 1] = tempUi.ChildAdded:Connect(onQteCandidate)
        ka.qteUiConns[#ka.qteUiConns + 1] = tempUi.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(ch)
          if ch == ka.activeQteFrame or ch.Name == "QTE" then
            ka.activeQteFrame = tempUi:FindFirstChild("QTE")
            syncNosAzHbLoop()
          end
        end)
        local curQte = tempUi:FindFirstChild("QTE")
        if curQte then onQteCandidate(curQte) end
      end
      local tempUi0 = pg:FindFirstChild("TemporaryUI")
      if tempUi0 then bindTempUiFolder(tempUi0) end
      ka.qteUiConns[#ka.qteUiConns + 1] = pg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        if ch.Name == "TemporaryUI" then
          task.defer(bindTempUiFolder, ch)
        end
      end)
    end

    local function clearNosAzCharConns()
      for i = #ka.charConns, 1, -1 do
        local c = ka.charConns[i]
        ka.charConns[i] = nil
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
      end
    end

    local function hookNosAzCharacter(ch)
      clearNosAzCharConns()
      unbindNosDiveAim()
      unbindAzGrabAim()
      ka.activeBatsInst = nil
      if not (ch and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then
        syncNosAzHbLoop()
        return
      end
      local function onRoleOrParentChanged()
        if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
        if isLocalNosferatu(ch) and (ka.nosSpireCtrl or ka.nosAscentCtrl) then
          syncNosferatuConfigs(false)
        end
        syncNosAzHbLoop()
      end
      ka.charConns[#ka.charConns + 1] = ch.AncestryChanged:Connect(onRoleOrParentChanged)
      ka.charConns[#ka.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CharacterName"):Connect(onRoleOrParentChanged)
      syncNosAzHbLoop()
      task.spawn(function()
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local animator = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5))
        if not (ch.Parent and localPlayer.Character == ch and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
        if isLocalNosferatu(ch) and (ka.nosSpireCtrl or ka.nosAscentCtrl) then
          syncNosferatuConfigs(false)
        end
        syncNosAzHbLoop()
        if animator then
          ka.charConns[#ka.charConns + 1] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
            if not isLocalNosferatu(ch) then return end
            local anim = track and track.Animation
            local aid = anim and tostring(anim.AnimationId):match("%d+")
            local aName = ((anim and anim.Name) or (track and track.Name) or ""):lower()
            if (aid and ka.nosBatsThrowAnims[aid]) or aName:find("batsthrow", 1, true) then
              ka.batsThrowAt = os.clock()
              ka.activeBatsInst = nil
              if ka.nosBatsAim then syncNosSilentAimHooks() end
            elseif (aid and ka.nosDiveAnims[aid]) or aName:find("batbite", 1, true) then
              ka.diveWindowUntil = os.clock() + 2.2
              if ka.nosAscentAim then ensureNosDiveAimBound() end
            end
          end)
        end
      end)
    end

    local function syncNosAzureState()
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
      syncNosferatuConfigs(false)
      syncNosSilentAimHooks()
      syncAzureHooks()
      bindQteUiWatchers()
      if not ka.nosAscentAim then unbindNosDiveAim() end
      if not ka.azGrabAim then unbindAzGrabAim() end
      local anyCharHookNeeded = ka.nosBatsAim or ka.nosSpireCtrl or ka.nosAscentCtrl or ka.nosAscentAim or ka.azGrabAim or ka.azNoGrabStam
      if anyCharHookNeeded then
        if not ka.mainCharConn then
          ka.mainCharConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
            if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
            clearNosAzCharConns()
            unbindNosDiveAim()
            unbindAzGrabAim()
            syncNosAzHbLoop()
            task.delay(0.5, function()
              if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and localPlayer.Character == ch then
                hookNosAzCharacter(ch)
                bindQteUiWatchers()
              end
            end)
          end)
        end
        if localPlayer.Character and #ka.charConns == 0 then
          hookNosAzCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
        end
      else
        clearNosAzCharConns()
        if ka.mainCharConn then
          pcall(function() ka.mainCharConn:Disconnect() end)
          ka.mainCharConn = nil
        end
      end
      syncNosAzHbLoop()
    end

    local function stopNosAzureSuite()
      ka.nosAutoQTE = false
      ka.nosBatsAim = false
      ka.nosSpireCtrl = false
      ka.nosAscentCtrl = false
      ka.nosAscentAim = false
      ka.azAutoQTE = false
      ka.azGrabAim = false
      ka.azNoGrabStam = false
      ka.activeBatsInst = nil
      stopNosAzHb()
      clearQteUiConns()
      unbindNosDiveAim()
      unbindAzGrabAim()
      clearNosAzCharConns()
      if ka.mainCharConn then
        pcall(function() ka.mainCharConn:Disconnect() end)
        ka.mainCharConn = nil
      end
      syncNosferatuConfigs(true)
      restoreNosSilentAimHooks()
      syncAzureHooks()
      table.clear(ka.qtePromptsSeen)
    end

    rawset(_G, "NERG_NOS_AZ", {
      setNosAutoQTE = function(v) ka.nosAutoQTE = v and true or false v2.set("nosAutoQTE", ka.nosAutoQTE) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setNosQteDelay = function(n) ka.nosQteDelay = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 85, 20, 350) v2.set("nosQteDelay", ka.nosQteDelay) end,
      setNosBatsAim = function(v) ka.nosBatsAim = v and true or false v2.set("nosBatsAim", ka.nosBatsAim) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setNosSpireCtrl = function(v) ka.nosSpireCtrl = v and true or false v2.set("nosSpireCtrl", ka.nosSpireCtrl) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setNosSpireTurn = function(n) ka.nosSpireTurn = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 28, 10, 50) v2.set("nosSpireTurn", ka.nosSpireTurn) if ka.nosSpireCtrl then syncNosferatuConfigs(false) end end,
      setNosAscentCtrl = function(v) ka.nosAscentCtrl = v and true or false v2.set("nosAscentCtrl", ka.nosAscentCtrl) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setNosDiveTurn = function(n) ka.nosDiveTurn = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 14, 4, 25) v2.set("nosDiveTurn", ka.nosDiveTurn) if ka.nosAscentCtrl then syncNosferatuConfigs(false) end end,
      setNosAscentAim = function(v) ka.nosAscentAim = v and true or false v2.set("nosAscentAim", ka.nosAscentAim) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setNosAscentTarget = function(val)
        local s = (val == "Nearest to Nosferatu") and "Nearest to Nosferatu" or "Nearest to Impact"
        ka.nosAscentTarget = s
        v2.set("nosAscentTarget", s)
      end,
      setAzAutoQTE = function(v) ka.azAutoQTE = v and true or false v2.set("azAutoQTE", ka.azAutoQTE) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setAzQteDelay = function(n) ka.azQteDelay = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 160, 40, 400) v2.set("azQteDelay", ka.azQteDelay) end,
      setAzGrabAim = function(v) ka.azGrabAim = v and true or false v2.set("azGrabAim", ka.azGrabAim) syncNosAzureState() end,
      setAzNoGrabStam = function(v) ka.azNoGrabStam = v and true or false v2.set("azNoGrabStam", ka.azNoGrabStam) syncNosAzureState() end,
      get = function(k) return ka[k] end,
      stop = stopNosAzureSuite,
    })

    CFG_UI["NosAutoQTE"] = nosMainSec:AddToggle("NosAutoQTE", {
      Text = "Auto Bloodhook QTE",
      Default = ka.nosAutoQTE,
      Callback = function(v)
        if uiBoot then return end
        pcall(function() _G.NERG_NOS_AZ.setNosAutoQTE(v) end)
      end,
    })
    CFG_UI["NosQteDelay"] = nosMainSec:AddSlider("NosQteDelay", {
      Text = "Bloodhook QTE Delay (ms)",

      Max = 350,
      Default = ka.nosQteDelay,
      Rounding = 0,
      Callback = function(n)
        if uiBoot then return end
        pcall(function() _G.NERG_NOS_AZ.setNosQteDelay(n) end)
      end,
    })
    CFG_UI["NosBatsAim"] = nosMainSec:AddToggle("NosBatsAim", {
      Text = "Hunter's Feast Redirect Aim",
      Default = ka.nosBatsAim,
      Callback = function(v)
        if uiBoot then return end

    CFG_UI["NosSpireCtrl"] = nosMainSec:AddToggle("NosSpireCtrl", {
