-- [A752] Combat Extensions: Killer M1 Aimbot, Jane Doe Suite & Veeronica Suite
do
  local EXPERIMENTAL_ON = { JaneDoe = true, Veeronica = true }
  local ext = {
    killerM1Aim = v2.get("killerM1Aim", false) and true or false,
    jdInstantCrystal = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.JaneDoe and (v2.get("jdInstantCrystal", false) and true or false) or false,
    jdCrystalAim = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.JaneDoe and (v2.get("jdCrystalAim", false) and true or false) or false,
    jdHatchetAim = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.JaneDoe and (v2.get("jdHatchetAim", false) and true or false) or false,
    veeAutoTrick = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica and (v2.get("veeAutoTrick", false) and true or false) or false,
    veeTrickStam = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica and (v2.get("veeTrickStam", false) and true or false) or false,
    veeSk8Ctrl = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica and (v2.get("veeSk8Ctrl", false) and true or false) or false,
    veeSk8Turn = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("veeSk8Turn", 5.0)) or 5.0, 1.0, 15.0),
    veeWallRebound = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica and (v2.get("veeWallRebound", false) and true or false) or false,
    veeAutoPhase = EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica and (v2.get("veeAutoPhase", false) and true or false) or false,
    m1AimBound = false,
    m1AimUntil = 0,
    crystalCharging = false,
    crystalChargeStartAt = 0,
    crystalThrowUntil = 0,
    hatchetAimBound = false,
    hatchetAimUntil = 0,
    savedCrystalConfigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    savedVeeConfigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    killerM1Anims = {},
    killerM1Sounds = {},
    jdCrystalChargeAnims = { ["106527725058030"] = true },
    jdCrystalThrowAnims = { ["139929602101552"] = true },
    jdHatchetAnims = { ["111918351126361"] = true },
    veeSk8Anims = { ["123803922491274"] = true, ["117058860640843"] = true },
    veeWatchConn = nil,
    veeLastTrickAt = 0,
    veeWasSkating = false,
    veePhaseFiredThisSk8 = false,
    veePhasePending = false,
    veeLastPhaseAt = 0,
    veeLastSk8StartAt = 0,
    veePhaseSessionId = 0,
    sprintingMod = nil,
    netMod = nil,
    charConns = {},
    uiConns = {},
    mainCharConn = nil,
    actorsMod = nil,
    mouseMod = nil,
    origGetMousePos = nil,
    origGetCamCF = nil,
    hookedMouseMod = false,
    utilMod = nil,
    origUtilMousePos = nil,
    origUtilCamCF = nil,
    hookedUtilMod = false,
  }

  local M1_SKILL_BLACKLIST = {
    "corrupt", "pursuit", "override", "spike", "spire", "unravel", "sow",
    "blossom", "shockwave", "burrow", "unearth", "nova", "voidrush",
    "observant", "cry", "bloodhunt", "pizza", "digital", "footprint",
    "raging", "enragedstart", "enragedidle", "enragedwalk", "enragedrun",
  }

  local M1_NAME_WHITELIST = {
    "slash", "enragedslash", "stab", "attack", "behead", "bite",
    "swing", "golemslash", "punch", "chomp",
  }

  local function isLocalKiller(ch)
    ch = ch or localPlayer.Character
    return ch ~= nil and ch.Parent ~= nil and ch.Parent.Name == "Killers"
  end

  local function isLocalJaneDoe(ch)
    ch = ch or localPlayer.Character
    if not (ch and ch.Parent and ch.Parent.Name == "Survivors") then return false end
    return ch.Name == "JaneDoe" or ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") == "JaneDoe"
  end

  local function isLocalVeeronica(ch)
    ch = ch or localPlayer.Character
    if not (ch and ch.Parent and ch.Parent.Name == "Survivors") then return false end
    return ch.Name == "Veeronica" or ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") == "Veeronica"
  end

  local function isAnyVeeOn()
    return ext.veeAutoTrick or ext.veeTrickStam or ext.veeSk8Ctrl or ext.veeWallRebound or ext.veeAutoPhase
  end

  local function isAnyCombatExtOn()
    return ext.killerM1Aim or ext.jdInstantCrystal or ext.jdCrystalAim or ext.jdHatchetAim or isAnyVeeOn()
  end

  local function extractIdsToSet(val, outSet, depth)
    if (depth or 0) > 3 or val == nil then return end
    if type(val) == "string" or type(val) == "number" then
      local id = tostring(val):match("%d+")
      if id then outSet[id] = true end
    elseif typeof(val) == "Instance" then
      if val:IsA("Animation") then
        local id = tostring(val.AnimationId):match("%d+")
        if id then outSet[id] = true end
      elseif val:IsA("Sound") then
        local id = tostring(val.SoundId):match("%d+")
        if id then outSet[id] = true end
      end
    elseif type(val) == "table" then
      for _, v in pairs(val) do
        extractIdsToSet(v, outSet, (depth or 0) + 1)
      end
    end
  end

  local function harvestKillerM1Catalog(ch)
    table.clear(ext.killerM1Anims)
    table.clear(ext.killerM1Sounds)
    if not isLocalKiller(ch) then return end
    local kname = ch:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or ch.Name
    local skin = ch:GetAttribute("SkinName") or ""
    local base = tostring(kname):gsub("^[!#]", "")
    pcall(function()
      if a742oCollectAnimIds then
        local animList = a742oCollectAnimIds(kname, skin)
        if type(animList) == "table" then
          for _, aid in ipairs(animList) do
            ext.killerM1Anims[tostring(aid)] = true
          end
        end
      end
      if a655ScanM1 then
        local baseSnds = a655ScanM1(kname)
        if type(baseSnds) == "table" then
          for sid in pairs(baseSnds) do
            ext.killerM1Sounds[tostring(sid)] = true
          end
        end
      end
      if skin ~= "" and a655SkinM1 then
        local skinSnds = a655SkinM1(base, skin)
        if type(skinSnds) == "table" then
          for sid in pairs(skinSnds) do
            ext.killerM1Sounds[tostring(sid)] = true
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  local CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL = {
    ChannelTime = 0.2,
    MinChargeTime = 0.25,
    MaxChargeTime = 2.0,
    MaximumHoldTime = 2.0,
    ChargeSpeedMult = 0.75,
  }

  local function patchSingleCrystalTable(crystalTbl, enable)
    if type(crystalTbl) ~= "table" then return end
    ext.savedCrystalConfigs[crystalTbl] = CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL
    if enable and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
      crystalTbl.ChannelTime = 0.15
      crystalTbl.MinChargeTime = 0.25
      crystalTbl.MaxChargeTime = 0.25
      crystalTbl.MaximumHoldTime = 999999
      crystalTbl.ChargeSpeedMult = 1
    else
      crystalTbl.ChannelTime = CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL.ChannelTime
      crystalTbl.MinChargeTime = CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL.MinChargeTime
      crystalTbl.MaxChargeTime = CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL.MaxChargeTime
      crystalTbl.MaximumHoldTime = CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL.MaximumHoldTime
      crystalTbl.ChargeSpeedMult = CANONICAL_JD_CRYSTAL.ChargeSpeedMult
    end
  end

  local jdCatalogHarvested = false
  local jdCrystalTables = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

  local function syncJaneDoeConfigs()
    local enable = ext.jdInstantCrystal and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
    pcall(function()
      if not jdCatalogHarvested then
        local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
        if assets then
          local function processJDConfigMod(cfgMod)
            if not (cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript")) then return end
            local ok, cfg = pcall(require, cfgMod)
            if not (ok and type(cfg) == "table") then return end
            if type(cfg.Crystal) == "table" then
              jdCrystalTables[cfg.Crystal] = true
              patchSingleCrystalTable(cfg.Crystal, enable)
            end
            if type(cfg.Animations) == "table" then
              for k, v in pairs(cfg.Animations) do
                local kl = tostring(k):lower()
                if kl:find("crystal") and kl:find("charge") then
                  extractIdsToSet(v, ext.jdCrystalChargeAnims, 0)
                elseif kl:find("crystal") and kl:find("throw") then
                  extractIdsToSet(v, ext.jdCrystalThrowAnims, 0)
                elseif kl:find("axe") or kl:find("hatchet") then
                  extractIdsToSet(v, ext.jdHatchetAnims, 0)
                end
              end
            end
          end

          local surv = assets:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
          local jdBase = surv and surv:FindFirstChild("JaneDoe")
          if jdBase then processJDConfigMod(jdBase:FindFirstChild("Config")) end

          local skins = assets:FindFirstChild("Skins")
          local sSurv = skins and skins:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
          local jdSkins = sSurv and sSurv:FindFirstChild("JaneDoe")
          if jdSkins then
            for _, sk in ipairs(jdSkins:GetChildren()) do
              processJDConfigMod(sk:FindFirstChild("Config"))
            end
          end
          jdCatalogHarvested = true
        end
      else
        for cTbl in pairs(jdCrystalTables) do
          patchSingleCrystalTable(cTbl, enable)
        end
      end

      if not ext.actorsMod then
        local okA, aMod = pcall(function()
          return require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Gameplay.Actors)
        end)
        if okA and type(aMod) == "table" then ext.actorsMod = aMod end
      end
      local curActors = ext.actorsMod and ext.actorsMod.CurrentActors
      if type(curActors) == "table" then
        for _, act in pairs(curActors) do
          if type(act) == "table" and (act.Player == localPlayer or act.Rig == localPlayer.Character) then
            if type(act.Config) == "table" and type(act.Config.Crystal) == "table" then
              patchSingleCrystalTable(act.Config.Crystal, enable)
            end
            if enable and type(act.State) == "table" then
              act.State.CrystalFullChargeTime = nil
            end
          end
        end
      end

      for crystalTbl in pairs(ext.savedCrystalConfigs) do
        patchSingleCrystalTable(crystalTbl, enable)
      end
    end)
  end

  local CANONICAL_VEE_SK8 = {
    Sk8TurnControl = 0.65,
    Sk8PhaseBounceEnabled = false,
    Sk8TrickStamina = 10,
    Sk8TrickStaminaNerfed = 4,
  }

  local function patchSingleVeeConfig(cfgTbl, forceRestore)
    if type(cfgTbl) ~= "table" then return end
    local orig = ext.savedVeeConfigs[cfgTbl]
    if not orig then
      orig = {
        TurnControl = tonumber(cfgTbl.Sk8TurnControl) or CANONICAL_VEE_SK8.Sk8TurnControl,
        PhaseBounce = (cfgTbl.Sk8PhaseBounceEnabled == true),
        TrickStam = tonumber(cfgTbl.Sk8TrickStamina) or CANONICAL_VEE_SK8.Sk8TrickStamina,
        TrickStamNerfed = tonumber(cfgTbl.Sk8TrickStaminaNerfed) or CANONICAL_VEE_SK8.Sk8TrickStaminaNerfed,
      }
      ext.savedVeeConfigs[cfgTbl] = orig
    end
    local alive = (not forceRestore) and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
    if alive and ext.veeSk8Ctrl then
      cfgTbl.Sk8TurnControl = math.clamp(tonumber(ext.veeSk8Turn) or 5.0, 1.0, 15.0)
    else
      cfgTbl.Sk8TurnControl = orig.TurnControl
    end
    if alive and ext.veeWallRebound then
      cfgTbl.Sk8PhaseBounceEnabled = true
    else
      cfgTbl.Sk8PhaseBounceEnabled = orig.PhaseBounce
    end
    if alive and ext.veeTrickStam then
      cfgTbl.Sk8TrickStamina = orig.TrickStam
      cfgTbl.Sk8TrickStaminaNerfed = orig.TrickStam
    else
      cfgTbl.Sk8TrickStamina = orig.TrickStam
      cfgTbl.Sk8TrickStaminaNerfed = orig.TrickStamNerfed
    end
  end

  local veeCatalogHarvested = false
  local veeConfigTables = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

  local function syncVeeronicaConfigs(forceRestore)
    pcall(function()
      if not veeCatalogHarvested then
        local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
        if assets then
          local function processVeeConfigMod(cfgMod, isBase)
            if not (cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript")) then return end
            local ok, cfg = pcall(require, cfgMod)
            if not (ok and type(cfg) == "table") then return end
            if isBase or cfg.Sk8TurnControl ~= nil or cfg.Sk8TrickStamina ~= nil or cfg.Sk8PhaseBounceEnabled ~= nil then
              veeConfigTables[cfg] = true
              patchSingleVeeConfig(cfg, forceRestore)
            end
            if type(cfg.Animations) == "table" then
              for k, v in pairs(cfg.Animations) do
                local kl = tostring(k):lower()
                if kl:find("sk8", 1, true) or kl:find("skate", 1, true) then
                  extractIdsToSet(v, ext.veeSk8Anims, 0)
                end
              end
            end
          end

          local surv = assets:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
          local veeBase = surv and surv:FindFirstChild("Veeronica")
          if veeBase then processVeeConfigMod(veeBase:FindFirstChild("Config"), true) end

          local skins = assets:FindFirstChild("Skins")
          local sSurv = skins and skins:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
          local veeSkins = sSurv and sSurv:FindFirstChild("Veeronica")
          if veeSkins then
            for _, sk in ipairs(veeSkins:GetChildren()) do
              processVeeConfigMod(sk:FindFirstChild("Config"), false)
            end
          end
          veeCatalogHarvested = true
        end
      else
        for cTbl in pairs(veeConfigTables) do
          patchSingleVeeConfig(cTbl, forceRestore)
        end
      end

      if not ext.actorsMod then
        local okA, aMod = pcall(function()
          return require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Gameplay.Actors)
        end)
        if okA and type(aMod) == "table" then ext.actorsMod = aMod end
      end
      local curActors = ext.actorsMod and ext.actorsMod.CurrentActors
      if type(curActors) == "table" then
        for _, act in pairs(curActors) do
          if type(act) == "table" and (act.Player == localPlayer or act.Rig == localPlayer.Character) and isLocalVeeronica(act.Rig or localPlayer.Character) then
            if type(act.Config) == "table" then
              patchSingleVeeConfig(act.Config, forceRestore)
            end
          end
        end
      end

      for cfgTbl in pairs(ext.savedVeeConfigs) do
        patchSingleVeeConfig(cfgTbl, forceRestore)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function findNearestLivingSurvivor(fromPos, maxDist)
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    if not sf then return nil end
    local bestHrp, bestD = nil, maxDist or 15
    for _, surv in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
      if surv:IsA("Model") and surv ~= localPlayer.Character and not surv:GetAttribute("Undetectable") then
        local sHrp = surv:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local sHum = surv:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if sHrp and sHum and sHum.Health > 0 then
          local d = (sHrp.Position - fromPos).Magnitude
          if d <= bestD then
            bestD = d
            bestHrp = sHrp
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return bestHrp
  end

  local function findNearestLivingKiller(fromPos, maxDist)
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    if not kf then return nil end
    local bestHrp, bestD = nil, maxDist or 180
    for _, k in ipairs(kf:GetChildren()) do
      if k:IsA("Model") and k ~= localPlayer.Character then
        local kHrp = k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local kHum = k:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if kHrp and (not kHum or kHum.Health > 0) then
          local d = (kHrp.Position - fromPos).Magnitude
          if d <= bestD then
            bestD = d
            bestHrp = kHrp
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return bestHrp
  end

  local KILLER_M1_STEP = "NergKillerM1Aim"

  local function stopKillerM1Aim()
    local wasBound = ext.m1AimBound
    ext.m1AimBound = false
    ext.m1AimUntil = 0
    ext.m1LockedTarget = nil
    pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(KILLER_M1_STEP) end)
    if wasBound or a724RotLocks["killer_m1"] then
      pcall(function()
        local ch = localPlayer.Character
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        a724RotUnlock(hum, "killer_m1")
      end)
    end
  end

  local function stepKillerM1Aim()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not ext.killerM1Aim or os.clock() > ext.m1AimUntil then
      stopKillerM1Aim()
      return
    end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalKiller(ch) then
      stopKillerM1Aim()
      return
    end
    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
      stopKillerM1Aim()
      return
    end
    local targetHrp = nil
    local locked = ext.m1LockedTarget
    if locked and locked.Parent then
      local tModel = locked.Parent
      local tHum = tModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if tModel.Parent and tModel.Parent.Name == "Survivors" and not tModel:GetAttribute("Undetectable") and tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and (locked.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude <= 16.5 then
        targetHrp = locked
      end
    end
    if not targetHrp then
      targetHrp = findNearestLivingSurvivor(myHrp.Position, 15)
      ext.m1LockedTarget = targetHrp
    end
    if not targetHrp then
      if a724RotLocks["killer_m1"] then
        a724RotUnlock(hum, "killer_m1")
      end
      return
    end
    local flat = Vector3.new(targetHrp.Position.X - myHrp.Position.X, 0, targetHrp.Position.Z - myHrp.Position.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
      a724RotLock(hum, "killer_m1")
      pcall(function() myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
      myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myHrp.Position, Vector3.new(targetHrp.Position.X, myHrp.Position.Y, targetHrp.Position.Z))
    end
  end

  local function triggerKillerM1Aim()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not ext.killerM1Aim then return end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalKiller(ch) then return end
    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then return end
    if not ext.m1AimBound then
      ext.m1LockedTarget = nil
    end
    ext.m1AimUntil = os.clock() + 0.42
    stepKillerM1Aim()
    if not ext.m1AimBound and ext.m1AimUntil > os.clock() then
      ext.m1AimBound = true
      pcall(function()
        runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(KILLER_M1_STEP)
        runService:BindToRenderStep(KILLER_M1_STEP, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 2, stepKillerM1Aim)
      end)
    end
  end

  local PITCH_COMP_ANGLE = -math.atan(1 / 3)

  local function getChargeDisplayGui()
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local tempUi = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TemporaryUI")
    local cd = tempUi and tempUi:FindFirstChild("ChargeDisplay")
    if cd and cd.Parent then
      if cd:IsA("GuiObject") and not cd.Visible then return nil end
      return cd
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function getMyJaneDoeActor()
    if not ext.actorsMod then
      local okA, aMod = pcall(function()
        return require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Gameplay.Actors)
      end)
      if okA and type(aMod) == "table" then ext.actorsMod = aMod end
    end
    local curActors = ext.actorsMod and ext.actorsMod.CurrentActors
    if type(curActors) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local myAct = curActors[localPlayer]
    if type(myAct) == "table" then return myAct end
    for _, act in pairs(curActors) do
      if type(act) == "table" and (act.Player == localPlayer or act.Rig == localPlayer.Character) then
        return act
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function isCrystalAimActiveNow()
    local now = os.clock()
    if ext.crystalCharging and (now - ext.crystalChargeStartAt) > 12 then
      ext.crystalCharging = false
    end
    if ext.crystalCharging or now <= ext.crystalThrowUntil then
      return true
    end
    if getChargeDisplayGui() ~= nil then
      if not ext.crystalCharging then
        ext.crystalCharging = true
        ext.crystalChargeStartAt = now
      end
      return true
    end
    local act = getMyJaneDoeActor()
    local st = act and act.State
    if type(st) == "table" and st.IsCrystalEquipped == true then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end

  local function computeCrystalBallisticAimPos()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ext.jdCrystalAim) then
      return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalJaneDoe(ch) then
      return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
      return nil, nil, nil
    end
    if not isCrystalAimActiveNow() then
      return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local kHrp = findNearestLivingKiller(myHrp.Position, 180)
    if not kHrp then
      return nil, nil, nil
    end

    local act = getMyJaneDoeActor()
    local cCfg = act and type(act.Config) == "table" and act.Config.Crystal
    local minSpd = (type(cCfg) == "table" and tonumber(cCfg.MinSpeed)) or 35
    local maxSpd = (type(cCfg) == "table" and tonumber(cCfg.MaxSpeed)) or 250
    local gravArc = (type(cCfg) == "table" and tonumber(cCfg.ProjectileArc)) or 40
    local maxChargeT = (type(cCfg) == "table" and tonumber(cCfg.MaxChargeTime)) or 2.0
    local chanT = (type(cCfg) == "table" and tonumber(cCfg.ChannelTime)) or 0.2

    local chargeRatio = 1.0
    if not ext.jdInstantCrystal and maxChargeT > 0.05 then
      local elapsed = math.max(0, os.clock() - (ext.crystalChargeStartAt or os.clock()) - chanT)
      chargeRatio = math.clamp(elapsed / maxChargeT, 0.125, 1.0)
    end
    local projSpd = minSpd + (maxSpd - minSpd) * chargeRatio
    local liftY = (hum.HipHeight + (myHrp.Size.Y * 0.5)) * 0.5
    local launchOrigin = myHrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, liftY, 0)

    local kPos = kHrp.Position
    local kVel = kHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local flatVel = Vector3.new(kVel.X, 0, kVel.Z)
    if flatVel.Magnitude > 85 then
      flatVel = flatVel.Unit * 85
    end
    local dist0 = (kPos - launchOrigin).Magnitude
    local tFlight = math.clamp(dist0 / math.max(projSpd, 35), 0.02, 2.2)
    local predPos = kPos + flatVel * tFlight
    tFlight = math.clamp((predPos - launchOrigin).Magnitude / math.max(projSpd, 35), 0.02, 2.2)
    predPos = kPos + flatVel * tFlight
    local gravDrop = 0.5 * gravArc * (tFlight * tFlight)
    local aimPoint = predPos + Vector3.new(0, gravDrop, 0)
    return aimPoint, launchOrigin, myHrp
  end

  local function buildCompensatedCamCF(aimPoint, myHrp, fallbackCF)
    local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
    local camPos = (cam and cam.CFrame.Position)
      or (typeof(fallbackCF) == "CFrame" and fallbackCF.Position)
      or myHrp.Position
    local delta = aimPoint - myHrp.Position
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.05 then
      return fallbackCF or (cam and cam.CFrame) or myHrp.CFrame
    end
    local dirToAim = delta.Unit
    return CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + dirToAim) * CFrame.Angles(PITCH_COMP_ANGLE, 0, 0)
  end

  local function restoreCrystalSilentAimHooks()
    if ext.hookedMouseMod and ext.mouseMod then
      pcall(function()
        if ext.origGetMousePos then ext.mouseMod.GetMousePos = ext.origGetMousePos end
        if ext.origGetCamCF then ext.mouseMod.GetCameraCFrame = ext.origGetCamCF end
      end)
      ext.hookedMouseMod = false
    end
    if ext.hookedUtilMod and ext.utilMod then
      pcall(function()
        if ext.origUtilMousePos then ext.utilMod.GetPlayerMousePosition = ext.origUtilMousePos end
        if ext.origUtilCamCF then ext.utilMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame = ext.origUtilCamCF end
      end)
      ext.hookedUtilMod = false
    end
  end

  local function syncCrystalSilentAimHooks()
    local want = ext.jdCrystalAim and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
    if not want then
      restoreCrystalSilentAimHooks()
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      if not ext.mouseMod then
        local sys = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Systems")
        local ply = sys and sys:FindFirstChild("Player")
        local misc = ply and ply:FindFirstChild("Miscellaneous")
        local mpMod = misc and misc:FindFirstChild("GetPlayerMousePosition")
        if mpMod and mpMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
          local okM, mTbl = pcall(require, mpMod)
          if okM and type(mTbl) == "table" then ext.mouseMod = mTbl end
        end
      end
      local mMod = ext.mouseMod
      if type(mMod) == "table" and not ext.hookedMouseMod then
        if type(mMod.GetMousePos) == "function" then
          ext.origGetMousePos = ext.origGetMousePos or mMod.GetMousePos
          mMod.GetMousePos = function(...)
            local aimPoint = computeCrystalBallisticAimPos()
            if aimPoint then
              return aimPoint
            end
            return ext.origGetMousePos(...)
          end
        end
        if type(mMod.GetCameraCFrame) == "function" then
          ext.origGetCamCF = ext.origGetCamCF or mMod.GetCameraCFrame
          mMod.GetCameraCFrame = function(...)
            local origCF = ext.origGetCamCF(...)
            local aimPoint, _, myHrp = computeCrystalBallisticAimPos()
            if aimPoint and myHrp then
              return buildCompensatedCamCF(aimPoint, myHrp, origCF)
            end
            return origCF
          end
        end
        ext.hookedMouseMod = true
      end
    end)

    pcall(function()
      if not ext.utilMod then
        local mods = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local utils = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Utilities")
        local uMod = utils and utils:FindFirstChild("Util")
        if uMod and uMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
          local okU, uTbl = pcall(require, uMod)
          if okU and type(uTbl) == "table" then ext.utilMod = uTbl end
        end
      end
      local uMod = ext.utilMod
      if type(uMod) == "table" and not ext.hookedUtilMod then
        if type(uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition) == "function" then
          ext.origUtilMousePos = ext.origUtilMousePos or uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition
          uMod.GetPlayerMousePosition = function(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
            local targetPlr = (plrArg == nil and typeof(selfArg) == "Instance") and selfArg or plrArg
            if targetPlr == nil or targetPlr == localPlayer then
              local aimPoint = computeCrystalBallisticAimPos()
              if aimPoint then
                return aimPoint
              end
            end
            return ext.origUtilMousePos(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
          end
        end
        if type(uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame) == "function" then
          ext.origUtilCamCF = ext.origUtilCamCF or uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame
          uMod.GetPlayerCameraCFrame = function(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
            local origCF = ext.origUtilCamCF(selfArg, plrArg, ...)
            local targetPlr = (plrArg == nil and typeof(selfArg) == "Instance") and selfArg or plrArg
            if targetPlr == nil or targetPlr == localPlayer then
              local aimPoint, _, myHrp = computeCrystalBallisticAimPos()
              if aimPoint and myHrp then
                return buildCompensatedCamCF(aimPoint, myHrp, origCF)
              end
            end
            return origCF
          end
        end
        ext.hookedUtilMod = true
      end
    end)
  end

  local function stopCrystalAim()
    ext.crystalCharging = false
    ext.crystalThrowUntil = 0
  end

  local function startCrystalAimWindow(isThrowPhase)
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not ext.jdCrystalAim then return end

    local now = os.clock()

      ext.crystalCharging = false
      ext.crystalThrowUntil = now + 0.85
    else
      if not ext.crystalCharging then
        ext.crystalChargeStartAt = now
      end
      ext.crystalCharging = true
    end
  end

  local JD_HATCHET_STEP = "NergJDHatchetAim"

  local function stopHatchetAim()
    local wasBound = ext.hatchetAimBound
    ext.hatchetAimBound = false
    ext.hatchetAimUntil = 0
    pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(JD_HATCHET_STEP) end)
    if wasBound or a724RotLocks["jd_hatchet"] then
      pcall(function()
        local ch = localPlayer.Character
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        a724RotUnlock(hum, "jd_hatchet")
      end)
    end
  end

  local function stepHatchetAim()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not ext.jdHatchetAim or os.clock() > ext.hatchetAimUntil then
      stopHatchetAim()
      return
    end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalJaneDoe(ch) then
      stopHatchetAim()
      return
    end
    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
      stopHatchetAim()
      return
    end
    local kHrp = findNearestLivingKiller(myHrp.Position, 28)
    if not kHrp then
      if a724RotLocks["jd_hatchet"] then
        a724RotUnlock(hum, "jd_hatchet")
      end
      return
    end
    local dist = (kHrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
    local kVel = kHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local flatVel = Vector3.new(kVel.X, 0, kVel.Z)
    local leadT = math.clamp(dist / 45, 0.04, 0.22)
    local aimPos = kHrp.Position + flatVel * leadT
    local flat = Vector3.new(aimPos.X - myHrp.Position.X, 0, aimPos.Z - myHrp.Position.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
      a724RotLock(hum, "jd_hatchet")
      pcall(function() myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
      myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myHrp.Position, Vector3.new(aimPos.X, myHrp.Position.Y, aimPos.Z))
    end
  end

  local function startHatchetAimWindow()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not ext.jdHatchetAim then return end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalJaneDoe(ch) then return end
    local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myHrp and hum and hum.Health > 0) then return end
    ext.hatchetAimUntil = os.clock() + 1.0
    stepHatchetAim()
    if not ext.hatchetAimBound and ext.hatchetAimUntil > os.clock() then
      ext.hatchetAimBound = true
      pcall(function()
        runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(JD_HATCHET_STEP)
        runService:BindToRenderStep(JD_HATCHET_STEP, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 3, stepHatchetAim)
      end)
    end
  end

  local extCharSeq = 0

  local function clearExtCharConns()
    extCharSeq += 1
    for i = #ext.charConns, 1, -1 do
      local c = ext.charConns[i]
      ext.charConns[i] = nil
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end

  local hookedCdInsts = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

  local function clearExtUiConns()
    table.clear(hookedCdInsts)
    for i = #ext.uiConns, 1, -1 do
      local c = ext.uiConns[i]
      ext.uiConns[i] = nil
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end

  local function isKillerM1Anim(animId, animName)
    if animId and (ext.killerM1Anims[animId] or (A742o_ANIM and A742o_ANIM[animId])) then
      return true
    end
    if not animName or animName == "" then return false end
    for _, bad in ipairs(M1_SKILL_BLACKLIST) do
      if animName:find(bad, 1, true) then
        return false
      end
    end
    for _, good in ipairs(M1_NAME_WHITELIST) do
      if animName:find(good, 1, true) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end

  local function ensureUtilMod()
    if ext.utilMod then return ext.utilMod end
    pcall(function()
      local mods = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
      local utils = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Utilities")
      local uMod = utils and utils:FindFirstChild("Util")
      if uMod and uMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local okU, uTbl = pcall(require, uMod)
        if okU and type(uTbl) == "table" then ext.utilMod = uTbl end
      end
    end)
    return ext.utilMod
  end

  local function forceUnstuckJaneDoeCrystal()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalJaneDoe(ch) then return end
    if getChargeDisplayGui() ~= nil then return end
    local act = getMyJaneDoeActor()
    local st = act and act.State
    if type(st) ~= "table" or st.IsCrystalEquipped ~= true then return end

    st.IsCrystalEquipped = false
    st.CrystalFullChargeTime = nil

    pcall(function()
      local anims = act.Animations
      if type(anims) == "table" and anims.CrystalThrowCharge and type(anims.CrystalThrowCharge.Stop) == "function" then
        anims.CrystalThrowCharge:Stop(0.1)
      end
    end)

    pcall(function()
      local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local an = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
      if an then
        for _, tr in ipairs(an:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
          local aid = tr.Animation and tostring(tr.Animation.AnimationId):match("%d+")
          local aName = ((tr.Animation and tr.Animation.Name) or tr.Name or ""):lower()
          if (aid and ext.jdCrystalChargeAnims[aid]) or (aName:find("crystal", 1, true) and aName:find("charge", 1, true)) then
            tr:Stop(0.1)
          end
        end
      end
    end)

    pcall(function()
      local uMod = ensureUtilMod()
      if type(uMod) == "table" and type(uMod.ToggleLockForAbilityIcon) == "function" then
        uMod:ToggleLockForAbilityIcon("Axe", "JaneDoeCrystalEquipped", false)
      end
    end)

    pcall(function()
      local beh = act.Behavior
      if type(beh) == "table" and type(beh.lcl_OnCrystalUnequipped) == "function" then
        beh:lcl_OnCrystalUnequipped(act)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function bindChargeDisplayWatchers()
    clearExtUiConns()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (ext.jdInstantCrystal or ext.jdCrystalAim)) then return end
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return end
    local function onChargeDisplayAdded(inst)
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
      if inst and inst.Name == "ChargeDisplay" and inst.Parent and inst.Parent.Name == "TemporaryUI" then
        if ext.jdInstantCrystal then
          syncJaneDoeConfigs()
        end
        if ext.jdCrystalAim then
          startCrystalAimWindow(false)
        end
        if not hookedCdInsts[inst] then
          local ancConn
          ancConn = inst.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if not parent then
              ext.crystalCharging = false
              if ext.jdCrystalAim then
                ext.crystalThrowUntil = math.max(ext.crystalThrowUntil, os.clock() + 0.85)
              end
              task.delay(0.38, forceUnstuckJaneDoeCrystal)
              hookedCdInsts[inst] = nil
              if ancConn then
                local c0 = ancConn
                ancConn = nil
                pcall(function() c0:Disconnect() end)
                local idx = table.find(ext.uiConns, c0)
                if idx then table.remove(ext.uiConns, idx) end
              end
            end
          end)
          hookedCdInsts[inst] = ancConn
          ext.uiConns[#ext.uiConns + 1] = ancConn
        end
      end
    end
    local hookedTempUi = nil
    local function bindTempUiFolder(tempUi)
      if not (tempUi and tempUi.Parent == pg) or hookedTempUi == tempUi then return end
      hookedTempUi = tempUi
      ext.uiConns[#ext.uiConns + 1] = tempUi.ChildAdded:Connect(onChargeDisplayAdded)
      local curCd = getChargeDisplayGui()
      if curCd then
        onChargeDisplayAdded(curCd)
      end
    end
    local tempUi0 = pg:FindFirstChild("TemporaryUI")
    if tempUi0 then
      bindTempUiFolder(tempUi0)
    end
    ext.uiConns[#ext.uiConns + 1] = pg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
      if child.Name == "TemporaryUI" then
        task.defer(bindTempUiFolder, child)
      end
    end)
  end

  local vimService = nil
  pcall(function() vimService = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager") end)

  local function fireVeeTrickInput()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ext.veeAutoTrick) then return end
    local pressedBtn = nil
    if type(firesignal) == "function" then
      pcall(function()
        if not ext.sprintingMod then
          local okS, sMod = pcall(function()
            return require(replicatedStorage.Systems.Character.Game.Sprinting)
          end)
          if okS and type(sMod) == "table" then ext.sprintingMod = sMod end
        end
        local mb = ext.sprintingMod and rawget(ext.sprintingMod, "MobileButton")
        if typeof(mb) == "Instance" and mb:IsA("GuiButton") and mb.Visible then
          pressedBtn = mb
          if mb.MouseButton1Down then firesignal(mb.MouseButton1Down) end
        end
      end)
    end
    if vimService then
      pcall(function()
        vimService:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
      end)
    end
    task.delay(0.04, function()
      if pressedBtn and type(firesignal) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
          if pressedBtn.MouseButton1Up then firesignal(pressedBtn.MouseButton1Up) end
        end)
      end
      if vimService then
        pcall(function()
          vimService:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        end)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function findNearestLivingKillerModel(fromPos)
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    if not kf then return nil end
    local bestModel, bestD = nil, math.huge
    for _, k in ipairs(kf:GetChildren()) do
      if k:IsA("Model") and k ~= localPlayer.Character then
        local kHrp = k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local kHum = k:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if kHrp and kHum and kHum.Health > 0 then
          local d = fromPos and (kHrp.Position - fromPos).Magnitude or 0
          if d < bestD then
            bestD = d
            bestModel = k
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return bestModel
  end

  local function scheduleVeeAutoPhase(sessionId)
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ext.veeAutoPhase) then return end
    if ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 or ext.veePhasePending then return end
    local now0 = os.clock()
    if now0 - (ext.veeLastPhaseAt or 0) < 1.0 then return end
    ext.veePhasePending = true
    task.delay(0.12, function()
      ext.veePhasePending = false
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ext.veeAutoPhase) then return end
      if ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 or ext.veePhaseSessionId ~= sessionId then return end
      local ch = localPlayer.Character
      if not isLocalVeeronica(ch) then return end
      local act = getMyJaneDoeActor()
      local st = act and type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
      for _ = 1, 4 do
        if st and st.isSkating == true then break end
        task.wait(0.06)
        if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and ext.veeAutoPhase) then return end
        if ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 or ext.veePhaseSessionId ~= sessionId then return end
        act = getMyJaneDoeActor()
        st = act and type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
      end
      if not (st and st.isSkating == true) then return end
      local meta = type(act.Meta) == "table" and act.Meta or nil
      local curChan = (meta and tonumber(meta.CurrentChannel)) or 1
      local uses = (meta and tonumber(meta.Sk8AbilityUses)) or 0
      if curChan ~= 1 or uses >= 1 then return end
      local myHrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local killerModel = findNearestLivingKillerModel(myHrp and myHrp.Position)
      if not killerModel then return end
      if not ext.netMod then
        pcall(function()
          ext.netMod = require(replicatedStorage.Modules.Network.Network)
        end)
      end
      if type(ext.netMod) == "table" and type(ext.netMod.FireServerConnection) == "function" then
        ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 = true
        ext.veeLastPhaseAt = os.clock()
        if meta then
          meta.Sk8AbilityUses = uses + 1
        end
        pcall(function()
          ext.netMod:FireServerConnection(localPlayer.Name .. "SkatePhase", "REMOTE_EVENT", killerModel)
        end)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function onVeeSk8Started()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (ext.veeLastSk8StartAt or 0) < 0.85 then return end
    ext.veeLastSk8StartAt = now
    ext.veePhaseSessionId += 1
    ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 = false
    if ext.veeAutoPhase then
      scheduleVeeAutoPhase(ext.veePhaseSessionId)
    end
  end

  local function stopVeeWatcher()
    if ext.veeWatchConn then
      local c = ext.veeWatchConn
      ext.veeWatchConn = nil
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    ext.veeWasSkating = false
    ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 = false
    ext.veePhasePending = false
    ext.veeLastSk8StartAt = 0
  end

  local function stepVeeSk8Watcher()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (ext.veeAutoTrick or ext.veeAutoPhase)) then
      stopVeeWatcher()
      return
    end
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    if not isLocalVeeronica(ch) then
      ext.veeWasSkating = false
      ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 = false
      ext.veePhasePending = false
      return
    end
    local act = getMyJaneDoeActor()
    if not act then return end
    if (ext.veeSk8Ctrl or ext.veeWallRebound or ext.veeTrickStam) and type(act.Config) == "table" and not ext.savedVeeConfigs[act.Config] then
      patchSingleVeeConfig(act.Config, false)
    end
    local st = type(act.State) == "table" and act.State or nil
    local skatingNow = (st and st.isSkating == true) == true
    if skatingNow and not ext.veeWasSkating then
      ext.veeWasSkating = true
      onVeeSk8Started()
    elseif not skatingNow and ext.veeWasSkating then
      ext.veeWasSkating = false
      ext.veePhaseFiredThisSk8 = false
      ext.veePhasePending = false
      ext.veeLastSk8StartAt = 0
    end

    if ext.veeAutoTrick and skatingNow then
      local insts = type(act.Instances) == "table" and act.Instances or nil
      local hl = (insts and insts.Sk8Highlight) or ch:FindFirstChild("Sk8Highlight")
      if hl and hl:IsA("Highlight") and hl.Adornee == (act.Rig or ch) then
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - (ext.veeLastTrickAt or 0) >= 0.30 then
          ext.veeLastTrickAt = now
          fireVeeTrickInput()
        end
      end
    end
  end

  local function syncVeeWatcher()
    local want = __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (ext.veeAutoTrick or ext.veeAutoPhase) and isLocalVeeronica(localPlayer.Character)
    if want then
      if not ext.veeWatchConn then
        ext.veeWatchConn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(stepVeeSk8Watcher)
      end
    else
      stopVeeWatcher()
    end
  end

  local function hookLocalCombatCharacter(ch)
    clearExtCharConns()
    ext.hookedChar = nil
    ext.killerSoundsHooked = false
    stopKillerM1Aim()
    stopCrystalAim()
    stopHatchetAim()
    stopVeeWatcher()
    if not (ch and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
    if not isAnyCombatExtOn() then return end

    ext.hookedChar = ch
    local mySeq = extCharSeq
    task.spawn(function()
      local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
      local animator = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5))
      if extCharSeq ~= mySeq or not (ch.Parent and localPlayer.Character == ch and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then
        return
      end

      harvestKillerM1Catalog(ch)
      syncJaneDoeConfigs()
      syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
      syncVeeWatcher()

      local localSndConns = {}
      ext.charConns[#ext.charConns + 1] = {
        Disconnect = function()
          for s, dropFn in pairs(localSndConns) do
            localSndConns[s] = nil
            pcall(dropFn)
          end
        end,
      }
      local function checkLocalM1Sound(snd)
        if not (ext.killerM1Aim and isLocalKiller(ch) and snd and snd.Parent) then return end
        local sid = tostring(snd.SoundId):match("%d+")
        if sid and (ext.killerM1Sounds[sid] or (A655_SWING and A655_SWING[sid])) then
          triggerKillerM1Aim()
        end
      end
      local function bindLocalSound(d)
        if not (d and d:IsA("Sound") and d.Parent) or localSndConns[d] then return end
        local cPlay, cPlaying, cId, cAnc
        local function dropLocalSnd()
          localSndConns[d] = nil
          if cPlay then pcall(function() cPlay:Disconnect() end) cPlay = nil end
          if cPlaying then pcall(function() cPlaying:Disconnect() end) cPlaying = nil end
          if cId then pcall(function() cId:Disconnect() end) cId = nil end
          if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
        end
        localSndConns[d] = dropLocalSnd
        cPlay = d.Played:Connect(function()
          checkLocalM1Sound(d)
        end)
        cPlaying = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsPlaying"):Connect(function()
          if d.IsPlaying then checkLocalM1Sound(d) end
        end)
        cId = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
          if d.IsPlaying then checkLocalM1Sound(d) end
        end)
        cAnc = d.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
          if not parent then dropLocalSnd() end
        end)
        if d.IsPlaying then checkLocalM1Sound(d) end
      end

      local killerSoundsHooked = false
      local function bindKillerSoundHooksIfNeeded()
        if killerSoundsHooked or extCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
        if not (ext.killerM1Aim and isLocalKiller(ch)) then return end
        killerSoundsHooked = true
        ext.killerSoundsHooked = true
        for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
          if d:IsA("Sound") then bindLocalSound(d) end
        end
        ext.charConns[#ext.charConns + 1] = ch.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
          if extCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
          if d:IsA("Sound") then
            task.defer(bindLocalSound, d)
          end
        end)
      end

      ext.charConns[#ext.charConns + 1] = ch.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if extCharSeq ~= mySeq or not ch.Parent then return end
        harvestKillerM1Catalog(ch)
        syncJaneDoeConfigs()
        syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
        syncVeeWatcher()
        bindKillerSoundHooksIfNeeded()
      end)
      ext.charConns[#ext.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SkinName"):Connect(function()
        if extCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
        harvestKillerM1Catalog(ch)
        syncJaneDoeConfigs()
        syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
      end)
      ext.charConns[#ext.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CharacterName"):Connect(function()
        if extCharSeq ~= mySeq then return end
        harvestKillerM1Catalog(ch)
        syncJaneDoeConfigs()
        syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
        syncVeeWatcher()
        bindKillerSoundHooksIfNeeded()
      end)

      bindKillerSoundHooksIfNeeded()

      if animator then
        ext.charConns[#ext.charConns + 1] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
          if extCharSeq ~= mySeq or not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then return end
          local anim = track and track.Animation
          local animId = anim and tostring(anim.AnimationId):match("%d+")
          local animName = ((anim and anim.Name) or (track and track.Name) or ""):lower()

          if ext.killerM1Aim and isLocalKiller(ch) then
            if isKillerM1Anim(animId, animName) then
              triggerKillerM1Aim()
            end
          end

          if isLocalJaneDoe(ch) then
            local isCharge = (animId and ext.jdCrystalChargeAnims[animId]) or (animName:find("crystal", 1, true) ~= nil and animName:find("charge", 1, true) ~= nil)
            local isThrow = (animId and ext.jdCrystalThrowAnims[animId]) or (animName:find("crystal", 1, true) ~= nil and animName:find("throw", 1, true) ~= nil and not isCharge)
            local isAxe = (animId and ext.jdHatchetAnims[animId]) or animName:find("axe", 1, true) ~= nil or animName:find("hatchet", 1, true) ~= nil

            if isCharge then
              if ext.jdInstantCrystal then
                syncJaneDoeConfigs()
              end
              if ext.jdCrystalAim then
                startCrystalAimWindow(false)
              end
              pcall(function()
                track.Stopped:Once(function()
                  ext.crystalCharging = false
                  if ext.jdCrystalAim then
                    ext.crystalThrowUntil = math.max(ext.crystalThrowUntil, os.clock() + 0.85)
                  end
                  task.delay(0.38, forceUnstuckJaneDoeCrystal)
                end)
              end)
            elseif isThrow then
              if ext.jdCrystalAim then
                startCrystalAimWindow(true)
              end
            elseif isAxe then
              if ext.jdHatchetAim then
                startHatchetAimWindow()
              end
            end
          end

          if isLocalVeeronica(ch) then
            local isSk8Anim = (animId and ext.veeSk8Anims[animId]) or animName:find("sk8", 1, true) ~= nil or animName:find("skate", 1, true) ~= nil
            if isSk8Anim then
              if ext.veeSk8Ctrl or ext.veeWallRebound or ext.veeTrickStam then
                syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
              end
              onVeeSk8Started()
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function syncCombatExtState()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
    syncJaneDoeConfigs()
    syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
    syncCrystalSilentAimHooks()
    syncVeeWatcher()
    if not ext.killerM1Aim then stopKillerM1Aim() end
    if not ext.jdCrystalAim then stopCrystalAim() end
    if not ext.jdHatchetAim then stopHatchetAim() end
    bindChargeDisplayWatchers()
    if isAnyCombatExtOn() then
      if not ext.mainCharConn then
        ext.mainCharConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
          if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
          clearExtCharConns()
          ext.hookedChar = nil
          ext.killerSoundsHooked = false
          stopKillerM1Aim()
          stopCrystalAim()
          stopHatchetAim()
          stopVeeWatcher()
          task.delay(0.5, function()
            if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and localPlayer.Character == ch then
              hookLocalCombatCharacter(ch)
            end
          end)
        end)
      end
      local curCh = localPlayer.Character
      if curCh and (#ext.charConns == 0 or ext.hookedChar ~= curCh or (ext.killerM1Aim and isLocalKiller(curCh) and not ext.killerSoundsHooked)) then
        hookLocalCombatCharacter(curCh)
      end
    else
      clearExtCharConns()
      ext.hookedChar = nil
      ext.killerSoundsHooked = false
      stopVeeWatcher()
      if ext.mainCharConn then
        pcall(function() ext.mainCharConn:Disconnect() end)
        ext.mainCharConn = nil
      end
    end
  end

  local function stopCombatExt()
    ext.killerM1Aim = false
    ext.jdInstantCrystal = false
    ext.jdCrystalAim = false
    ext.jdHatchetAim = false
    ext.veeAutoTrick = false
    ext.veeTrickStam = false
    ext.veeSk8Ctrl = false
    ext.veeWallRebound = false
    ext.veeAutoPhase = false
    syncJaneDoeConfigs()
    syncVeeronicaConfigs(true)
    stopVeeWatcher()
    restoreCrystalSilentAimHooks()
    stopKillerM1Aim()
    stopCrystalAim()
    stopHatchetAim()
    clearExtCharConns()
    ext.hookedChar = nil
    ext.killerSoundsHooked = false
    clearExtUiConns()
    if ext.mainCharConn then
      pcall(function() ext.mainCharConn:Disconnect() end)
      ext.mainCharConn = nil
    end
  end

  rawset(_G, "NERG_COMBAT_EXT", {
    setKillerM1Aim = function(v)
      ext.killerM1Aim = v and true or false
      v2.set("killerM1Aim", ext.killerM1Aim)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setJDInstantCrystal = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.JaneDoe then
        ext.jdInstantCrystal = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.jdInstantCrystal = v and true or false
      v2.set("jdInstantCrystal", ext.jdInstantCrystal)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setJDCrystalAim = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.JaneDoe then
        ext.jdCrystalAim = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.jdCrystalAim = v and true or false
      v2.set("jdCrystalAim", ext.jdCrystalAim)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setJDHatchetAim = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.JaneDoe then
        ext.jdHatchetAim = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.jdHatchetAim = v and true or false
      v2.set("jdHatchetAim", ext.jdHatchetAim)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setVeeAutoTrick = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica then
        ext.veeAutoTrick = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.veeAutoTrick = v and true or false
      v2.set("veeAutoTrick", ext.veeAutoTrick)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setVeeTrickStam = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica then
        ext.veeTrickStam = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.veeTrickStam = v and true or false
      v2.set("veeTrickStam", ext.veeTrickStam)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setVeeSk8Ctrl = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica then
        ext.veeSk8Ctrl = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.veeSk8Ctrl = v and true or false
      v2.set("veeSk8Ctrl", ext.veeSk8Ctrl)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setVeeSk8Turn = function(n)
      ext.veeSk8Turn = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 5.0, 1.0, 15.0)
      v2.set("veeSk8Turn", ext.veeSk8Turn)
      if ext.veeSk8Ctrl then
        syncVeeronicaConfigs(false)
      end
    end,
    setVeeWallRebound = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica then
        ext.veeWallRebound = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.veeWallRebound = v and true or false
      v2.set("veeWallRebound", ext.veeWallRebound)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    setVeeAutoPhase = function(v)
      if not EXPERIMENTAL_ON.Veeronica then
        ext.veeAutoPhase = false
        syncCombatExtState()
        return
      end
      ext.veeAutoPhase = v and true or false
      v2.set("veeAutoPhase", ext.veeAutoPhase)
      syncCombatExtState()
    end,
    get = function(k)
      return ext[k]
    end,
    stop = stopCombatExt,
  })

  local function setTabboxHolderVisible(tb, firstSubTab, vis)
    pcall(function()
      local h = (tb and (rawget(tb, "Holder") or rawget(tb, "BoxHolder") or rawget(tb, "Main")))
      if not (typeof(h) == "Instance" and h:IsA("GuiObject")) and firstSubTab then
        local c = rawget(firstSubTab, "Container") or rawget(firstSubTab, "Holder")
        if typeof(c) == "Instance" then
          local cur = c
          while cur.Parent and not cur.Parent:IsA("ScrollingFrame") do
            cur = cur.Parent
          end
          if cur and cur:IsA("GuiObject") then h = cur end
        end
      end
      if typeof(h) == "Instance" and h:IsA("GuiObject") then
        h.Visible = (vis == true)
      end
    end)
  end

    CFG_UI["JDCrystalAim"] = jdSec:AddToggle("JDCrystalAim", {

    CFG_UI["VeeAutoTrick"] = veeSec:AddToggle("VeeAutoTrick", {

    CFG_UI["VeeTrickStam"] = veeSec:AddToggle("VeeTrickStam", {
      Text = "Trick Stamina Boost (10)",
      Default = ext.veeTrickStam,

  local function disconnectList(list)
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
      local c = list[i]
      list[i] = nil
      if type(c) == "function" then
        pcall(c)
      else
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
      end
    end
  end

  local function isUndetectable(ch)
    ch = ch or (localPlayer and localPlayer.Character)
    if not ch then return false end
    if ch:GetAttribute("Undetectable") == true or ch:GetAttribute("Invisible") == true or ch:GetAttribute("Invisibility") == true then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end

  local function isMeNearestSurvivorTo(originPos, tolerance)
    if not originPos then return false end
    local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
    local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myChar and myChar.Parent and myChar.Parent.Name == "Survivors" and myHrp and myHum and myHum.Health > 0) or isUndetectable(myChar) then
      return false
    end
    local myDist = (myHrp.Position - originPos).Magnitude
    local minOther = math.huge
    local otherAlive = 0
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local sf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
    if sf then
      for _, s in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
        if s ~= myChar and s:IsA("Model") and not isUndetectable(s) then
          local sHrp = s:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local sHum = s:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if sHrp and sHum and sHum.Health > 0 then
            otherAlive += 1
            local d = (sHrp.Position - originPos).Magnitude
            if d < minOther then
              minOther = d
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if otherAlive > 0 and myDist > 85 and minOther < myDist then
      return false
    end
    return myDist <= (minOther + (tonumber(tolerance) or 3.0))
  end

  local function ensureStatusesMod()
    if hdec.statusesMod then return hdec.statusesMod end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (hdec.lastStatusesTry or 0) < 1.5 then return nil end
    hdec.lastStatusesTry = now
    pcall(function()
      local mods = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
      local gp = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
      local stMod = gp and gp:FindFirstChild("Statuses")
      if stMod and stMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local ok, m = pcall(require, stMod)
        if ok and type(m) == "table" then
          hdec.statusesMod = m
        end
      end
    end)
    return hdec.statusesMod
  end

  local function matchRevealKeyword(str)
    if type(str) ~= "string" or str == "" then return nil end
    local exact = STATUS_REVEAL_MAP[str] or STATUS_REVEAL_MAP[str:lower()]
    if exact then return exact end
    local low = str:lower()
    for _, kw in ipairs(STATUS_REVEAL_KEYS) do
      if low:find(kw:lower(), 1, true) then
        return kw
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function getActiveRevealStatus(myChar)
    local sMod = ensureStatusesMod()
    if sMod and type(sMod.CurrentStatuses) == "table" then
      local myMap = sMod.CurrentStatuses[localPlayer] or (myChar and sMod.CurrentStatuses[myChar])
      if type(myMap) == "table" then
        for stKey, rec in pairs(myMap) do
          local matched = matchRevealKeyword(tostring(stKey))
          if matched and rec ~= nil then
            local rem = nil
            if type(rec) == "table" then
              local tReq = tonumber(rec.TimeRequired)
              local tPast = tonumber(rec.TimePast)
              if tReq and tPast then
                rem = math.max(0, tReq - tPast)
              end
            end
            if rem == nil or rem > 0.02 then
              return true, matched, rem
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local pg = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local mu = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MainUI")
    if mu then
      for _, sc in ipairs(mu:GetChildren()) do
        if sc.Name == "StatusContainer" then
          for _, ch in ipairs(sc:GetChildren()) do
            local matched = matchRevealKeyword(ch.Name)
            if matched then
              return true, matched, nil
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false, nil, nil
  end

  local function isForeignRevealHighlight(hl, myChar)
    if not (hl and hl:IsA("Highlight") and hl.Parent and myChar) then return false end
    if not hl.Enabled then return false end
    local nm = hl.Name
    if nm == "goodbai" or nm == "Highlight" or nm == "Sk8Highlight" or nm == "VFXHighlight" then
      return false
    end
    if hl:GetAttribute("NergHL") == true or nm == tostring(_G.__NERG_HL_NAME) or nm == "External_Protected_HL" or nm == "NP_ObjHL" or nm == "NP_MapItemHL" or nm == "NergGenHL" then
      return false
    end
    if hl.FillTransparency >= 0.98 and hl.OutlineTransparency >= 0.98 then
      return false
    end
    local ad = hl.Adornee
    local targetsMe = (ad == myChar)
      or (typeof(ad) == "Instance" and ad:IsDescendantOf(myChar))
      or (ad == nil and hl:IsDescendantOf(myChar))
    if not targetsMe then return false end
    if nm == "PlayerAura" then return true end
    local p = hl.Parent
    if p and p.Name == "TemporaryUI" then
      local fc = hl.FillColor
      if fc.G > 0.65 and fc.R < 0.45 then
        return false
      end
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
