  local function stopHDecHb()
    if hdec.hbConn then
      pcall(function() hdec.hbConn:Disconnect() end)
      hdec.hbConn = nil
    end
  end

  local triggerTimedReveal
  local function checkActiveMinionTarget()
    local now = os.clock()
    local bestRem = nil
    for m, birthT in pairs(hdec.minions) do
      local age = now - birthT
      local mHum = (m and m.Parent) and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
      local mHrp = (m and m.Parent) and m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
      if not (mHum and mHum.Health > 0 and mHrp and age < 30.0) then
        hdec.minions[m] = nil
      else
        if isMeNearestSurvivorTo(mHrp.Position, 3.0) then
          local rem = math.max(0, 30.0 - age)
          if not bestRem or rem > bestRem then
            bestRem = rem
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if next(hdec.azurePlants) ~= nil then
      local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
      local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if myChar and myChar.Parent and myChar.Parent.Name == "Survivors" and myHrp and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 and not isUndetectable(myChar) then
        local linVel = myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local flatSpd = math.sqrt(linVel.X * linVel.X + linVel.Z * linVel.Z)
        local isRunning = (flatSpd >= 16.0)
        if not isRunning and flatSpd > 2.0 then
          if not hdec.sprintingMod then
            pcall(function()
              hdec.sprintingMod = require(replicatedStorage.Systems.Character.Game.Sprinting)
            end)
          end
          if type(hdec.sprintingMod) == "table" and hdec.sprintingMod.IsSprinting == true then
            isRunning = true
          end
        end
        local myPos = myHrp.Position
        local triggeredPlant = false
        for plant, rec in pairs(hdec.azurePlants) do
          if not (plant and plant.Parent and plant:IsDescendantOf(workspaceService)) then
            hdec.azurePlants[plant] = nil
          else
            local bp = rec.part
            if not (bp and bp.Parent) then
              bp = plant.PrimaryPart or plant:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or plant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
              rec.part = bp
            end
            if bp then
              local d = (bp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
              if d <= (rec.radius or 20.0) then
                local plantActive = isRunning
                if not plantActive then
                  local snd = bp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound") or plant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound")
                  if snd and snd.IsPlaying then
                    plantActive = true
                  end
                end
                if plantActive then
                  triggeredPlant = true
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if triggeredPlant and triggerTimedReveal then
          if hdec.timedReason == "Azure Plant" then
            hdec.lastTriggerAt["Azure Plant"] = 0
          end
          triggerTimedReveal(3.0, "Azure Plant")
        end
      end
    end
    if bestRem then
      return true, "Pizza Target", bestRem
    end
    return false, nil, nil
  end

  local function checkRawDirectExposure()
    local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
    if not (myChar and myChar.Parent and myChar.Parent.Name == "Survivors") or isUndetectable(myChar) then
      return false, nil, nil
    end
    if myChar:GetAttribute("Revealed") == true or myChar:GetAttribute("Highlighted") == true then
      return true, "Attribute", nil
    end
    local hasSt, stName, stRem = getActiveRevealStatus(myChar)
    if hasSt then
      return true, stName, stRem
    end
    local hasMinion, minionName, minionRem = checkActiveMinionTarget()
    if hasMinion then
      return true, minionName, minionRem
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
      if d:IsA("Highlight") and isForeignRevealHighlight(d, myChar) then
        return true, (d.Name == "PlayerAura" and "PlayerAura" or "Highlight"), nil
      end
    end
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local tempUi = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TemporaryUI")
    if tempUi then
      for _, ch in ipairs(tempUi:GetChildren()) do
        if ch:IsA("Highlight") and isForeignRevealHighlight(ch, myChar) then
          return true, (ch.Name == "PlayerAura" and "PlayerAura" or "Highlight"), nil
        end
        if ch.Name == "PlayerAura" then
          local okAd, ad = pcall(function() return (ch :: any).Adornee end)
          if okAd and (ad == myChar or (typeof(ad) == "Instance" and ad:IsDescendantOf(myChar))) then
            return true, "PlayerAura", nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local myHum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local containers = {
      myHum and myHum:FindFirstChild("Status"),
      myChar:FindFirstChild("StatusEffects"),
      myChar:FindFirstChild("Effects"),
    }
    for _, folder in ipairs(containers) do
      if folder then
        for _, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
          local matched = matchRevealKeyword(item.Name)
          if matched then
            return true, matched, nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false, nil, nil
  end

  local evaluateDirectExposure
  local function syncHDecVisual()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not hdec.on then
      if hdec.bb then hdec.bb.Enabled = false end
      stopHDecHb()
      return
    end
    local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
    if not (myChar and myChar.Parent and myChar.Parent.Name == "Survivors") or isUndetectable(myChar) then
      hdec.directExposed = false
      hdec.directReason = nil
      hdec.directRem = nil
      hdec.timedUntil = 0
      hdec.timedReason = nil
      if hdec.bb then hdec.bb.Enabled = false end
      stopHDecHb()
      return
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    local remTimed = hdec.timedUntil - now
    local activeTimed = remTimed > 0
    if not activeTimed and hdec.timedUntil > 0 then
      hdec.timedUntil = 0
      hdec.timedReason = nil
    end
    local hasMinions = next(hdec.minions) ~= nil or next(hdec.azurePlants) ~= nil
    if not hdec.directExposed and not activeTimed then
      if hdec.bb then hdec.bb.Enabled = false end
      if not hasMinions then
        stopHDecHb()
        return
      end
    end

    if hdec.directExposed or activeTimed then
      local adornee = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not adornee then
        if hdec.bb then hdec.bb.Enabled = false end
        stopHDecHb()
        return
      end

      local bb, lbl = ensureHDecGui()
      if bb.Adornee ~= adornee then
        bb.Adornee = adornee
      end
      local txt = string.format("👁️ REVEALED (%s)", tostring(hdec.directReason or "Aura"))
      if activeTimed then
        txt = string.format("👁️ REVEALED: %s [%.1fs]", tostring(hdec.timedReason or "Aura"), remTimed)
      else
        if type(hdec.directRem) == "number" and hdec.directRem > 0 then
          txt = string.format("👁️ REVEALED: %s [%.1fs]", tostring(hdec.directReason or "Status"), hdec.directRem)
        end
      end
      if lbl.Text ~= txt then
        lbl.Text = txt
      end
      if not bb.Enabled then
        bb.Enabled = true
      end
    end

    if not hdec.hbConn then
      hdec.hbAcc = 0
      hdec.hbConn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not hdec.on then
          syncHDecVisual()
          return
        end
        hdec.hbAcc += (dt or 0.016)
        if hdec.hbAcc < 0.10 then return end
        hdec.hbAcc = 0
        if (hdec.directExposed or next(hdec.minions) ~= nil or next(hdec.azurePlants) ~= nil) and evaluateDirectExposure then
          evaluateDirectExposure()
        else
          syncHDecVisual()
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  evaluateDirectExposure = function()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not hdec.on then return end
    local found, reason, rem = checkRawDirectExposure()
    hdec.directExposed = found
    hdec.directReason = reason
    hdec.directRem = rem
    syncHDecVisual()
  end

  triggerTimedReveal = function(duration, reason)
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not hdec.on then return end
    local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
    if not (myChar and myChar.Parent and myChar.Parent.Name == "Survivors") or isUndetectable(myChar) then
      return
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    local dur = tonumber(duration) or 6.0
    local rStr = tostring(reason or "Aura Reveal")
    local lastAt = hdec.lastTriggerAt[rStr] or 0
    if hdec.timedReason == rStr and hdec.timedUntil > now then
      if (now - lastAt) <= 2.2 then
        local cand = lastAt + dur
        if cand > hdec.timedUntil then
          hdec.timedUntil = cand
        end
      else
        hdec.timedUntil = now + dur
        hdec.lastTriggerAt[rStr] = now
      end
    else
      local newUntil = now + dur
      if newUntil > hdec.timedUntil then
        hdec.timedUntil = newUntil
        hdec.timedReason = rStr
        hdec.lastTriggerAt[rStr] = now
      end
    end
    syncHDecVisual()
  end

  local function harvestRevealCatalog()
    if hdec.catalogBuilt then return end
    hdec.catalogBuilt = true
    pcall(function()
      local assets = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      if not assets then return end
      local function extractIds(val, outTbl, infoObj, depth)
        if (depth or 0) > 3 or val == nil then return end
        if type(val) == "string" or type(val) == "number" then
          local id = tostring(val):match("%d+")
          if id and not outTbl[id] then outTbl[id] = infoObj end
          return
        end
        if typeof(val) == "Instance" and (val:IsA("Animation") or val:IsA("Sound")) then
          local raw = val:IsA("Animation") and val.AnimationId or val.SoundId
          local id = tostring(raw):match("%d+")
          if id and not outTbl[id] then outTbl[id] = infoObj end
          return
        end
        if type(val) == "table" then
          for _, v in pairs(val) do
            extractIds(v, outTbl, infoObj, (depth or 0) + 1)
          end
        end
      end
      local function scanSubTable(subTbl, outTbl, r, info)
        if type(subTbl) ~= "table" then return end
        for k, v in pairs(subTbl) do
          local kl = tostring(k):lower()
          for _, kw in ipairs(r.keys) do
            if kl:find(kw, 1, true) then
              extractIds(v, outTbl, info, 0)
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local function scanCfgMod(cfgMod, kName, baseCfg)
        if not (cfgMod and cfgMod:IsA("ModuleScript")) then return end
        local ok, cfg = pcall(require, cfgMod)
        if not (ok and type(cfg) == "table") then return end
        local rules = REVEAL_KILLER_RULES[kName]
        if not rules then return end
        local kAnims = hdec.revealAnims[kName] or {}
        hdec.revealAnims[kName] = kAnims
        local kSnds = hdec.revealSounds[kName] or {}
        hdec.revealSounds[kName] = kSnds
        for _, r in ipairs(rules) do
          local baseDur = (r.durKey and (tonumber(cfg[r.durKey]) or (baseCfg and tonumber(baseCfg[r.durKey])))) or r.defDur
          local extraDur = (r.extraDurKey and (tonumber(cfg[r.extraDurKey]) or (baseCfg and tonumber(baseCfg[r.extraDurKey])))) or 0
          local dur = baseDur + extraDur + (r.windup or 0)
          local info = { label = r.label, dur = dur, nearestOnly = r.nearestOnly, hitRadius = r.hitRadius }
          scanSubTable(cfg.Animations, kAnims, r, info)
          scanSubTable(cfg.Sounds, kSnds, r, info)
        end
        return cfg
      end
      local killersFolder = assets:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      local skinsKillers = assets:FindFirstChild("Skins") and assets.Skins:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      for kName in pairs(REVEAL_KILLER_RULES) do
        local kDir = killersFolder and killersFolder:FindFirstChild(kName)
        local baseCfg = kDir and scanCfgMod(kDir:FindFirstChild("Config"), kName, nil)
        local skDir = skinsKillers and skinsKillers:FindFirstChild(kName)
        if skDir then
          for _, sk in ipairs(skDir:GetChildren()) do
            scanCfgMod(sk:FindFirstChild("Config"), kName, baseCfg)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  local function bindTempUi()
    disconnectList(hdec.tempUiConns)
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
    local pg = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return end
    local tempUi = pg:FindFirstChild("TemporaryUI")
    if tempUi then
      hdec.tempUiConns[#hdec.tempUiConns + 1] = tempUi.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      end)
      hdec.tempUiConns[#hdec.tempUiConns + 1] = tempUi.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      end)
    end
  end

  local function bindStatusContainer()
    disconnectList(hdec.statusUiConns)
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
    local pg = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local mu = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MainUI")
    if mu then
      for _, sc in ipairs(mu:GetChildren()) do
        if sc.Name == "StatusContainer" then
          hdec.statusUiConns[#hdec.statusUiConns + 1] = sc.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
            task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
          end)
          hdec.statusUiConns[#hdec.statusUiConns + 1] = sc.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
            task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
          end)
        end
      end
    end
    local sMod = ensureStatusesMod()
    if sMod then
      local function hookStatusSig(sig)
        if type(sig) ~= "table" and typeof(sig) ~= "RBXScriptSignal" then return end
        local ok, conn = pcall(function()
          return sig:Connect(function(plr)
            if plr == nil or plr == localPlayer or plr == localPlayer.Character then
              task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
            end
          end)
        end)
        if ok and conn then
          hdec.statusUiConns[#hdec.statusUiConns + 1] = function()
            if type(conn) == "table" or typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
              if conn.Disconnect then
                pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
              elseif conn.Destroy then
                pcall(function() conn:Destroy() end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      hookStatusSig(sMod.StatusApplied)
      hookStatusSig(sMod.StatusUpdated)
      hookStatusSig(sMod.StatusRemoved)
    end
  end

  local function bindMyCharacter(ch)
    disconnectList(hdec.charConns)
    hdec.directExposed = false
    hdec.directReason = nil
    hdec.directRem = nil
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on and ch) then
      syncHDecVisual()
      return
    end
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Undetectable"):Connect(evaluateDirectExposure)
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Invisible"):Connect(evaluateDirectExposure)
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Invisibility"):Connect(evaluateDirectExposure)
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Revealed"):Connect(evaluateDirectExposure)
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Highlighted"):Connect(evaluateDirectExposure)
    local hookedStatusFolders = {}
    local function bindStatusSubfolder(f)
      if not (f and (f.Name == "StatusEffects" or f.Name == "Effects" or f.Name == "Status")) or hookedStatusFolders[f] then
        return
      end
      hookedStatusFolders[f] = true
      hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = f.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      end)
      hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = f.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      end)
    end
    for _, subName in ipairs({ "StatusEffects", "Effects" }) do
      bindStatusSubfolder(ch:FindFirstChild(subName))
    end
    local myHum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if myHum then
      bindStatusSubfolder(myHum:FindFirstChild("Status"))
    end
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch.ChildAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("Highlight") then
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      elseif d.Name == "StatusEffects" or d.Name == "Effects" then
        bindStatusSubfolder(d)
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      end
    end)
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("Highlight") or d.Name == "StatusEffects" or d.Name == "Effects" then
        task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
      end
    end)
    hdec.charConns[#hdec.charConns + 1] = ch.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
    end)
    task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
  end

  local function unhookKillerReveal(k)
    local c = hdec.killerConns[k]
    if c then
      hdec.killerConns[k] = nil
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end

  local function hookKillerForReveal(k)
    if not (k and k:IsA("Model") and k.Parent and hdec.on) or hdec.killerConns[k] then return end
    local subConns = {}
    local sndMap = {}
    local function dropAll()
      hdec.killerConns[k] = nil
      for s, fn in pairs(sndMap) do
        sndMap[s] = nil
        pcall(fn)
      end
      disconnectList(subConns)
    end
    hdec.killerConns[k] = { Disconnect = dropAll }

    local function getKillerBaseName()
      return tostring(k:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or k.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
    end

    local function dispatchRevealInfo(info, srcInst)
      if not info then return end
      if info.hitRadius then
        local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return end
        local hitMe = (srcInst and myChar and srcInst:IsDescendantOf(myChar)) or false
        if not hitMe and srcInst then
          local p = srcInst.Parent
          while p and p ~= workspaceService and not p:IsA("BasePart") do
            p = p.Parent
          end
          if p and p:IsA("BasePart") and (p.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude <= info.hitRadius then
            hitMe = true
          end
        end
        if not hitMe then return end
      end
      if info.nearestOnly then
        local kHrp = k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (kHrp and isMeNearestSurvivorTo(kHrp.Position, 3.0)) then
          return
        end
      end
      triggerTimedReveal(info.dur, info.label)
    end

    local function checkKillerSound(snd)
      if not (hdec.on and snd and snd.Parent) then return end
      local sid = tostring(snd.SoundId):match("%d+")
      local kBase = getKillerBaseName()
      local kSnds = hdec.revealSounds[kBase]
      local info = (sid and kSnds) and kSnds[sid] or nil
      if info then
        dispatchRevealInfo(info, snd)
      end
    end

    local function bindKillerSound(d)
      if not (d and d:IsA("Sound") and d.Parent) or sndMap[d] then return end
      local cPlay, cPlaying, cId, cAnc
      local function dropSnd()
        sndMap[d] = nil
        if cPlay then pcall(function() cPlay:Disconnect() end) cPlay = nil end
        if cPlaying then pcall(function() cPlaying:Disconnect() end) cPlaying = nil end
        if cId then pcall(function() cId:Disconnect() end) cId = nil end
        if cAnc then pcall(function() cAnc:Disconnect() end) cAnc = nil end
      end
      sndMap[d] = dropSnd
      cPlay = d.Played:Connect(function() checkKillerSound(d) end)
      cPlaying = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsPlaying"):Connect(function()
        if d.IsPlaying then checkKillerSound(d) end
      end)
      cId = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
        if d.IsPlaying then checkKillerSound(d) end
      end)
      cAnc = d.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then dropSnd() end
      end)
      if d.IsPlaying then checkKillerSound(d) end
    end

    local function checkSpeedMult(child)
      if not (hdec.on and child and k.Parent) then return end
      local nm = child.Name
      if nm == "404Error" then
        dispatchRevealInfo({ label = "404 Error", dur = 7.2 }, child)
      end
      if nm == "UnstableEye" then
        dispatchRevealInfo({ label = "Unstable Eye", dur = 8.9 }, child)
      end
      if nm:upper() == "ENRAGED" or nm == "RagingPace" then
        dispatchRevealInfo({ label = "Raging Pace", dur = 16.0, nearestOnly = true }, child)
      end
      if nm:find("BloodHunt", 1, true) then
        dispatchRevealInfo({ label = "Blood Hunt", dur = 25.0 }, child)
      end
    end

    local function bindSpeedMultipliersFolder(sm)
      if not (sm and sm.Parent == k) then return end
      for _, ch in ipairs(sm:GetChildren()) do
        checkSpeedMult(ch)
      end
      subConns[#subConns + 1] = sm.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        task.defer(checkSpeedMult, ch)
      end)
    end

    local sm0 = k:FindFirstChild("SpeedMultipliers")
    if sm0 then bindSpeedMultipliersFolder(sm0) end
    subConns[#subConns + 1] = k.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
      if ch.Name == "SpeedMultipliers" then
        task.defer(bindSpeedMultipliersFolder, ch)
      end
    end)

    for _, d in ipairs(k:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("Sound") then bindKillerSound(d) end
    end
    subConns[#subConns + 1] = k.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("Sound") then task.defer(bindKillerSound, d) end
    end)
    subConns[#subConns + 1] = k.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
      if not parent then dropAll() end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
      local hum = k:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or k:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
      local an = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5))
      if not (an and k.Parent and hdec.killerConns[k]) then return end
      subConns[#subConns + 1] = an.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
        if not hdec.on then return end
        local anim = track and track.Animation
        local aid = anim and tostring(anim.AnimationId):match("%d+")
        local kBase = getKillerBaseName()
        local kAnims = hdec.revealAnims[kBase]
        local info = (aid and kAnims) and kAnims[aid] or nil
        if not info then
          local aName = ((anim and anim.Name) or (track and track.Name) or ""):lower()
          local rules = REVEAL_KILLER_RULES[kBase]
          if rules and aName ~= "" then
            for _, r in ipairs(rules) do
              for _, kw in ipairs(r.keys) do
                if aName:find(kw, 1, true) then
                  info = { label = r.label, dur = r.defDur + (r.windup or 0), nearestOnly = r.nearestOnly, hitRadius = r.hitRadius }
                  break
                end
              end
              if info then break end
            end
          end
        end
        if info then
          dispatchRevealInfo(info, k)
        end
      end)
    end)
  end

  local bindWorldFolders
  local function scheduleBindWorldFolders()
    if hdec.bindWorldQueued then return end
    hdec.bindWorldQueued = true
    task.defer(function()
      hdec.bindWorldQueued = false
      if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on then
        bindWorldFolders()
      end
    end)
  end

  bindWorldFolders = function()
    hdec.bindWorldQueued = false
    disconnectList(hdec.folderConns)
    for k in pairs(hdec.killerConns) do unhookKillerReveal(k) end
    table.clear(hdec.minions)
    table.clear(hdec.azurePlants)
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end

    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    if pf then
      hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = pf.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        if ch.Name == "Killers" or ch.Name == "Survivors" then
          scheduleBindWorldFolders()
        end
      end)
      if kf then
        for _, k in ipairs(kf:GetChildren()) do
          hookKillerForReveal(k)
        end
        hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = kf.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
          task.delay(0.15, function()
            if hdec.on and ch.Parent then hookKillerForReveal(ch) end
          end)
        end)
        hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = kf.ChildRemoved:Connect(unhookKillerReveal)
      end

      local sf = pf:FindFirstChild("Survivors")
      if sf then
        hdec.survCount = #sf:GetChildren()
        hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = sf.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
          hdec.survCount = #sf:GetChildren()
        end)
        hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = sf.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
          local prev = hdec.survCount
          local remList = sf:GetChildren()
          local cur = #remList
          hdec.survCount = cur
          if prev >= 2 and cur == 1 and remList[1] == localPlayer.Character then
            triggerTimedReveal(5.0, "LMS Aura")
          end
        end)
      end
    end

    local mp = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if mp then
      hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = mp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        if ch.Name == "Ingame" then
          scheduleBindWorldFolders()
        end
      end)
      local ing = mp:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
      if ing then
        local function hasCoolkiddKiller()
          if not kf then return false end
          for _, k in ipairs(kf:GetChildren()) do
            local kb = tostring(k:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or k.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
            if kb == "c00lkidd" then return true end
          end
          return false
        end
        local function checkIngameMinion(m)
          if not (hdec.on and m and m:IsA("Model") and m.Parent == ing) then return end
          if players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) or players:FindFirstChild(m.Name) then return end
          local nm = m.Name
          if nm == "GroundBulbModel" or nm == "GroundBulb" or nm == "VineModel" then
            local bp = m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if bp then
              local rad = (nm == "VineModel") and 20.0 or 30.0
              hdec.azurePlants[m] = { radius = rad, part = bp }
              task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
            end
            return
          end
          if nm:find("Sentry") or nm:find("Dispenser") then return end
          local isPizzaName = nm:lower():find("pizza", 1, true) ~= nil
          if not (isPizzaName or hasCoolkiddKiller()) then return end
          local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.WalkSpeed > 0 and hum.WalkSpeed ~= 16 and hum.WalkSpeed ~= 26 then
            if not hdec.minions[m] then
              hdec.minions[m] = os.clock()
            end
            task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
          end
        end
        for _, ch in ipairs(ing:GetChildren()) do
          checkIngameMinion(ch)
        end
        hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = ing.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
          if ch:IsA("Model") then
            task.delay(0.2, function()
              checkIngameMinion(ch)
            end)
          end
        end)
        hdec.folderConns[#hdec.folderConns + 1] = ing.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(ch)
          if hdec.minions[ch] or hdec.azurePlants[ch] then
            hdec.minions[ch] = nil
            hdec.azurePlants[ch] = nil
            task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end

  local function stopHDec()
    hdec.bindWorldQueued = false
    hdec.directExposed = false
    hdec.directReason = nil
    hdec.directRem = nil
    hdec.timedUntil = 0
    hdec.timedReason = nil
    table.clear(hdec.lastTriggerAt)
    table.clear(hdec.minions)
    table.clear(hdec.azurePlants)
    stopHDecHb()
    disconnectList(hdec.charConns)
    disconnectList(hdec.tempUiConns)
    disconnectList(hdec.statusUiConns)
    disconnectList(hdec.folderConns)
    if hdec.rootConns then
      disconnectList(hdec.rootConns)
    end
    for k in pairs(hdec.killerConns) do unhookKillerReveal(k) end
    if hdec.gui then
      pcall(function() hdec.gui:Destroy() end)
      hdec.gui, hdec.bb, hdec.lbl = nil, nil, nil
    end
  end

  local function startHDec()
    stopHDec()
    if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
    hdec.rootConns = hdec.rootConns or {}
    harvestRevealCatalog()
    bindTempUi()
    bindStatusContainer()
    bindWorldFolders()
    if localPlayer.Character then
      bindMyCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
    end
    hdec.rootConns[#hdec.rootConns + 1] = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
      hdec.timedUntil = 0
      hdec.timedReason = nil
      task.delay(0.35, function()
        if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on and localPlayer.Character == ch then
          bindTempUi()
          bindStatusContainer()
          bindWorldFolders()
          bindMyCharacter(ch)
        end
      end)
    end)
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg then
      local hookedMainUi = nil
      local function bindMainUiForStatus(mu)
        if not (mu and mu.Parent == pg) or hookedMainUi == mu then return end
        hookedMainUi = mu
        hdec.rootConns[#hdec.rootConns + 1] = mu.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
          if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
          if ch.Name == "StatusContainer" then
            task.defer(bindStatusContainer)
            task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
          end
        end)
      end
      local mu0 = pg:FindFirstChild("MainUI")
      if mu0 then bindMainUiForStatus(mu0) end
      hdec.rootConns[#hdec.rootConns + 1] = pg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
        if ch.Name == "TemporaryUI" then
          task.defer(bindTempUi)
          task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
        end
        if ch.Name == "MainUI" then
          task.defer(bindMainUiForStatus, ch)
          task.defer(bindStatusContainer)
          task.defer(evaluateDirectExposure)
        end
      end)
    end
    hdec.rootConns[#hdec.rootConns + 1] = workspaceService.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and hdec.on) then return end
      if ch.Name == "Players" or ch.Name == "Map" then
        scheduleBindWorldFolders()
      end
    end)
  end

  rawset(_G, "NERG_HDEC", {
    get = function() return hdec.on end,
    set = function(v)
      hdec.on = v and true or false
      v2.set("hdecOn", hdec.on)
      if hdec.on then startHDec() else stopHDec() end
      return hdec.on
    end,
    stop = function()
      hdec.on = false
      stopHDec()
    end,
    status = function()
      return {
        on = hdec.on,
        direct = hdec.directExposed,
        directReason = hdec.directReason,
        directRem = hdec.directRem,
        timedRem = math.max(0, hdec.timedUntil - os.clock()),
        timedReason = hdec.timedReason,
        hb = (hdec.hbConn ~= nil),
      }
    end,
  })

  if hdec.on then
    task.defer(startHDec)
  end
end

do
local camCore = {
  fov = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("camFovVal", 70)) or 70, 60, 120),
  origFov = 70,
  zoom = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("camZoomVal", 12)) or 12, 12, 128),
  keep = false,
  on = v2.get("camFovOn", false) and true or false,
  bound = false,
  pushing = false,
  fovPropConn = nil,
  camChangedConn = nil,
}
local function readDefaultFov()
  local pd = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
  local st = pd and pd:FindFirstChild("Settings")
  local gm = st and st:FindFirstChild("Game")
  local fv = (gm and gm:FindFirstChild("FieldOfView")) or (pd and pd:FindFirstChild("FieldOfView", true))
  if fv and (fv:IsA("NumberValue") or fv:IsA("IntValue")) then
    return math.clamp(math.floor(fv.Value), 60, 120)
  end
  local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
  if cam then
    return math.clamp(math.floor(cam.FieldOfView), 60, 120)
  end
  return 70
end
local function writeGameBaseFov(val)
  pcall(function()
    local pd = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
    local st = pd and pd:FindFirstChild("Settings")
    local gm = st and st:FindFirstChild("Game")
    local fv = (gm and gm:FindFirstChild("FieldOfView")) or (pd and pd:FindFirstChild("FieldOfView", true))
    if fv and (fv:IsA("NumberValue") or fv:IsA("IntValue")) then
      fv.Value = val
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local ch = localPlayer.Character
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum:GetAttribute("BaseFOV") ~= nil then
      hum:SetAttribute("BaseFOV", val)
    end
  end)
end
pcall(function()
  local defFov = readDefaultFov()
  camCore.origFov = defFov
  if v2.get("camFovVal", nil) == nil then camCore.fov = defFov end
  local defZoom = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CameraMaxZoomDistance
  if v2.get("camZoomVal", nil) == nil then camCore.zoom = defZoom end
end)
local function camPushFov()
  if camCore.pushing or not camCore.on then return end
  local c0 = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
  if c0 and math.abs(c0.FieldOfView - camCore.fov) > 0.05 then
    camCore.pushing = true
    pcall(function() c0.FieldOfView = camCore.fov end)
    camCore.pushing = false
  end
end
local function bindCameraFovSignal(cam)
  if camCore.fovPropConn then
    pcall(function() camCore.fovPropConn:Disconnect() end)
    camCore.fovPropConn = nil
  end
  if not (cam and camCore.on) then return end
  camCore.fovPropConn = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FieldOfView"):Connect(function()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not camCore.on or camCore.pushing then return end
    if math.abs(cam.FieldOfView - camCore.fov) > 0.05 then
      camPushFov()
    end
  end)
end
local function setCustomFov(v)
  local want = v and true or false
  local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
  if want then
    if not camCore.on then
      camCore.origFov = readDefaultFov()
    end
    camCore.on = true
    writeGameBaseFov(camCore.fov)
    if not camCore.bound then
      camCore.bound = true
      pcall(function()
        runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NergCamFov")
        runService:BindToRenderStep("NergCamFov", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 99, function()
          if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not camCore.on then return end
          camPushFov()
        end)
      end)
    end
    bindCameraFovSignal(cam)
    if not camCore.camChangedConn then
      camCore.camChangedConn = workspaceService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not camCore.on then return end
        bindCameraFovSignal(workspaceService.CurrentCamera)
        camPushFov()
      end)
    end
    camPushFov()
  else
    camCore.on = false
    if camCore.bound then
      camCore.bound = false
      pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NergCamFov") end)
    end
    if camCore.fovPropConn then
      pcall(function() camCore.fovPropConn:Disconnect() end)
      camCore.fovPropConn = nil
    end
    if camCore.camChangedConn then
      pcall(function() camCore.camChangedConn:Disconnect() end)
      camCore.camChangedConn = nil
    end
    local restoreFov = camCore.origFov or 70
    writeGameBaseFov(restoreFov)
    if cam then
      pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = restoreFov end)
    end
  end
end
local function setCamFovVal(n)
  camCore.fov = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 70, 60, 120)
  if camCore.on then
    writeGameBaseFov(camCore.fov)
    camPushFov()
  end
end
local function setCamZoomVal(n)
  camCore.zoom = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 12, 12, 128)
  camCore.keep = camCore.zoom > game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CameraMaxZoomDistance
  pcall(function() localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = camCore.zoom end)
end
camCore.set = setCustomFov
rawset(_G, "NERG_CAM", {
  get = function(k) return camCore[k] end,
  setOn = function(v) v2.set("camFovOn", v and true or false) setCustomFov(v) end,
  setFov = function(n) setCamFovVal(n) v2.set("camFovVal", camCore.fov) end,
  setZoom = function(n) setCamZoomVal(n) v2.set("camZoomVal", camCore.zoom) end,
})
rawset(_G, "__NERG_CAM_RELEASE", function()
  pcall(function() camCore.set(false) end)
  pcall(function() camCore.keep = false end)
  if camCore.zoomConn then pcall(function() camCore.zoomConn:Disconnect() end) camCore.zoomConn = nil end
end)

oceanUI.espPreview = espPrevBox

  _G.NERG_ESP_SET._espPrevBox = espPrevBox
  _G.NERG_ESP_SET._gfxSubTab = gfxSubTab
end

do
  camCore.zoomConn = localPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraMaxZoomDistance"):Connect(function()
    if camCore.keep and localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance < camCore.zoom then
      pcall(function() localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = camCore.zoom end)

end

local stamCore = {
	run = false,
	statsApplied = false,
	conns = {},
	neg = nil,
	origMod = nil,
	origChar = nil,
	memo = { m = nil, t = 0 },
	fire = { v = nil, t = 0 },
	val = { inf = false },
	surv = { on = false, max = 100, min = 0, loss = 10, gain = 20, sprint = 26 },
	killer = { on = false, max = 110, min = 0, loss = 9.5, gain = 21, sprint = 28 },
	view = { conn = nil, dragConns = {}, pos = nil, gui = nil, lbl = nil, lastV = nil, lastM = nil, sim = nil },
	mgmt = { conn = nil, charConn = nil, on = false, pct = 10, locked = false },
}
function stamCore.guard()
	local ch = localPlayer.Character
	if not ch or (ch.Parent and ch.Parent.Name == "Spectating") then
		stamCore._cachedChar, stamCore._cachedHum, stamCore._cachedRoot = nil, nil, nil
		return true
	end
	local hu = stamCore._cachedHum
	if ch ~= stamCore._cachedChar or not (hu and hu.Parent == ch) then
		stamCore._cachedChar = ch
		hu = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		stamCore._cachedHum = hu
		stamCore._cachedRoot = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	if not hu or hu.Health <= 0 then
		stamCore._cachedChar, stamCore._cachedHum, stamCore._cachedRoot = nil, nil, nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end
function stamCore.mod()
	local now = tick()
	if stamCore.memo.m and now - stamCore.memo.t < 2 then return stamCore.memo.m end
	local ok, mod = pcall(function() return require(replicatedStorage.Systems.Character.Game.Sprinting) end)
	if ok and mod then stamCore.memo.m, stamCore.memo.t = mod, now return mod end
	return nil
end
function stamCore.activeRoleCfg()
	local ch = localPlayer.Character
	local p = ch and ch.Parent
	local pName = p and p.Name
	if pName == "Survivors" then
		return stamCore.surv
	elseif pName == "Killers" then
		return stamCore.killer
	end
	return nil
end
function stamCore.calcSprintMult(mod)
	local mult = 1
	if mod and type(mod.SprintMultipliers) == "table" then
		for _, m in pairs(mod.SprintMultipliers) do
			if type(m) == "number" then mult = mult * m end
		end
	end
	return mult
end
function stamCore.captureOrig(mod)
	local ch = localPlayer.Character
	local p = ch and ch.Parent
	local pName = p and p.Name
	if not ch or (pName ~= "Survivors" and pName ~= "Killers") then return end
	if not mod or not (mod.Character == ch or mod.DefaultsSet == true) then return end
	if not stamCore.origMod or stamCore.origChar ~= ch then
		stamCore.origChar = ch
		stamCore.origMod = {
			max = mod.MaxStamina,
			min = mod.MinStamina,
			loss = mod.StaminaLoss,
			gain = mod.StaminaGain,
			sprint = mod.SprintSpeed,
			curSprint = mod.CurrentSprintSpeed,
		}
	end
end
function stamCore.restoreStatsOnly(mod)
	pcall(function()
		mod = mod or stamCore.mod()
		if not mod then return end
		local o = stamCore.origMod
		if o then
			if o.max ~= nil then mod.MaxStamina = o.max end
			if o.min ~= nil then mod.MinStamina = o.min end
			if o.loss ~= nil then mod.StaminaLoss = o.loss end
			if o.gain ~= nil then mod.StaminaGain = o.gain end
			if o.sprint ~= nil then
				local mult = stamCore.calcSprintMult(mod)
				local prevCur = mod.CurrentSprintSpeed or mod.SprintSpeed
				local targetCur = o.sprint * mult
				mod.SprintSpeed = o.sprint
				mod.CurrentSprintSpeed = targetCur
				if prevCur ~= targetCur then
					pcall(function() mod:Resync() end)
				end
			end
		else
			mod.MinStamina = 0
		end
		if type(mod.Stamina) == "number" and type(mod.MaxStamina) == "number" then
			mod.Stamina = math.clamp(mod.Stamina, 0, mod.MaxStamina)
		end
		stamCore.statsApplied = false
	end)
end
function stamCore.restoreMod()
	pcall(function()
		local mod = stamCore.mod()
		if not mod then return end
		mod.StaminaLossDisabled = false
		stamCore.restoreStatsOnly(mod)
	end)
end
function stamCore.apply(mod)
	local ch = localPlayer.Character
	if ch ~= stamCore.origChar then
		stamCore.origMod = nil
		stamCore.origChar = nil
		stamCore.statsApplied = false
	end
	stamCore.captureOrig(mod)
	local roleCfg = stamCore.activeRoleCfg()
	if roleCfg and roleCfg.on then
		local effMax = roleCfg.max
		local effMin = roleCfg.min
		local effLoss = roleCfg.loss
		local effGain = roleCfg.gain
		local effSprint = roleCfg.sprint
		mod.StaminaLoss = effLoss
		mod.StaminaGain = effGain
		mod.MinStamina = effMin
		mod.MaxStamina = effMax
		if type(effSprint) == "number" and effSprint > 0 then
			local mult = stamCore.calcSprintMult(mod)
			local targetCur = effSprint * mult
			local prevCur = mod.CurrentSprintSpeed or mod.SprintSpeed
			mod.SprintSpeed = effSprint
			mod.CurrentSprintSpeed = targetCur
			if prevCur ~= targetCur and mod.IsSprinting == true then
				pcall(function() mod:Resync() end)
			end
		end
		stamCore.statsApplied = true
	elseif stamCore.statsApplied then
		stamCore.restoreStatsOnly(mod)
	end
	mod.StaminaLossDisabled = stamCore.val.inf
	if stamCore.val.inf then
		local capMax = tonumber(mod.MaxStamina) or (roleCfg and roleCfg.on and roleCfg.max) or 100
		mod.Stamina = capMax
		if mod.__staminaChangedEvent then
			local now = tick()
			if mod.Stamina ~= stamCore.fire.v or now - stamCore.fire.t >= 0.25 then
				stamCore.fire.v, stamCore.fire.t = mod.Stamina, now
				pcall(function() mod.__staminaChangedEvent:Fire(capMax) end)
			end
		end
	end
end
function stamCore.stop()
	for _, c in ipairs(stamCore.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	stamCore.conns = {}
	stamCore.neg = nil
	stamCore.run = false
	stamCore.restoreMod()
end
function stamCore.start()
	if stamCore.run then return end
	stamCore.run = true
	table.insert(stamCore.conns, runService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		if stamCore.guard() then return end
		local mod = stamCore.mod()
		if mod and mod.DefaultsSet then stamCore.apply(mod) end
	end))
	table.insert(stamCore.conns, runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		if stamCore.guard() then stamCore.neg = nil return end
		local activeCfg = stamCore.activeRoleCfg()
		if not (activeCfg and activeCfg.on) or stamCore.val.inf or activeCfg.min >= 0 then
			stamCore.neg = nil
			return
		end
		local mod = stamCore.mod()
		if not (mod and mod.DefaultsSet) or type(mod.Stamina) ~= "number" then return end
		local st = mod.Stamina
		if st > 0 then
			stamCore.neg = st
			return
		end
		local ch = localPlayer.Character
		local hu = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local moving = hu ~= nil and hu.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		local isSpr = (mod.IsSprinting == true) and moving
		local nv = stamCore.neg or 0
		if nv > 0 then nv = 0 end
		if isSpr then
			nv = nv - activeCfg.loss * (delta or 0.0166666666666667)
		else
			nv = nv + activeCfg.gain * (delta or 0.0166666666666667)
		end
		nv = math.clamp(nv, activeCfg.min, activeCfg.max)
		mod.Stamina = nv
		if mod.__staminaChangedEvent then
			pcall(function() mod.__staminaChangedEvent:Fire(nv) end)
		end
		stamCore.neg = nv
	end))
end
function stamCore.poke()
	if not stamCore.val.inf then
		pcall(function()
			local mod = stamCore.mod()
			if mod then mod.StaminaLossDisabled = false end
		end)
	end
	local roleCfg = stamCore.activeRoleCfg()
	if not (roleCfg and roleCfg.on) and stamCore.statsApplied then
		stamCore.restoreStatsOnly()
	end
	if not stamCore.run then
		return
	end
	if stamCore.guard() then return end
	local mod = stamCore.mod()
	if mod and mod.DefaultsSet then stamCore.apply(mod) end
end
function stamCore.syncLoop()
	local want = (stamCore.val.inf == true) or (stamCore.surv.on == true) or (stamCore.killer.on == true)
	if want then
		if not stamCore.run then
			stamCore.start()
		end
		stamCore.poke()
	else
		if stamCore.run then
			stamCore.stop()
		else
			stamCore.restoreMod()
		end
	end
end
function stamCore.resetDefaults()
	stamCore.val.inf = false
	stamCore.surv.on, stamCore.surv.max, stamCore.surv.min, stamCore.surv.loss, stamCore.surv.gain, stamCore.surv.sprint = false, 100, 0, 10, 20, 26
	stamCore.killer.on, stamCore.killer.max, stamCore.killer.min, stamCore.killer.loss, stamCore.killer.gain, stamCore.killer.sprint = false, 110, 0, 9.5, 21, 28
	stamCore.mgmt.on = false
	stamCore.mgmt.pct = 10
	stamCore.mgmtStop()
	stamCore.viewStop()
	stamCore.stop()
	pcall(function()
		local prevBoot = uiBoot
		uiBoot = true
		local mapUi = {
			StamInf = false, StamView = false, StamMgOn = false, StamMgPct = "10",
			StamCtl = false, StamSprint = "26", StamGain = "20", StamLoss = "10", StamMax = "100", StamMin = "0",
			StamKCtl = false, StamKSprint = "28", StamKGain = "21", StamKLoss = "9.5", StamKMax = "110", StamKMin = "0",
		}
		for k, val in pairs(mapUi) do
			local ctrl = CFG_UI and CFG_UI[k]
			if ctrl and ctrl.SetValue then
				pcall(function() ctrl:SetValue(val) end)
			elseif ctrl and ctrl.Set then
				pcall(function() ctrl:Set(val) end)
			end
		end
		uiBoot = prevBoot
	end)
end
function stamCore.viewStop()
	if stamCore.view.conn then pcall(function() stamCore.view.conn:Disconnect() end) stamCore.view.conn = nil end
	if stamCore.view.dragConns then
		for i = #stamCore.view.dragConns, 1, -1 do
			local dc = stamCore.view.dragConns[i]
			stamCore.view.dragConns[i] = nil
			pcall(function() dc:Disconnect() end)
		end
	end
	if stamCore.view.gui then pcall(function() stamCore.view.gui:Destroy() end) stamCore.view.gui = nil stamCore.view.lbl = nil end
	stamCore.view.lastV, stamCore.view.lastM = nil, nil
	stamCore.view.sim = nil
end
function stamCore.viewStart()
	if stamCore.view.conn then return end
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "NergStaminaView"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.DisplayOrder = 520
	gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 30)
	lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	lbl.Position = stamCore.view.pos or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.82, 0)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	lbl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	lbl.TextSize = 18
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.Text = "..."
	lbl.Active = true
	lbl.Visible = false
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = lbl
	lbl.Parent = gui
	stamCore.view.gui, stamCore.view.lbl = gui, lbl
	local vDrag, vDragInput, vStart, vPos0 = false, nil, nil, nil
	stamCore.view.dragConns[#stamCore.view.dragConns + 1] = lbl.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if vDrag then return end
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			vDrag = true
			vDragInput = inp
			vStart = inp.Position
			vPos0 = lbl.Position
			local endC
			endC = inp.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inp == vDragInput and (inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel) then
					endC:Disconnect()
					vDrag = false
					vDragInput = nil
					stamCore.view.pos = lbl.Position
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	stamCore.view.dragConns[#stamCore.view.dragConns + 1] = userInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if vDrag and vDragInput and vStart and vPos0 and ((vDragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inp == vDragInput) or (vDragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
			local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
			local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
			local d = inp.Position - vStart
			local nx = math.clamp((vPos0.X.Scale * vp.X + vPos0.X.Offset + d.X) / math.max(1, vp.X), 0.05, 0.95)
			local ny = math.clamp((vPos0.Y.Scale * vp.Y + vPos0.Y.Offset + d.Y) / math.max(1, vp.Y), 0.05, 0.95)
			lbl.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, ny, 0)
		end
	end)
	stamCore.view.conn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local lb = stamCore.view.lbl
		if not lb then return end
		if stamCore.guard() then
			if lb.Visible then lb.Visible = false end
			return
		end
		local mod = stamCore.mod()
		if not (mod and mod.DefaultsSet and type(mod.Stamina) == "number" and type(mod.MaxStamina) == "number") or mod.MaxStamina <= 0 then
			if lb.Visible then lb.Visible = false end
			return
		end
		local m = math.floor(mod.MaxStamina)
		local v
		if stamCore.val.inf then
			local sv = stamCore.view.sim
			if not sv then
				sv = { v = mod.Stamina, pen = false, tur = 0, wasSpr = false }
				stamCore.view.sim = sv
			end
			local ch = localPlayer.Character
			local root = (stamCore._cachedRoot and stamCore._cachedRoot.Parent == ch and stamCore._cachedRoot) or (ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
			stamCore._cachedRoot = root
			local isK = ch and ch.Parent and ch.Parent.Name == "Killers"
			local sLoss = tonumber(mod.StaminaLoss) or (isK and 9.5 or 10)
			local sGain = tonumber(mod.StaminaGain) or (isK and 21 or 20)
			if root then
				local linVel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local flatVelMag = Vector3.new(linVel.X, 0, linVel.Z).Magnitude
				local hum = stamCore._cachedHum
				local moveDirMag = hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude or 0
				local moving = flatVelMag > 0.5 or moveDirMag > 0.1
				local sprinting = mod.IsSprinting == true
				local isSpr = sprinting and moving and (not sv.pen)
				if isSpr then
					sv.tur = math.clamp((sv.tur or 0) + dt * 0.05, 0.2, 3)
					sv.v = math.clamp(sv.v - sLoss * dt, 0, m)
					if sv.v <= 0 then
						sv.v = 0
						sv.pen = true
						sv.tur = 2
					end
				else
					if sv.wasSpr and not sv.pen then
						sv.tur = math.max(sv.tur or 0, 0.11)
					end
					sv.tur = math.clamp((sv.tur or 0) - dt, 0, 3)
					if sv.pen then
						if sv.tur <= 0 then
							sv.pen = false
						end
					elseif sv.tur <= 0 then
						sv.v = math.clamp(sv.v + sGain * dt, 0, m)
					end
				end
				sv.wasSpr = isSpr
			end
			v = math.floor(sv.v)
		else
			stamCore.view.sim = nil
			v = math.floor(mod.Stamina)
		end
		if v ~= stamCore.view.lastV or m ~= stamCore.view.lastM then
			stamCore.view.lastV, stamCore.view.lastM = v, m
			lb.Text = string.format("%d/%d", v, m)
			local r = v / m
			local col
			if r > 0.6 then col = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 130)
			elseif r > 0.25 then col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80)
			else col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80) end
			if lb.TextColor3 ~= col then lb.TextColor3 = col end
		end
		if not lb.Visible then lb.Visible = true end
	end)
end
function stamCore.stopSprintNow(mod)
	if not mod or mod.IsSprinting ~= true then return end
	mod.IsSprinting = false
	local sEv = rawget(mod, "__sprintedEvent")
	if typeof(sEv) == "Instance" and sEv:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		pcall(function() sEv:Fire(false) end)
	elseif type(mod.Toggle) == "function" then
		pcall(function() mod:Toggle(false) end)
	end
	if type(mod.timeUntilStaminaRecovers) == "number" then
		if mod.timeUntilStaminaRecovers > 0.1 then
			mod.timeUntilStaminaRecovers = math.clamp(mod.timeUntilStaminaRecovers + 0.1, 0, 2)
		else
			mod.timeUntilStaminaRecovers = 0.1
		end
	end
	local rEv = rawget(mod, "__timeUntilStaminaRecovers")
	if typeof(rEv) == "Instance" and rEv:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		pcall(function() rEv:Fire() end)
	end
	local mb = rawget(mod, "MobileButton")
	if typeof(mb) == "Instance" and mb:IsA("ImageButton") then
		pcall(function() mb.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end)
	end
end
function stamCore.mgmtStop()
	if stamCore.mgmt.conn then pcall(function() stamCore.mgmt.conn:Disconnect() end) stamCore.mgmt.conn = nil end
	if stamCore.mgmt.charConn then pcall(function() stamCore.mgmt.charConn:Disconnect() end) stamCore.mgmt.charConn = nil end
	stamCore.mgmt.locked = false
	pcall(function()
		local mod = stamCore.mod()
		if mod then mod.BindsEnabled = true end
	end)
end
function stamCore.mgmtStart()
	if stamCore.mgmt.conn then return end
	stamCore.mgmt.locked = false
	if not stamCore.mgmt.charConn then
		stamCore.mgmt.charConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
			if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not stamCore.mgmt.on then return end
			stamCore.mgmt.locked = false
			stamCore.memo.m, stamCore.memo.t = nil, 0
			pcall(function()
				local mod = stamCore.mod()
				if mod then mod.BindsEnabled = true end
			end)
			task.delay(0.5, function()
				if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not stamCore.mgmt.on or localPlayer.Character ~= ch then return end
				stamCore.mgmt.locked = false
				pcall(function()
					local mod = stamCore.mod()
					if mod then mod.BindsEnabled = true end
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end
	stamCore.mgmt.conn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or not stamCore.mgmt.on then
			stamCore.mgmtStop()
			return
		end
		local mod = stamCore.mod()
		if stamCore.guard() then
			if stamCore.mgmt.locked then
				stamCore.mgmt.locked = false
				if mod then mod.BindsEnabled = true end
			end
			return
		end
		if not (mod and mod.DefaultsSet and type(mod.Stamina) == "number" and type(mod.MaxStamina) == "number") or mod.MaxStamina <= 0 then return end
		local below = (mod.Stamina / mod.MaxStamina) * 100 < stamCore.mgmt.pct
		if below then
			if not stamCore.mgmt.locked then
				stamCore.mgmt.locked = true
				mod.BindsEnabled = false
				stamCore.stopSprintNow(mod)
			else
				if mod.BindsEnabled ~= false then
					mod.BindsEnabled = false
				end
				if mod.IsSprinting == true then
					stamCore.stopSprintNow(mod)
				end
			end
		elseif stamCore.mgmt.locked then
			stamCore.mgmt.locked = false
			mod.BindsEnabled = true
		end
	end)
end

		abBtn.BackgroundColor3 = autoBlock and AB_ON or AB_OFF
		local wantText = autoBlock and "AutoBlock : On" or "AutoBlock : Off"

	end

	a742jPaint = abPaint
	a742jGui = abGui
	local function abToggle()
		local now = tick()
		if now - abLastToggle < 0.25 then return end
		abLastToggle = now
		if _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG and _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.toggleAB then
			_G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.toggleAB(not autoBlock, true)
		end

				local ny = math.clamp(py / math.max(1, vp.Y), 0.04, 0.96)
				abBtn.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, ny, 0)
			end
		end
	end)

local function sanitizePreviewRig(cl)
  if not cl then return nil end
  pcall(function()
    cl:SetAttribute("__ESP_UID", nil)
    cl:SetAttribute("__A641_ANIM_EAR", nil)
    cl:SetAttribute("__NP_REAL_GEAR", nil)
    cl:SetAttribute("NergHL", nil)
  end)
  for _, d in ipairs(cl:GetDescendants()) do
    if d:IsA("BaseScript") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("ForceField") or d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("HandleAdornment") or d:IsA("BodyMover") or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
      pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
    elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
      local nm = d.Name
      if nm == "NoclipDetector" or nm == "CollisionHitbox" or nm == "QueryHitbox" or nm:find("Hitbox") or nm:find("Detector") then
        pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
      else
        if nm == "HumanoidRootPart" then d.Transparency = 1 end
        d.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        d.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        d.Anchored = (nm == "HumanoidRootPart")
        d.CanCollide = false
        d.CanQuery = false
        d.CanTouch = false
        d.CastShadow = false
      end
    end
    if d:IsA("Motor6D") then
      pcall(function() d.Transform = CFrame.identity end)
    end
  end
  cl.PrimaryPart = cl:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or cl.PrimaryPart or cl:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
  if cl.PrimaryPart then
    cl.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
  end
  return cl.PrimaryPart and cl or nil
end

local function createFallbackR6Rig(rigName, torsoCol)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = rigName or "PreviewRig"
  local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
  hum.RequiresNeck = false
  hum.Parent = m
  local an = Instance.new("Animator")
  an.Parent = hum
  local function addP(nm, sz, cf, col, trans)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name, p.Size, p.CFrame, p.Color = nm, sz, cf, col
    p.Transparency = trans or 0
    p.Anchored = (nm == "HumanoidRootPart")
    p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
    p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    p.Parent = m
    return p
  end
  local hrp = addP("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), CFrame.new(0, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170), 1)
  local torso = addP("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), CFrame.new(0, 3, 0), torsoCol or Color3.fromHex("#00C2FF"), 0)
  local head = addP("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 4.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245), 0)
  local lArm = addP("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), CFrame.new(-1.5, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 215), 0)
  local rArm = addP("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), CFrame.new(1.5, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 215), 0)
  local lLeg = addP("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), CFrame.new(-0.5, 1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(130, 145, 165), 0)
  local rLeg = addP("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), CFrame.new(0.5, 1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(130, 145, 165), 0)
  local function m6d(nm, p0, p1, c0, c1)
    local j = Instance.new("Motor6D")
    j.Name, j.Part0, j.Part1, j.C0, j.C1 = nm, p0, p1, c0, c1
    j.Parent = p0
  end
  local rotY = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
  m6d("RootJoint", hrp, torso, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * rotY, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * rotY)
  m6d("Neck", torso, head, CFrame.new(0, 1, 0) * rotY, CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0) * rotY)
  m6d("Left Shoulder", torso, lArm, CFrame.new(-1, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0), CFrame.new(0.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0))
  m6d("Right Shoulder", torso, rArm, CFrame.new(1, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), CFrame.new(-0.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0))
  m6d("Left Hip", torso, lLeg, CFrame.new(-1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0), CFrame.new(-0.5, 1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0))
  m6d("Right Hip", torso, rLeg, CFrame.new(1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), CFrame.new(0.5, 1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0))
  m.PrimaryPart = hrp
  return m
end

local function cloneModelArchivable(src)
  if not (src and src:IsA("Model")) then return nil end
  local cl = nil
  pcall(function()
    local prev = src.Archivable
    src.Archivable = true
    cl = src:Clone()
    src.Archivable = prev
  end)
  return sanitizePreviewRig(cl)
end

local previewAnimSlots = {}
local previewAnimConn = nil

local function computeProceduralEmotePose(modeIdx, t)
  local m = ((modeIdx - 1) % 12) + 1
  local s1 = math.sin(t * 4.5)
  local c1 = math.cos(t * 4.5)
  local s2 = math.sin(t * 9.0)
  if m == 1 then
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.16),
      CFrame.Angles(s2 * 0.08, 0, -s1 * 0.14),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.85 - s1 * 0.45),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.85 - s1 * 0.45),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.18),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.18)
  elseif m == 2 then
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, c1 * 0.15),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.12),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -1.4 + c1 * 0.25),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.4 + c1 * 0.25),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.14),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.14)
  elseif m == 3 then
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.14),
      CFrame.Angles(s2 * 0.1, 0, 0),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.95 + s1 * 0.25),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.95 - s1 * 0.25),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.22),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.22)
  elseif m == 4 then
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.cos(t * 3.0) * 0.14),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -math.sin(t * 3.0) * 0.12),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.45 + s1 * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.45 - s1 * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.15),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.15)
  elseif m == 5 then
    local f = math.sin(t * 6.5)
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, f * 0.12),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, f * 0.1),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, f * 0.65),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -f * 0.65),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -f * 0.35),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, f * 0.35)
  elseif m == 6 then
    local sp = math.sin(t * 7.0)
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, sp * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -sp * 0.15),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -1.2 + sp * 0.5),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.2 - sp * 0.5),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, sp * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -sp * 0.2)
  elseif m == 7 then
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.18),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.14),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -1.6 + s1 * 0.4),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.6 + s1 * 0.4),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.25),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.25)
  elseif m == 8 then
    local k = math.sin(t * 6.0)
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, k * 0.12),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -k * 0.12),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.75),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.75),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.max(0, k) * 0.65),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -math.max(0, -k) * 0.65)
  elseif m == 9 then
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.16),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.15),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -1.5 + s1 * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5 + s1 * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.18),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.18)
  elseif m == 10 then
    local stp = math.sin(t * 5.5)
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, stp * 0.22),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -stp * 0.18),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, stp * 0.5),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -stp * 0.5),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -stp * 0.25),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, stp * 0.25)
  elseif m == 11 then
    local mw = math.sin(t * 4.5)
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, mw * 0.14),
      CFrame.Angles(0.08, 0, 0),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -mw * 0.35),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, mw * 0.35),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, mw * 0.35),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -mw * 0.35)
  else
    return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, c1 * 0.12),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -1.2 + s1 * 0.45),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.6 - c1 * 0.35),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s1 * 0.2),
      CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s1 * 0.2)
  end
end

local function ensurePreviewAnimLoop()
  local active = false
  if not oceanUI.closed then
    for _, slot in pairs(previewAnimSlots) do if slot.active then active = true break end end
  end
  if not active then
    if previewAnimConn then previewAnimConn:Disconnect() previewAnimConn = nil end
    return
  end
  if previewAnimConn then return end
  previewAnimConn = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then
      if previewAnimConn then pcall(function() previewAnimConn:Disconnect() end) previewAnimConn = nil end
      return
    end
    if windUI and windUI.Unloaded then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    for k, slot in pairs(previewAnimSlots) do
      local rig = slot.rig
      if not (rig and rig.Parent) then
        if slot.unwatch then slot.unwatch() end
        previewAnimSlots[k] = nil
      elseif slot.active then
        if rig.Parent:IsA("ViewportFrame") then
          pcall(function()
            local vpf = rig.Parent
            local wm = vpf:FindFirstChildOfClass("WorldModel") or Instance.new("WorldModel")
            wm.Parent = vpf
            rig.Parent = wm
          end)
        end
        local tr = slot.track
        local j = slot.joints
        local o = slot.origC0
        if tr and tr.IsPlaying and (tr.TimePosition > 0 or tr.Length > 0) then
          if slot.procApplied then
            slot.procApplied = false
            if j.root and o.root then j.root.C0 = o.root end
            if j.neck and o.neck then j.neck.C0 = o.neck end
            if j.lShoulder and o.lShoulder then j.lShoulder.C0 = o.lShoulder end
            if j.rShoulder and o.rShoulder then j.rShoulder.C0 = o.rShoulder end
            if j.lHip and o.lHip then j.lHip.C0 = o.lHip end
            if j.rHip and o.rHip then j.rHip.C0 = o.rHip end
          end
        else
          slot.procApplied = true
          local rOff, nOff, lsOff, rsOff, lhOff, rhOff = computeProceduralEmotePose(slot.idx or 1, now * (slot.speed or 1))
          if j.root and o.root then j.root.C0 = o.root * rOff end
          if j.neck and o.neck then j.neck.C0 = o.neck * nOff end
          if j.lShoulder and o.lShoulder then j.lShoulder.C0 = o.lShoulder * lsOff end
          if j.rShoulder and o.rShoulder then j.rShoulder.C0 = o.rShoulder * rsOff end
          if j.lHip and o.lHip then j.lHip.C0 = o.lHip * lhOff end
          if j.rHip and o.rHip then j.rHip.C0 = o.rHip * rhOff end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end

local function registerAnimatedPreviewRig(slotKey, worldRig, idx)
  if not worldRig then return nil end
  local chosenIdx = idx or math.random(1, #EMOTE_REGISTRY)
  local em = EMOTE_REGISTRY[chosenIdx] or EMOTE_REGISTRY[1]

  local existing = previewAnimSlots[slotKey]
  if existing and existing.unwatch then existing.unwatch() end
  if existing and existing.track then pcall(function() existing.track:Stop(0) existing.track:Destroy() end) end
  local joints, origC0
  if existing and existing.rig == worldRig and existing.joints and existing.origC0 then
    joints = existing.joints
    origC0 = existing.origC0
  else
    joints, origC0 = {}, {}
    for _, d in ipairs(worldRig:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("Motor6D") then
        local nm = d.Name
        local p1Name = d.Part1 and d.Part1.Name or ""
        if nm == "RootJoint" or nm == "Root" or p1Name == "Torso" or p1Name == "UpperTorso" then
          joints.root = d
          origC0.root = d.C0
        elseif nm == "Neck" or p1Name == "Head" then
          joints.neck = d
          origC0.neck = d.C0
        elseif nm == "Left Shoulder" or p1Name == "Left Arm" or p1Name == "LeftUpperArm" then
          joints.lShoulder = d
          origC0.lShoulder = d.C0
        elseif nm == "Right Shoulder" or p1Name == "Right Arm" or p1Name == "RightUpperArm" then
          joints.rShoulder = d
          origC0.rShoulder = d.C0
        elseif nm == "Left Hip" or p1Name == "Left Leg" or p1Name == "LeftUpperLeg" then
          joints.lHip = d
          origC0.lHip = d.C0
        elseif nm == "Right Hip" or p1Name == "Right Leg" or p1Name == "RightUpperLeg" then
          joints.rHip = d
          origC0.rHip = d.C0
        end
      end
    end
  end

  previewAnimSlots[slotKey] = {
    rig = worldRig,
    idx = chosenIdx,
    speed = math.clamp((em.Speed or 1) * 0.45, 0.75, 1.65),
    joints = joints,
    origC0 = origC0,
  }

  pcall(function()
    local hum = worldRig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
      hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
      hum.Parent = worldRig
    end
    hum.RequiresNeck = false
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then
      animator = Instance.new("Animator")
      animator.Parent = hum
    end
    for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
      tr:Stop(0)
    end
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = em.AnimId
    local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    track.Looped = true
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play(0.1, 1, em.Speed or 1)
    previewAnimSlots[slotKey].track = track
    anim:Destroy()
  end)

  local slot = previewAnimSlots[slotKey]
  slot.unwatch = oceanUI.watch(worldRig, function(active)
    slot.active = active
    if slot.track then pcall(function() slot.track:AdjustSpeed(active and (em.Speed or 1) or 0) end) end
    ensurePreviewAnimLoop()
  end)
  ensurePreviewAnimLoop()
  return em
end

  local function captureRigAppearance(rig, outList)
    table.clear(outList)
    for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
      if d.Name == "_NergChamsShell" then
        pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
      end
    end
    local origDesc = rig:GetDescendants()
    for _, d in ipairs(origDesc) do
      if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and d.Name ~= "_NergChamsShell" and d.Transparency < 0.95 then
        d.Anchored = true
        local isAcc = (d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") ~= nil) or (d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Hat") ~= nil) or (d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") ~= nil)
        local shell = nil
        if not isAcc then
          pcall(function()

            for _, ch in ipairs(cl:GetChildren()) do
              if ch:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                ch.TextureId = ""
                ch.Scale = ch.Scale * 1.05
              else
                ch:Destroy()
              end
            end
            if cl:IsA("MeshPart") then
              cl.TextureID = ""
            end
