            cl.CanQuery = false
            cl.CanTouch = false
            cl.CastShadow = false
            cl.Massless = true
            cl.Parent = d
            shell = cl
          end)
        end
        outList[#outList + 1] = { kind = "part", inst = shell, part = d, origCol = d.Color }
      elseif (d:IsA("SpecialMesh") or d:IsA("FileMesh")) and (not d.Parent or d.Parent.Name ~= "_NergChamsShell") then
        outList[#outList + 1] = { kind = "mesh", inst = d, vcol = d.VertexColor }
      end
    end
  end

  local function applyRigChamsTint(appearList, enabled, teamCol, alphaScale)
    local shellTrans = math.clamp(1 - 0.52 * alphaScale, 0.35, 0.82)
    local partBlend = math.clamp(0.20 * alphaScale, 0.05, 0.25)
    local tcVec = Vector3.new(teamCol.R, teamCol.G, teamCol.B)
    for i = 1, #appearList do
      local rec = appearList[i]
      if rec.kind == "part" then
        local sh = rec.inst
        local pt = rec.part
        if sh and sh.Parent then
          sh.Color = teamCol
          sh.Transparency = enabled and shellTrans or 1
        end
        if pt and pt.Parent then
          pt.Color = enabled and rec.origCol:Lerp(teamCol, partBlend) or rec.origCol
        end
      elseif rec.kind == "mesh" then
        local ms = rec.inst
        if ms and ms.Parent then
          ms.VertexColor = enabled and rec.vcol:Lerp(tcVec, partBlend) or rec.vcol
        end
      end
    end
  end

  local function mountRigInWorld(wm, cam, rig, appearOut)
    for _, ch in ipairs(wm:GetChildren()) do
      pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("Animator") then
        pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
      elseif d:IsA("Motor6D") then
        pcall(function() d.Transform = CFrame.identity end)
      end
    end
    rig.Parent = wm
    local hrp = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or rig.PrimaryPart or rig:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if hrp then
      pcall(function() rig:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)) end)
      for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
          d.Anchored = true
        end
      end
      hrp = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or rig.PrimaryPart or hrp
      hrp.Anchored = true
      local okBB, bbCF, bbSize = pcall(function() return rig:GetBoundingBox() end)
      if okBB and bbCF and bbSize then
        local centerPos = bbCF.Position
        local maxDim = math.max(bbSize.Y * 1.12, bbSize.X * 1.25, 5.4)
        local dist = math.clamp(maxDim * 1.08, 5.8, 15.5)
        local lookDir = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        cam.FieldOfView = 50
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centerPos + lookDir * dist + Vector3.new(0.25, maxDim * 0.08, 0), centerPos + Vector3.new(0, maxDim * 0.05, 0))
      else
        cam.FieldOfView = 50
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 7.2 + Vector3.new(0.4, 0.7, 0), hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0))
      end
    end
    captureRigAppearance(rig, appearOut)
  end

  local function buildKillerPreviewRig()
    local rig = nil
    local pf = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local kf = pf and pf:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    if kf then
      for _, m in ipairs(kf:GetChildren()) do
        if m:IsA("Model") then
          rig = cloneModelArchivable(m)
          if rig then
            curKillerName = tostring(m:GetAttribute("CharacterName") or m.Name):gsub("^[!#]", "")
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if not rig then
      local as = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      local insts = as and as:FindFirstChild("Instances")
      local dum = insts and insts:FindFirstChild("Dummy")
      rig = cloneModelArchivable(dum)
      curKillerName = "Slasher"
    end
    if not rig then
      rig = createFallbackR6Rig("KillerPreview", Color3.fromRGB(235, 95, 95))
      curKillerName = "Slasher"
    end
    mountRigInWorld(wmKiller, camKiller, rig, kOrigAppearance)
  end

  local function buildSurvPreviewRig()
    local rig = nil
    local npcFolder = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CulledLobbyNPCs")
    if npcFolder then
      local list = {}
      for _, c in ipairs(npcFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Model") then list[#list + 1] = c end
      end
      if #list > 0 then
        local pick = list[math.random(1, #list)]
        rig = cloneModelArchivable(pick)
        if rig then curSurvName = pick.Name end
      end
    end
    if not rig and localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
      rig = cloneModelArchivable(localPlayer.Character)
      if rig then curSurvName = localPlayer.Name end
    end
    if not rig then
      local as = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
      local insts = as and as:FindFirstChild("Instances")
      local dum = insts and insts:FindFirstChild("Dummy")
      rig = cloneModelArchivable(dum)
      curSurvName = "Guest1337"
    end
    if not rig then
      rig = createFallbackR6Rig("SurvPreview", Color3.fromRGB(105, 225, 135))
      curSurvName = "Guest1337"
    end
    mountRigInWorld(wmSurv, camSurv, rig, sOrigAppearance)
  end

  buildKillerPreviewRig()
  buildSurvPreviewRig()

  local prevConns = {}
  local kfChildConn = nil
  local pfChildConn = nil
  local killerPreviewDirty = false
  ESP_SET._previewConns = prevConns
  prevConns[#prevConns + 1] = {
    Disconnect = function()
      if kfChildConn then pcall(function() kfChildConn:Disconnect() end) kfChildConn = nil end
      if pfChildConn then pcall(function() pfChildConn:Disconnect() end) pfChildConn = nil end
      if previewAnimConn then pcall(function() previewAnimConn:Disconnect() end) previewAnimConn = nil end
      for _, slot in pairs(previewAnimSlots) do
        if slot.unwatch then slot.unwatch() end
        if slot.track then pcall(function() slot.track:Stop(0) slot.track:Destroy() end) end
      end
      table.clear(previewAnimSlots)
    end,
  }
  local function hookKillersPreviewFolder(kf)
    if kfChildConn then pcall(function() kfChildConn:Disconnect() end) kfChildConn = nil end
    if not kf then return end
    kfChildConn = kf.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
      if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
      if ch:IsA("Model") then
        task.delay(0.5, function()
          if __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
            if oceanUI.visible(espPrevFrame) then
              killerPreviewDirty = false
              pcall(buildKillerPreviewRig)
              if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
            else
              killerPreviewDirty = true
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function bindPlayersPreviewFolder(pf)
    if pfChildConn then pcall(function() pfChildConn:Disconnect() end) pfChildConn = nil end
    if not pf then return end
    hookKillersPreviewFolder(pf:FindFirstChild("Killers"))
    pfChildConn = pf.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
      if c.Name == "Killers" then hookKillersPreviewFolder(c) end
    end)
  end
  local pf0 = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Players")
  if pf0 then
    bindPlayersPreviewFolder(pf0)
  end
  prevConns[#prevConns + 1] = workspaceService.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
    if c.Name == "Players" then
      task.defer(bindPlayersPreviewFolder, c)
    end
  end)
  oceanUI.watch(espPrevFrame, function(vis)
    if vis and killerPreviewDirty then
      killerPreviewDirty = false
      pcall(buildKillerPreviewRig)
      if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
    end
  end)

  local function formatPreviewTag(cName, roleTag, hpStr, stamStr, col, opts)
    local hex = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(col.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(col.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(col.B * 255 + 0.5))
    local l1, l2 = {}, {}
    if opts.Name == true then l1[#l1 + 1] = cName end
    if opts.Role == true then l1[#l1 + 1] = roleTag end
    if opts.Health == true then l2[#l2 + 1] = hpStr end
    if opts.Stamina == true then l2[#l2 + 1] = stamStr end
    if opts.Distance == true then l2[#l2 + 1] = "12m" end
    if opts.Velocity == true then l2[#l2 + 1] = "26 st/s" end
    local s1 = (#l1 > 0) and string.format('<font color="%s">%s</font>', hex, table.concat(l1, " ")) or nil
    local s2 = (#l2 > 0) and table.concat(l2, " | ") or nil
    if s1 and s2 then return s1 .. "\n" .. s2 end
    return s1 or s2 or ""
  end

  local function refreshEspPreview()
    if killerPreviewDirty and oceanUI.visible(espPrevFrame) then
      killerPreviewDirty = false
      pcall(buildKillerPreviewRig)
    end
    local kCol = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("KillerColor")) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 95, 95)
    local sCol = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("SurvColor")) or Color3.fromRGB(105, 225, 135)
    local opPct = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("EspOpacityPct")) or 100
    local tSize = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("EspTextSize")) or 14
    local iconSz = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("EspIconSize")) or 28
    local opts = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.getOptions and ESP_SET.getOptions()) or {}
    local kOn = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("KillerEsp") == true)
    local sOn = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("SurvEsp") == true)
    local tagsOn = (ESP_SET and ESP_SET.get and ESP_SET.get("TagsEsp") == true)
    local showAb = (_G.NERG_ABILITY_ESP == true) or (tagsOn and opts.Abilities == true)
    local alphaScale = math.clamp(opPct / 100, 0.3, 1.0)

    kHdrLbl.TextColor3 = kCol
    sHdrLbl.TextColor3 = sCol

    kHlBox.Visible = false
    sHlBox.Visible = false

    applyRigChamsTint(kOrigAppearance, kOn, kCol, alphaScale)
    applyRigChamsTint(sOrigAppearance, sOn, sCol, alphaScale)

    kVpStroke.Color = oceanUI.tint(kVpStroke, "Color", 4)
    kVpStroke.Thickness = 1
    sVpStroke.Color = oceanUI.tint(sVpStroke, "Color", 4)
    sVpStroke.Thickness = 1

    local boxPx = math.clamp(math.floor(iconSz * 0.62 + 0.5), 11, 36)
    local timerSz = math.clamp(math.floor(boxPx * 0.42 + 0.5), 8, 14)
    local cornerR = UDim.new(0, math.max(3, math.floor(boxPx * 0.2)))
    local function resizeSampleAbBadge(badge)
      if not badge then return end
      badge.Visible = showAb
      badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(boxPx * 2 + 6, boxPx + 2)
      for _, ch in ipairs(badge:GetChildren()) do
        if ch:IsA("Frame") then
          ch.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(boxPx, boxPx)
          local uc = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
          if uc then uc.CornerRadius = cornerR end
          local sh = ch:FindFirstChild("CooldownShade")
          if sh then
            local suc = sh:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if suc then suc.CornerRadius = cornerR end
          end
          local tm = ch:FindFirstChild("Timer")
          if tm and tm:IsA("TextLabel") then
            tm.TextSize = timerSz
          end
        end
      end
    end
    resizeSampleAbBadge(kAbBadge)
    resizeSampleAbBadge(sAbBadge)

    if not tagsOn then
      kTagLbl.Visible = false
      sTagLbl.Visible = false
    else
      local clampedSz = math.clamp(tSize, 9, 14)
      local txtTrans = math.clamp(1 - alphaScale, 0, 0.7)
      local kTxt = formatPreviewTag(curKillerName, "[KILLER]", "HP 100%", "⚡110", kCol, opts)
      local sTxt = formatPreviewTag(curSurvName, "[SUR]", "HP 100%", "⚡100", sCol, opts)
      kTagLbl.TextSize = clampedSz
      kTagLbl.TextTransparency = txtTrans
      kTagLbl.Text = kTxt
      kTagLbl.Visible = (#kTxt > 0)
      sTagLbl.TextSize = clampedSz
      sTagLbl.TextTransparency = txtTrans
      sTagLbl.Text = sTxt
      sTagLbl.Visible = (#sTxt > 0)
    end
  end
  ESP_SET.refreshPreview = refreshEspPreview
  refreshEspPreview()

  local okPass = pcall(function()
    if type(espPrevBox.AddUIPassthrough) == "function" then
      espPrevBox:AddUIPassthrough("ESPEmbeddedPreview", { Instance = espPrevFrame, Height = 228, Visible = true })
    else
      error("fallback")
    end
  end)
  if not okPass then
    pcall(function()
      espPrevFrame.Parent = espPrevBox.Container or espPrevBox
      if espPrevBox.Resize then espPrevBox:Resize() end
    end)
  end
end)

pcall(function()
  local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
  local hudState = { on = false, gui = nil, bar = nil, lbl = nil, hbConn = nil, dragConns = {}, accTime = 0, frames = 0, pos = nil }

  local function clearHudConns()
    if hudState.hbConn then pcall(function() hudState.hbConn:Disconnect() end) hudState.hbConn = nil end
    for i = #hudState.dragConns, 1, -1 do
      local c = hudState.dragConns[i]
      hudState.dragConns[i] = nil
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end

  local function setupStatusHud(v)
    hudState.on = v and true or false
    clearHudConns()
    if not hudState.on then
      if hudState.gui then pcall(function() hudState.gui:Destroy() end) hudState.gui = nil hudState.bar = nil hudState.lbl = nil end
      return
    end
    if not (hudState.gui and hudState.gui.Parent) then
      local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      g.Name = "NergStatusHUD"
      g.ResetOnSpawn = false
      g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      g.DisplayOrder = 550
      g.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

      local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
      bar.Name = "Bar"
      bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 26)
      bar.Position = hudState.pos or UDim2.new(0.5, -65, 0, 12)
      bar.BackgroundColor3 = oceanUI.tint(bar, "BackgroundColor3", 6)
      bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
      bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
      bar.Active = true
      bar.Parent = g

      local cor = Instance.new("UICorner")
      cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
      cor.Parent = bar

      local str = Instance.new("UIStroke")
      str.Color = oceanUI.tint(str, "Color", 1)
      str.Thickness = 1.2
      str.Transparency = 0.2
      str.Parent = bar

      local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      lbl.Name = "StatusText"
      lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
      lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
      lbl.TextSize = 12
      lbl.TextColor3 = oceanUI.tint(lbl, "TextColor3", 5)
      lbl.Text = "FPS: -- | -- ms"
      lbl.Parent = bar

      hudState.gui, hudState.bar, hudState.lbl = g, bar, lbl
    end

    local bar = hudState.bar
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil, nil
    hudState.dragConns[#hudState.dragConns + 1] = bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
      if dragging then return end
      if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragInput = inp
        dragStart = inp.Position
        startPos = bar.Position
        local endConn
        endConn = inp.Changed:Connect(function()
          if inp == dragInput and (inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel) then
            endConn:Disconnect()
            dragging = false
            dragInput = nil
            hudState.pos = bar.Position
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
    hudState.dragConns[#hudState.dragConns + 1] = userInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
      if dragging and dragInput and dragStart and startPos and ((dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inp == dragInput) or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
        local cam = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
        local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        local d = inp.Position - dragStart
        local nx = math.clamp(startPos.X.Scale * vp.X + startPos.X.Offset + d.X, 4, math.max(4, vp.X - 134))
        local ny = math.clamp(startPos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y, 4, math.max(4, vp.Y - 30))
        bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(nx, ny)
      end
    end)

    hudState.accTime, hudState.frames = 0.5, 0
    hudState.hbConn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
      if _G.__NERG_KILLED or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or not hudState.on then
        setupStatusHud(false)
        return
      end
      hudState.frames += 1
      hudState.accTime += (dt or 0.016)
      if hudState.accTime < 0.5 then return end
      local fps = math.clamp(math.floor((hudState.frames / math.max(0.05, hudState.accTime)) + 0.5), 1, 999)
      hudState.frames, hudState.accTime = 0, 0
      local ping = 0
      local okP, pVal = pcall(function() return localPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
      if okP and type(pVal) == "number" and pVal > 0 then
        ping = math.floor(pVal + 0.5)
      else
        pcall(function()
          local net = statsService:FindFirstChild("Network")
          local ssi = net and net:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
          local dp = ssi and ssi:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
          if dp then ping = math.floor(dp:GetValue() + 0.5) end
        end)
      end
      if hudState.lbl then
        hudState.lbl.Text = string.format("FPS: %d | %d ms", fps, ping)
      end
    end)
  end

  rawset(_G, "NERG_HUD", {
    get = function() return hudState.on end,
    set = function(v) v2.set("gfxStatusHud", v and true or false) setupStatusHud(v) end,
    shutdown = function() setupStatusHud(false) end
  })

  do
    local fbOn, ltOn = false, false
    local fbTask, ltWorker = nil, nil
    local gfxConns, fxConns, ltConns = {}, {}, {}
    local ltRoots, rootConns = {}, {}
    local ltQueue = {}
    local ltQueued = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local PROTECTED_LT_NAMES = {
      Players = true, Graffiti = true, GraffitiCL = true, BottleSpawns = true,
      OrangeFruits = true, CurrencySpawns = true, PUMPKINS_SPAWNERS = true,
      Generators = true, Generator = true, FakeGenerator = true,
      PlusVis_DLCHUB = true, NergABBoxes = true, NergProjLines = true,
      ProjectileWindupPreview = true, NergPlus_A743_GearESP = true,
    }
    local lightValues = {
      Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178),
      OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128),
      Brightness = 2, ClockTime = 12, FogStart = 100000, FogEnd = 100000,
      GlobalShadows = false,
    }
    local function alive()
      return __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED
    end
    local function disconnectAll(list)
      for key, conn in pairs(list) do
        list[key] = nil
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
      end
    end
    local function watch(list, signal, callback)
      local ok, conn = pcall(function()
        return signal:Connect(function(arg)
          pcall(callback, arg)
        end)
      end)
      if ok then list[#list + 1] = conn end
    end
    local function applyFxFullbright(inst)
      if not (fbOn and alive() and inst.Parent == lighting) then return end
      if inst:IsA("Atmosphere") then
        if inst.Density ~= 0 then inst.Density = 0 end
        if inst.Haze ~= 0 then inst.Haze = 0 end
        if inst.Glare ~= 0 then inst.Glare = 0 end
      elseif inst:IsA("BlurEffect") or inst:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        or inst:IsA("BloomEffect") or inst:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
        if inst.Enabled then inst.Enabled = false end
      end
    end
    local function pushFullbright()
      if not (fbOn and alive()) then return end
      for prop, value in pairs(lightValues) do
        pcall(function()
          if lighting[prop] ~= value then lighting[prop] = value end
        end)
      end
      for inst in pairs(fxConns) do pcall(applyFxFullbright, inst) end
    end
    local function scheduleFullbright()
      if not (fbOn and alive()) or fbTask then return end
      fbTask = task.defer(function()
        fbTask = nil
        -- A change during this flush may schedule one trailing flush.
        pcall(pushFullbright)
      end)
    end
    local function bindFullbrightFx(inst)
      if not (fbOn and alive() and inst.Parent == lighting) or fxConns[inst] then return end
      local props
      if inst:IsA("Atmosphere") then
        props = { "Density", "Haze", "Glare" }
      elseif inst:IsA("BlurEffect") or inst:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        or inst:IsA("BloomEffect") or inst:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
        props = { "Enabled" }
      else
        return
      end
      local conns = {}
      fxConns[inst] = conns
      for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
        watch(conns, inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop), scheduleFullbright)
      end
      watch(conns, inst.AncestryChanged, function()
        if inst.Parent ~= lighting then
          disconnectAll(conns)
          fxConns[inst] = nil
        end
      end)
      scheduleFullbright()
    end
    local function enableFullbright()
      if not alive() then return end
      if not fbOn then
        fbOn = true
        for prop in pairs(lightValues) do
          watch(gfxConns, lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop), scheduleFullbright)
        end
        watch(gfxConns, lighting.ChildAdded, bindFullbrightFx)
        for _, inst in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do pcall(bindFullbrightFx, inst) end
      end
      scheduleFullbright()
      nergNotify("Graphics", "Fullbright & No Fog applied", 2)
    end

    local function validTarget(root)
      if not (ltOn and alive() and root and root.Parent) then return false end
      if root == ltRoots.lobby then
        return root.Name == "Lobby" and root.Parent == workspaceService
          and workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Lobby") == root
      end
      if root ~= ltRoots.staticMap or root.Name ~= "Map" then return false end
      local ing = root.Parent
      local map = ing.Parent
      return (ing.Name == "Ingame" or ing.Name == "ingame") and map ~= nil
        and map.Name == "Map" and map.Parent == workspaceService
        and workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Map") == map
        and (map:FindFirstChild("Ingame") or map:FindFirstChild("ingame")) == ing
        and ing:FindFirstChild("Map") == root
    end
    local function protectedInstance(d, root)
      if not (validTarget(root) and d and d.Parent) then return true end
      if d ~= root and not d:IsDescendantOf(root) then return true end
      local p = d
      while p and p ~= workspaceService do
        if PROTECTED_LT_NAMES[p.Name] or p:IsA("Tool")
          or (p:IsA("Model") and p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
          return true
        end
        p = p.Parent
      end
      return false
    end
    local function applyLowTexSingle(d, root)
      if protectedInstance(d, root) then return end
      if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d:IsA("Terrain") then
        d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        d.MaterialVariant = ""
        d.CastShadow = false
        d.Reflectance = 0
        if d:IsA("MeshPart") then d.TextureID = "" end
      elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
        -- File meshes use SpecialMesh with MeshType.FileMesh.
        d.TextureId = ""
      elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
        if d.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and not d.Parent:IsA("Terrain") then d:Destroy() end
      elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
        d.Transparency = 1
      elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam")
        or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
        d.Enabled = false
      elseif d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
        d.Enabled = false
        d.Shadows = false
      end
    end
    local function enqueueLowTexInst(d, root)
      if ltQueued[d] == root or protectedInstance(d, root) then return end
      ltQueued[d] = root
      ltQueue[#ltQueue + 1] = { node = d, root = root }
    end
    local function startLtWorker()
      if ltWorker or not (ltOn and alive()) then return end
      ltWorker = task.defer(function()
        local count, started = 0, os.clock()
        while ltOn and alive() and #ltQueue > 0 do
          local job = table.remove(ltQueue)
          local d, root = job.node, job.root
          local ok, skip = pcall(protectedInstance, d, root)
          if ok and not skip then
            if job.children then
              local child = job.children[job.index]
              if child then
                job.index += 1
                ltQueue[#ltQueue + 1] = job
                pcall(enqueueLowTexInst, child, root)
              end
            else
              if ltQueued[d] == root then ltQueued[d] = nil end
              pcall(applyLowTexSingle, d, root)
              local got, children = pcall(function() return d:GetChildren() end)
              if got and #children > 0 then
                ltQueue[#ltQueue + 1] = { node = d, root = root, children = children, index = 1 }
              end
            end
          elseif not job.children and ltQueued[d] == root then
            ltQueued[d] = nil
          end
          count += 1
          if count >= 60 or os.clock() - started >= 0.003 then
            task.wait()
            count, started = 0, os.clock()
          end
        end
        ltWorker = nil
      end)
    end
    local function bindLowTexStaticTarget(slot, root)
      if ltRoots[slot] == root then return end
      if rootConns[slot] then disconnectAll(rootConns[slot]) end
      rootConns[slot] = nil
      ltRoots[slot] = root
      if not root then return end
      local conns = {}
      rootConns[slot] = conns
      watch(conns, root.DescendantAdded, function(d)
        if not validTarget(root) then return end
        enqueueLowTexInst(d, root)
        startLtWorker()
      end)
      watch(conns, root.AncestryChanged, function()
        if not validTarget(root) then
          disconnectAll(conns)
          if rootConns[slot] == conns then
            rootConns[slot], ltRoots[slot] = nil, nil
          end
        end
      end)
      enqueueLowTexInst(root, root)
      startLtWorker()
    end
    local refreshTargets
    refreshTargets = function()
      if not (ltOn and alive()) then return end
      disconnectAll(ltConns)
      local map = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local lobby = workspaceService:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
      local ing = map and (map:FindFirstChild("Ingame") or map:FindFirstChild("ingame"))
      local staticMap = ing and ing:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local function changed()
        if ltOn and alive() then refreshTargets() end
      end
      watch(ltConns, workspaceService.ChildAdded, changed)
      watch(ltConns, workspaceService.ChildRemoved, changed)
      if map then
        watch(ltConns, map.ChildAdded, changed)
        watch(ltConns, map.ChildRemoved, changed)
        watch(ltConns, map.AncestryChanged, changed)
      end
      if ing then
        watch(ltConns, ing.ChildAdded, changed)
        watch(ltConns, ing.ChildRemoved, changed)
        watch(ltConns, ing.AncestryChanged, changed)
      end
      bindLowTexStaticTarget("lobby", lobby)
      bindLowTexStaticTarget("staticMap", staticMap)
    end
    local function enableLowTexture()
      if not alive() then return end
      if not ltOn then
        ltOn = true
        refreshTargets()
      end
      nergNotify("Graphics", "Low Texture Mode queued smoothly", 2)
    end
    rawset(_G, "NERG_GFX", {
      enableFullbright = enableFullbright,
      enableLowTexture = enableLowTexture,
      shutdown = function()
        fbOn, ltOn = false, false
        disconnectAll(gfxConns)
        for inst, conns in pairs(fxConns) do
          disconnectAll(conns)
          fxConns[inst] = nil
        end
        disconnectAll(ltConns)
        for slot, conns in pairs(rootConns) do
          disconnectAll(conns)
          rootConns[slot] = nil
        end
        if fbTask then pcall(task.cancel, fbTask) end
        if ltWorker then pcall(task.cancel, ltWorker) end
        fbTask, ltWorker = nil, nil
        table.clear(ltRoots)
        table.clear(ltQueue)
        table.clear(ltQueued)
      end,
    })
  end

  local initHud = v2.get("gfxStatusHud", false) and true or false

  local gfxSec = (_G.NERG_ESP_SET and _G.NERG_ESP_SET._gfxSubTab) or visualTab:AddRightGroupbox("Graphics Optimizer", "sparkles")
  CFG_UI["StatusHud"] = gfxSec:AddToggle("StatusHud", {
    Text = "Status HUD (FPS/Ping)",
    Default = initHud,
    Callback = function(v) if uiBoot then return end pcall(_G.NERG_HUD.set, v) end
  })
  gfxSec:AddButton({
    Text = "Fullbright & No Fog",
    Func = function() pcall(_G.NERG_GFX.enableFullbright) end
  })
  gfxSec:AddButton({
    Text = "Low Texture Mode",
    Func = function() pcall(_G.NERG_GFX.enableLowTexture) end
  })
  if initHud then task.defer(setupStatusHud, true) end
end)

local genCore = {
	esp = false, espGen = 0,
	conns = {}, hl = {}, tags2 = {},
	bars = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	colr = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	prog = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	core = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	pos = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	cachedGens = nil,
	dirty = true,
	cap = 6,
}
local function genIsFake(name)
	return name == "FakeGenerator" or string.match(name, "^FakeGenerator%d+$") ~= nil
end
local function genIsGen(name)
	return name == "Generator" or string.match(name, "^Generator%d+$") ~= nil or genIsFake(name)
end
local function genResolveCore(child)
	local cached = genCore.core[child]
	if cached and cached.Parent and (cached == child or cached:IsDescendantOf(child)) then
		return cached
	end
	local ins = child:FindFirstChild("Instances")
	if ins then
		local m = ins:FindFirstChild("Generator")
		if m and m:IsA("Model") then
			genCore.core[child] = m
			return m
		end
	end
	genCore.core[child] = child
	return child
end
local function genPosOf(child)
	local cachedPos = genCore.pos[child]
	if cachedPos then return cachedPos end
	local okP, pv = pcall(function() return genResolveCore(child):GetPivot().Position end)
	if okP and typeof(pv) == "Vector3" then
		genCore.pos[child] = pv
		return pv
	end
	return nil
end
local function genProgressOf(child)
	if genIsFake(child.Name) then return 0 end
	local pr = genCore.prog[child]
	if pr == nil or (pr ~= false and not (pr.Parent and pr:IsDescendantOf(child))) then
		pr = child:FindFirstChild("Progress") or false
		genCore.prog[child] = pr
	end
	if pr then
		local okv, vv = pcall(function() return pr.Value end)
		if okv and type(vv) == "number" then
			if vv >= 100 then genCore.bars[child] = nil end
			return vv
		end
	end
	local bar = genCore.bars[child]
	if bar == false then return 0 end
	if bar ~= nil and not (bar.Parent and bar:IsDescendantOf(child)) then
		bar = nil
		genCore.bars[child] = nil
	end
	if not bar then
		local best, bestScale = nil, -1
		for _, d in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Frame") and d.Name == "Bar" then
				local okv2, sv = pcall(function() return d.Size.X.Scale end)
				if okv2 and type(sv) == "number" and sv > bestScale then
					best, bestScale = d, sv
				end
			end
		end
		if best then
			genCore.bars[child] = best
			bar = best
		else
			genCore.bars[child] = false
			return 0
		end
	end
	if bar then
		local okv3, sv3 = pcall(function() return bar.Size.X.Scale end)
		if okv3 and type(sv3) == "number" then return sv3 * 100 end
	end
	return 0
end
function genCore.findMaps()
	local found = {}
	local function harvest(container)
		if not container then return end
		local direct = {}
		for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if genIsGen(c.Name) then table.insert(direct, c) end
		end
		if #direct > 0 then
			table.insert(found, { container = container, gens = direct })
			return
		end
		local gfolder = container:FindFirstChild("Generators")
		if gfolder then
			local gg = {}
			for _, c in ipairs(gfolder:GetChildren()) do
				if genIsGen(c.Name) then table.insert(gg, c) end
			end
			if #gg > 0 then table.insert(found, { container = gfolder, gens = gg }) end
		end
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if map then
		harvest(map)
		local ing = map:FindFirstChild("Ingame") or map:FindFirstChild("ingame")
		harvest(ing)
		if ing then harvest(ing:FindFirstChild("Map")) end
	end
	for _, nm in ipairs({ "ingame", "Ingame", "Game" }) do
		local alt = workspace:FindFirstChild(nm)
		if alt then
			harvest(alt)
			if nm ~= "Game" then harvest(alt:FindFirstChild("Map")) end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function genDone(inst)
	return genProgressOf(inst) >= 100
end
function genCore.clearAll()
	for _, h in pairs(genCore.hl) do pcall(function() h:Destroy() end) end
	genCore.hl = {}
	for _, d in pairs(genCore.tags2) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end
	genCore.tags2 = {}
	table.clear(genCore.bars)
	table.clear(genCore.colr)
	table.clear(genCore.prog)
	table.clear(genCore.core)
	table.clear(genCore.pos)
	genCore.cachedGens = nil
	genCore.dirty = true
end
function genCore.espApply()
	if genCore.dirty or not genCore.cachedGens then
		local list = {}
		local seen = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(genCore.findMaps()) do
			for _, child in ipairs(entry.gens) do
				if not seen[child] then
					seen[child] = true
					list[#list + 1] = child
				end
			end
		end
		genCore.cachedGens = list
		genCore.dirty = (#list == 0)
	end
	local alive = {}
	local doneCache = {}
	local function isChildDone(inst)
		local v = doneCache[inst]
		if v == nil then
			v = genDone(inst)
			doneCache[inst] = v
		end
		return v
	end
	local refPos = nil
	pcall(function()
		local ch = localPlayer.Character
		local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		refPos = (root and root.Position) or (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)
	end)
	local cachedList = genCore.cachedGens or {}
	local validCount = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(cachedList) do
		if child and child.Parent and child:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			validCount += 1
			if genCore.esp and not isChildDone(child) then
				alive[#alive + 1] = child
			end
		end
	end
	if #cachedList > 0 and validCount == 0 then
		genCore.dirty = true
	end
	if refPos and #alive > (genCore.cap or 6) then
		local dMap = {}
		for _, g2 in ipairs(alive) do
			local gPos = genPosOf(g2)
			dMap[g2] = gPos and (gPos - refPos).Magnitude or math.huge
		end
		table.sort(alive, function(a2, b2)
			return (dMap[a2] or math.huge) < (dMap[b2] or math.huge)
		end)
	end
	local limit = genCore.cap or 6
	for i2, child in ipairs(alive) do
		local h = genCore.hl[child]
		if i2 <= limit then
			local coreM = genResolveCore(child)
			if h and not h.Parent then
				h = nil
				genCore.hl[child] = nil
			end
			local genFillT = _G.__NERG_ESP_T and _G.__NERG_ESP_T(0.65) or 0.65
			local genOutT = _G.__NERG_ESP_T and _G.__NERG_ESP_T(0.3) or 0.3
			if not h and not coreM:FindFirstChild("NergGenHL") then
				h = Instance.new("Highlight")
				h.Name = "NergGenHL"
				h.Adornee = coreM
				h.FillTransparency = genFillT
				h.OutlineTransparency = genOutT
				h.Parent = coreM
				genCore.hl[child] = h
				genCore.colr[child] = nil
			elseif h then
				if math.abs(h.FillTransparency - genFillT) > 0.01 then h.FillTransparency = genFillT end
				if math.abs(h.OutlineTransparency - genOutT) > 0.01 then h.OutlineTransparency = genOutT end
			end
			if h then
				local band = "y"
				if genIsFake(child.Name) then
					band = "o"
				elseif isChildDone(child) then
					band = "g"
				end
				if genCore.colr[child] ~= band then
					genCore.colr[child] = band
					local c = (band == "g" and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)) or (band == "o" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
					pcall(function() h.FillColor = c h.OutlineColor = c end)
				end
			end
		elseif h then
			genCore.hl[child] = nil
			genCore.colr[child] = nil
			pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	for child, h in pairs(genCore.hl) do
		if not (child.Parent and child:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or isChildDone(child) then
			genCore.hl[child] = nil
			genCore.colr[child] = nil
			genCore.bars[child] = nil
			pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	for child, bar in pairs(genCore.bars) do
		if not (child and child.Parent and child:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or (bar ~= false and not (bar.Parent and bar:IsDescendantOf(child))) or isChildDone(child) then
			genCore.bars[child] = nil
			genCore.colr[child] = nil
		end
	end
end
function genCore.espStart()
	genCore.espStop()
	genCore.esp = true
	genCore.dirty = true
	genCore.espApply()
	local function markGenDirtyAndApply(delaySec)
		genCore.dirty = true
		task.delay(delaySec or 1.0, function()
			if genCore.esp and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
				genCore.dirty = true
				pcall(genCore.espApply)
			end
		end)
	end
	local function hookGenIngame(ing)
		if not ing then return end
		table.insert(genCore.conns, ing.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
			if c.Name == "Map" or c.Name == "Generators" or genIsGen(c.Name) then
				markGenDirtyAndApply(0.8)
			end
		end))
		table.insert(genCore.conns, ing.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
			if c.Name == "Map" or c.Name == "Generators" or genIsGen(c.Name) then
				genCore.dirty = true
			end
		end))
	end
	local function hookGenMap(map)
		if not map then return end
		local ing0 = map:FindFirstChild("Ingame") or map:FindFirstChild("ingame")
		if ing0 then hookGenIngame(ing0) end
		table.insert(genCore.conns, map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
			if c.Name == "Ingame" or c.Name == "ingame" then
				hookGenIngame(c)
				markGenDirtyAndApply(1.0)
			elseif c.Name == "Generators" or genIsGen(c.Name) then
				markGenDirtyAndApply(0.5)
			end
		end))
	end
	local map0 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if map0 then hookGenMap(map0) end
	table.insert(genCore.conns, workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		if c.Name == "Map" then
			task.defer(hookGenMap, c)
			markGenDirtyAndApply(1.0)
		elseif c.Name == "Ingame" or c.Name == "ingame" or c.Name == "Game" then
			markGenDirtyAndApply(1.0)
		end
	end))
	genCore.espGen = (genCore.espGen or 0) + 1
	local myGen = genCore.espGen
	task.spawn(function()
		while genCore.esp and genCore.espGen == myGen and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
			task.wait(1)
			if genCore.esp and genCore.espGen == myGen then
				pcall(function() genCore.espApply() end)
			end
		end
	end)
end
function genCore.espStop()
	genCore.esp = false
	genCore.espGen = (genCore.espGen or 0) + 1
	for _, c in ipairs(genCore.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	genCore.conns = {}
	genCore.clearAll()
end
rawset(_G, "__NERG_GEN_OPACITY", function()
	if genCore.esp then pcall(genCore.espApply) end
end)


pcall(function()
	CFG_UI["GenEsp"] = mapGenSubTab:AddToggle("GenEsp", {
	  Text = "Generator ESP",
	  Default = false,
	  Callback = function(v)
	    if uiBoot then return end
	    if v then genCore.espStart() else genCore.espStop() end
	  end,
	})
end)
local genA743
do
  local okA743, modA743 = pcall(function()
    local RunA = game:GetService("RunService")
    local RSA = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local LPA = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    -- A743 GEN HELPERS (minigames) — Flow n-1 / Lock frame-exact / Connect mates / Gear ESP
    -- luật: chỉ đường-input thật của game · Heartbeat+accumulator · ESP tự hạ 3s khi có bàn
    local mod = {
      flow = { on = false }, lock = { on = false }, conn = { on = false },
      gear = { on = false }, gearSolve = { on = v2.get("a743mGearSolve", false) and true or false },
      flowMin = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a743mFlowMin", 2.0)) or 2.0, 1.0, 10.0),
      flowMax = math.clamp(tonumber(v2.get("a743mFlowMax", 5.0)) or 5.0, 1.0, 10.0),
      pace = 0.15, jit = 0.2,
    }
    local active = {}
    local hlogC, logL = {}, {}
    local function paced()
      local base = tonumber(mod.pace) or 0.15
      local j = tonumber(mod.jit) or 0
      local d = base * (1 - j + math.random() * 2 * j)
      if d < 0.03 then d = 0.03 end
      return d
    end
    local function moduleOf(name)
      local sys = RSA:FindFirstChild("Systems")
      local ply = sys and sys:FindFirstChild("Player")
      local gam = ply and ply:FindFirstChild("Game")
      local mgFolder = gam and gam:FindFirstChild("Minigames")
      if not mgFolder then
        pcall(function()
          mgFolder = RSA:WaitForChild("Systems", 5):WaitForChild("Player", 5):WaitForChild("Game", 5):WaitForChild("Minigames", 5)
        end)
      end
      local m = mgFolder and (mgFolder:FindFirstChild(name) or mgFolder:WaitForChild(name, 5))
      if not m then return nil end
      local okR, mm = pcall(require, m)
      if okR and type(mm) == "table" then return mm end
      return nil
    end
    local function classValues(mm)
      if type(mm) ~= "table" then return nil end
      for k in pairs(mm) do
        if tostring(k):find("ClassValues") then
          local cls = mm[k]
          if type(cls) == "table" and type(cls.Start) == "function" then return cls end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local origStarts = {}
    local function hookStart(cls, onSession)
      local cur = cls.Start
      if not origStarts[cls] then origStarts[cls] = cur end
      cls.Start = function(...)
        local a = { ... }
        local rets = { cur(table.unpack(a)) }
        for _, v in ipairs(a) do
          if type(v) == "table" and (type(v.Network) == "table" or v.__input ~= nil or v.__renderer ~= nil) then
            local ses = v
            task.spawn(function()
              active[ses] = true
              pcall(onSession, ses)
              active[ses] = nil
            end)
            break
          end
        end
        return table.unpack(rets)
      end
    end
    mod.restoreHooks = function()
      for cls, orig in pairs(origStarts) do
        pcall(function() cls.Start = orig end)
      end
      origStarts = {}
    end
    do -- FLOW: tự giải n-1 cặp (BFS gọn + DFS dự bị) — owner kéo cú chốt
      local cls = classValues(moduleOf("FlowClientMinigame"))
      if cls then hookStart(cls, function(ses)
        if not mod.flow.on then return end
        local b, inp, rd
        for _ = 1, 28 do
          inp = ses.__input
          rd = ses.__renderer
          b = inp and inp.Board
          if b and rd and not inp.Ended
            and type(b.Size) == "number" and b.Size > 0
            and type(b.Pairs) == "table" and next(b.Pairs) ~= nil
            and type(b.Paths) == "table" and type(b.Position) == "table" then
            break
          end
          task.wait(0.25)
        end
        if not (b and rd and inp and not inp.Ended and type(b.Pairs) == "table" and next(b.Pairs) ~= nil) then return end
        local solveStartT = os.clock()
        task.wait(0.45)
        if inp.Ended or not mod.flow.on then return end
        local s = b.Size
        local function rc(c) return math.ceil(c / s), (c - 1) % s + 1 end
        local function pairDist(i)
          local pr = b.Pairs[i]
          if type(pr) ~= "table" then return 999 end
          return math.abs(math.ceil(pr[1] / s) - math.ceil(pr[2] / s)) + math.abs((pr[1] - 1) % s - (pr[2] - 1) % s)
        end
        local maxI = 0
        for i in pairs(b.Pairs) do
          if i > maxI then maxI = i end
        end
        for i = 1, maxI do
          if type(b.Paths[i]) ~= "table" then b.Paths[i] = {} end
        end
        local endpointOwner = {}
        for i, pr in pairs(b.Pairs) do
          if type(pr) == "table" and pr[1] and pr[2] then
            endpointOwner[pr[1]] = i
            endpointOwner[pr[2]] = i
          end
        end
        local tran, co = {}, {}
        for i, pr in pairs(b.Pairs) do
          if type(pr) == "table" and pr[1] and pr[2] then
            local pp = b.Paths[i]
            if type(pp) == "table" and #pp >= 2 and pp[1] == pr[1] and pp[#pp] == pr[2] then
              co[#co + 1] = i
            else
              tran[#tran + 1] = i
            end
          end
        end
        table.sort(tran)
        if #tran == 0 then return end
        local bestI, bestD
        for _, i in ipairs(tran) do
          local d = pairDist(i)
          if not bestD or d < bestD then
            bestD, bestI = d, i
          end
        end
        local function mutatePath(i2, pts)
          local tgt = b.Paths[i2]
          if type(tgt) ~= "table" then
            tgt = {}
            b.Paths[i2] = tgt
          end
          for j = #tgt, 1, -1 do
            tgt[j] = nil
          end
          for j, v in ipairs(pts) do
            tgt[j] = v
          end
        end
        for _, i in ipairs(tran) do
          local oldP = b.Paths[i]
          if type(oldP) == "table" then
            for _, cc in ipairs(oldP) do
              b.Position[cc] = nil
              if type(b.Owner) == "table" then b.Owner[cc] = nil end
            end
          end
          mutatePath(i, {})
        end
        for cc, ow in pairs(b.Owner or {}) do
          local isDone = false
          for _, ci in ipairs(co) do
            if ci == ow then isDone = true break end
          end
          if not isDone then
            b.Owner[cc] = nil
            b.Position[cc] = nil
          end
        end
        local used = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(co) do
          local pp = b.Paths[i]
          if type(pp) == "table" then
            for _, cc in ipairs(pp) do
              used[cc] = true
            end
          end
        end
        local prs = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(tran) do
          if i ~= bestI then prs[#prs + 1] = i end
        end
        table.sort(prs, function(iA, iB)
          local dA, dB = pairDist(iA), pairDist(iB)
          if dA ~= dB then return dA < dB end
          return iA < iB
        end)
        local solveOrder = table.clone(prs)
        solveOrder[#solveOrder + 1] = bestI
        local nbrCache = {}
        for c = 1, s * s do
          local r, co2 = rc(c)
          local t = {}
          if r > 1 then t[#t + 1] = c - s end
          if r < s then t[#t + 1] = c + s end
          if co2 > 1 then t[#t + 1] = c - 1 end
          if co2 < s then t[#t + 1] = c + 1 end
          nbrCache[c] = t
        end
        local function canStep(nx, i2)
          return (not used[nx]) and (endpointOwner[nx] == nil or endpointOwner[nx] == i2)
        end
        local function reachable(a2, z2, i2)
          if a2 == z2 then return true end
          local seen = { [a2] = true }
          local q = { a2 }
          local head = 1
          while head <= #q do
            local cur = q[head]
            head += 1
            for _, nx in ipairs(nbrCache[cur]) do
              if not seen[nx] and canStep(nx, i2) then
                if nx == z2 then return true end
                seen[nx] = true
                q[#q + 1] = nx
              end
            end
          end
          return false
        end
        local function allRemainingReachable(fromK)
          for k2 = fromK, #solveOrder do
            local idx2 = solveOrder[k2]
            local p2 = b.Pairs[idx2]
            if not reachable(p2[1], p2[2], idx2) then
              return false
            end
          end
          return true
        end
        local function commit(i2, snap)
          mutatePath(i2, snap)
          for j, cc in ipairs(snap) do
            used[cc] = true
            b.Position[cc] = j
            if type(b.Owner) == "table" then b.Owner[cc] = i2 end
          end
        end
        local function uncommit(i2, snap)
          mutatePath(i2, {})
          for _, cc in ipairs(snap) do
            used[cc] = nil
            b.Position[cc] = nil
            if type(b.Owner) == "table" then b.Owner[cc] = nil end
          end
        end
        local success = false
        local nodes = 0
        local allowSelfTouch = false
        local function isChordless(nx, cur, z2, onp)
          if allowSelfTouch or nx == z2 then return true end
          for _, nb in ipairs(nbrCache[nx]) do
            if nb ~= cur and onp[nb] then
              return false
            end
          end
          return true
        end
        local function bt(k)
          if success then return end
          if k > #solveOrder then success = true return end
          local i2 = solveOrder[k]
          local pr = b.Pairs[i2]
          local a2, z2 = pr[1], pr[2]
          local bpath
          do
            local prev = { [a2] = 0 }
            local q = { a2 }
            local head = 1
            while head <= #q and not prev[z2] do
              local cur = q[head]
              head += 1
              for _, nx in ipairs(nbrCache[cur]) do
                if not prev[nx] and canStep(nx, i2) then
                  prev[nx] = cur
                  q[#q + 1] = nx
                end
              end
            end
            if prev[z2] then
              local rev = {}
              local cur = z2
              while cur ~= 0 do
                rev[#rev + 1] = cur
                cur = prev[cur]
              end
              bpath = {}
              for j = #rev, 1, -1 do bpath[j] = rev[#rev - j + 1] end
            end
          end
          if bpath then
            commit(i2, bpath)
            if allRemainingReachable(k + 1) then
              bt(k + 1)
            end
            if not success then
              uncommit(i2, bpath)
            end
          end
          if success then return end
          local rz, cz = rc(z2)
          local onp = { [a2] = true }
          local cells = { a2 }
          local function cmpNbr(p, q)
            local rp, cp = rc(p)
            local rq, cq = rc(q)
            return (math.abs(rp - rz) + math.abs(cp - cz)) < (math.abs(rq - rz) + math.abs(cq - cz))
          end
          local function dfs(c)
            nodes += 1
            if nodes > 45000 or success or inp.Ended or not mod.flow.on then return end
            if nodes % 600 == 0 then
              task.wait()
              if inp.Ended or not mod.flow.on then return end
            end
            if c == z2 then
              local snap = table.clone(cells)
              commit(i2, snap)
              if allRemainingReachable(k + 1) then
                bt(k + 1)
              end
              if not success then
                uncommit(i2, snap)
              end
              return
            end
            local nbrs = table.clone(nbrCache[c])
            table.sort(nbrs, cmpNbr)
            for _, nx in ipairs(nbrs) do
              if not onp[nx] and canStep(nx, i2) and isChordless(nx, c, z2, onp) then
                onp[nx] = true
                cells[#cells + 1] = nx
                dfs(nx)
                cells[#cells] = nil
                onp[nx] = nil
                if nodes > 45000 or success or inp.Ended or not mod.flow.on then return end
              end
            end
          end
          dfs(a2)
          return success
        end
        bt(1)
        if not success and not inp.Ended and mod.flow.on then
          nodes = 0
          allowSelfTouch = true
          bt(1)
        end
        if not success then
          return
        end
        local solvedSnap = {}
        for _, idx in ipairs(solveOrder) do
          solvedSnap[idx] = table.clone(b.Paths[idx] or {})
          uncommit(idx, solvedSnap[idx])
        end
        if type(b.__rebuild) == "function" then pcall(function() return b:__rebuild() end) end
        if type(rd) == "table" and type(rd.Render) == "function" then
          pcall(function() return rd:Render() end)
        end
        local lo = math.clamp(math.min(tonumber(mod.flowMin) or 2.0, tonumber(mod.flowMax) or 5.0), 1.0, 10.0)
        local hi = math.clamp(math.max(tonumber(mod.flowMin) or 2.0, tonumber(mod.flowMax) or 5.0), 1.0, 10.0)
        local totalWait = lo + math.random() * (hi - lo)
        local remWait = math.max(0.15, totalWait - (os.clock() - solveStartT))
        local stepWait = math.max(0.05, remWait / math.max(1, #solveOrder))
        for k, idx in ipairs(solveOrder) do
          task.wait(stepWait)
          if not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED or inp.Ended or not mod.flow.on then return end
          local snap = solvedSnap[idx]
          if k == #solveOrder then
            inp.Dragging = nil
            for _, i2 in ipairs(solveOrder) do
              local oldP = b.Paths[i2]
              if type(oldP) == "table" then
                for _, cc in ipairs(oldP) do
                  b.Position[cc] = nil
                  if type(b.Owner) == "table" then b.Owner[cc] = nil end
                end
              end
              mutatePath(i2, {})
            end
            for cc, ow in pairs(b.Owner or {}) do
              local keep = false
              for _, ci in ipairs(co) do
                if ci == ow then keep = true break end
              end
              if not keep then
                b.Owner[cc] = nil
                b.Position[cc] = nil
              end
            end
            for _, i2 in ipairs(solveOrder) do
              commit(i2, solvedSnap[i2])
            end
          else
            commit(idx, snap)
          end
          if type(b.__rebuild) == "function" then pcall(function() return b:__rebuild() end) end
          if type(rd) == "table" and type(rd.Render) == "function" then
            pcall(function() return rd:Render() end)
          end
          if type(rd) == "table" and type(rd.Pulse) == "function" and type(snap) == "table" and snap[#snap] then
            pcall(function() rd:Pulse(snap[#snap]) end)
          end
        end
        if not inp.Ended and mod.flow.on and type(b.IsSolved) == "function" and b:IsSolved() then
          task.wait(0.08)
          if not inp.Ended and mod.flow.on and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED then
            if type(inp.__finish) == "function" then pcall(function() inp:__finish() end) end
            local cb = inp.Callbacks
            if type(cb) == "table" and type(cb.OnSolved) == "function" then
              pcall(cb.OnSolved)
            end
          end
        end
      end) end
    end
    do -- LOCK: bấm sớm mép đầu Target theo LockBoard:AngleAt(ServerTimeNow)
      local cls = classValues(moduleOf("LockClientMinigame"))
      if cls then hookStart(cls, function(ses)
        if not mod.lock.on then return end
        local inp, rd
        for _ = 1, 40 do
          inp = ses.__input
          rd = ses.__renderer
          if inp and rd and not inp.Ended then break end
          task.wait(0.05)
        end
        if not (inp and rd and not inp.Ended) then return end
        local b = rd.Board
        local circle = rd.Circle
        if type(b) ~= "table" or typeof(circle) ~= "Instance" then return end
        local line = circle:FindFirstChild("Line")
        if not line then return end
        local cb = inp.Callbacks
        if type(cb) ~= "table" or type(cb.OnPress) ~= "function" then return end
        local startTime = tonumber(b.Config and b.Config.StartTime) or 0
        local waitT0 = os.clock()
        while mod.lock.on and not inp.Ended and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and (os.clock() - waitT0) < 3.0 do
          if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= startTime + 0.02 then break end
          RunA.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if inp.Ended or not mod.lock.on or not __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE or _G.__NERG_KILLED then return end
        local hasAngleAt = (type(b.AngleAt) == "function")
        local hasIsOnTarget = (type(b.IsOnTarget) == "function")
        local guard = 0
        while mod.lock.on and not inp.Ended and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED and guard < 30 do
          guard += 1
          local st = b.State
          local remaining = tonumber(st and st.Remaining) or 0
          if remaining <= 0 or rd.__broken then break end
          local target = tonumber(st.Target)
          if not target then
            RunA.Heartbeat:Wait()
            continue
          end
          local cfg = b.Config
          local half = (tonumber(cfg and cfg.TargetSize) or 45) * 0.5
          local hitThreshold = math.max(4, half * 0.88)
          local t0 = os.clock()
          local prevOff, prevRot = nil, nil
          local fired, offAtFire = false, nil
          while os.clock() - t0 < 12 and mod.lock.on and not inp.Ended and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
            if tonumber(st.Target) ~= target or (tonumber(st.Remaining) or 0) <= 0 or rd.__broken then
              fired = true
              break
            end
            local nowSrv = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            local okAng, srvAng = false, nil
            if hasAngleAt then
              okAng, srvAng = pcall(b.AngleAt, b, nowSrv)
            end
            local rot = (okAng and type(srvAng) == "number") and srvAng or line.Rotation
            local off = (rot - target + 180) % 360 - 180
            local dist = math.abs(off)
            local crossed = false
            if prevOff and prevRot then
              local dd = (rot - prevRot + 180) % 360 - 180
              if dd > 0 then
                crossed = (prevOff < 0 and off >= 0)
              elseif dd < 0 then
                crossed = (prevOff > 0 and off <= 0)
              end
            end
            if dist <= hitThreshold or crossed then
              local onTgt = true
              if hasIsOnTarget then
                local okT, resT = pcall(b.IsOnTarget, b, rot)
                if okT then onTgt = (resT == true) end
              end
              if onTgt then
                offAtFire = off
                pcall(function() return cb.OnPress() end)
                fired = true
                break
              end
            end
            prevOff, prevRot = off, rot
            RunA.Heartbeat:Wait()
          end
          if not fired then
            break
          end
          if offAtFire ~= nil then
            logL[#logL + 1] = { sp = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Speed), sz = tonumber(cfg and cfg.TargetSize), off = offAtFire }
            if #logL > 200 then table.remove(logL, 1) end
          end
          local postT0 = os.clock()
          repeat
            RunA.Heartbeat:Wait()
          until inp.Ended or not mod.lock.on or (tonumber(st.Remaining) or 0) < remaining or tonumber(st.Target) ~= target or (os.clock() - postT0) >= 0.05
        end
      end) end
    end
    do -- CONNECT: nối đúng Mates qua __begin/__release (input thật) — nhịp paced()
      local cls = classValues(moduleOf("ConnectClientMinigame"))
      if cls then hookStart(cls, function(ses)
        if not mod.conn.on then return end
        local inp, rd
        for _ = 1, 16 do
          inp = ses.__input
          rd = ses.__renderer
          if inp and rd and not inp.Ended and type(inp.Board) == "table"
            and type(inp.Board.Mates) == "table" and next(inp.Board.Mates) ~= nil
            and type(rd.Blobs) == "table" then
            break
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
        end
        if not (inp and rd and not inp.Ended) then return end
        task.wait(0.5)
        if inp.Ended or not mod.conn.on then return end
        local board = inp.Board
        local function ctr(i)
          local f = rd.Blobs[i]
          if typeof(f) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
          local go = f :: any
          return Vector2.new(go.AbsolutePosition.X + go.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, go.AbsolutePosition.Y + go.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2)
        end
        local guard = 0
        while mod.conn.on and not inp.Ended and guard < 12 do
          guard += 1
          local links = board.Links
          local pending = nil
          for i, mate in pairs(board.Mates) do
            i = tonumber(i)
            mate = tonumber(mate)
            if i and mate and links[tonumber(i)] == nil then
              pending = { i, mate }
              break
            end
          end
          if not pending then break end
          local c1, c2 = ctr(pending[1]), ctr(pending[2])
          if c1 and c2 then
            inp:__begin(pending[1], c1)
            inp:__release(c2)
            hlogC[#hlogC + 1] = { a = pending[1], b = pending[2] }
            if #hlogC > 60 then table.remove(hlogC, 1) end
          end
          task.wait(paced())
        end
        task.wait(0.4)
      end) end
    end
    do -- GEAR solver + tracker: đánh dấu activeSessions (ESP hạ 3s) & tự động xoay bánh răng khi bật Gear Solver
      local cls = classValues(moduleOf("GearClientMinigame"))
      if cls then hookStart(cls, function(ses)
        local inp, rd = ses.__input, ses.__renderer
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while (inp == nil or rd == nil) and os.clock() - t0 < 8 and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
          task.wait(0.2)
          inp = ses.__input
          rd = ses.__renderer
        end
        while inp and inp.Ended == false and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
          if mod.gearSolve.on and rd and rd.__flying ~= nil and rd.__flight == nil and not rd.__isSpinning then
            task.wait(0.05)
            local cb = inp.Callbacks
            local onTurn = type(cb) == "table" and cb.OnTurn
            while mod.gearSolve.on and not inp.Ended and rd.__flying ~= nil and rd.__flight == nil and not rd.__isSpinning and __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
              local dt = RunA.Heartbeat:Wait()
              if not (mod.gearSolve.on and not inp.Ended and not rd.__isSpinning) then break end
              local stepDeg = math.clamp((dt or 0.016) * 1080, 18, 65)
              if type(onTurn) == "function" then
                pcall(onTurn, stepDeg)
              end
            end
          else
            task.wait(0.15)
          end
        end
      end) end
    end
    local espFolder, espConn, hlPool, bbPool, boxPool, slotUsed, tracked = nil, nil, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local gearPool, gearIng, gearAddConn, gearRemConn = {}, nil, nil, nil
    local MAXD, CAP = 200, 8
    local accA743 = 0
    local idleG = 0
    local function espClean()
      for _, e in pairs(tracked) do
        if e.hl then e.hl.Enabled = false e.hl.Adornee = nil end
        if e.bb then e.bb.Enabled = false e.bb.Adornee = nil end
        if e.box then e.box.Visible = false e.box.Adornee = nil end
        if e.slot then slotUsed[e.slot] = nil end
        if e.ghl and e.ghl.Parent then pcall(function() e.ghl.Enabled = true end) end
        e.hl, e.bb, e.box, e.slot, e.ghl = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
      end
      table.clear(tracked)
      table.clear(slotUsed)
    end
    local function allocSlot()
      for s = 1, CAP do
        if not slotUsed[s] then
          slotUsed[s] = true
          return s
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function espBuild()
      if espFolder and espFolder.Parent then return end
      espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
      espFolder.Name = "NergPlus_A743_GearESP"
      espFolder.Parent = workspace
      for i = 1, CAP do
        local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        box.Name = "NergPlus_A743_GearBox"
        box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 0)
        box.Transparency = 0.35
        box.AlwaysOnTop = true
        box.ZIndex = 8
        box.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
        box.Visible = false
        box.Parent = espFolder
        boxPool[i] = box
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "NergPlus_A743_GearTag"
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 22)
        bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Enabled = false
        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tl.Name = "TextLabel"
        tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tl.TextScaled = true
        tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
        tl.Text = "Gear"
        tl.Parent = bb
        bb.Parent = espFolder
        bbPool[i] = bb
      end
    end
    local gearTick = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
      for ses in pairs(active) do
        local i2 = ses.__input
        if not i2 or i2.Ended ~= false then active[ses] = nil end
      end
      local interval = (mod.gear.on and next(active) ~= nil) and 3 or 1
      accA743 = accA743 + dt
      if accA743 < interval then return end
      accA743 = 0
      if not mod.gear.on then
        if mod.gearStop then pcall(mod.gearStop) end
        return
      end
      idleG = 0
      espBuild()
      local chr = LPA.Character
      local hrp = chr and chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not hrp then
        espClean()
        return
      end
      local seen = {}
      local mapInst = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local ing = mapInst and mapInst:FindFirstChild("Ingame")
      if not ing then
        if gearIng then
          gearIng = nil
          table.clear(gearPool)
          if gearAddConn then pcall(function() gearAddConn:Disconnect() end) gearAddConn = nil end
          if gearRemConn then pcall(function() gearRemConn:Disconnect() end) gearRemConn = nil end
        end
        espClean()
        return
      end
      if ing ~= gearIng then
        gearIng = ing
        table.clear(gearPool)
        espClean()
        if gearAddConn then pcall(function() gearAddConn:Disconnect() end) gearAddConn = nil end
        if gearRemConn then pcall(function() gearRemConn:Disconnect() end) gearRemConn = nil end
        for _, d0 in ipairs(ing:GetDescendants()) do
          if d0:IsA("Model") and d0.Name == "Gear" then gearPool[d0] = true end
        end
        gearAddConn = ing.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d0)
          if d0:IsA("Model") and d0.Name == "Gear" then gearPool[d0] = true end
        end)
        gearRemConn = ing.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d0)
          gearPool[d0] = nil
        end)
      end
      for d, isCand in pairs(gearPool) do
        if not (d.Parent and d:IsDescendantOf(ing)) then
          gearPool[d] = nil
        elseif isCand == true and d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == "Gear" then
          local realG = (d:GetAttribute("__NP_REAL_GEAR") == true)
          local ghl = d:FindFirstChild("GearHighlight")
          if ghl then
            realG = true
          elseif not realG then
            local prompt = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
            if prompt then
              local act = tostring(prompt.ActionText):lower()
              local obj = tostring(prompt.ObjectText):lower()
              if act:find("pick") or act:find("take") or act:find("grab") or act:find("collect")
                 or act:find("gear") or obj:find("gear") then
                realG = true
              end
            end
          end
          if realG then
            if d:GetAttribute("__NP_REAL_GEAR") ~= true then
              pcall(function() d:SetAttribute("__NP_REAL_GEAR", true) end)
            end
            local bp = (ghl and ghl.Parent and ghl.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and ghl.Parent)
              or d.PrimaryPart
              or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if bp and bp.Size.Magnitude <= 25 then
              local ok, pv = pcall(function() return bp.Position end)
              if ok and pv then
                local kc = (hrp.Position - pv).Magnitude
                if kc <= (tracked[d] and MAXD or 185) then
                  local entry = tracked[d]
                  if not entry then
                    local s = allocSlot()
                    if s then
                      entry = { slot = s, hl = hlPool[s], bb = bbPool[s], box = boxPool[s], dist = kc, ghl = ghl }
                      tracked[d] = entry
                    end
                  else
                    entry.dist = kc
                    entry.ghl = ghl or entry.ghl
                  end
                  if entry then
                    seen[d] = true
                    if entry.hl then
                      entry.hl.Enabled = false
                      entry.hl.Adornee = nil
                    end
                    entry.box.Adornee = bp
                    entry.box.Size = bp.Size + Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
                    entry.box.Visible = true
                    entry.bb.Adornee = bp
                    entry.bb.Enabled = true
                    entry.bb.TextLabel.Text = string.format("Gear [%dm]", math.floor(kc + 0.5))
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          else
            gearPool[d] = false
          end
        end
      end
      for d, entry in pairs(tracked) do
        if seen[d] and d.Parent and d:IsDescendantOf(ing) then
          entry.miss = 0
        else
          entry.miss = (entry.miss or 0) + 1
          if not (d.Parent and d:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or entry.miss >= 2 then
            if entry.hl then entry.hl.Enabled = false entry.hl.Adornee = nil end
            if entry.bb then entry.bb.Enabled = false entry.bb.Adornee = nil end
            if entry.box then entry.box.Visible = false entry.box.Adornee = nil end
            if entry.slot then slotUsed[entry.slot] = nil end
            tracked[d] = nil
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    function mod.gearStart()
      if mod.gear.on then return end
      mod.gear.on = true
      espBuild()
      if not espConn then
        espConn = RunA.Heartbeat:Connect(gearTick)
      end
    end
    function mod.gearStop()
      mod.gear.on = false
      if espConn then pcall(function() espConn:Disconnect() end) espConn = nil end
      if gearAddConn then pcall(function() gearAddConn:Disconnect() end) gearAddConn = nil end
      if gearRemConn then pcall(function() gearRemConn:Disconnect() end) gearRemConn = nil end
      gearIng = nil
      table.clear(gearPool)
      espClean()
      if espFolder then pcall(function() espFolder:Destroy() end) espFolder = nil table.clear(hlPool) table.clear(bbPool) table.clear(boxPool) end
    end
    return mod
  end)
  if okA743 and type(modA743) == "table" then genA743 = modA743 end
end

local abKeybind = tostring(v2.get("guestAutoBlockKeybind", "None") or "None")
local function readAbKeybindStr()
  local kb = CFG_UI["ABKey"]
  local kv = kb and rawget(kb, "Value")
  if typeof(kv) == "EnumItem" then
    return kv.Name
  elseif type(kv) == "string" and kv ~= "" then
    return kv
  end
  return abKeybind
end
local function applyAbKeybindStr(v)
  local ks = (typeof(v) == "EnumItem" and v.Name) or (type(v) == "table" and tostring(v[1] or "None")) or tostring(v or "None")
  if ks == "" or ks == "Unknown" then ks = "None" end
  abKeybind = ks
  v2.set("guestAutoBlockKeybind", ks)
  local kb = CFG_UI["ABKey"]
  if kb and kb.SetValue then
    pcall(function() kb:SetValue({ ks, "Toggle" }) end)
  end
end

CFG_UI["ABKey"] = CFG_UI["AutoBlock"]:AddKeyPicker("ABKey", {
  Text = "Toggle Auto Block Keybind",

  end

  syncModeLabel()

    Text = "3D Hitbox Preview",
    Default = a742pPreviewOn,
    Callback = function(v)
      if uiBoot then return end
      a742pPreviewOn = v
      v2.set("a742pPreviewOn", v)
      if a742pSetPreview then pcall(a742pSetPreview, v) end
    end,
  })
  if a742pPreviewGui then
    local okPass = pcall(function()
      if type(hbPrevSection.AddUIPassthrough) == "function" then
        hbPrevSection:AddUIPassthrough("ABEmbeddedPreview", {
          Instance = a742pPreviewGui,
          Height = 236,
          Visible = true,
        })
      else
        error("fallback")
      end
    end)
    if not okPass then
      pcall(function()
        a742pPreviewGui.Parent = hbPrevSection.Container or hbPrevSection
        if hbPrevSection.Resize then hbPrevSection:Resize() end
      end)
    end
  end
  if a742pPreviewGui then
    oceanUI.watch(a742pPreviewGui, function(active)
      if a742pSetPreview then a742pSetPreview(a742pPreviewOn and active) end
    end)
  end
  if a742pPreviewOn and a742pSetPreview then
    task.defer(a742pSetPreview, true)
  end
end

  uiRepaint = function()
    uiBoot = true
    for _, e in ipairs(CFG_REG) do
      local tag = e[6]
      local obj = tag and CFG_UI[tag]
      if obj then
        pcall(function()
          local val = e[3]()
          if tag == "ABKey" then
            local ks = (type(val) == "string" and val ~= "") and val or "None"
            if obj.SetValue then
              obj:SetValue({ ks, "Toggle" })
            end
          elseif (tag == "VisKillerColor" or tag == "VisSurvColor") and obj.SetValueRGB then
            local r, g2, b = tostring(val):match("^(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
            if r then obj:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(r), tonumber(g2), tonumber(b))) end
          elseif (tag == "TagOptions" or tag == "ObjTypes") and type(val) == "table" and obj.SetValue then
            local dict = {}
            if type(obj.Values) == "table" then
              for _, kName in ipairs(obj.Values) do dict[kName] = false end
            end
            for k, v in pairs(val) do
              if type(k) == "number" and type(v) == "string" then dict[v] = true
              elseif v == true and type(k) == "string" then dict[k] = true end
            end
            obj:SetValue(dict)
          elseif obj.SetValue then
            if (obj.Min ~= nil and obj.Max ~= nil) or tag == "GenPace" or tag == "GenJit" then
              val = tonumber(val) or val
            end
            obj:SetValue(val)
          elseif obj.Set then
            obj:Set(val)
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    if ESP_SET and ESP_SET.refreshPreview then pcall(ESP_SET.refreshPreview) end
    if _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG and _G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.refreshPose then pcall(_G.__NERG_BLK_LOG.refreshPose) end
    task.delay(0.25, function()
      uiBoot = false
    end)
  end
  pcall(function()
    if type(v2._data) == "table" and next(v2._data) ~= nil then
      if v2._data["a742pHitboxMode"] ~= nil and v2._data["blockDetectMode"] == nil then
        v2._data["blockDetectMode"] = v2._data["a742pHitboxMode"] and "Hitbox" or "Cone"
      end
      if v2._data["a742oAnimM1"] ~= nil and v2._data["blockM1Detect"] == nil then
        v2._data["blockM1Detect"] = v2._data["a742oAnimM1"] and "Animation" or "Sound"
      end
      for _, e in ipairs(CFG_REG) do
        local savedVal = v2._data[e[2]]
        if savedVal ~= nil then
          pcall(e[4], savedVal)
        end
      end
      pcall(uiRepaint)
    end
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
    while __PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED do
      task.wait(1.0)
      if not (__PLUS_GEN_ALIVE and not _G.__NERG_KILLED) then break end
      if not uiBoot then
        local dirty = false
        for _, e in ipairs(CFG_REG) do
          local okV, curVal = pcall(e[3])
          if okV and curVal ~= nil then
            local k = e[2]
            local oldVal = v2._data[k]
            if type(curVal) == "table" then
              local ok1, j1 = pcall(function() return httpService:JSONEncode(curVal) end)
              local ok2, j2 = pcall(function() return type(oldVal) == "table" and httpService:JSONEncode(oldVal) or "" end)
              if ok1 and (not ok2 or j1 ~= j2) then
                v2._data[k] = curVal
                dirty = true
              end
            elseif oldVal ~= curVal then
              v2._data[k] = curVal
              dirty = true
            end
          end
        end
        if dirty then
          v2.save()
        end
      end
    end
  end)

    if not okJ or not s then cfgNotify("generate failed (JSON)") return end
    local b = (base64_encode and base64_encode(s)) or (crypt and crypt.base64_encode and crypt.base64_encode(s)) or (crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.encode and crypt.base64.encode(s))
    local code = "VP1|" .. (b or s)
    local setcb = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard

    cfgNotify("copied config code (" .. #CFG_REG .. " keys) — stash it somewhere safe")
  end }) end)
